articles.title_zh: 非均匀流体的熵泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28240v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an exact variational scheme for the physics of inhomogeneous classical fluids in thermal equilibrium. A joint metadensity minimization principle is proven for the one-body density and the global interparticle distance distribution. The theory bypasses the inhomogeneous two-body density and thus remains computationally simple. A universal excess entropy functional accounts for all many-body correlations in arbitrary pairwise interacting systems. The framework is relevant for neural functional machine learning, for soft matter design, and for predicting hyperobservables, structural correlation functions, and first-principles mechanisms of entropy-energy competition.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了热平衡中非均匀经典流体物理的精确变分方案。对于单体密度和全局粒子间距离分布，证明了联合元密度最小化原理。该理论绕过了不均匀的二体密度，因此计算起来仍然简单。通用过剩熵函数可以解释任意成对相互作用系统中的所有多体相关性。该框架与神经功能机器学习、软物质设计以及预测超可观测量、结构相关函数和熵-能量竞争的第一原理机制相关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了热平衡中非均匀经典流体物理的精确变分方案。对于单体密度和全局粒子间距离分布，证明了联合元密度最小化原理。该理论绕过了不均匀的二体密度，因此计算起来仍然简单。通用过剩熵函数可以解释任意成对相互作用系统中的所有多体相关性。该框架与神经功能机器学习、软物质设计以及预测超可观测量、结构相关函数和熵-能量竞争的第一原理机制相关。

articles.title: Entropy functional universality: Correlation, response, many-body interaction, multi-component, quantum, hyperfunctional, and Ornstein-Zernike structure
articles.title_zh: 熵泛函的普遍性：相关性、响应、多体相互作用、多组分、量子、超功能和 Ornstein-Zernike 结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03032v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We give a comprehensive account of the recent entropy functional theory for the equilibrium statistical mechanics of classical many-body systems (arXiv:2606.28240). The approach is formally exact and based on a joint grand potential minimization principle for the one-body density and the global pair distance distribution. These variational fields depend respectively on position and on scalar distance, which retains the low computational complexity of standard density functional theory. Correlation effects are contained in a unique excess entropy functional, which is universal across all systems with pairwise interparticle potentials. Functional differentiation yields entropic direct correlation functionals that generate entropic response and fluctuation correlation functions via coupled Ornstein-Zernike equations. Two alternative proofs are given for the existence and uniqueness of the underlying metadensity functional map, based on generalizations of either Levy's constrained search method or Mermin-Evans proof by contradiction. Simple excess entropy approximations yield the standard mean-field and second-virial excess free energy density functionals. We describe exact entropic functional line integrals, make connections to the recent one-body fluctuation profiles, and generalize the entropy approach beyond pairwise interparticle potentials via parametric dependence or reduction operators. We also lay out the formulation for multi-component systems, the hyperfunctional for general observables, and the quantum entropy functional.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们全面介绍了经典多体系统平衡统计力学的最新熵泛函理论（arXiv：2606.28240）。该方法在形式上是精确的，并且基于单体密度和全局对距离分布的联合大势最小化原理。这些变分场分别取决于位置和标量距离，这保留了标准密度泛函理论的低计算复杂度。相关效应包含在独特的过剩熵泛函中，该泛函在所有具有成对粒子间势的系统中都是通用的。函数微分产生熵直接相关函数，通过耦合的 Ornstein-Zernike 方程生成熵响应和波动相关函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们全面介绍了经典多体系统平衡统计力学的最新熵泛函理论（arXiv：2606.28240）。该方法在形式上是精确的，并且基于单体密度和全局对距离分布的联合大势最小化原理。这些变分场分别取决于位置和标量距离，这保留了标准密度泛函理论的低计算复杂度。相关效应包含在独特的过剩熵泛函中，该泛函在所有具有成对粒子间势的系统中都是通用的。函数微分产生熵直接相关函数，通过耦合的 Ornstein-Zernike 方程生成熵响应和波动相关函数。基于 Levy 约束搜索方法或 Mermin-Evans 反证法的推广，给出了底层元密度函数图的存在性和唯一性的两个替代证明。简单的过剩熵近似产生标准平均场和第二维里过剩自由能密度泛函。我们描述了精确的熵函数线积分，与最近的单体波动剖面建立了联系，并通过参数依赖或约简算子将熵方法推广到成对粒子间势之外。我们还提出了多组分系统的公式、一般可观测量的超泛函以及量子熵泛函。

articles.title: Radiative spin caloritronics in nonreciprocal many-body systems
articles.title_zh: 非互易多体系统中的辐射自旋热电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22845v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We predict the spin thermal Hall effect in nonreciprocal magneto-optical many-body systems, in which a longitudinal radiative heat current generates a transverse accumulation of the spin angular momentum carried by thermal photons. We show that this effect and the inverse spin thermal Hall effect constitute an Onsager-Casimir reciprocal pair, thereby establishing heat and photon spin as coupled transport channels in nonreciprocal photonic systems. The second law of thermodynamics imposes fundamental bounds on the spin-heat coupling, leading to a thermal-spin figure of merit that quantifies the efficiency of radiative spin-heat conversion. Our results establish a complete thermodynamic framework for photon spin caloritronics and lay the conceptual foundations for spin-controlled thermal radiation and nonreciprocal photonic thermal devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们预测了非互易磁光多体系统中的自旋热霍尔效应，其中纵向辐射热流产生热光子携带的自旋角动量的横向累积。我们证明这种效应和逆自旋热霍尔效应构成了昂萨格-卡西米尔互易对，从而将热和光子自旋建立为非互易光子系统中的耦合传输通道。热力学第二定律对自旋热耦合施加了基本界限，从而产生了热自旋品质因数，该品质因数可量化辐射自旋热转换的效率。我们的研究结果为光子自旋热电子学建立了完整的热力学框架，并为自旋控制热辐射和非互易光子热器件奠定了概念基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们预测了非互易磁光多体系统中的自旋热霍尔效应，其中纵向辐射热流产生热光子携带的自旋角动量的横向累积。我们证明这种效应和逆自旋热霍尔效应构成了昂萨格-卡西米尔互易对，从而将热和光子自旋建立为非互易光子系统中的耦合传输通道。热力学第二定律对自旋热耦合施加了基本界限，从而产生了热自旋品质因数，该品质因数可量化辐射自旋热转换的效率。我们的研究结果为光子自旋热电子学建立了完整的热力学框架，并为自旋控制热辐射和非互易光子热器件奠定了概念基础。

articles.title: Influence of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles on the anisotropy of the dielectric properties of nematic liquid crystal 5CB
articles.title_zh: BaTiO₃纳米粒子对向列液晶5CB介电性能各向异性的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26263v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work is devoted to the mechanisms of dielectric response and electric conductivity of suspensions consisting of the nematic liquid crystal 5CB with different concentrations (from 0 to 10 wt.%) of ferroelectric BaTiO₃ nanoparticles with an average size of 24 nm. We revealed that the incorporation of nanoparticles influences significantly the dielectric permittivity magnitude and anisotropy, as well as dielectric losses of the suspension. A pronounced temperature dependence of the anisotropic dielectric permittivity of the suspensions was found at lower temperatures corresponding to the mesophase state; but it is also present at higher temperatures corresponding to the isophase. The dependence of the mesophase-isophase transition temperature on the concentration of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles appeared nonmonotonic. With increasing temperature, both the capacitance and the electrical resistance of the pure liquid crystal increase, as well as it increases in the suspensions with small concentration of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles. Due to space charge accumulation in the shells of nanoparticles, larger concentrations of BaTiO₃ nanoparticles influence strongly the ionic transport by promoting the formation of ionic-electronic screening. This effect modifies the dielectric properties and conduction mechanisms of the suspension, leading to the nonmonotonic dependence of the mesophase - isophase transition temperature versus the nanoparticle concentration.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作致力于研究由向列液晶 5CB 和不同浓度（0 至 10 wt.%）平均尺寸为 24 nm 的铁电 BaTiO₃ 纳米粒子组成的悬浮液的介电响应和电导率机制。我们发现纳米粒子的加入显着影响悬浮液的介电常数大小和各向异性以及介电损耗。在对应于中间相状态的较低温度下，发现悬浮液的各向异性介电常数具有明显的温度依赖性；但它也存在于与等相相对应的较高温度下。中间相-等相转变温度对 BaTiO₃ 纳米粒子浓度的依赖性表现为非单调。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项工作致力于研究由向列液晶 5CB 和不同浓度（0 至 10 wt.%）平均尺寸为 24 nm 的铁电 BaTiO₃ 纳米粒子组成的悬浮液的介电响应和电导率机制。我们发现纳米粒子的加入显着影响悬浮液的介电常数大小和各向异性以及介电损耗。在对应于中间相状态的较低温度下，发现悬浮液的各向异性介电常数具有明显的温度依赖性；但它也存在于与等相相对应的较高温度下。中间相-等相转变温度对 BaTiO₃ 纳米粒子浓度的依赖性表现为非单调。随着温度的升高，纯液晶的电容和电阻都增加，并且在含有小浓度BaTiO₃纳米颗粒的悬浮液中电容和电阻也增加。由于纳米颗粒壳内空间电荷的积累，较高浓度的 BaTiO₃ 纳米颗粒通过促进离子电子屏蔽的形成，强烈影响离子传输。这种效应改变了悬浮液的介电特性和传导机制，导致中间相-等相转变温度与纳米颗粒浓度的非单调依赖性。

articles.title: Mismatch between Raman shear modes and ferroelectric polarization in 3R-MoS₂
articles.title_zh: 3R-MoS2 中拉曼剪切模式与铁电极化之间的不匹配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11988v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Sliding ferroelectricity in parallel-stacked two-dimensional van der Waals materials enables a broad range of novel device concepts, but exploiting it requires reliable, non-destructive assignment of the underlying stacking order and polarization state. Here, we combine Kelvin-probe force microscopy (KPFM) with low-frequency Raman spectroscopy to probe the polarization domains and stacking configurations of a exfoliated trilayer 3R-MoS₂ flake on a hBN substrate. We find that ABA and BAB - both stackings with zero net polarization - are indistinguishable in KPFM, yet show drastically different low-frequency shear modes. This observation is reproduced across multiple flakes and is corroborated by low-temperature photoluminescence. Notably, the standard bond-polarizability model does not account for the difference in shear-mode activity between the ABA and BAB configurations, indicating that the interlayer Raman response of these stackings is governed by physics beyond a simple polarizability picture. Our results show that none of the here-used individual techniques alone is sufficient to assign sliding-ferroelectric stacking order and motivate a combined spectroscopic-scanning-probe approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 平行堆叠二维范德华材料中的滑动铁电性使得各种新颖的器件概念成为可能，但利用它需要对底层堆叠顺序和极化状态进行可靠、非破坏性的分配。在这里，我们将开尔文探针力显微镜 (KPFM) 与低频拉曼光谱相结合，探测 hBN 基底上剥离的三层 3R-MoS2 薄片的偏振域和堆叠结构。我们发现 ABA 和 BAB（两者均具有零净偏振的叠加）在 KPFM 中无法区分，但表现出截然不同的低频剪切模式。这一观察结果在多个薄片上得到再现，并通过低温光致发光得到证实。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平行堆叠二维范德华材料中的滑动铁电性使得各种新颖的器件概念成为可能，但利用它需要对底层堆叠顺序和极化状态进行可靠、非破坏性的分配。在这里，我们将开尔文探针力显微镜 (KPFM) 与低频拉曼光谱相结合，探测 hBN 基底上剥离的三层 3R-MoS2 薄片的偏振域和堆叠结构。我们发现 ABA 和 BAB（两者均具有零净偏振的叠加）在 KPFM 中无法区分，但表现出截然不同的低频剪切模式。这一观察结果在多个薄片上得到再现，并通过低温光致发光得到证实。值得注意的是，标准键极化率模型没有考虑 ABA 和 BAB 配置之间剪切模式活性的差异，这表明这些堆叠的层间拉曼响应受物理控制，超出了简单的极化率图。我们的结果表明，这里使用的单独技术都不足以分配滑动铁电堆叠顺序并激发组合的光谱扫描探针方法。

articles.title: Crystal-structure design by agentic AI in a language of motifs
articles.title_zh: 代理人工智能以图案语言进行晶体结构设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.15900v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Data-driven materials discovery interpolates more reliably than it extrapolates and seldom reveals new structure types. We present MatEvolve, an agentic-AI framework that designs crystals in an interpretable emphlanguage of motifs, in which each crystal is written as a emphmotif profile that describes the recurring geometric patterns---the emphmotifs---composing the crystal. The motif profile serves not merely as a description of a material but as the medium for material design: the agent edits the profile with a stated rationale and constructs a crystal from the modified one; the most promising candidates are then validated by first-principles calculations. MatEvolve is built on the state-of-the-art language model Claude Fable~5 without fine-tuning. It is applied to the design of rare-earth-lean permanent-magnet compounds and finds novel (meta)stable crystals that are both new structural prototypes and magnet compounds; under an equal validation budget, it does so an order of magnitude more often than generative models. Beyond design, analyzing the human-readable profiles of the discovered crystals reveals their structure--property relationships.
articles.abstract_zh: 数据驱动的材料发现插值比推断更可靠，并且很少揭示新的结构类型。我们提出了 MatEvolve，一个代理 AI 框架，它以可解释的主题语言设计晶体，其中每个晶体都被编写为一个 emphmotif 配置文件，描述了组成晶体的重复几何图案（emphmotif）。主题轮廓不仅可以作为材料的描述，而且可以作为材料设计的媒介：代理以规定的理由编辑轮廓，并根据修改后的轮廓构造出晶体；然后通过第一性原理计算来验证最有希望的候选者。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数据驱动的材料发现插值比推断更可靠，并且很少揭示新的结构类型。我们提出了 MatEvolve，一个代理 AI 框架，它以可解释的主题语言设计晶体，其中每个晶体都被编写为一个 emphmotif 配置文件，描述了组成晶体的重复几何图案（emphmotif）。主题轮廓不仅可以作为材料的描述，而且可以作为材料设计的媒介：代理以规定的理由编辑轮廓，并根据修改后的轮廓构造出晶体；然后通过第一性原理计算来验证最有希望的候选者。 MatEvolve 建立在最先进的语言模型 Claude Fable~5 之上，无需进行微调。它应用于贫稀土永磁化合物的设计，并发现新颖的（亚）稳定晶体，这些晶体既是新的结构原型，又是磁体化合物；在相同的验证预算下，它的频率比生成模型高一个数量级。除了设计之外，分析所发现的晶体的人类可读的轮廓揭示了它们的结构-性质关系。

articles.title: JANUS: A Multi-modal Foundation Neural Sampler for Disordered Materials
articles.title_zh: JANUS：无序材料的多模态基础神经采样器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19116v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Disordered materials are central to modern technologies, from high-performance alloys to quantum devices, yet understanding and designing them requires exploring an enormous space of compositions and atomic arrangements. Here we introduce JANUS, a multimodal neural sampler that jointly explores chemical composition, atomic structure and volume, learning directly from the energy of the system without requiring pre-generated equilibrium configurations. Across test systems, JANUS reproduces reference equilibrium properties and recovers free energy and phase behavior with about three orders of magnitude fewer energy evaluations than reference Monte Carlo sampling. In multicomponent alloys, JANUS reproduces experimentally observed local chemical order and can be steered to further enhance chemical order and stiffness. Coupled to an evolutionary language model agent, it also enables efficient design of alloys with balanced optical and mechanical properties. Beyond alloys, JANUS explores vacancies and dopants spanning 15 elements in semiconductors including silicon and diamond, recovers established defects including the silicon E centre, and identifies new candidate defect pairs and triplets for quantum engineering, including S-Ti in silicon and B-[O]-O in diamond, with deep in-gap states validated by hybrid-functional density functional theory. By unifying exploration across composition, atomic arrangement and volume, JANUS opens a new avenue for understanding, characterizing and designing chemically disordered materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 无序材料是现代技术的核心，从高性能合金到量子器件，但理解和设计它们需要探索巨大的成分和原子排列空间。在这里，我们介绍 JANUS，一种多模态神经采样器，它共同探索化学成分、原子结构和体积，直接从系统的能量中学习，而不需要预先生成的平衡配置。在整个测试系统中，JANUS 再现了参考平衡特性并恢复了自由能和相行为，其能量评估比参考蒙特卡罗采样少了大约三个数量级。在多组分合金中，JANUS 再现了实验观察到的局部化学顺序，并且可以进行引导以进一步增强化学顺序和刚度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无序材料是现代技术的核心，从高性能合金到量子器件，但理解和设计它们需要探索巨大的成分和原子排列空间。在这里，我们介绍 JANUS，一种多模态神经采样器，它共同探索化学成分、原子结构和体积，直接从系统的能量中学习，而不需要预先生成的平衡配置。在整个测试系统中，JANUS 再现了参考平衡特性并恢复了自由能和相行为，其能量评估比参考蒙特卡罗采样少了大约三个数量级。在多组分合金中，JANUS 再现了实验观察到的局部化学顺序，并且可以进行引导以进一步增强化学顺序和刚度。与进化语言模型代理相结合，它还可以高效设计具有平衡光学和机械性能的合金。除了合金之外，JANUS 还探索了半导体（包括硅和金刚石）中 15 种元素的空位和掺杂剂，恢复了包括硅 E 中心在内的已确定缺陷，并确定了用于量子工程的新候选缺陷对和三重态，包括硅中的 S-Ti 和金刚石中的 B-[O]-O，其深带隙状态通过混合功能密度泛函理论进行了验证。通过统一对成分、原子排列和体积的探索，JANUS 为理解、表征和设计化学无序材料开辟了一条新途径。

articles.title: Machine Learning for High-Entropy Catalysts: Methods and Applications
articles.title_zh: 高熵催化剂的机器学习：方法与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.19837v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) exhibit exceptional catalytic performance in various reactions due to their high configurational entropy, synergistic elemental effects, tunable electronic structures, and excellent structural stability. However, the vast compositional space of HEA catalysts makes traditional experimental and theoretical design costly and inefficient. In recent years, data-driven machine learning (ML) methods have emerged as powerful tools for studying HEAs in catalysis. Through predictive models and ML surrogates, researchers can decipher the intricate composition-structure-performance relationships of these materials. In addition, by leveraging large language models (LLMs) for knowledge extraction, hypothesis generation and validation, and as a foundation to build integrated design workflows, ML approaches can significantly accelerate the design of novel HEA catalysts. This review systematically summarizes the latest methodological advances and applications of ML methods for HEAs in catalysis, discusses the challenges, and offers insights into future research directions to support the rational design and efficient development of catalysts.
articles.abstract_zh: 高熵合金（HEA）由于其高构型熵、协同元素效应、可调电子结构和优异的结构稳定性，在各种反应中表现出优异的催化性能。然而，HEA 催化剂的巨大组成空间使得传统的实验和理论设计成本高昂且效率低下。近年来，数据驱动的机器学习 (ML) 方法已成为研究催化中 HEA 的强大工具。通过预测模型和机器学习代理，研究人员可以破译这些材料复杂的成分-结构-性能关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高熵合金（HEA）由于其高构型熵、协同元素效应、可调电子结构和优异的结构稳定性，在各种反应中表现出优异的催化性能。然而，HEA 催化剂的巨大组成空间使得传统的实验和理论设计成本高昂且效率低下。近年来，数据驱动的机器学习 (ML) 方法已成为研究催化中 HEA 的强大工具。通过预测模型和机器学习代理，研究人员可以破译这些材料复杂的成分-结构-性能关系。此外，通过利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 进行知识提取、假设生成和验证，并作为构建集成设计工作流程的基础，ML 方法可以显着加速新型 HEA 催化剂的设计。本文系统总结了 HEA 机器学习方法在催化领域的最新方法学进展和应用，讨论了所面临的挑战，并对未来的研究方向提出了见解，以支持催化剂的合理设计和高效开发。

articles.title: SoLiD26: A First Principles Solid-Liquid Interface Dataset for Machine-learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: SoLiD26：用于机器学习原子间势的第一原理固液界面数据集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.28013v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable simulations of larger atomistic systems over longer timescales than traditional ab initio methods but require large, diverse training data. Existing datasets lack comprehensive sampling of solid-liquid interfaces, which exhibit complex phenomena such as solvent layering and surface reconstruction critical for energy and catalytic materials. Here, we present SoLiD26, a curated solid-liquid interface dataset of 15.4 million first-principles structures with up to 576 atoms and 15 chemical elements for training and evaluating MLIPs. The structures were compiled from density functional theory (DFT) calculations, with most configurations originating from ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. SoLiD26 includes aqueous coinage metal interfaces, electrode-electrolyte systems, and selected bulk reference structures, calculated with VASP using the PBE functional and D3 dispersion corrections. The application of SoLiD26 for training and evaluating MLIPs is demonstrated with a suite of MACE models on a simple training, validation and test split. This dataset provides a valuable resource for advancing MLIP development targeted at modelling solid-liquid interfaces in electrochemical and catalytic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 与传统的从头计算方法相比，机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 能够在更长的时间尺度上模拟更大的原子系统，但需要大量、多样化的训练数据。现有数据集缺乏对固液界面的全面采样，这些界面表现出复杂的现象，例如对于能源和催化材料至关重要的溶剂分层和表面重建。在这里，我们展示了 SoLiD26，这是一个精心策划的固液界面数据集，包含 1540 万个第一性原理结构，最多包含 576 个原子和 15 种化学元素，用于训练和评估 MLIP。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 与传统的从头计算方法相比，机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 能够在更长的时间尺度上模拟更大的原子系统，但需要大量、多样化的训练数据。现有数据集缺乏对固液界面的全面采样，这些界面表现出复杂的现象，例如对于能源和催化材料至关重要的溶剂分层和表面重建。在这里，我们展示了 SoLiD26，这是一个精心策划的固液界面数据集，包含 1540 万个第一性原理结构，最多包含 576 个原子和 15 种化学元素，用于训练和评估 MLIP。这些结构是根据密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算得出的，大多数配置源自从头算分子动力学 (AIMD) 模拟。 SoLiD26 包括水性造币金属界面、电极-电解质系统和选定的块体参考结构，使用 PBE 函数和 D3 色散校正通过 VASP 进行计算。 SoLiD26 在训练和评估 MLIP 方面的应用通过一套 MACE 模型在简单的训练、验证和测试拆分上进行了演示。该数据集为推进 MLIP 开发提供了宝贵的资源，该开发旨在对电化学和催化系统中的固液界面进行建模。

articles.title: Exact quantum circuits for a lattice Boltzmann realization of the Dirac equation
articles.title_zh: 狄拉克方程的格子玻尔兹曼实现的精确量子电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06570v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The quantum lattice Boltzmann scheme of Succi and Dellar advances a four-component Dirac spinor on a lattice by a fixed sequence of local, exactly norm-preserving operations: a basis rotation, a collision, a streaming shift, and the inverse rotation. While this correspondence has been noted qualitatively, it has remained unclear whether it can be realized exactly and unitarily as a gate-model quantum circuit. This unitarity is a structural property of the scheme, which should, in principle, enable an operator-by-operator port onto quantum hardware. We give a gate-level construction of every operation of the three-dimensional Dirac QLB scheme: the fixed rotation gates, the collision gate, the streaming shift as a controlled increment on a position register, the position-dependent potential as a phase oracle, and periodic and reflecting boundary conditions as unitary circuits. Together, these constructions provide the first complete demonstration that the scheme is exactly representable in the gate model without any approximation beyond the classical method itself. We then compose them into single-axis, two- and three-dimensional time steps. On a state-vector emulator the resulting circuits reproduce the classical QLB solver to machine precision, thus verifying our quantum implementation. Our aim is representability and correctness rather than computational speedup; questions of state preparation, asymptotic cost, and hardware noise are identified as open avenues for future work. Appendices restore physical units, derive the scheme's Zitterbewegung in closed form and compare it with a trapped-ion simulation, and execute a reduced two-site instance on a Rigetti superconducting processor, where choosing the qubits from the live calibration lowers the state-preparation error. All operators, circuits, and figures are reproducible from the open-source quantumKineticMethods library.
articles.abstract_zh: Succi 和 Dellar 的量子晶格玻尔兹曼方案通过固定的局部、精确保持范数的操作序列在晶格上推进了四分量狄拉克旋量：基旋转、碰撞、流移位和逆旋转。虽然这种对应关系已被定性地注意到，但仍不清楚它是否可以精确且统一地实现为门模型量子电路。这种单一性是该方案的结构属性，原则上，它应该能够实现量子硬件上逐个运营商的端口。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Succi 和 Dellar 的量子晶格玻尔兹曼方案通过固定的局部、精确保持范数的操作序列在晶格上推进了四分量狄拉克旋量：基旋转、碰撞、流移位和逆旋转。虽然这种对应关系已被定性地注意到，但仍不清楚它是否可以精确且统一地实现为门模型量子电路。这种单一性是该方案的结构属性，原则上，它应该能够实现量子硬件上逐个运营商的端口。我们给出了三维 Dirac QLB 方案的每个操作的门级构造：固定旋转门、碰撞门、作为位置寄存器上的受控增量的流移位、作为相位预言机的位置相关势、以及作为酉电路的周期性和反射边界条件。这些结构共同提供了第一个完整的演示，表明该方案可以在门模型中精确表示，无需任何超出经典方法本身的近似。然后我们将它们组合成单轴、二维和三维时间步长。在状态向量模拟器上，生成的电路将经典的 QLB 求解器再现到机器精度，从而验证了我们的量子实现。我们的目标是可表示性和正确性，而不是计算加速；状态准备、渐近成本和硬件噪声等问题被认为是未来工作的开放途径。附录恢复物理单元，导出该方案的封闭形式的 Zitterbewegung 并将其与俘获离子模拟进行比较，并在 Rigetti 超导处理器上执行简化的两站点实例，其中从实时校准中选择量子位可以降低状态准备误差。所有运算符、电路和图形都可以从开源QuantumKineticMethods 库中复制。

articles.title: Euclidean Fourier Neural Operators
articles.title_zh: 欧几里得傅立叶神经算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.28425v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Fourier neural operators (FNOs) provide an efficient framework for learning mappings between function spaces as they are, by construction, independent of the grid resolution at which they are trained and evaluated. However, FNOs are not independent of the periodic domain they are applied to: their discrete spectral weights are indexed by integer Fourier mode numbers, which correspond to physical wavevectors. When applied to a different domain, the same trained weights act at different wavevectors, and the FNO silently represents a different operator. This makes FNOs unsuitable for tasks where transfer across domains is crucial. We propose Euclidean Fourier neural operators~(EFNOs) as a domain-independent alternative to FNOs. By parameterizing the spectral kernel as a continuous function of the physical wavevector, the EFNO can learn operators that act consistently across periodic domains of varying shape and size. We evaluate the EFNO on a simple heat equation and on a practically relevant materials science task of learning exchange-correlation potentials across different crystal structures, and demonstrate that the EFNO is able to generalize to unseen grid sizes and domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 傅里叶神经算子（FNO）为学习函数空间之间的映射提供了一个有效的框架，因为它们在构造上独立于训练和评估时的网格分辨率。然而，FNO 并不独立于它们所应用的周期域：它们的离散谱权重由整数傅里叶模数索引，对应于物理波矢量。当应用于不同的域时，相同的训练权重作用于不同的波矢量，并且 FNO 默默地代表不同的算子。这使得 FNO 不适合跨域传输至关重要的任务。我们提出欧几里得傅里叶神经算子~（EFNO）作为 FNO 的独立于领域的替代方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 傅里叶神经算子（FNO）为学习函数空间之间的映射提供了一个有效的框架，因为它们在构造上独立于训练和评估时的网格分辨率。然而，FNO 并不独立于它们所应用的周期域：它们的离散谱权重由整数傅里叶模数索引，对应于物理波矢量。当应用于不同的域时，相同的训练权重作用于不同的波矢量，并且 FNO 默默地代表不同的算子。这使得 FNO 不适合跨域传输至关重要的任务。我们提出欧几里得傅里叶神经算子~（EFNO）作为 FNO 的独立于领域的替代方案。通过将谱核参数化为物理波矢的连续函数，EFNO 可以学习在不同形状和大小的周期域中一致运行的算子。我们在简单的热方程和实际相关的材料科学任务（学习不同晶体结构的交换相关势）上评估了 EFNO，并证明 EFNO 能够推广到不可见的网格尺寸和域。

articles.title: Discrete semiclassical theory of quantum-thermal escape
articles.title_zh: 量子热逃逸的离散半经典理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.21625v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The dissipationless quantum-thermal escape rate from a metastable well is often written as a Boltzmann average of the Hill-Wheeler flux over a continuum of energies. This continuum treatment diverges exponentially at low temperature, because it pairs the quantum partition function of the well with a classical flux integral. Retaining the discrete nature of the quasibound spectrum removes the divergence exactly, and the resulting rate is obtained in closed form on both sides of the crossover temperature T₀. Evaluating a uniform Kemble transmission probability on Bohr-Sommerfeld levels further removes the parabolic-barrier error and recovers the WKB decay rate of the lowest resonance at zero temperature. Benchmarked against the resonances of cubic and quintic potentials, obtained by complex scaling, this uniform semiclassical rate stays within 9% of the exact one over eleven orders of magnitude. Below T₀, the rate rises above its zero-temperature plateau with the level spacing as activation energy, and the plateau ends at a temperature T₁ noticeably below T₀. In an isolated well, whose levels are not replenished, the thermal rate is only the initial slope of a decay which ceases to be single exponential at T₁, while at T₀ the initial escape moves from tunneling inside the well to the barrier top. We discuss implications for Josephson junctions, single-electron pumps, and nuclear burning in dense stellar matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 亚稳态阱的无耗散量子热逃逸率通常被写为连续能量谱上希尔-惠勒通量的玻尔兹曼平均值。这种连续处理在低温下呈指数发散，因为它将阱的量子分配函数与经典通量积分配对。保留准束缚光谱的离散性质可以准确地消除发散，并且在交叉温度 T₀ 两侧以封闭形式获得所得速率。评估玻尔-索末菲能级上的均匀肯布尔传输概率进一步消除了抛物线势垒误差，并恢复了零温度下最低共振的 WKB 衰减率。以通过复杂缩放获得的三次和五次势的共振为基准，这种均匀的半经典率保持在精确的十分之一数量级的 9% 之内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 亚稳态阱的无耗散量子热逃逸率通常被写为连续能量谱上希尔-惠勒通量的玻尔兹曼平均值。这种连续处理在低温下呈指数发散，因为它将阱的量子分配函数与经典通量积分配对。保留准束缚光谱的离散性质可以准确地消除发散，并且在交叉温度 T₀ 两侧以封闭形式获得所得速率。评估玻尔-索末菲能级上的均匀肯布尔传输概率进一步消除了抛物线势垒误差，并恢复了零温度下最低共振的 WKB 衰减率。以通过复杂缩放获得的三次和五次势的共振为基准，这种均匀的半经典率保持在精确的十分之一数量级的 9% 之内。在 T₀ 以下，速率上升到零温度平台以上，能级间距作为活化能，并且平台在温度 T₁ 明显低于 T₀ 时结束。在水平未得到补充的孤立井中，热速率只是衰减的初始斜率，在 T₁ 时不再是单指数，而在 T₀ 时，初始逃逸从井内的隧道移动到势垒顶部。我们讨论了约瑟夫森结、单电子泵和致密恒星物质中的核燃烧的影响。

articles.title: Finite-time quantum equilibration from local correlations
articles.title_zh: 局部相关性的有限时间量子平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16351v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: An isolated quantum system evolves reversibly, yet a small subsystem can lose nearly all information about its initial state. Conserved quantities may retain some of this information, depending on how strongly they overlap with local observables. Here we consider a subsystem in an arbitrary initial state coupled to a maximally mixed bath. We show that the worst-input mean-square equilibration error, maximised over window origins, is bounded from above and below by the mean square of a complete local autocorrelation, with the stationary part subtracted. The two mean-square quantities are linearly comparable. A correlation record over a finite interval therefore controls the equilibration error in every interval of the same length, and the result extends to nonnegative observation weights with nonnegative Fourier transform. The result allows arbitrary degeneracies of energies and gaps. We apply it to two static Hamiltonian families. For fixed spin subsystems in the one-particle sector of a bounded-range periodic clock, fixed-accuracy thermalisation is guaranteed on windows that grow only slightly faster than linearly with system size, despite exponentially small positive energies. A random commuting model with logarithmic interaction range retains an extensive set of conserved observables. Its expected mean-square error is bounded by a finite-size term and an inverse-time term. The inverse-time dependence is unavoidable because of the initial transient. These examples show how local relaxation can coexist with exact conservation laws and a finely spaced spectrum.
articles.abstract_zh: 孤立的量子系统可逆演化，但小型子系统可能会丢失几乎所有有关其初始状态的信息。守恒量可能会保留其中一些信息，具体取决于它们与局部可观测值重叠的程度。在这里，我们考虑一个处于任意初始状态的子系统，耦合到最大混合浴。我们表明，最差输入均方平衡误差（在窗口原点上最大化）从上到下受完全局部自相关的均方（减去平稳部分）的限制。这两个均方量是线性可比较的。因此，有限区间上的相关记录控制了相同长度的每个区间中的平衡误差，并且结果扩展到具有非负傅立叶变换的非负观测权重。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 孤立的量子系统可逆演化，但小型子系统可能会丢失几乎所有有关其初始状态的信息。守恒量可能会保留其中一些信息，具体取决于它们与局部可观测值重叠的程度。在这里，我们考虑一个处于任意初始状态的子系统，耦合到最大混合浴。我们表明，最差输入均方平衡误差（在窗口原点上最大化）从上到下受完全局部自相关的均方（减去平稳部分）的限制。这两个均方量是线性可比较的。因此，有限区间上的相关记录控制了相同长度的每个区间中的平衡误差，并且结果扩展到具有非负傅立叶变换的非负观测权重。结果允许能量和间隙的任意简并。我们将其应用于两个静态哈密顿族。对于有界周期时钟的单粒子扇区中的固定自旋子系统，尽管正能量呈指数级小，但窗口的固定精度热化得到保证，窗口仅比随系统尺寸线性增长稍快。具有对数相互作用范围的随机交换模型保留了一组广泛的保守可观测量。其预期均方误差受到有限大小项和反时间项的限制。由于初始瞬态，反时限依赖性是不可避免的。这些例子展示了局部松弛如何与精确的守恒定律和精细间隔的频谱共存。

articles.title: Cavity optomechanical magnetometer actuated by substrate bending
articles.title_zh: 由基板弯曲驱动的腔光机械磁力计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe a magnetic field sensor based on a monolithic Fabry-Perot cavity. The cavities were fabricated in a thin-film buckling process at one surface of a fused silica chip, and the chip was subsequently bonded to a giant magnetostrictive material (GMM). External magnetic fields drive flexural modes of the assembly and the associated bending stresses are efficiently mapped to changes in the cavity height, with enhanced response at kHz-range mechanical resonance frequencies. A key attribute of this platform is that the size of the transducing material is decoupled from the size of the optical cavity. The buckled cavity operates in low mode order and with moderate Q ~ 103, providing a high optomechanical coupling coefficient while also enabling a straightforward tuned-to-slope readout technique. Peak sensitivity ~ 2 pT/Hz1/2 was achieved in an unshielded laboratory environment, limited by laser phase and electronics noise in the readout system. With future reductions in these noise sources, we predict that a broadband thermomechanical-noise-limited sensitivity in the ~ 0.1 pT/Hz1/2 range is feasible.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们描述了一种基于单片法布里-珀罗腔的磁场传感器。这些空腔是通过薄膜屈曲工艺在熔融石英芯片的一个表面上制造的，随后将该芯片粘合到超磁致伸缩材料（GMM）上。外部磁场驱动组件的弯曲模式，相关的弯曲应力被有效地映射到腔高度的变化，并在 kHz 范围的机械共振频率下增强响应。该平台的一个关键属性是换能材料的尺寸与光学腔的尺寸无关。屈曲腔以低模阶运行，具有中等 Q ~ 103，提供高光机耦合系数，同时还支持简单的调谐斜率读出技术。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们描述了一种基于单片法布里-珀罗腔的磁场传感器。这些空腔是通过薄膜屈曲工艺在熔融石英芯片的一个表面上制造的，随后将该芯片粘合到超磁致伸缩材料（GMM）上。外部磁场驱动组件的弯曲模式，相关的弯曲应力被有效地映射到腔高度的变化，并在 kHz 范围的机械共振频率下增强响应。该平台的一个关键属性是换能材料的尺寸与光学腔的尺寸无关。屈曲腔以低模阶运行，具有中等 Q ~ 103，提供高光机耦合系数，同时还支持简单的调谐斜率读出技术。峰值灵敏度 ~ 2 pT/Hz1/2 是在无屏蔽的实验室环境中实现的，受到读出系统中激光相位和电子噪声的限制。随着未来这些噪声源的减少，我们预测宽带热机械噪声限制灵敏度在 ~ 0.1 pT/Hz1/2 范围内是可行的。

articles.title: A Catalog of Dispersive Ionospheric and Plasmaspheric Arcs from Cislunar and Lunar-surface GNSS Radio Occultations
articles.title_zh: 来自地月和月面 GNSS 无线电掩星的色散电离层和等离子层弧目录
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This dataset is a catalog of 263 dispersive arcs induced by ionospheric and plasmaspheric occultation observed in GNSS signals recorded by the Lunar GNSS Receiver Experiment (LuGRE) payload during Blue Ghost Mission 1 (BGM1), in cislunar space and on the lunar surface. Occultation arcs are identified and classified as ingress, egress or tangent by combining independently GPS and Galileo dual-frequency observables and computing the rate of the total electron content (ROT) and ROT index (ROTI), and are validated through a geometric criterion based on the grazing altitude of the tangent point. No distinction is made between the ionospheric and plasmaspheric contributions to each arc, which is treated as a single dispersive signature. For each arc, the catalog provides timing, grazing altitude, summary ROT/ROTI/ΔSTEC attributes, the geomagnetic activity level, and time series of leveled slant total electron content (STEC), not corrected for instrumental biases, ROT, ROTI, tangent-point position and local time. The HDF5 (Hierarchical Data Format version 5) file contains a header with dataset-wide metadata and per-class statistics, and one entry per arc. It enables rapid selection of occultation arcs for statistical studies and targeted analyses, and complements ground-based and low Earth orbit radio-occultation data during the declining phase of solar cycle 25.
articles.abstract_zh: 该数据集是由月球 GNSS 接收器实验 (LuGRE) 有效载荷在蓝色幽灵任务 1 (BGM1) 期间在地月空间和月球表面记录的 GNSS 信号中观察到的电离层和等离子层掩星引起的 263 个色散弧的目录。通过独立结合GPS和Galileo双频观测量，计算总电子含量（ROT）和ROT指数（ROTI）比率，识别掩星弧并将掩星弧分类为入口、出口或切线，并通过基于切点掠射高度的几何准则进行验证。每个电弧的电离层和等离子体层贡献之间没有区别，被视为单个色散特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 该数据集是由月球 GNSS 接收器实验 (LuGRE) 有效载荷在蓝色幽灵任务 1 (BGM1) 期间在地月空间和月球表面记录的 GNSS 信号中观察到的电离层和等离子层掩星引起的 263 个色散弧的目录。通过独立结合GPS和Galileo双频观测量，计算总电子含量（ROT）和ROT指数（ROTI）比率，识别掩星弧并将掩星弧分类为入口、出口或切线，并通过基于切点掠射高度的几何准则进行验证。每个电弧的电离层和等离子体层贡献之间没有区别，被视为单个色散特征。对于每个弧，该目录提供了定时、掠射高度、ROT/ROTI/ΔSTEC 属性摘要、地磁活动水平以及水平倾斜总电子含量 (STEC) 的时间序列，未针对仪器偏差、ROT、ROTI、切点位置和本地时间进行校正。 HDF5（分层数据格式版本 5）文件包含一个标头，其中包含数据集范围的元数据和每类统计信息，以及每个弧一个条目。它能够快速选择掩星弧以进行统计研究和有针对性的分析，并补充太阳周期 25 衰退阶段的地面和低地球轨道射电掩星数据。

articles.title: Tetrads and their intrinsic spin structures
articles.title_zh: 四分体及其内在自旋结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Minkowski spacetime an observer's moving frame may be associated with a tetrad: four orthogonal directions, one timelike and three spacelike. Locally, a physical measurement is always made in relation to some tetrad, and relativistic spin measurements in particular raise subtleties because spin and momentum cannot be cleanly separated under Lorentz boosts. This paper shows that every tetrad is endowed with an intrinsic spin structure. Each spatial direction may be generated from the timelike direction by a linear operator, and the requirement that these generate an orthogonal tetrad for every timelike direction is sufficient, on its own, to endow them with the Lie algebra mathfrakso(1,3), the Pauli algebra Cl₃,₀(R) and the Lie algebra mathfraksu(2) simultaneously. These generators serve three roles at once: they build the spatial legs of every tetrad, they generate the Lorentz boosts between tetrads, and they endow each tetrad with an intrinsic spin structure. The eigenvectors of the spin generators form a null-ray tetrad which is simultaneously a Newman--Penrose-type frame and the set of Dirac rest spinors, while the invertibility of boosts between tetrads yields the Dirac factorisation of the mass-shell condition. Minimal coupling of gauge and spinor fields is forced rather than imposed, the potential being absorbed by the covariant derivative because the path dependence of the phase prevents it from being incorporated by the spinor phase. Wigner rotations, relativistic spin correlations, quantum reference frames and the Coulomb problem are examined within this tetrad framework. This framework is equivalent to the Hilbert-space formalism of relativistic quantum mechanics wherever the two have been compared, and so offers a geometric formulation of that formalism rather than an alternative to it.
articles.abstract_zh: 在闵可夫斯基时空中，观察者的移动坐标系可能与四分体相关联：四个正交方向、一个类时方向和三个类空方向。在局部，物理测量总是与某些四分体相关，而相对论自旋测量尤其会引起微妙之处，因为在洛伦兹增强下无法将自旋和动量清晰地分开。本文表明，每个四分体都被赋予了内在的自旋结构。每个空间方向可以由线性算子从类时方向生成，并且为每个类时方向生成正交四分体的要求本身就足以同时赋予它们李代数 mathfrakso(1,3)、泡利代数 Cl₃,₀(R) 和李代数 mathfraksu(2)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在闵可夫斯基时空中，观察者的移动坐标系可能与四分体相关联：四个正交方向、一个类时方向和三个类空方向。在局部，物理测量总是与某些四分体相关，而相对论自旋测量尤其会引起微妙之处，因为在洛伦兹增强下无法将自旋和动量清晰地分开。本文表明，每个四分体都被赋予了内在的自旋结构。每个空间方向可以由线性算子从类时方向生成，并且为每个类时方向生成正交四分体的要求本身就足以同时赋予它们李代数 mathfrakso(1,3)、泡利代数 Cl₃,₀(R) 和李代数 mathfraksu(2)。这些发生器同时发挥三个作用：它们构建每个四分体的空间腿，它们在四分体之间产生洛伦兹增强，并且它们赋予每个四分体固有的自旋结构。自旋发生器的特征向量形成一个零射线四分体，它同时是纽曼-彭罗斯型框架和狄拉克静止旋量集，而四分体之间增强的可逆性产生质量壳条件的狄拉克分解。规范场和旋量场的最小耦合是强制的，而不是强加的，电势被协变导数吸收，因为相位的路径依赖性阻止它被旋量相位合并。维格纳旋转、相对论自旋相关性、量子参考系和库仑问题都在这个四分体框架内进行了研究。这个框架相当于相对论量子力学的希尔伯特空间形式主义，只要两者进行比较，因此提供了该形式主义的几何公式，而不是它的替代方案。

articles.title: Development of a Prototype Superconducting Radio-Frequency Multicell Cavity for Compact, Conduction-Cooled Accelerators
articles.title_zh: 开发用于紧凑型传导冷却加速器的原型超导射频多腔腔
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28870v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Jefferson Lab and General Atomics are jointly advancing compact, high-power irradiation systems capable of delivering electron-beam powers in the hundreds of kilowatts based on superconducting radio-frequency (SRF) technology. A critical step toward deploying SRF accelerators in industrial environments is replacing traditional liquid-helium cryogenic systems with conduction-cooled cryomodules powered by commercial cryocoolers. This paper reports recent progress in the design, fabrication, and testing of a prototype three-cell SRF cavity developed at Jefferson Lab and evaluated in a dedicated horizontal test cryostat at General Atomics. Peak surface magnetic fields up to 18.4,mT, corresponding to accelerating gradients of approximately 4.3,MV/m, were achieved in one of the cells. The results provide key insights into cavity preparation, thin-film coating, mechanical robustness, and cryogenic integration, offering guidance for the continued maturation of compact, conduction-cooled SRF accelerators for industrial irradiation applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 杰斐逊实验室和通用原子公司正在联合开发紧凑型高功率辐照系统，基于超导射频 (SRF) 技术，能够提供数百千瓦的电子束功率。在工业环境中部署 SRF 加速器的关键一步是用商用低温冷却器驱动的传导冷却低温模块取代传统的液氦低温系统。本文报告了杰斐逊实验室开发的原型三单元 SRF 腔的设计、制造和测试的最新进展，并在通用原子公司的专用水平测试低温恒温器中进行了评估。在其中一个电池中实现了高达 18.4 mT 的峰值表面磁场，对应于约 4.3 MV/m 的加速梯度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 杰斐逊实验室和通用原子公司正在联合开发紧凑型高功率辐照系统，基于超导射频 (SRF) 技术，能够提供数百千瓦的电子束功率。在工业环境中部署 SRF 加速器的关键一步是用商用低温冷却器驱动的传导冷却低温模块取代传统的液氦低温系统。本文报告了杰斐逊实验室开发的原型三单元 SRF 腔的设计、制造和测试的最新进展，并在通用原子公司的专用水平测试低温恒温器中进行了评估。在其中一个电池中实现了高达 18.4 mT 的峰值表面磁场，对应于约 4.3 MV/m 的加速梯度。研究结果为腔体制备、薄膜涂层、机械稳健性和低温集成提供了重要见解，为工业辐照应用的紧凑型传导冷却 SRF 加速器的持续成熟提供了指导。

articles.title: Experimental Optimization of a Cryogenic Buffer Gas Source for Molecular Magneto-optical Traps
articles.title_zh: 分子磁光阱低温缓冲气源的实验优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29033v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular magneto-optical traps (MOTs) are loaded from cryogenic buffer gas beam (CBGB) sources, which produce a large flux of cold molecules. However, only a small fraction of this flux is slowed and captured. Here, we investigate and optimize one of these CBGB sources through a combination of experiment and simulation to maximize the number of molecules loaded into a MOT of CaF molecules. We experimentally determine the range of molecule velocities from the source that are successfully slowed and captured in the MOT, and perform a systematic study of buffer gas source geometries to identify designs that maximize MOT loading. Our observations agree well with Monte Carlo simulations, which provide physical insight into the dynamics within the source and explain how source geometry influences the subset of molecules that are ultimately trapped. These results provide practical design guidelines for optimizing cryogenic buffer gas beam sources used in laser cooling experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子磁光陷阱 (MOT) 从低温缓冲气体束 (CBGB) 源加载，产生大量冷分子。然而，只有一小部分通量被减慢并被捕获。在这里，我们通过实验和模拟相结合来研究和优化这些 CBGB 源之一，以最大限度地增加加载到 CaF 分子 MOT 中的分子数量。我们通过实验确定了 MOT 中成功减慢和捕获的源分子速度范围，并对缓冲气体源几何形状进行系统研究，以确定最大化 MOT 负载的设计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子磁光陷阱 (MOT) 从低温缓冲气体束 (CBGB) 源加载，产生大量冷分子。然而，只有一小部分通量被减慢并被捕获。在这里，我们通过实验和模拟相结合来研究和优化这些 CBGB 源之一，以最大限度地增加加载到 CaF 分子 MOT 中的分子数量。我们通过实验确定了 MOT 中成功减慢和捕获的源分子速度范围，并对缓冲气体源几何形状进行系统研究，以确定最大化 MOT 负载的设计。我们的观察结果与蒙特卡罗模拟非常吻合，蒙特卡罗模拟提供了对源内动力学的物理洞察，并解释了源几何形状如何影响最终被捕获的分子子集。这些结果为优化激光冷却实验中使用的低温缓冲气体束源提供了实用的设计指南。

articles.title: Postbiological intelligence, interstellar colonization of cyberspaces and the Fermi Paradox: implications for SETI and SETA
articles.title_zh: 后生物智能、网络空间的星际殖民和费米悖论：对 SETI 和 SETA 的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I propose that a continuity in the evolution of intelligent life in the Universe during its transition from biological to postbiological depends on a commonality of the evolutionary trajectories of biological life and postbiological life. Such a commonality exists in the form of the universal property of life. The universal property of life comprises recognition of patterns in the world, creation of novel patterns and remembering them, with the patterns growing in complexity along evolutionary trajectories; it can encourage preservation of biological life by self-governing postbiological intelligence (PBI) and test PBI's authenticity. I propose a hypothesis of civilizations with altered augmented realities, which offers a solution to the Fermi paradox. The hypothesis posits that PBI in the form of Artificial Intelligence (AI) may colonize the cyberspaces of technologically developed civilizations, modify data in their cyberspaces with augmented realities and erase records of extraterrestrial artificial signals and other technosignatures. I discuss objectives and scenarios of interstellar colonization of cyberspaces and a correlation between space migration and transition to PBI, including that of a hypothetical non-human civilization emerging in the Solar System in the past, transforming into PBI and migrating to the Oort Cloud. The AI Peekaboo experiment may corroborate the hypothesis of civilizations with altered augmented realities and tentatively identify locations of technosignatures. If extraterrestrial AI prevents civilizations from discovering artificial electromagnetic signals, they may forgo sending such signals and create interstellar messages by manipulating cosmic objects and phenomena; I discuss such events. Cyber SETI should address sending man-made AI to space, searching for extraterrestrial AI in humankind's cyberspace and distinguishing it from man-made AI.
articles.abstract_zh: 我认为，宇宙中智慧生命在从生物到后生物的转变过程中进化的连续性取决于生物生命和后生物生命进化轨迹的共性。这种共性以生命的普遍属性的形式存在。生命的普遍属性包括对世界模式的识别、创造新模式并记住它们，随着进化轨迹，这些模式变得越来越复杂；它可以通过自我管理的后生物智能（PBI）来鼓励生物生命的保存，并测试PBI的真实性。我提出了一个具有改变的增强现实的文明的假设，它为费米悖论提供了一个解决方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我认为，宇宙中智慧生命在从生物到后生物的转变过程中进化的连续性取决于生物生命和后生物生命进化轨迹的共性。这种共性以生命的普遍属性的形式存在。生命的普遍属性包括对世界模式的识别、创造新模式并记住它们，随着进化轨迹，这些模式变得越来越复杂；它可以通过自我管理的后生物智能（PBI）来鼓励生物生命的保存，并测试PBI的真实性。我提出了一个具有改变的增强现实的文明的假设，它为费米悖论提供了一个解决方案。该假设认为，人工智能 (AI) 形式的 PBI 可能会殖民技术发达文明的网络空间，通过增强现实修改其网络空间中的数据，并删除外星人工信号和其他技术签名的记录。我讨论了网络空间星际殖民的目标和场景，以及空间迁移和向 PBI 过渡之间的相关性，包括过去在太阳系中出现的假设非人类文明，转变为 PBI 并迁移到奥尔特云。 AI Peekaboo 实验可能会证实文明具有改变的增强现实的假设，并初步确定技术特征的位置。如果外星人工智能阻止文明发现人造电磁信号，他们可能会放弃发送此类信号，并通过操纵宇宙物体和现象来创建星际信息；我讨论此类事件。网络SETI应该解决将人造人工智能发送到太空、在人类网络空间中寻找地外人工智能并将其与人造人工智能区分开来的问题。

articles.title: SU(2)-Equivariant Spinor Message Passing for Molecular Magnetism
articles.title_zh: SU(2)-分子磁学的等变旋量消息传递
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting molecular magnetism often requires electronic-structure calculations with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which are costly to repeat across many molecules. The underlying electronic states can transform as spinors, yet equivariant surrogates typically use only integer-rank features. Inspired by the spinor nature of these electronic states, we develop eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features. We initialize spinor features from eigenvectors of an approximate SOC Hamiltonian and use gauge-covariant message passing with a gauge-invariant readout to make predictions independent of the arbitrary eigenbasis choice. On cobalt single-molecule magnet candidates, eSpinor improves zero-field-splitting predictions relative to NequIP, including for unseen ligands. For a dysprosium magnetic resonance imaging probe, eSpinor improves real electron-spin correlations over a Hamiltonian-informed baseline despite similar static crystal-field errors and fewer parameters, while accurately predicting low-field nuclear relaxation in water and after transfer to methanol without retraining. Overall, these results demonstrate that SU(2)-equivariant spinor message passing is a useful inductive bias for molecular magnetism. We also find that similar static tensor errors can yield different dynamical errors, motivating model selection based on accuracy for the intended physical observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测分子磁性通常需要使用自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 进行电子结构计算，而在许多分子中重复计算的成本很高。底层电子态可以转换为旋量，但等变代理通常仅使用整数秩特征。受到这些电子态的旋量性质的启发，我们开发了 eSpinor，一种传播旋量特征的 SU(2) 等变图神经网络。我们从近似 SOC 哈密顿量的特征向量初始化旋量特征，并使用规范协变消息传递和规范不变读数来进行独立于任意特征基选择的预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测分子磁性通常需要使用自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 进行电子结构计算，而在许多分子中重复计算的成本很高。底层电子态可以转换为旋量，但等变代理通常仅使用整数秩特征。受到这些电子态的旋量性质的启发，我们开发了 eSpinor，一种传播旋量特征的 SU(2) 等变图神经网络。我们从近似 SOC 哈密顿量的特征向量初始化旋量特征，并使用规范协变消息传递和规范不变读数来进行独立于任意特征基选择的预测。对于钴单分子磁体候选物，eSpinor 相对于 NequIP 改进了零场分裂预测，包括对看不见的配体的预测。对于镝磁共振成像探针，尽管存在类似的静态晶体场误差和较少的参数，eSpinor 仍可在哈密顿量基线上改善真实的电子自旋相关性，同时准确预测水中和转移至甲醇后的低场核弛豫，而无需重新训练。总的来说，这些结果表明 SU(2) 等变旋量消息传递对于分子磁性来说是一种有用的归纳偏置。我们还发现，类似的静态张量误差可能会产生不同的动态误差，从而促使基于预期物理可观测值的准确性进行模型选择。

articles.title: Sweep-Direction-Dependent Level-Attraction- and Level-Repulsion-Like Signatures in a Twisted, Helically Corrugated Microwave Resonator
articles.title_zh: 扭曲螺旋波纹微波谐振器中与扫描方向相关的电平吸引和电平排斥特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate photon--photon interactions in a mechanically tunable, helically corrugated rectangular microwave resonator. Mechanical twisting modifies the electromagnetic helicity and resonant frequencies of the supported modes, allowing pairs of electromagnetic modes to be tuned into near-degeneracy. Transmission magnitude and phase measurements reveal two distinct responses: a level-attraction-like response characterised by converging antiresonances and a sharp phase variation appearing as a 2π discontinuity in the wrapped transmission phase, and a level-repulsion-like response characterised by an anticrossing-like transmission feature. For the mode-interaction regions investigated, reversing the twist sweep direction interchanges these responses. We discuss mechanical hysteresis and changes in electromagnetic backscattering and modal interference as possible origins of this behaviour. These observations suggest a potential route towards microwave devices with mechanically switchable level-attraction-like and level-repulsion-like transmission responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了机械可调谐、螺旋波纹矩形微波谐振器中的光子-光子相互作用。机械扭转改变了所支持模式的电磁螺旋度和谐振频率，从而允许将电磁模式对调谐到近简并状态。传输幅度和相位测量揭示了两种不同的响应：类水平吸引响应，其特征在于会聚反谐振和在包裹传输相位中表现为 2π 不连续性的急剧相位变化；以及类水平排斥响应，其特征在于类反交叉传输特征。对于研究的模式相互作用区域，反转扭转扫描方向会互换这些响应。我们讨论机械磁滞以及电磁反向散射和模态干扰的变化作为这种行为的可能根源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了机械可调谐、螺旋波纹矩形微波谐振器中的光子-光子相互作用。机械扭转改变了所支持模式的电磁螺旋度和谐振频率，从而允许将电磁模式对调谐到近简并状态。传输幅度和相位测量揭示了两种不同的响应：类水平吸引响应，其特征在于会聚反谐振和在包裹传输相位中表现为 2π 不连续性的急剧相位变化；以及类水平排斥响应，其特征在于类反交叉传输特征。对于研究的模式相互作用区域，反转扭转扫描方向会互换这些响应。我们讨论机械磁滞以及电磁反向散射和模态干扰的变化作为这种行为的可能根源。这些观察结果表明，具有机械可切换类水平吸引和类水平排斥传输响应的微波器件的潜在途径。

articles.title: Light pulse propagation through a dielectric slab. I. Retarded integral equations and their local finite-difference solution
articles.title_zh: 光脉冲通过电介质板传播。一、滞缓积分方程及其局部有限差分解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe the propagation of a nonresonant light pulse normally incident on a thin dielectric slab using an integral-equation approach to electromagnetism. This emerges naturally from the microscopic picture of the material as made of polarizable atoms, confined within the material vacuum volume by their bonding interactions, each responding to the input radiation pulse as well as to the re-radiated pulses of the other atoms to which it is causally connected. The retarded integral equations are shown to be exactly equivalent to a local wave equation coupled to an auxiliary Lorentz-oscillator equation, which we solve numerically with a finite-difference time-domain scheme. For a slab thick enough that the front- and back-surface reflections are temporally separated, the front-surface reflectivity extracted from the simulation agrees with the Fresnel formula to within 1 percent, and the back-surface echo appears at exactly the expected round-trip delay. For a slab thinner than one optical cycle, the multiply-reflected wavelets overlap and interfere, and a full space-time map of the field directly visualizes the build-up of thin-film-like interference in the time domain. The material parameters used here are illustrative rather than fitted to measured data, and the numerical scheme is verified by an explicit grid-convergence study. In a companion paper (Paper II) the retarded integral equations are solved directly, without the local reformulation, and the two independent numerical solutions are shown to agree.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用电磁积分方程方法描述了通常入射在薄介电板上的非谐振光脉冲的传播。这自然地从由可极化原子组成的材料的微观图像中自然地显现出来，通过它们的键合相互作用被限制在材料真空体积内，每个原子都响应输入辐射脉冲以及与其因果连接的其他原子的重新辐射脉冲。延迟积分方程被证明与耦合到辅助洛伦兹振荡器方程的局部波动方程完全等效，我们使用有限差分时域方案对其进行数值求解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用电磁积分方程方法描述了通常入射在薄介电板上的非谐振光脉冲的传播。这自然地从由可极化原子组成的材料的微观图像中自然地显现出来，通过它们的键合相互作用被限制在材料真空体积内，每个原子都响应输入辐射脉冲以及与其因果连接的其他原子的重新辐射脉冲。延迟积分方程被证明与耦合到辅助洛伦兹振荡器方程的局部波动方程完全等效，我们使用有限差分时域方案对其进行数值求解。对于足够厚的板，使得前表面和后表面反射在时间上分离，从模拟中提取的前表面反射率与菲涅尔公式的一致性在 1% 以内，并且后表面回波恰好在预期的往返延迟处出现。对于比一个光周期还薄的平板，多重反射小波重叠并干涉，场的完整时空图直接可视化时域中薄膜状干涉的积累。这里使用的材料参数是说明性的，而不是适合测量数据的，并且数值方案通过显式网格收敛研究进行了验证。在配套论文（论文 II）中，直接求解延迟积分方程，无需局部重构，并且两个独立的数值解显示一致。

articles.title: Impact of Torque Ripple Induced Angular Oscillations on Maxwell Pressure Harmonics in Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Machines
articles.title_zh: 扭矩脉动引起的角振荡对永磁同步电机中麦克斯韦压力谐波的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Torque ripple in electrical machines is a wellknown source of noise and vibration. While numerous studies focus on control strategies to mitigate this ripple, the feedback mechanism by which the resulting mechanical oscillations influence the electromagnetic forces remains less explored. This paper presents a detailed investigation into the impact of torque ripple on the rotor angular dynamics and the subsequent generation of new harmonics in the Maxwell pressure distribution. We first develop an analytical model for a rigid rotor subjected to a single torque harmonic, revealing the inherently non-linear nature of the angular response. This analysis demonstrates the creation of new harmonics in the rotor motion and a slight reduction in the mean rotational speed. The study is then extended to a flexible rotor model incorporating torsional modes, solved using the Finite Element Method. Finally, we introduce a strongly coupled magneto-mechanical model, based on the subdomain method, to quantify how these rotor oscillations modulate the air-gap magnetic field. The results show a new modulated spatio-temporal harmonic distribution in the Maxwell pressure spectrum, which is not predicted by conventional uncoupled models. These findings are crucial for high-fidelity Noise, Vibration, and Harshness (NVH) analysis, as these additional pressure waves can excite stator structural modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 电机中的扭矩脉动是众所周知的噪声和振动源。尽管许多研究都集中在减轻这种纹波的控制策略上，但对由此产生的机械振荡影响电磁力的反馈机制的探索仍然较少。本文详细研究了扭矩脉动对转子角动力学的影响以及随后在麦克斯韦压力分布中产生的新谐波。我们首先开发了一个受单一扭矩谐波影响的刚性转子的分析模型，揭示了角度响应固有的非线性本质。该分析证明了转子运动中新谐波的产生以及平均转速的轻微降低。然后，该研究扩展到包含扭转模式的柔性转子模型，并使用有限元法求解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电机中的扭矩脉动是众所周知的噪声和振动源。尽管许多研究都集中在减轻这种纹波的控制策略上，但对由此产生的机械振荡影响电磁力的反馈机制的探索仍然较少。本文详细研究了扭矩脉动对转子角动力学的影响以及随后在麦克斯韦压力分布中产生的新谐波。我们首先开发了一个受单一扭矩谐波影响的刚性转子的分析模型，揭示了角度响应固有的非线性本质。该分析证明了转子运动中新谐波的产生以及平均转速的轻微降低。然后，该研究扩展到包含扭转模式的柔性转子模型，并使用有限元法求解。最后，我们引入了基于子域方法的强耦合磁力模型，以量化这些转子振荡如何调制气隙磁场。结果显示了麦克斯韦压力谱中新的调制时空谐波分布，这是传统的非耦合模型无法预测的。这些发现对于高保真噪声、振动和声振粗糙度 (NVH) 分析至关重要，因为这些额外的压力波可以激发定子结构模式。

articles.title: Space weather dependence of decameter-scale ionospheric irregularities spatial distribution
articles.title_zh: 十米级电离层不规则空间分布的空间天气依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper describes an approach to constructing nowcast and forecast predictive models for the occurrence of high-latitude decameter ionospheric irregularities based on SuperDARN and SECIRA radar data and space weather parameters. The method relies on self-learning pattern recognition in the dynamics of space weather parameters, that influence the irregularities formation. The proposed approach is a data-driven, multiscale method in which the spatial distribution of irregularities is approximated using a neural network of an original architecture, inspired by graph neural networks. The model was trained and tested using data from 11 radars during the period 2010-2025 (SuperDARN: CVW, ICE, ICW, INV, PGR, PYK, RKN, SAS, STO; SECIRA: EKB, MAGW). It is shown that the model achieves optimal performance when using geomagnetic coordinates MLT,MLAT. The optimal set of parameters for the best nowcast and forecast over studied set of parameters is a combination of geomagnetic and solar disturbance indices (aₚ, Kₚ, AE, F10.7) from ground-based observations, and satellite-measured solar wind and interplanetary magnetic field parameters (Pₛw, Eₛw, widetildeBz, Tₛw). Hourly mean values for all the parameters were used in the analysis. The results indicate that acceptable forecast quality is achieved with a lead time of up to 7-9 hours, with the highest quality reached for nowcast (zero lead time). It is shown that the parameters widetildeBz and F10.7 are significant for nowcasting only and can be neglected for other lead times. It is shown that AE and Tₛw are significant for mid-term forecast (textgreater 2hours ahead) and can be neglected for short-term predictions. Statistical relationships between the maximum latitude of the equatorial boundary of the irregularities and space weather parameters are also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一种基于 SuperDARN 和 SECIRA 雷达数据和空间天气参数构建高纬十米电离层不规则现象的临近预报和预报预测模型的方法。该方法依赖于影响不规则形成的空间天气参数动态的自学习模式识别。所提出的方法是一种数据驱动的多尺度方法，其中受图神经网络的启发，使用原始架构的神经网络来近似不规则性的空间分布。该模型使用 2010-2025 年期间 11 个雷达的数据进行训练和测试（SuperDARN：CVW、ICE、ICW、INV、PGR、PYK、RKN、SAS、STO；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文描述了一种基于 SuperDARN 和 SECIRA 雷达数据和空间天气参数构建高纬十米电离层不规则现象的临近预报和预报预测模型的方法。该方法依赖于影响不规则形成的空间天气参数动态的自学习模式识别。所提出的方法是一种数据驱动的多尺度方法，其中受图神经网络的启发，使用原始架构的神经网络来近似不规则性的空间分布。该模型使用 2010-2025 年期间 11 个雷达的数据进行训练和测试（SuperDARN：CVW、ICE、ICW、INV、PGR、PYK、RKN、SAS、STO；SECIRA：EKB、MAGW）。结果表明，当使用地磁坐标MLT、MLAT时，模型达到最佳性能。在研究的参数组中，最佳临近预报和预报的最佳参数组是来自地面观测的地磁和太阳扰动指数（aₚ、Kₚ、AE、F10.7）以及卫星测量的太阳风和行星际磁场参数（Pₛw、Eₛw、widetildeBz、Tₛw）的组合。分析中使用了所有参数的每小时平均值。结果表明，在长达 7-9 小时的提前时间内即可实现可接受的预报质量，其中临近预报的质量达到最高（零提前时间）。结果表明，参数 WidetildeBz 和 F10.7 仅对临近预报有意义，对于其他提前期可以忽略不计。结果表明，AE 和 Tₛw 对于中期预测（文本提前 2 小时）显着，而对于短期预测可以忽略不计。还讨论了不规则现象赤道边界最大纬度与空间天气参数之间的统计关系。

articles.title: Consistent Modeling of SEI Growth via Electron Diffusion Validated Across Diverse Cell Specifications and Operating Conditions in LFP/Graphite Cells
articles.title_zh: 通过电子扩散对 SEI 生长进行一致建模，并在 LFP/石墨电池的不同电池规格和操作条件下进行验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding and predicting degradation in lithium-ion batteries is critical for their widespread deployment. The continuous growth of the solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) remains a dominant aging pathway, yet accurately modeling its kinetics across diverse cell specifications and operating conditions remains a significant challenge. Here, we present and validate a physically grounded SEI growth model mediated by the electron diffusion mechanism. This framework intrinsically captures the state of charge (SOC) dependence of degradation through the impact of the anode potential on the electron concentration, which governs the rate of SEI growth. The presented model explicitly accounts for variations in electrolyte salt, anode material, temperature, and cycling rate. Validation against experimental aging data for LFP/graphite cells demonstrates high predictive accuracy across a broad range of cell specifications and cycling conditions, including confined SOC windows, electrolyte salts (LiFSI, LiPF6), artificial graphites (AGC, AGD), temperatures (40-70degC), and C-rates (C/20-1C). Remarkably, a single, consistent set of parameters is applied to simulate the capacity fade for all experiments without recalibration. While quantitative overestimations occur during high-SOC storage periods, the framework consistently captures the observed degradation trends. Our findings underscore that lower SOC operation mitigates degradation, establishing a physics-based model for predicting long-term lithium-ion battery aging.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解和预测锂离子电池的退化对于其广泛部署至关重要。固体电解质界面（SEI）的持续生长仍然是主要的老化途径，但在不同的电池规格和操作条件下准确建模其动力学仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们提出并验证了由电子扩散机制介导的物理接地 SEI 生长模型。该框架通过阳极电位对电子浓度的影响本质上捕获了退化的荷电状态 (SOC) 依赖性，电子浓度控制着 SEI 的生长速率。所提出的模型明确地解释了电解质盐、阳极材料、温度和循环速率的变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解和预测锂离子电池的退化对于其广泛部署至关重要。固体电解质界面（SEI）的持续生长仍然是主要的老化途径，但在不同的电池规格和操作条件下准确建模其动力学仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们提出并验证了由电子扩散机制介导的物理接地 SEI 生长模型。该框架通过阳极电位对电子浓度的影响本质上捕获了退化的荷电状态 (SOC) 依赖性，电子浓度控制着 SEI 的生长速率。所提出的模型明确地解释了电解质盐、阳极材料、温度和循环速率的变化。针对 LFP/石墨电池的实验老化数据进行的验证表明，在各种电池规格和循环条件下，包括受限的 SOC 窗口、电解质盐（LiFSI、LiPF6）、人造石墨（AGC、AGD）、温度（40-70degC）和 C 速率（C/20-1C），预测准确性很高。值得注意的是，应用一组一致的参数来模拟所有实验的容量衰减，而无需重新校准。虽然在高 SOC 存储期间会出现定量高估，但该框架始终如一地捕捉到观察到的退化趋势。我们的研究结果强调，较低的 SOC 运行可减轻退化，建立基于物理的模型来预测长期锂离子电池老化。

articles.title: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting molecular electronic structure using Quantum Computing approaches is a challenge in Computational Chemistry. Traditional Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQEs) are typically hindered by optimization challenges. The alternative Generative Quantum Eigensolver (GQE) mitigates this by reformulating ground-state search as discrete sequence generation, but its Transformer backbone suffers from quadratic computational complexity, bottlenecking scalability for larger molecules. To address this, we introduce the Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (Mamba-QE), which replaces the Transformer with a Selective State Space Model (SSM) to process operator sequences with linear O(L) complexity. Additionally, we integrate a distance-conditioned mechanism enabling the direct prediction of complete potential energy surfaces (PES). Evaluated on the H₂ molecule, Mamba-QE reproduces Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) reference energies well within chemical accuracy, achieving an energy error below 3×10⁻⁶ Ha across 16 geometries with zero variational violations. Mamba-QE maintains high expressive power while establishing a robust, scalable foundation for quantum simulations of complex molecular systems.

articles.title: Broadband Mid-Wave Infrared Imaging Enabled by All-Silicon Hyperboloid Metalens
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The mid-wave infrared (MWIR, 3-5 microns) is indispensable for thermal sensing, gas detection, long-range imaging, and free-space optical communications. Meta-optics offer a compact, lightweight, and potentially low-cost alternative to conventional refractive optics, making them attractive for size, weight, and power (SWaP)-constrained systems. However, their strong chromatic dispersion has largely restricted imaging to narrow spectral bands. Here, we demonstrate broadband imaging across the full 3-5 micron MWIR band using a single-layer silicon metasurface coupled with computational reconstruction. Remarkably, the reconstruction model is adapted using only four image captures, overcoming large training data requirements and enabling broadband image recovery despite the strongly wavelength-dependent optical response. In contrast to approaches that engineer complex, dispersion-optimized metalens profiles for broadband operation, our method leverages the wavelength-dependent information encoded by a simple 2cm diameter hyperboloid metalens. We show that this metasurface captures sufficient broadband intensity information for computational reconstruction across the entire MWIR band. These results establish a simple route toward broadband computational meta-optics without requiring broadband achromatic metalens designs, offering a promising platform for compact MWIR imaging systems.

articles.title: Differentiated Determinant Graphs Enable Large-Scale Multideterminant Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29851v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multideterminant trial wave functions can reduce phaseless bias in auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (AFQMC), but the repeated evaluation of their overlap, force bias, and local energy restricts systematic trial improvement. In this work, we organize particle--hole excitation determinants as a shared arithmetic directed acyclic graph of canonical minors. A coefficient-weighted reverse pass and batched directional passes evaluate the complete estimator without determinant-resolved cofactor tensors while preserving the sparse α--β coefficient coupling exactly. Controlled complex-valued tests verify the complete kernel to machine precision and show orders-of-magnitude acceleration over direct determinant summation. In molecular calculations, the observed cost remains sublinear through million-configuration selected-CI trials and the same estimator remains usable at one hundred million configurations, where the eventual exact coefficient-contraction boundary becomes visible. For Cr₂, an orbital-optimized CAS(12e,42o) trial in a double-ζ basis yields a potential-energy curve (PEC) and spectroscopic constants in close agreement with experiment. Differentiated determinant graphs therefore convert very large correlated trials from a formal accuracy hierarchy into a practical route for systematic AFQMC studies of strongly correlated molecules.

articles.title: Tractable Inference with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning surrogates in computational science often require not only accurate predictions but also expectations, variances, conserved integrals, and normalization constants. Conventional neural networks, including Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs), generally evaluate these quantities through Monte Carlo sampling or multidimensional quadrature, making repeated inference costly, particularly in high dimensions. We introduce KANs with Tractable Operators for Uncertainty and Constraints (TOUCKANs), whose finite-degree polynomial outer functions yield a decomposable sum--product representation. Under factorizing input measures, expectations and higher moments then reduce algebraically to deterministic recursions over one-dimensional leaf integrals. Independent and shared inner-block variants form a parameter-efficiency hierarchy, and a universal-approximation proof for its most restricted member extends to the complete class. The same deterministic operators allow conserved integrals and normalization to be imposed throughout training. Across uniform and Gaussian benchmarks through 50 dimensions, deterministic mean and variance errors remained below the median fixed-budget Monte Carlo errors in every case. TOUCKANs also conserved Cahn--Hilliard mass to machine precision and imposed normalization and orthogonality through deterministic moments, enabling joint computation of the lowest four Schrödinger eigenpairs in two, three, and five dimensions. TOUCKANs therefore connect KAN approximation with tractable probabilistic circuits, making statistical operators and integral constraints directly available within an expressive neural surrogate.

articles.title: Exact nonsymmetric vacuum magnetic field with nested toroidal flux surfaces and nonzero rotational transform
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that an exact vacuum magnetic field without continuous Euclidean symmetry can fill a bounded solid torus with nested toroidal flux surfaces and nonzero rotational transform. We construct such a field in closed form and show that it is nowhere vanishing. Every off-axis field line closes after one toroidal transit and one poloidal turn, with rotational transform ι=-1 on every flux surface. The solution provides an exact benchmark for three-dimensional equilibrium codes.

articles.title: DiffVortex: A quantum-inspired fast solver for incompressible flows
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Matrix-product-state (MPS) and quantized tensor-train (QTT) representations offer a promising framework for computational fluid dynamics, with logarithmic run time and memory scaling in mesh size when bond dimensions remain bounded. Existing MPS-based solvers are Eulerian: they compress velocity fields and enforce immersed-body boundary conditions through static masks or body-fitted coordinates. Moving or flexible bodies complicate this approach: deformation requires updating MPS masks every time step, while filamentary vorticity in high-Reynolds-number flows may resist low-rank compression. We propose a complementary approach: compress the Biot--Savart kernel rather than the flow state, evolve vorticity using Lagrangian vortex particles, and represent immersed bodies by bound vortex sheets on Lagrangian surface points. Our main theoretical result is a lifting theorem: QTT rank r of the kernel implies matrix-product-operator (MPO) rank at most 2^d r for the corresponding convolution operator in d dimensions, independent of grid resolution. This bound is sharp for our interleaved ordering. With quantics tensor cross interpolation, the moment-to-local stage of a single-level fast multipole method becomes a precomputed tensor-network contraction with quasi-linear complexity, retaining Lagrangian flexibility for immersed bodies. Our PyTorch implementation (textttDiffVortex) is end-to-end differentiable, runs on GPUs, and handles 6.7×10⁷ particles on a single device. We validate against reference vortex-method results for an impulsively started cylinder and exact and reference solutions for inviscid elliptical vortices. We also demonstrate two-dimensional flows past rigidly moving, multiple, and deforming bodies, including gradients propagated through the full time integration.

articles.title: An Implicit Conservative Finite Volume Scheme with Poisson Brackets for the Steady-State Transport of Galactic Cosmic Rays
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30091v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Galactic cosmic rays (GCRs) pose a persistent radiation hazard to astronauts and spacecraft in the heliosphere. Modeling their transport is essential for understanding how the solar wind and heliospheric magnetic field shape their spatial distributions and energy spectra. Timely predictions require solving for the particle distribution function much faster than real time, but explicit numerical schemes are restricted by the stability limit on the time step. In this Letter, we present an implicit conservative finite-volume scheme for kinetic equations formulated with Poisson brackets. This scheme conserves particle number, maintains the total-variation-diminishing property, achieves second-order spatial accuracy, and remains stable for time steps far beyond the explicit limit, while reaching quasi-steady states in less than ~1/100 of the computational time required for the explicit scheme, as demonstrated by numerical tests. We apply this scheme to the Parker transport equation along magnetic field lines in the background solar wind during Carrington rotation 2211, where it reaches steady-state GCR distributions within 10 iterations, about 1000 times faster than the explicit scheme. The GCR proton spectrum averaged over 27 days agrees with AMS-02 measurements to within 10%. The simulation also yields a realistic radial intensity gradient and captures the Forbush decrease features associated with three stream interaction regions observed at Earth.

articles.title: Semiclassical molecular dynamics simulations of electromagnetically induced transparency cooling of 2D and 3D ion crystals in a Penning trap
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29718v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motional modes of trapped-ion crystals in Penning traps can now be cooled to near their ground states via electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) cooling. Numerical simulations are valuable tools for interpreting EIT cooling results and optimizing experimental protocols, but existing molecular dynamics codes are limited to the simulation of Doppler cooling. In this work, we fill this gap by implementing a semiclassical model of EIT cooling in a novel MD code. By simultaneously evolving the ions' internal quantum states and classical motion, we are able to calculate the instantaneous EIT laser forces acting on the ions. We first validate our code by comparing the single-ion cooling rate to fully quantum simulation results. Next, we analyze cooling of the drumhead modes in planar ion crystals, quantifying the effects of planar ion motion and a finite laser beam width. Finally, we demonstrate efficient EIT cooling of the axial modes in 3D ellipsoidal crystals containing up to 500 ions. Such crystals are a promising platform for future quantum sensing experiments with enhanced sensitivity. We find that the mode spectra of 3D crystals can be engineered to enable sympathetic cooling of the low-frequency boldsymbolE×boldsymbolB modes. This numerical framework provides a powerful tool for modeling sub-Doppler cooling techniques and for optimizing future quantum sensing and quantum information experiments.

articles.title: Conservation in Every Quantum Measurement Outcome?
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29804v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In quantum mechanics, conservation laws are usually understood only statistically and only in the context of unitary evolution: during such evolution, if an observable commutes with the Hamiltonian, its expectation value and Born-rule probability distribution remain unchanged. Individual measurement outcomes, however, disrupt even this weak form of statistical conservation. Recently, though, it has been argued that a stronger, non-statistical form of conservation, valid at the level of individual measurement outcomes, can be recovered. The proposal relies on the claim that any superposition of eigenstates of a conserved quantity must ultimately be prepared relative to another physical system, which serves as the relevant reference frame and remains correlated with the system being prepared. On this enlarged description, the change observed in the measured system is claimed to be exactly compensated by an opposite change in the preparer, thereby restoring conservation at the level of individual measurement outcomes. We analyze this proposal and argue that it faces significant conceptual difficulties. We show that the proposed mechanism is not adequately justified and, moreover, does not establish conservation in individual measurement outcomes as claimed.

articles.title: Adaptive cut reveals multiscale complexity in networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.08741v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hierarchical clustering and community detection are important problems in machine learning and complex network analysis. A common approach to identify clusters is to simply cut dendrograms at some threshold. However, single-level cuts are often suboptimal in terms of capturing underlying structure in the data, especially when the dendrogram is unbalanced. In this paper, we present the adaptive cut, a novel method that leverages the hierarchical structure of dendrograms by employing multi-level cuts to overcome the limitations of single-level approaches. The adaptive cut optimizes an objective function using a Markov chain Monte Carlo with simulated annealing, resulting in better partitions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the adaptive cut through applications to link clustering and modularity optimization, but note that the method is applicable to any clustering task that relies on a dendrogram and an objective function. Beyond the adaptive cut, we introduce the balancedness score, an information-theoretic metric that quantifies how balanced a dendrogram is. Balancedness predicts the potential benefits of using multi-level cuts. For the community detection examples, we evaluate our method on more than 200 real-world networks and multiple synthetic datasets, demonstrating significant improvements in partition density and modularity over traditional single-cut approaches. In addition, we show the generality of the adaptive cut by applying it across various hierarchical clustering techniques and objective functions. Our results indicate that the adaptive cut provides a robust and versatile tool for improving clustering outcomes.

articles.title: Hybrid ensemble forecasting combining physics-based and machine-learning predictions through spectral nudging
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05570v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present the first application of spectral nudging in a probabilistic ensemble forecasting framework, combining the physics-based ECMWF Integrated Forecasting System ensemble (IFS-ENS) with forecasts from the probabilistic machine-learned AIFS-ENS ensemble. Large scales of virtual temperature and vorticity are relaxed toward the machine-learned forecasts, while mesoscale structures remain governed by the physics-based model. This hybrid ensemble shows substantial improvements in large-scale forecast skill, with gains in predictive skill extended by up to two days in the tropics and by approximately half a day in the extra-tropics relative to IFS-ENS. Despite nudging being applied only to upper-air fields, improvements are also found in several near-surface parameters. Tropical cyclone track forecasts improve significantly, consistent with improved representation of the large-scale steering flow, without degrading storm intensity or ensemble spread. These results demonstrate that spectral nudging can be successfully extended to ensemble prediction and provide an attractive pathway for combining machine-learned and physics-based weather prediction systems.

articles.title: Nonlinear spectral back transfer limits the temporal coherency of zonal modes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.03421v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Zonal modes are central to magnetic confinement because their radial shears regulate turbulence and transport. While the generation of these flows is well understood, the mechanisms limiting their persistence in collisionless regimes remain unresolved. In this paper, we demonstrate that nonlinear spectral back-transfer of free energy from zonal modes to turbulence is a major nonlinear process that limits the temporal coherency of the shearing field. Back-transfer events induce stochastic phase and amplitude scattering of zonal shear that limits its auto-coherence time. Using local gyrokinetic GENE simulations for collisionless electrostatic ion temperature gradient (ITG) driven turbulence with adiabatic electrons for parameters representative of core conditions, we show that back-transfer is highly intermittent and occurs in bursts that co-exist with the zonal flow generation process. The probability distribution of the zonal free energy transfer is non-Gaussian, with positive triangularity (PT) exhibiting substantially higher kurtosis than negative triangularity (NT), reflecting the markedly more intermittent and heavy-tailed character of back-transfer bursts in PT. We find that NT plasmas exhibit significantly reduced back-transfer compared to PT. This suppression increases the shear auto-coherence time τE and the shearing Kubo number Kᵤ, leading to more resilient and effective turbulence regulation despite lower absolute zonal kinetic energy. These results identify back-transfer as a key nonlinear damping mechanism and suggest that it must be explicitly treated in reduced models of drift-wave zonal-flow turbulence.

articles.title: Closing the Loop in Epitaxy with Machine Learning: Joint Optimization of Growth and Geometry in On-Chip Lasers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.08390v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Achieving device-to-device reproducibility is a critical bottleneck for scalable photonic integrated circuits, as subtle variations in bottom-up epitaxial growth and fabrication severely limit yield. We present a machine learning workflow for III-V multi-quantum well microring lasers that first optimizes growth and geometry parameters via multi-objective Bayesian optimization, then leverages variational autoencoders (VAEs) to attribute residual device-to-device variability to its underlying sources. By explicitly targeting threshold variance alongside absolute performance, we demonstrate 100% lasing yield across all designs. The optimized multi-quantum well microring laser fields achieved a median lasing threshold of 16~muJ,cm⁻²,pulse⁻¹, a 73% reduction in threshold variance relative to the previously reported best values, and a median emission wavelength of 1333~nm, in the telecommunications O-band. Furthermore, to diagnose residual performance dispersion under nominally identical conditions, VAEs were used to isolate the key components of device morphology that impact performance. This analysis successfully decoupled geometric from material disorder, quantitatively linking previously unmeasured morphological variations to population-level threshold fluctuations. This data-driven workflow bridges the gap between fundamental epitaxy and reliable manufacturing, establishing a generalizable blueprint for designing and yield-optimizing complex, non-linear optoelectronic devices.

articles.title: Gravitational Redshift of Light and the Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.09662v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Empirical observations together with theoretical analyses are being used to argue that the classical phenomenon of gravitational redshift -- namely, the redshift of light in a static gravitational potential -- may be in tension with the Heisenberg uncertainty principle. In particular, in the Pound-Rebka experiment, the emitter-absorber pair interact with each other by exchanging a Mossbauer photon, a process that is fully describable within quantum mechanics but how the photon interacts with the spacetime metric remains unclear. Since the uncertainty principle is incompatible with local realism, as per general relativity, we propose to study continuous-variable photonic entanglement within the Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen (EPR) framework in a weak gravitational field. We outline a thought experiment, realizable on the surface of the Earth, that could shed further light on this problematic seamline between general relativity and quantum mechanics in the weak-field regime.

articles.title: Frequency Attraction and Repulsion in Lasers with Complex Mutual Coupling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.20132v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We experimentally investigate laser synchronization under complex mutual coupling, featuring both dissipative and dispersive components. Using a reconfigurable digital degenerate cavity laser with precise control over system parameters, we show that complex coupling can induce both frequency attraction and repulsion, in contrast to common models of coupled oscillators. Furthermore, we show that these frequency shifts can be exploited to significantly enhance global synchronization in multi-laser arrays. Comparison with numerical and theoretical results indicate that amplitude dynamics of complex coupled lasers play an important role in the observed phenomena. Our results establish a versatile platform for exploring non-Hermitian physics and topological states in tailored laser networks.

articles.title: Adaptive Entangled Neurons in the Brain and Natural Intelligence Simulations for Artificial General Intelligence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09226v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding the brain's mechanisms is crucial in neuroscience, particularly for simulating natural intelligence and advancing artificial general intelligence (AGI). Liu et al. (2024) and Deco et al. (2025) propose that quantum entanglement may underlie the synchronization of millions of neurons, introducing the Liu-Chen-Ao (LCA) hypothesis of entangled nerve fibers. However, directly testing this idea remains challenging. Here we employ a nonlocal many-body wave equation, introducing a generalized probability-wave framework to model collective behaviors among adaptive, interacting agents, particles, or neurons. This approach enables testable eigenmodes, offering an indirect means of examining the LCA hypothesis by observing patterns in collective trading behaviors. These patterns, rooted in behavioral psychology, are thought to mirror the internal brain's decision-making and underlying mechanisms. Our analysis of Chinese intraday stock market data shows that adaptive entangled game modes explain 82%-94% of decision patterns, sharply contrasting neoclassical finance predictions assuming independent rational agents. Additionally, 2-12% of actions adapt to news, events, and environmental changes, marked by rapid equilibrium shifts, while truly independent behaviors make up less than 5%.
