articles.title: macroqc 2.0: An electronic structure theory software for large-scale applications
articles.abstract: macroqc is a quantum chemistry software package designed for high-accuracy electronic structure computations and large-scale molecular simulations. The macroqc framework provides efficient implementations of energies and analytic gradients for a wide range of many-body perturbation theory and coupled-cluster (CC) methods. In particular, the analytic gradient implementations of second-order Møller–Plesset perturbation theory (MP2), coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD), and CCSD with perturbative triples [CCSD(T)] exhibit excellent computational performance, even in comparison with established commercial quantum chemistry programs. In addition to conventional correlated methods, macroqc incorporates several advanced capabilities, including molecular fragmentation techniques for ground and excited state molecular systems and density-fitted analytic gradients. The software also supports interoperability with selected external packages through a flexible plugin framework, allowing developers to construct customized interfaces and extensions. The notable features of macroqc are the linear-scaling systematic molecular fragmentation (LSSMF) and the cluster-in-molecule (CIM) approaches, which enable the application of high-level post-Hartree–Fock approaches to large molecular systems that would otherwise be computationally prohibitive. Furthermore, the new machine learning (ML) library enables the integration of data-driven approaches into quantum chemical workflows, providing efficient tools for developing and applying ML-based models for molecular property prediction and electronic structure computations. With its combination of efficient implementations, advanced theoretical methods, and extensible design, macroqc is expected to serve as a useful platform for a broad range of computational chemistry applications.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Probing the potential for anti-Kasha behavior through direct measurements of S 2 lifetimes in xanthione and thioxanthone
articles.abstract: Several examples of “anti-Kasha” emission from higher excited electronic states (S n , n ≥ 2) have been reported recently for a variety of aromatic organic molecules. Even a modest suppression of the fast S n → S 1 internal conversion expected from the energy gap law, which underlies typical Kasha behavior, would have many advantages in photochemistry and in the development of photonic materials. Thus, it seems important to reassess the extent and reliability of the energy gap law. Here, we apply ultrafast spectroscopy and quantum chemical calculations to measure and interpret the S 2 relaxation times of a pair of structurally similar molecules, thioxanthone and xanthione. Our measurements broadly agree with earlier literature data, and the calculations suggest very different S 2 relaxation dynamics in these chromophores. The data are placed in the context of the energy gap law, which is found to work well for these and other planar aromatics regardless of the ππ * or nπ * character of the excited states involved. More flexible molecules placed on the energy gap law plot show enhanced rates of internal conversion. This reaffirmation of the broad applicability of the energy gap law suggests that where a molecule exhibits unexpectedly large “anti-Kasha” emission that result must be discussed in terms of particular features of vibronic coupling in that molecule.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Information content is a general-purpose collective variable for enhanced sampling
articles.abstract: Enhanced sampling methods typically require predefined collective variables (CVs) that presuppose knowledge of reaction coordinates, restricting the discovery of unanticipated transition mechanisms or intermediates. Here, we show that a local measure of information content in atomistic systems is a general-purpose CV for rare event sampling across molecular and condensed-phase systems. The method biases simulations toward information-changing configurations following a well-tempered metadynamics approach, thus balancing novelty and thermodynamic accessibility. Blind exploration of potential energy surfaces enables unsupervised discovery of metastable basins and reaction pathways, including competing transition channels inaccessible to conventional order parameters. We demonstrate the generality of the method across five systems spanning conformational sampling, homogeneous nucleation, glass formation, and solid-state phase transformations. Our approach uncovers non-classical phase transformation mechanisms despite its focus on general information theoretical quantities rather than kinetic or thermodynamic factors.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Introducing Vmol software: A highly parallelized multi-purpose DFT program based on real-space grid formalism
articles.abstract: We present a review of “Vmol,” a highly parallelized, multi-purpose density functional theory (DFT) software based on a real-space grid formalism. By utilizing higher-order finite difference methods and nonlocal pseudopotentials, “Vmol” serves as a versatile and computationally robust platform for Kohn–Sham DFT calculations. By virtue of the hybrid parallel implementation (message passing interface/OpenMP), it delivers high performance on massively parallel computers integrating many processors. In the development of these several decades, “Vmol” offered marked adaptability as an electronic structure program to various extensions, such as the hybrid Quantum Mechanical (QM)/Molecular Mechanical (MM) approach and its combination with a theory of solutions (QM/MM-energy representation) based on statistical mechanics. We provide brief reviews of these methods as well as the important results obtained by their applications. “Vmol” was also utilized to implement kinetic energy and static correlation functionals formulated within the novel framework of DFT. The outline of the method will also be reviewed.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Unraveling the electronic structure of 2-cyanonaphthalene: A cosmic PAH
articles.abstract: The recent astronomical detection of 2-cyanonaphthalene in Taurus Molecular Cloud-1 has highlighted the importance of substituted polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in astrochemistry. Here, we present a combined experimental and theoretical study of the electronic absorption spectrum of 2-cyanonaphthalene in the ultraviolet (UV) and vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) regions (3.7–10.8 eV). Photoabsorption spectra in the UV region 3.7–4.9 eV are recorded in an n-hexane solvent at room temperature. Gas-phase photoabsorption spectra and absolute cross sections are measured at 343 K using synchrotron radiation in the VUV region (5.1–10.8 eV). Analysis supported by TDDFT calculations reveals that the UV region is dominated by valence π * ← π transitions, while the VUV region contains extensive Rydberg series converging to the first three ionization potentials. The strongest absorption band, arising from the HOMO–LUMO transition, peaks at 224 nm, close to the 217.5 nm interstellar extinction bump, suggesting that 2-CNN may contribute to this astrophysical feature. A well-resolved vibronic structure is observed throughout the spectrum. Franck–Condon simulations including the Herzberg–Teller effect for the S 1 , S 2 , and S 5 states reproduce the experimental spectra and identify the dominant progressions as arising from various C–H bending modes. Temperature-dependent simulations (15–500 K) of vibronic bands are used to study changes in spectral profile across various temperatures. Potential energy curves of singlet and triplet excited states with respect to C–H and C–CN bond lengths provide insights into the photostability of 2-cyanonaphthalene. The spectroscopic data and theoretical simulations presented here provide valuable inputs for understanding the photophysics and astrochemical evolution of 2-cyanonaphthalene.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Physically motivated iso-orbital indicator for meta-GGA exchange functionals
articles.abstract: The iso-orbital indicator α = ( τ − τ vW )/ τ UEG is a key ingredient of meta-generalized gradient approximation (meta-GGA) functionals but diverges in low-density tails, causing unphysical exchange potentials and systematic bandgap errors as noted in Bartók and Yates [J. Chem. Phys. 150 , 161101 (2019)]. We replace the denominator of α with a physically motivated Pauli kinetic energy density drawn from the orbital-free density functional theory literature, eliminating the divergence in the low density atomic tail without any empirical regularization parameter. Testing two such enhancement factors, LKT and PGS, within the r 2 SCAN and MS2 exchange functionals, we find that the modified indicators suppress spurious oscillations in the semilocal exchange potential and restore correct electron localization in atomic tails. For a ten-member cubic semiconductor benchmark, the bandgap mean absolute error is reduced by 41.1% for r 2 SCAN@PGS and 48.8% for MS2@PGS, while cohesive energy accuracy is largely preserved. The consistent improvement across two functionals with distinct constructions confirms a physical rather than functional specific origin and motivates further development of meta-GGA functionals with constraint satisfying iso-orbital indicators.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: A cross-species comparison of excitation energy transfer in red-lineage photosystem I
articles.abstract: The photosystem I supercomplex (PSI) is a central component of photosynthesis in plants and algae. Its antenna subunits absorb light and transfer the excitation energy through an interconnected pigment network to the reaction center (RC), where it is converted to chemical energy. Although the excitation energy transfer (EET) in photosystems has been well characterized for individual organisms, evolutionary variation and inconsistent modeling settings have obscured cross-species comparisons, and it remains unclear which common structural features sustain EET efficiency. To address this, we combined kinetic modeling and rate theories to simulate EET processes in multiple red-lineage PSI complexes, each consisting of hundreds of chlorophylls, using the same set of experiment-derived parameters. We performed network analysis to probe how their EET processes respond to structural variation across distinct species. The exciton becomes increasingly delocalized as it approaches the core region of the PSI complexes. This, together with a radial site-energy bias, creates a strong exciton energy gradient (EEG) that funnels the exciton to the RC. However, the EEG is effective only over a limited distance range from the core region. In large PSI complexes, the pigments farther from the RC are weakly coupled, and the efficiency of long-range EET is maintained by additional features that complement the EEG, such as the pigment composition in the peripheral regions of the antenna, which also broadens the energy range of light absorption. By comparing red-lineage PSI complexes with a common parameter set, we provide a framework for relating EET to structural rearrangements in the pigment network.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Translation–rotation internal coordinates with splicing (TRICS): A new approach to molecular geometry interpolation
articles.abstract: We present TRICS (Translation–Rotation Internal Coordinates with Splicing), a novel internal-coordinate-based interpolation method for generating high-quality approximations to minimum energy pathways. Non-redundant internal coordinate (IC) systems can be used to generate chemically reasonable interpolated pathways between reactant and product structures, but it may fail for regions of configuration space where the IC system becomes numerically ill-defined. TRICS overcomes this limitation using multiple IC systems to generate separate interpolated paths that are iteratively spliced together into one continuous and smooth trajectory. We benchmarked the new method on 679 chemically diverse reactions, demonstrating excellent performance in generating interpolated pathways close to optimized transition-state structures. We further demonstrate the utility of TRICS for generating smooth and barrier-free interpolated pathways between critical points on excited-state potential energy surfaces. TRICS is available from the open-source geomeTRIC package.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: High magnetic moments in small rhodium-doped neutral cobalt clusters
articles.abstract: In the search for new magnetic materials, few atom metal clusters are of great interest because they can posses greatly enhanced magnetic moments with respect to bulk moments per atom. This is particularly the case for bimetallic transition metal clusters. Here, we report on the magnetism of Co n Rh m (n = 10–45 and m = 0–3) neutral clusters studied in molecular beam experiments using a combination of Stern–Gerlach magnetic deflection and mass spectrometry. Large dopant-induced and size-dependent increases in the total magnetic moment of the clusters were found, of up to 10% per added rhodium atom in the n = 15–30 size range. Density functional theory calculations indicate significant induced local spin magnetic moments on the rhodium atoms but fail to predict systematic enhancement of the spin magnetic moments on the cobalt atoms. The observed large enhancement of magnetic moments suggests an important role of orbital contributions.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Efficient and reliable modeling of large π -electron systems with the Pariser–Parr–Pople Hamiltonian and pCCD-based methods
articles.abstract: Model Hamiltonians offer a cost-effective way to capture the key physics of large π -conjugated systems. In this study, we combine the Pariser–Parr–Pople (PPP) model Hamiltonian with pair Coupled Cluster Doubles (pCCD)-based methods to study the excited-state electronic structures of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). The model Hamiltonian is implemented in the open-source PyBEST software package, which provides numerous pCCD-type models that have been shown to perform well for the electronic structure properties of large organic molecules when combined with quantum-chemical Hamiltonians and all-electron basis sets. Within the PPP model, we probe canonical Hartree–Fock and natural pCCD-optimized orbitals in predicting excited-state properties using the linear response formalism on top of pCCD. Their performance is compared with configuration-interaction-based methods and the conventional equation of motion coupled cluster singles and doubles (EOM-CCSD) approach. Our study demonstrates that pCCD/PPP-based approaches are an efficient, cost-effective, and accurate framework to compute excited-state properties in large π -conjugated organic systems, such as extended PAHs or other systems relevant to organic electronics.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Deriving initial kinetic energy and longitudinal spatial distributions of charged particles from time-of-flight profiles
articles.abstract: We present strategies for using time-of-flight (TOF) profiles to derive the kinetic energy distribution (KED) and the longitudinal spatial distribution (along the flight axis) of charged particles by varying the bias voltages on the acceleration electrodes. We take advantage of the spatial-focusing condition of the Wiley–McLaren design and, by applying a low field but a relatively high average potential in the acceleration region, can separate forward- and backward-flying ions in their TOF. Using an inversion method, the KED can be derived from the TOF of either forward- or backward-flying ions, and the overall TOF profiles can be reproduced. By grounding one of the electrodes in the acceleration region, the energy gained by a charged particle from the acceleration field becomes a sensitive function of its position along the flight axis. The time spread of the particles can then be used to directly derive the position of ionization along the flight axis when the initial kinetic energy of the charged particles is much lower than the acceleration energy. On the other hand, when both the initial kinetic energy and the longitudinal spatial distributions are significant, an optimization process involving an adjustable Gaussian spatial spread function and a few functions for the speed distribution can be performed. The TOF profile generated from the spatial spread function is convoluted with the TOF profile obtained from the speed distribution, allowing the longitudinal spatial spread and the kinetic energy distributions to be determined simultaneously. Both the theoretical framework and the experimental results are presented.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Effect of Mn²⁺ Substitution on the Structural, Magnetic, and Electrical Properties of Nanocrystalline Mg₀.₂MnₓCo₀.₈₋ₓFe₂O₄ Ferrites
articles.abstract: Nanocrystalline Mg₀.₂MnₓCo₀.₈₋ₓFe₂O₄ ferrites with Mn concentrations of x = 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8 were synthesized by the citrate-assisted sol–gel auto-combustion method to systematically investigate the influence of Mn²⁺ substitution on their structural, morphological, magnetic, and electrical properties. X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns together with Rietveld refinement confirmed the formation of a cubic spinel ferrite structure without secondary phases. The structural parameters exhibited a composition-dependent evolution with Mn incorporation. The crystallite size decreased from approximately 50 to 20 nm with increasing Mn content, indicating progressive crystallite refinement, while the lattice parameter and hopping lengths showed an overall increasing tendency associated with the substitution of Co²⁺ by the comparatively larger Mn²⁺ ions and the accompanying redistribution of cations between tetrahedral and octahedral sites. Williamson–Hall analysis revealed composition-dependent microstrain, demonstrating the influence of Mn substitution on lattice distortion and defect-related structural characteristics. The calculated structural parameters, including X-ray density, dislocation density, and unit-cell volume, further established the correlation between Mn concentration and the evolution of the spinel lattice. FESEM and AFM investigations revealed nanoscale particles with composition-dependent agglomeration, surface morphology, and topographical characteristics. FTIR spectra exhibited the characteristic metal–oxygen vibrational bands associated with the tetrahedral and octahedral sites of the spinel lattice, confirming the structural framework of the synthesized ferrites. Magnetic measurements performed at 300 and 5 K demonstrated ferrimagnetic behavior for the investigated compositions. The M–H hysteresis loops showed relatively narrow loops at room temperature, whereas a pronounced increase in coercivity and remanent magnetization was observed at low temperature, reflecting enhanced magnetocrystalline anisotropy and reduced thermal fluctuations. The corresponding dM/dH curves provided further evidence of the temperature-dependent magnetic reversal mechanism. ZFC–FC magnetization measurements at different applied fields revealed significant thermomagnetic irreversibility, with stronger separation between the ZFC and FC branches at lower magnetic fields, indicating the contribution of magnetic interactions, anisotropy-energy barriers, and thermally activated spin dynamics. Impedance spectroscopy demonstrated strong frequency- and temperature-dependent electrical behavior characteristic of semiconducting ferrites. The decrease in impedance with increasing frequency and temperature suggests thermally activated charge-carrier hopping, while the broad and frequency-dependent relaxation features indicate non-Debye-type dielectric relaxation arising from the heterogeneous grain–grain-boundary structure. Among the investigated compositions, x = 0.6 exhibited particularly pronounced impedance and relaxation characteristics, suggesting enhanced grain-boundary polarization and charge-carrier localization. Overall, the results establish clear structure–morphology–magnetism–electrical property correlations induced by Mn²⁺ substitution and demonstrate that controlled compositional modification of Mg–Co ferrites provides an effective route for tailoring their magnetic anisotropy, magnetic reversal, charge transport, and relaxation behavior. The obtained multifunctional characteristics make Mg₀.₂MnₓCo₀.₈₋ₓFe₂O₄ ferrites attractive for potential applications in magnetic sensors, high-frequency devices, electromagnetic components, and related multifunctional magnetic technologies..

articles.title: Surface and pore co-functionalized ceramic membrane with Zr doped Co3O4 for SMX degradation through coupling peroxymonosulfate activation
articles.abstract: Peroxymonosulfate (PMS) based advanced oxidation has emerged as a promising strategy to decompose sulfamethoxazole (SMX). However, traditional powder catalysts commonly suffer from severe agglomeration and poor recyclability, In this work, Zr‑doped Co₃O₄ serving as an efficient PMS catalyst, was immobilized onto both surface and pore channels of an Al₂O₃ ceramic membrane, generating a dual functional CoZr@CM composite membrane. Such simultaneous surface‑pore functionalization delivers abundant accessible active sites, prolongs reactant retention duration and facilitates interfacial mass transfer. Benefiting from these merits, 97.1% SMX was degraded in optimized CoZr@CM and the first-order kinetic constant of SMX degradation was 90 times higher than that for powder catalyst. Moreover, the CoZr@CM/PMS system exhibited satisfactory removal capacity toward multiple recalcitrant organic contaminants including phenol, bisphenol A and rhodamine B. Long‑term continuous experiment demonstrated robust operational stability, with 87.5% SMX removal maintained after 17 h run time. Water‑matrix variables including solution pH and ubiquitous background anions were further evaluated for their influences on SMX degraation Quenching experiment and electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) test confirmed SO₄•⁻ as dominant species, accompanied by a small amount of •OH and 1O2. Based on the liquid chromatography mass spectrometry (LC-MS) results, three plausible degradation pathways of SMX were proposed and the trends in toxicity changes of intermediate products were analyzed. This research offers an alternative route to mitigate the application bottlenecks of powder catalysts for wastewater remediation.

articles.title: Ultra-broadband and time-resolved depolarized dynamic light scattering for probing molecular dynamics in supercooled liquids and glasses
articles.abstract: Dynamic light scattering (DLS) is a versatile technique for probing microscopic dynamics in soft condensed matter. However, applying DLS to supercooled molecular liquids and glasses demands exceptional experimental performance due to weak depolarized scattering, slow relaxation near the glass transition, and the need for quantitative comparison with complementary spectroscopic techniques. In this tutorial, we discuss how a depolarized dynamic light scattering (DDLS) setup can be tailored to meet these challenges. By combining conventional fiber-optical photon correlation spectroscopy and multispeckle photon correlation imaging with high-frequency DDLS, such a setup allows us to capture rotational dynamics across more than 20 orders of magnitude in time. We detail the experimental design required for high signal-to-noise ratios and long-term optical stability, alongside the treatment of coherence and partial heterodyning effects. As we demonstrate, after proper treatment, the different detection schemes yield the same electric-field autocorrelation function, enabling the construction of continuous, ultra-broadband DDLS datasets. Furthermore, multispeckle detection enables time-resolved correlation measurements without temporal averaging, extending DDLS to non-equilibrium systems such as aging molecular glasses. This methodology establishes a unified experimental framework for quantitative investigations of equilibrium and non-equilibrium molecular reorientation dynamics over an exceptionally broad time range.

articles.title: UV pump vibrational sum frequency generation probe spectroscopy with fluorescence suppression using a spatial filter
articles.abstract: Time-resolved vibrational sum-frequency generation (TR-VSFG) spectroscopy probes photoinduced structural dynamics at interfaces, but UV-pump TR-VSFG experiments are often hampered by fluorescence from chromophores, which can overwhelm the weak SFG signal. Here, we demonstrate a spatial filter as a simple, effective method to suppress this fluorescence background. Because fluorescence is emitted incoherently across a broad range of angles while the coherent SFG signal propagates in a well-defined spatial mode, the spatial filter selectively rejects the former while preserving the latter. Using the UV-photoexcitation of phenol at the air–water interface as a test case, we show that the spatial filter suppresses the fluorescence background by 86.4% while reducing spectral noise by up to an order of magnitude, all with little attenuation of the resonant vibrational signal itself. This approach should be broadly applicable to UV-pump TR-VSFG studies of photoinduced dynamics at aqueous and other interfaces.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Electrolytes confined between polarizable surfaces in slit pores with anisotropic permittivity tensor
articles.abstract: We present a method that enables efficient simulations of coarse-grained electrolyte solutions inside a narrow slit pore with an anisotropic dielectric permittivity tensor. The electrostatic equations for polarizable surfaces are solved using a 2D periodic Green’s function method combined with a slab-corrected anisotropic 3D Ewald summation. We apply this approach in Monte Carlo simulations to study 1:1 electrolytes confined between both polarizable dielectric and metallic surfaces. Our results show that dielectric anisotropy strongly reshapes the double-layer structure. While the individual ion–image interactions depend strictly on the bulk-like parallel permittivity, the suppression of the perpendicular permittivity dramatically amplifies direct in-plane ion–ion correlations. Under strong anisotropy, these lateral correlations dominate the thermodynamics completely, rendering the structural profiles of mutually opposing dielectric and metallic boundaries practically identical by forcing the smaller cations directly into the contact plane of the larger anions.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: The effect of electrocatalyst roughness and morphology on selectivity due to mass transport
articles.abstract: Mass transport can significantly affect electrocatalytic selectivity as surface-bound reaction intermediates are exchanged between the electrode and bulk electrolyte. The underlying desorption–re-adsorption–reaction mechanism allows an intermediate to escape the surface as a partially converted product or re-adsorb for continued conversion, but it is still not clear how the catalyst morphology affects this competition. Here, we focus on the role of the electrocatalyst surface morphology and its effective representation in transport-coupled kinetic models. Using CO selectivity during CO 2 reduction on copper as a model system, we compare predictions from a 1D diffusion model, where surface roughness serves as a single morphological descriptor, against a more advanced 3D diffusion model that explicitly resolves the full catalyst geometry. We analyze the results in terms of overlapping diffusion spheres between neighboring catalyst particles and find that the two models largely agree across the experimentally relevant parameter space due to a simple disparity in length scales. As diffusion occurs on a ∼μm scale, spatially resolved features of typical nm-sized catalyst particles are inconsequential. Surface roughness thus emerges as a surprisingly robust descriptor of electrocatalytic selectivity within the desorption–re-adsorption–reaction mechanism.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Strongly screened Yukawa fluids: Benchmark thermodynamics and the soft-to-hard interaction crossover
articles.abstract: The excess energy and pressure of a strongly screened Yukawa fluid (screening parameter κ in the range of 5 ≤ κ ≤ 12) are calculated using molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. These results are used to verify the accuracy of the variational approach that uses a fluid of hard spheres as a reference system, and the relatively high precision of this method is documented. We also show that the energy and pressure cannot be described by the ion-sphere model, which works well under weak screening. The Rosenfeld–Tarazona scaling for the thermal component of excess energy remains applicable, but in a slightly modified form compared with that in the weak-screening regime. The effective inverse-power-law exponent is determined. The excess entropy is evaluated using the variational approach and the MD excess energy data, and a good agreement is demonstrated. These results can be of some interest in the context of complex plasmas and colloidal suspensions as well as for systems in the vicinity of the soft-to-hard interaction crossover in general.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Solvent environment controls ultrafast bifurcation between dissociation and isomerization in iodoform
articles.abstract: Solvent environments can profoundly influence reaction dynamics, yet capturing ultrafast atomic motions during these events remains challenging. Here, we employ femtosecond time-resolved x-ray liquidography to track the atomic motions of iodoform (CHI 3 ) in acetonitrile. We observe an ultrafast bifurcation (<200 fs) into two distinct pathways: complete dissociation to CHI 2 • + I • radicals and roaming-like isomerization to iso -CHI 2 –I. Along the dissociation branch, the I⋯I distance increases with time, accompanied by increasing spatial dispersion. In contrast, the isomerization branch exhibits a rapid contraction of the bonding I–I pair to ∼2.8 Å, while non-bonded pairs persist at 3.6–3.9 Å, indicative of reorientation rather than separation. This behavior differs sharply from dynamics in cyclohexane, where sub-picosecond isomer formation is absent. These findings provide an atomically resolved visualization of the bifurcation between dissociation and roaming-like isomerization in solution, demonstrating how solvent environments fundamentally alter the structural dynamics of ultrafast solution photochemistry.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Nanoporous graphene homojunction mediated by interface charge transfer
articles.abstract: The construction of carbon-based hetero- or homojunctions is a key strategy for expanding their functional boundaries and enabling new quantum devices. On-surface synthesis provides a promising route for the precise fabrication of such structures. Although significant progress has been achieved in one-dimensional graphene nanoribbon hetero- or homojunctions, analogous two-dimensional systems remain largely unexplored. Here, we developed an AgTe monolayer intercalation method to fabricate nanoporous graphene (NPG) homojunctions. By controlling tellurium deposition, NPG islands spanning both the Ag(111) substrate and the AgTe monolayer were successfully synthesized. Owing to the interfacial charge transfer differences, the NPG exhibits different semiconductor behaviors on Ag(111) and the AgTe monolayer, resulting in the formation of an NPG homojunction with the type-II band alignment. The entire fabrication process of the NPG homojunctions was examined by scanning tunneling microscopy, and evidence for the type-II band alignment was obtained by scanning tunneling spectroscopy and density functional theory calculations. This intercalation strategy circumvents the randomness inherent in the synthesis of carbon-based heterostructures and offers a promising route toward two-dimensional carbon-based junctions with controllable band alignment.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Real-time simulation of charge migration within the time-dependent Kohn–Sham DFT
articles.abstract: Attosecond technologies provide unique opportunities to study electron dynamics and electron correlation on their intrinsic timescales. From a theoretical perspective, this places strong constraints, as an accurate treatment of electron correlation is required. Recently, it was demonstrated that time-dependent density-functional theory (TDDFT) is capable of correctly predicting correlation-driven charge migration arising from hole mixing following ionization of the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO). Given the ability of TDDFT to treat large-scale systems, this approach offers promising perspectives for investigating electron-correlation-driven mechanisms in complex molecules. In this work, we assessed the constraints and limitations associated with using TDDFT to study this mechanism. We found that the charge-migration dynamics are already correctly reproduced using the local-density approximation for the exchange-correlation functional, provided the states involved in the coherent superposition are well described within TDDFT. However, for dynamics triggered by the ionization of orbitals below the HOMO, artificial ultrafast dynamics may appear on top of the charge-migration dynamics. These artifacts indicate that careful analysis of the simulated dynamics is required to reliably predict phenomena that could be observed experimentally.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Action-detected two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy: Theory, methods, and future directions
articles.abstract: Action-detected two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy (A-2DES) has emerged as a powerful alternative to coherent 2DES, offering unique advantages, including freedom from geometrical constraints imposed by directional phase-matching requirements, lower demands on sample quality, operando capability, and seamless integration with microscopy. By measuring incoherent observables, such as fluorescence, photocurrent, photoelectrons, or photoions from excited-state populations, action detection enables studies of systems that might be difficult to access using traditional coherent methods. However, this approach introduces fundamental challenges, including incoherent mixing, additional Liouville pathways, and detection nonlinearities that require careful consideration. This article provides the theoretical foundations, experimental implementations, key advantages, and critical limitations of action-detected spectroscopy, providing guidance for optimal application of this rapidly evolving technique across diverse systems ranging from single molecules to working photovoltaic devices.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Noncontact friction of a semiconductor with charge carriers of differing mobilities
articles.abstract: The coefficient of noncontact friction as measured in an electric force microscopy experiment is computed for a semiconductor with positive and negative charge carriers of distinct mobilities. The friction is determined for a sample represented by classical electrodynamics coupled to diffusing carriers in a dielectric continuum. The analysis generalizes previous work in which positive and negative carriers were taken to have identical mobilities, allowing application to a wider range of semiconductors. Dielectric and electrical properties of the material are shown to be revealed by the dependence of the friction on experimentally accessible parameters such as probe-sample separation and carrier density.

articles.title: A machine learning closure for polymer integral equation theory
articles.abstract: Polymer reference interaction site model (PRISM) theory, a descendant of Ornstein–Zernike liquid state theory, is a powerful tool to predict the structure and thermodynamics of equilibrium polymer systems, but its accuracy and applicability can be limited in some important cases. Typically, these shortcomings are traced to the analytical closure relationships used to solve the integral equations. Here, we propose a machine learning (ML)-based closure relation trained on a dataset of coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations of homopolymer melts and solutions. PRISM theory with the ML closure outperforms traditional atomic closures (e.g., Percus–Yevick) in predicting the structure of typical coarse-grained model systems. We also use the ML closure to accurately model the results of small-angle neutron scattering experiments. This ML-enhanced PRISM theory can, therefore, enable rapid soft materials discovery and design efforts.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Quantum Kolmogorov--Arnold networks are classically reproducible at their attained accuracy, and a discrete-logarithm encoding need not be: a measurement-based map of where quantum advantage can live
articles.title_zh: 量子柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络在其所达到的精度方面具有典型的可重复性，并且离散对数编码不必是：基于测量的量子优势可以存在的地图
articles.abstract: Quantum machine-learning models are useful only if classical computers cannot cheaply imitate them. We test this directly for quantum Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (QKANs)---neural networks whose tunable ``activation functions'' are small quantum circuits---by asking whether each model can be contracted as an efficient tensor network (TN). Our task-aware yardstick is the bond dimension a classical surrogate needs to copy the model's output at the accuracy the model itself reaches. We find a clear ladder. The amplitude-encoded Chebyshev QKAN uses only logarithmically many qubits and is exactly classical. The variational QKAN, built from all-to-all controlled rotations, looks hard at random settings but generalizes only weakly once trained (held-out R²!le!0.27) and is copied at that attained accuracy by a low-bond-dimension surrogate (n!le!10); at fixed strict tolerance the required bond dimension grows near-exponentially. Depolarizing noise erases it (purity collapse) near p!approx!0.03--0.05 at the sizes we reach. Every generic attempt to force hardness---a global measurement or an interaction-based (IQP) feature map---instead destroys trainability through exponentially small gradients (a ``barren plateau''). The escape is a discrete-logarithm feature map: its kernel variance is flat from 4 to 14 qubits while a generic IQP kernel concentrates exponentially, and a support-vector machine with it learns a classically hard concept to ge99% accuracy while generic and classical kernels stay at chance; wired into the KAN architecture, it fits discrete-log targets to R²!approx!1. Hardness placed in number theory stays classically hard, shot-efficient, and learnable. The work provides a measurement-based reproducibility criterion and a design rule: seek advantage in structured, provably hard encodings rather than in deep entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 仅当经典计算机无法廉价地模仿量子机器学习模型时，它们才有用。我们直接针对量子柯尔莫哥洛夫——阿诺德网络（QKAN）——可调“激活函数”是小型量子电路的神经网络——通过询问每个模型是否可以收缩为有效的张量网络（TN）来测试这一点。我们的任务感知标准是经典代理以模型本身达到的精度复制模型输出所需的键维度。我们找到了一个清晰的梯子。幅度编码的切比雪夫 QKAN 仅使用对数数量的量子位，并且完全是经典的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 仅当经典计算机无法廉价地模仿量子机器学习模型时，它们才有用。我们直接针对量子柯尔莫哥洛夫——阿诺德网络（QKAN）——可调“激活函数”是小型量子电路的神经网络——通过询问每个模型是否可以收缩为有效的张量网络（TN）来测试这一点。我们的任务感知标准是经典代理以模型本身达到的精度复制模型输出所需的键维度。我们找到了一个清晰的梯子。幅度编码的切比雪夫 QKAN 仅使用对数数量的量子位，并且完全是经典的。变分 QKAN 由全对所有受控旋转构建而成，在随机设置下看起来很困难，但一旦训练后泛化能力就很弱（R²!le!0.27），并通过低键维代理（n!le!10）在达到准确度时进行复制；在固定的严格公差下，所需的粘合尺寸几乎呈指数增长。在我们达到的尺寸下，去极化噪声将其擦除（纯度崩溃）接近 p!approx!0.03--0.05。每一次强制硬度的通用尝试——全局测量或基于交互的（IQP）特征图——反而会通过指数级的小梯度（“贫瘠的高原”）破坏可训练性。逃逸是一个离散对数特征图：它的内核方差从 4 到 14 个量子位是平坦的，而通用 IQP 内核呈指数集中，并且支持向量机用它学习经典的困难概念，达到 99% 的准确度，而通用和经典内核则保持机会；连接到 KAN 架构中，它适合 R²!approx!1 的离散对数目标。数论中的难度仍然是经典的难度、射击效率和可学习性。这项工作提供了基于测量的再现性标准和设计规则：在结构化、可证明的硬编码而不是深度纠缠中寻求优势。

articles.title: A quantitative bound on motional narrowing in the radical-pair nuclear register: the neural band requires S²lesssim0.07
articles.title_zh: 自由基对核记录中运动窄化的定量界限：神经带需要 S²lesssim0.07
articles.abstract: Motional narrowing has been proposed as the mechanism that lets a biological radical pair hold usable memory on the SI10ms timescale of neural computation.  We test that proposal against the feasibility predicate of the underlying reservoir theory, in which the useful horizon is max_T,[MC(q(T))-C₀]· T with q(T)=1-e⁻T/Toⁿe.  Our implementation reproduces that theory's published feasibility numbers to better than SI0.5percent.  Under the predicate the proposal fails at the order parameters available to this system: a proton register on the cryptochrome flavin--tryptophan pair reaches a ceiling of SI3.99ms, and internal motional narrowing reaches the band only below Ssqsimeq0.07, that is, only if the internal motion leaves less than SI7percent of the second-rank dipolar order intact.  Flavin 8α-methyl rotation, the specific candidate proposed to supply it, has Ssq=0.25 and gives SI7.12ms, outside the band across the hydration and bath-density uncertainty (SIrange4.319.49ms).  One route crosses by a wide margin, and it is isotopic rather than dynamic: substituting the register nucleus rescales the like-spin intramolecular rate as γ⁴ and the unlike-spin bath rate as γ², with an additional heteronuclear factor 2/3, raising Tone to SI28.4ms for ³¹P and SI91.2ms for ¹³C.  Neither nucleus is physiological.  We also withdraw the long-lived-singlet route, which protects an observable orthogonal to the one carrying the memory, and we state the in-vitro measurement that would falsify our conclusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 运动缩小已被提出作为一种机制，让生物自由基对在神经计算的 SI10ms 时间尺度上保留可用记忆。  我们根据基础油藏理论的可行性谓词测试了该建议，其中有用层位为 max_T,[MC(q(T))-C₀]· T，其中 q(T)=1-e⁻T/Toⁿe。  我们的实现再现了该理论已发布的可行性数字，优于 SI0.5%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 运动缩小已被提出作为一种机制，让生物自由基对在神经计算的 SI10ms 时间尺度上保留可用记忆。  我们根据基础油藏理论的可行性谓词测试了该建议，其中有用层位为 max_T,[MC(q(T))-C₀]· T，其中 q(T)=1-e⁻T/Toⁿe。  我们的实现再现了该理论已发布的可行性数字，优于 SI0.5%。  在该谓词下，该提议在该系统可用的序参数处失败：隐色黄素-色氨酸对上的质子寄存器达到 SI3.99ms 的上限，并且内部运动变窄仅达到低于 Ssqsimeq0.07 的带，也就是说，只有当内部运动留下小于 SI7% 的二阶偶极序完好时。  黄素 8α-甲基旋转，建议提供它的具体候选物，具有 Ssq=0.25 并给出 SI7.12ms，在水合和浴密度不确定性的范围之外 (SIrange4.319.49ms)。  一条路线有很大的交叉，并且它是同位素的而不是动态的：替换记录核将同自旋分子内速率重新调整为γ⁴，将异自旋浴速率重新调整为γ²，并附加异核因子2/3，将 31P 的 Tone 提高到 SI28.4ms，将 13C 的 Tone 提高到 SI91.2ms。  两个细胞核都不是生理性的。  我们还撤回了长寿命单峰路线，该路线保护了与携带记忆的路线正交的可观察到的路线，并且我们陈述了会证伪我们结论的体外测量结果。

articles.title: Catalytic competence bounds the decay rates of a thermally formed radical pair
articles.title_zh: 催化能力限制了热形成的自由基对的衰变速率
articles.abstract: A flavoenzyme could respond to the geomagnetic field through the radical-pair mechanism only if its catalytic cycle passes through a radical pair that lives long enough for a 50 μT field to act. For a pair formed thermally from a closed- shell enzyme–substrate complex, returning to it only through the singlet and carrying the catalytic flux, we show that detailed balance bounds both decay rates from below: the singlet back-transfer rate must exceed 4kcate∆/kBT and the spin-independent onward rate kcate∆/kBT , where ∆ is the free energy of the pair. The second bound rests on an inequality, ΦP ≤ 4kP/kS, that holds for any spin Hamiltonian and any trace-preserving, unital, positivity-preserving relaxation and cannot be improved over that class; neither bound involves electronic couplings or reorganization energies. In a numerical search over a flavin–aminium spin model with density-functional hyperfine and dipolar couplings, the largest field effect found among pairs that satisfy both bounds for kcat = 1 s−1 falls below 0.1 % at ∆ = 0.47 eV (0.50 eV with anisotropic hyperfine tensors) and stays below up to 0.61 eV, the grid limit; electron spin relaxation does not raise these thresholds. Measured flavin potentials of the monoamine oxidases, with a dialkylamine potential as a substrate proxy, place an amine-to-flavin pair 0.86–1.44 eV above the closed-shell state in water; continuum estimates for the active site bring it within the range of a measurable effect only in the most favourable case, about 0.49 eV
articles.abstract_zh: 只有当黄素酶的催化循环经过寿命足够长、足以在 50 μT 场作用的自由基对时，黄素酶才能通过自由基对机制对地磁场做出反应。对于由闭壳酶-底物复合物热形成的一对，仅通过单线态返回并携带催化通量，我们表明详细的平衡从下面限制了两种衰减速率：单线态反向传输速率必须超过 4kcateΔ/kBT 和自旋无关的前向速率 kcateΔ/kBT，其中 Δ 是该对的自由能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 只有当黄素酶的催化循环经过寿命足够长、足以在 50 μT 场作用的自由基对时，黄素酶才能通过自由基对机制对地磁场做出反应。对于由闭壳酶-底物复合物热形成的一对，仅通过单线态返回并携带催化通量，我们表明详细的平衡从下面限制了两种衰减速率：单线态反向传输速率必须超过 4kcateΔ/kBT 和自旋无关的前向速率 kcateΔ/kBT，其中 Δ 是该对的自由能。第二个界限基于不等式 ΦP ≤ 4kP/kS，该不等式适用于任何自旋哈密顿量和任何保迹、统一、保正性松弛，并且无法在该类别上进行改进；这两个束缚都不涉及电子耦合或重组能量。在对具有密度泛函超精细和偶极耦合的黄素-铵自旋模型的数值搜索中，在满足 kcat = 1 s−1 两个边界的对中发现的最大场效应在 Δ = 0.47 eV 时降至 0.1% 以下（各向异性超精细张量为 0.50 eV），并保持低于 0.61 eV（网格极限）；电子自旋弛豫不会提高这些阈值。测量单胺氧化酶的黄素电位，以二烷基胺电位作为底物代理，将胺-黄素对置于水中闭壳状态之上 0.86-1.44 eV 处；对活性位点的连续估计仅在最有利的情况下（约 0.49 eV）使其处于可测量效应范围内

articles.title: Structural and Optical Properties of Zn2SnO4 Thin Films for Enhanced Photovoltaic Performance
articles.title_zh: Zn2SnO4 薄膜的结构和光学特性可增强光伏性能
articles.abstract: Today, the development of inexpensive, non-toxic and highly transparent oxide semiconductors is very crucial for the sustainable growth of next-generation photovoltaic technologies owing to their efficient charge transport properties and higher thermal stability. The present study involves fabrication and characterization of a transparent thin-film heterojunction comprising of Zn2SnO4 and NiO hetero-partners, synthesized by a unique combinatorial approach. The phenomena of carrier injection, directional transportation, generation/recombination, and their extraction are rigorously analyzed through band alignment engineering. The growth of all-oxide p-n heterojunction with Al/p-NiO/n-ZTO/ITO device architecture demonstrated a sound J-V response in the dark with an ideality factor of ~ 2.58, turn on voltage of ~ 1.44 V, a series resistance of ~ 2.8 Ω. A type-II band alignment is perceived for the proposed heterojunction with improved electrical conduction, yielding a built-in-potential of ~ 0.54 V across the hetero-interface. Under 1-sun illumination, the thin-film heterojunction solar cell demonstrates an open circuit voltage of ~ 0.62V, short circuit current density of ~ 15.4 mAcm− 2, fill factor of ~ 31%, and power conversion efficiency of ~ 2.95%. The realization of low-cost and environmentally benign oxide-based thin-film heterojunction would open new avenues for sustainable and high-performance photovoltaic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 如今，廉价、无毒和高度透明的氧化物半导体的开发对于下一代光伏技术的可持续发展至关重要，因为它们具有高效的电荷传输特性和更高的热稳定性。本研究涉及由 Zn2SnO4 和 NiO 异质伙伴组成的透明薄膜异质结的制造和表征，该异质结通过独特的组合方法合成。通过能带排列工程严格分析载流子注入、定向传输、生成/重组及其提取现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 如今，廉价、无毒和高度透明的氧化物半导体的开发对于下一代光伏技术的可持续发展至关重要，因为它们具有高效的电荷传输特性和更高的热稳定性。本研究涉及由 Zn2SnO4 和 NiO 异质伙伴组成的透明薄膜异质结的制造和表征，该异质结通过独特的组合方法合成。通过能带排列工程严格分析载流子注入、定向传输、生成/重组及其提取现象。采用 Al/p-NiO/n-ZTO/ITO 器件架构的全氧化物 p-n 异质结的生长在黑暗中表现出良好的 J-V 响应，理想因子为 ~ 2.58，开启电压为 ~ 1.44 V，串联电阻为 ~ 2.8 Ω。所提出的异质结具有 II 型能带排列，具有改善的导电性，在异质界面上产生约 0.54 V 的内置电势。在1太阳光照下，薄膜异质结太阳能电池的开路电压~ 0.62V，短路电流密度~ 15.4 mAcm− 2，填充因子~ 31%，功率转换效率~ 2.95%。低成本且环境友好的氧化物薄膜异质结的实现将为可持续和高性能光伏应用开辟新途径。

articles.title: Improved design and field deployment of laser induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) in-situ groundwater trace element analyzer
articles.title_zh: 激光诱导击穿光谱 (LIBS) 原位地下水微量元素分析仪的改进设计和现场部署
articles.abstract: The present work describes the deployment activities of the updated side facing miniaturized laser induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) subsurface deployable liquid sensor. Previous work illustrated prototype development with laboratory work validating the system operation as well as deployment of the initial sensor probe with data collection and lessons learned. The probe design was modified to turn the laser focal spot 90 degrees to shoot out of the side of the sensor housing instead of straight down. This was done to eliminate data variability introduced due to bubble production and coalescence within the optical deliver and collection pathway. The new design was tested in the subsurface for 7 weeks continuously with daily data collection. The collected data showed improved performance of the sensor system including lower data variability. The overall design and data collection is described and discussed and future work and avenues of research as well as application areas are listed.
articles.abstract_zh: 目前的工作描述了更新的侧面小型激光诱导击穿光谱（LIBS）地下可部署液体传感器的部署活动。之前的工作展示了原型开发和实验室工作，验证系统运行以及通过数据收集和经验教训部署初始传感器探头。探头设计经过修改，将激光焦点旋转 90 度，从传感器外壳的侧面射出，而不是垂直向下。这样做是为了消除由于光学传输和收集路径内的气泡产生和聚结而引入的数据可变性。新设计在地下连续测试 7 周，每天收集数据。收集的数据显示传感器系统的性能得到改善，包括数据变异性降低。

articles.title: LatticeMind: A Validation-Gated Agentic Framework for Density Functional Theory Workflows
articles.title_zh: LatticeMind：密度泛函理论工作流程的验证门代理框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles calculations are rarely single solver calls: they are multistage workflows in which structures, settings, and saved densities must pass correctly between dependent stages. Language models can write a valid single input, but reliability collapses once stages are chained: a dropped dependency, wrong file handoff, or hallucinated keyword can invalidate results even when the solver runs, and such errors surface only after costly execution. We introduce LatticeMind, a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable density functional theory (DFT) projects. A workflow contract specifies required stages, files, and dependencies; deterministic validators inspect the project before any solver launch; failed checks trigger bounded repair; and reports remain traceable to project files. On a 44-case RESCU benchmark spanning total-energy, density-of-states, band-structure, magnetic, phonon workflows, three non-flagship LLM backends reproduced every reference value; 119 of 132 runs passed on the first validated plan and the rest after one repair cycle. Ablations identify the workflow contract and pre-execution validation as the principal reliability mechanisms; a conventional trial-and-repair baseline reaches 71% at twice the token cost per success. The same architecture reproduces every reference value on a 19-case VASP benchmark, demonstrating transfer across solvers. Beyond these task families, LatticeMind generated and validated the 23 inputs of a multistage study of Rh-induced electronic responses at a Rh₆/InₓGa₁₋ₓN photocatalyst interface. These results establish workflow contracts, deterministic validation, bounded repair, and traceable records as a practical foundation for reliable AI-assisted scientific computing, where preventable errors are caught before execution and the solver is never the first validator.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 第一原理计算很少是单个求解器调用：它们是多阶段工作流程，其中结构、设置和保存的密度必须在相关阶段之间正确传递。语言模型可以编写有效的单个输入，但一旦阶段链接起来，可靠性就会崩溃：即使在求解器运行时，丢失的依赖项、错误的文件切换或幻觉的关键字也可能使结果无效，并且此类错误只有在昂贵的执行后才会出现。我们引入了 LatticeMind，这是一个验证门控代理框架，可将自然语言请求转换为可执行、可检查的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 项目。工作流合同指定所需的阶段、文件和依赖项；确定性验证器在启动任何求解器之前检查项目；失败的检查触发有限修复；报告仍然可以追溯到项目文件。在涵盖总能量、态密度、能带结构、磁性、声子工作流程的 44 例 RESCU 基准测试中，三个非旗舰 LLM 后端再现了每个参考值； 132 次运行中的 119 次通过了第一个验证计划，其余的则在一个修复周期后通过。 Ablations 将工作流契约和执行前验证确定为主要的可靠性机制；传统的试验和修复基线达到 71%，每次成功的代币成本是两倍。相同的架构重现了 19 个案例 VASP 基准上的每个参考值，展示了跨求解器的传输。除了这些任务系列之外，LatticeMind 还生成并验证了 Rh₆/InₓGa₁₋ₓN 光催化剂界面处 Rh 诱导电子响应的多阶段研究的 23 个输入。这些结果建立了工作流契约、确定性验证、有界修复和可追溯记录，作为可靠的人工智能辅助科学计算的实践基础，在执行之前捕获可预防的错误，并且求解器永远不是第一个验证器。

articles.title: Vortex matter as a magnetically programmable metasurface for tuning near-field radiative heat transfer
articles.title_zh: 涡旋物质作为磁性可编程超表面，用于调节近场辐射传热
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near-field radiative heat transfer (NFRHT) is of great interest for energy conversion and thermal management. Recent work on NFRHT has shown that metasurfaces can enhance NFRHT and reshape its spectral characteristics. Here, we show that the vortex lattice of a type-II superconductor represents a self-assembled metasurface whose lattice dimensions, in contrast to most other metasurfaces, can be tuned by magnetic fields, allowing NFRHT to be varied by orders of magnitude. Specifically, we show that for two Nb surfaces at 4.2 K and separated by a 100 nm gap, NFRHT can be magnetically tuned by a factor >200. Further, we show that the tuning range grows upon cooling, exceeding 10⁵ at 2 K, which is far beyond the order-unity modulation of many proposed schemes for tuning NFRHT. Our results establish vortex matter as a magnetically programmable thermal metasurface and open new opportunities for tuning the flow of heat at the nanoscale.
articles.abstract_zh: 近场辐射传热（NFRHT）对于能量转换和热管理具有重要意义。最近有关 NFRHT 的研究表明，超表面可以增强 NFRHT 并重塑其光谱特性。在这里，我们表明，II 型超导体的涡旋晶格代表了一种自组装的超表面，与大多数其他超表面相比，其晶格尺寸可以通过磁场调节，从而允许 NFRHT 发生几个数量级的变化。具体来说，我们表明，对于 4.2 K 且间隔 100 nm 间隙的两个 Nb 表面，NFRHT 可以通过 >200 的因子进行磁调谐。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近场辐射传热（NFRHT）对于能量转换和热管理具有重要意义。最近有关 NFRHT 的研究表明，超表面可以增强 NFRHT 并重塑其光谱特性。在这里，我们表明，II 型超导体的涡旋晶格代表了一种自组装的超表面，与大多数其他超表面相比，其晶格尺寸可以通过磁场调节，从而允许 NFRHT 发生几个数量级的变化。具体来说，我们表明，对于 4.2 K 且间隔 100 nm 间隙的两个 Nb 表面，NFRHT 可以通过 >200 的因子进行磁调谐。此外，我们还表明，调谐范围随着冷却而增大，在 2 K 时超过 10⁵，这远远超出了许多提出的用于调谐 NFRHT 方案的阶次单位调制。我们的研究结果将涡旋物质确立为磁性可编程热超表面，并为在纳米尺度上调节热流开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: High-Field and Light-Dependent Magnetization Provides Evidence for Coexisting Granular Superconductivity and Superparamagnetism in Nitrogen-Doped Diamond
articles.title_zh: 高场和光相关磁化为掺氮金刚石中共存的颗粒超导性和超顺磁性提供了证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26880v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated the field-, temperature-, and time-dependent magnetic moment of a nitrogen-doped type Ib diamond in darkness and under monochromatic light with a low laser intensity of about 160 μW cm⁻². In darkness, below approximately 25 K, the magnetic moment exhibits unconventional hysteresis loops that can be explained by the coexistence of superparamagnetism and superconductivity in certain regions of the sample. Under illumination, this hysteresis largely disappears, leaving mainly the superparamagnetic contribution. Temperature-dependent measurements reveal an irreversibility below 25 K in darkness, which vanishes under illumination. Similarly, at 0.5 T and below 25 K, the time-dependent magnetization shows flux-creep-like behavior that disappears when the sample is illuminated. All light-induced changes are fully reversible: the magnetic properties measured in darkness are restored after the sample is heated above roughly 50 K. Removing the superparamagnetic contribution from magnetization measurements up to ± 14 T reveals clear characteristics of a granular superconductor, namely, a well-defined penetration field Hₚ approx 2.6 T and a critical field Hc₂ approx 10.6 T. Based on theoretical considerations, we attribute the observed phenomena to the combined effects of internal stress and local variations in nitrogen concentration within localized regions that can be regarded as grains. This interpretation is supported by Raman and birefringence spectroscopy measurements on the same sample.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了氮掺杂 Ib 型金刚石在黑暗中和单色光下（约 160 μW cm-2 的低激光强度）的场、温度和时间依赖性磁矩。在黑暗中，低于约 25 K，磁矩表现出非常规的磁滞回线，这可以通过样品某些区域中超顺磁性和超导性的共存来解释。在照明下，这种磁滞大部分消失，主要留下超顺磁性的贡献。与温度相关的测量揭示了在黑暗中低于 25 K 时的不可逆性，在光照下会消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了氮掺杂 Ib 型金刚石在黑暗中和单色光下（约 160 μW cm-2 的低激光强度）的场、温度和时间依赖性磁矩。在黑暗中，低于约 25 K，磁矩表现出非常规的磁滞回线，这可以通过样品某些区域中超顺磁性和超导性的共存来解释。在照明下，这种磁滞大部分消失，主要留下超顺磁性的贡献。与温度相关的测量揭示了在黑暗中低于 25 K 时的不可逆性，在光照下会消失。同样，在 0.5 T 和低于 25 K 时，随时间变化的磁化强度表现出类似磁通蠕变的行为，当样品被照亮时，这种行为就会消失。所有光引起的变化都是完全可逆的：在黑暗中测量的磁特性在样品被加热到大约 50 K 以上后恢复。从磁化测量中去除高达 ± 14 T 的超顺磁贡献，揭示了粒状超导体的清晰特征，即明确的穿透场 Hₚ 约 2.6 T 和临界场 Hc2 约 10.6 T。基于理论考虑，我们将观察到的现象归因于内应力和内部氮浓度局部变化的综合影响。可以被视为颗粒的局部区域。对同一样品的拉曼光谱和双折射光谱测量支持了这一解释。

articles.title: Tailoring Dielectric Relaxation and Charge Transport in Amorphous Ge-Te-Se Phase-Change Materials through Yttrium Incorporation
articles.title_zh: 通过掺钇调整非晶 Ge-Te-Se 相变材料的介电弛豫和电荷传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx (x = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15) alloys were prepared by a melt-quenching method and characterized using dielectric spectroscopy. The dielectric parameters and electrical conductivity were evaluated to assess their potential for phase-change memory and other electronic applications. The temperature and frequency dependence of the dielectric constants, ac conductivity, and dielectric loss of prepared chalcogenide glassy alloys were investigated over the frequency range 1 Hz - 1 MHz, and the temperature range 302 - 422 K, below the glass transition temperature. Both dielectric loss and dielectric constant were found to decrease with increasing frequency and decreasing temperature. The observed dielectric loss change was interpreted using the Guintini model of dielectric dispersion, correlated barrier hopping (CBH) model, and orientation polarization. The Cole-Cole analysis confirmed a distribution of relaxation times and yielded activation energies consistent with the CBH conduction mechanism. The frequency dependence of the ac conductivity follows the power law (Aωs), where the frequency exponent (s < 1) decreases with increasing temperature, further supporting the CBH conduction mechanism. The incorporation of Y increases the density of localized tail states, resulting in enhanced ac conductivity. These findings suggest that the investigated materials are promising candidates for future phase-change memory and other electronic device applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 采用熔融淬火方法制备了Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx (x = 0.05,0.10,0.15)合金，并使用介电谱进行了表征。评估介电参数和电导率，以评估其在相变存储器和其他电子应用中的潜力。研究了所制备的硫族化物玻璃合金的介电常数、交流电导率和介电损耗的温度和频率依赖性，频率范围为 1 Hz - 1 MHz，温度范围为 302 - 422 K（低于玻璃化转变温度）。发现介电损耗和介电常数随着频率的增加和温度的降低而降低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 采用熔融淬火方法制备了Te(1-x)(GeSe0.5)Yx (x = 0.05,0.10,0.15)合金，并使用介电谱进行了表征。评估介电参数和电导率，以评估其在相变存储器和其他电子应用中的潜力。研究了所制备的硫族化物玻璃合金的介电常数、交流电导率和介电损耗的温度和频率依赖性，频率范围为 1 Hz - 1 MHz，温度范围为 302 - 422 K（低于玻璃化转变温度）。发现介电损耗和介电常数随着频率的增加和温度的降低而降低。使用介电色散的 Guintini 模型、相关势垒跳跃 (CBH) 模型和取向极化来解释观察到的介电损耗变化。 Cole-Cole 分析证实了弛豫时间的分布并产生了与 CBH 传导机制一致的活化能。交流电导率的频率依赖性遵循幂律 (Aωs)，其中频率指数 (s < 1) 随着温度的升高而减小，进一步支持了 CBH 传导机制。 Y 的掺入增加了局域尾态的密度，从而增强了交流电导率。这些发现表明，所研究的材料是未来相变存储器和其他电子设备应用的有希望的候选材料。

articles.title: Heat-current-induced nonreciprocal phonon damping
articles.title_zh: 热电流引起的不可逆声子阻尼
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-reversal symmetry enforces equal equilibrium linewidths for time-reversed phonon modes at opposite wave vectors. Here we show that a steady heat current can produce nonreciprocal anharmonic damping even in centrosymmetric nonmagnetic crystals. The effect arises from nonequilibrium occupations of scattering partners, which change the statistical weights of time-reversed three-phonon channels while their squared matrix elements remain equal. Within the single-mode relaxation-time approximation, we derive a linewidth correction that is linear in the temperature gradient and odd under wave-vector reversal. The response depends on scattering-partner velocities and equilibrium lifetimes and retains signed channel weights absent from the equilibrium linewidth. First-principles calculations for centrosymmetric MgO and diamond yield nonzero, mode-dependent linewidth corrections at selected finite wave vectors, demonstrating the mechanism in both ionic and covalent crystals. Reversing the heat current at fixed local temperature exchanges the broadening and narrowing of paired modes. This current-reversible linewidth contrast provides a spectral signature of occupation feedback, with potential implications for nonlinear phonon transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 时间反演对称性强制相反波矢的时间反演声子模式具有相等的平衡线宽。在这里，我们证明即使在中心对称非磁性晶体中，稳定的热流也可以产生非互易非谐波阻尼。这种效应是由散射伙伴的非平衡占据引起的，它改变了时间反转三声子通道的统计权重，而它们的平方矩阵元素保持相等。在单模弛豫时间近似中，我们得出了线宽校正，该校正在温度梯度中呈线性，在波矢量反转下呈奇数。响应取决于散射伙伴速度和平衡寿命，并保留平衡线宽中不存在的有符号通道权重。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 时间反演对称性强制相反波矢的时间反演声子模式具有相等的平衡线宽。在这里，我们证明即使在中心对称非磁性晶体中，稳定的热流也可以产生非互易非谐波阻尼。这种效应是由散射伙伴的非平衡占据引起的，它改变了时间反转三声子通道的统计权重，而它们的平方矩阵元素保持相等。在单模弛豫时间近似中，我们得出了线宽校正，该校正在温度梯度中呈线性，在波矢量反转下呈奇数。响应取决于散射伙伴速度和平衡寿命，并保留平衡线宽中不存在的有符号通道权重。中心对称 MgO 和金刚石的第一性原理计算在选定的有限波矢量下产生非零、模式相关的线宽校正，证明了离子和共价晶体中的机制。在固定的局部温度下反转热流会交换配对模式的加宽和变窄。这种电流可逆线宽对比提供了占用反馈的光谱特征，对非线性声子传输具有潜在影响。

articles.title: MOFFieldBench: A Machine Learning Benchmark for Continuous Electronic Fields in Metal-Organic Frameworks
articles.title_zh: MOFFieldBench：金属有机框架中连续电子场的机器学习基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) predominantly rely on atomic structures, whereas electron-density (ED) and electrostatic-potential (ESP) fields remain underexplored as scalable learning representations. These continuous fields encode complementary spatial and electronic information relevant to structure-property relationships, particularly pore geometry and guest-framework interactions, but costly first-principles calculations, storage requirements and the scarcity of systematically aligned datasets limit their broader use. Here we introduce MOFFieldBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 46,000 MOFs with one-to-one aligned crystallographic structures, ED fields and ESP fields. A unified workflow integrates field generation, error-controlled compression and sparse point-cloud representation, supporting field reconstruction, prediction of 13 material properties, multimodal property prediction and pairwise cross-modal retrieval. ED and ESP provide competitive representations for pore geometry, adsorption and separation properties. Multimodal fusion improves several prediction tasks relative to the best unimodal reference, supporting complementary predictive roles for atomic structures and electronic fields. Learned ED reconstruction closely approximates first-principles reference densities, while predicted-density initialization reduces self-consistent-field calculation time by 13.59% on average in paired tests. These results support electronic fields as practical, informative learning modalities and establish MOFFieldBench as a resource for studying representation choice, multimodal learning and electronic-field-driven MOF modelling.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属有机框架（MOF）的机器学习模型主要依赖于原子结构，而电子密度（ED）和静电势（ESP）场作为可扩展的学习表示仍然没有得到充分探索。这些连续场编码与结构-性质关系相关的互补空间和电子信息，特别是孔隙几何形状和客体-框架相互作用，但昂贵的第一原理计算、存储要求和系统对齐数据集的稀缺限制了它们的更广泛使用。在这里，我们介绍 MOFFieldBench，这是一个多模态基准，由大约 46,000 个 MOF 组成，具有一对一排列的晶体结构、ED 场和 ESP 场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属有机框架（MOF）的机器学习模型主要依赖于原子结构，而电子密度（ED）和静电势（ESP）场作为可扩展的学习表示仍然没有得到充分探索。这些连续场编码与结构-性质关系相关的互补空间和电子信息，特别是孔隙几何形状和客体-框架相互作用，但昂贵的第一原理计算、存储要求和系统对齐数据集的稀缺限制了它们的更广泛使用。在这里，我们介绍 MOFFieldBench，这是一个多模态基准，由大约 46,000 个 MOF 组成，具有一对一排列的晶体结构、ED 场和 ESP 场。统一的工作流程集成了场生成、误差控制压缩和稀疏点云表示，支持场重建、13 种材料属性预测、多模态属性预测和成对跨模态检索。 ED 和 ESP 为孔隙几何形状、吸附和分离特性提供了有竞争力的表征。多模态融合相对于最佳单模态参考改进了多项预测任务，支持原子结构和电子领域的互补预测作用。学习的 ED 重建非常接近第一原理参考密度，而预测密度初始化在配对测试中将自洽场计算时间平均减少了 13.59%。这些结果支持电子场作为实用、信息丰富的学习方式，并将 MOFFieldBench 建立为研究表示选择、多模态学习和电子场驱动的 MOF 建模的资源。

articles.title: An efficient approach to electron-phonon coupling calculations of heterostructures within an all-electron framework
articles.title_zh: 全电子框架内异质结构电子声子耦合计算的有效方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A major challenge in calculating electron-phonon coupling at interfaces from first principles is the prohibitive computational cost due to the large supercells involved. Here, we present an efficient approach, which builds the electron-phonon matrix of weakly bound heterostructures from the properties of the isolated layers. The two key ingredients, the dynamical matrices and the potential response, are constructed in two steps. In the expansion step, these quantities are folded from the unit cells onto the supercell through an exact Fourier mapping. In the addition step, the interatomic force constants and the potential responses of the heterostructure are assembled blockwise from the corresponding quantities of the isolated layers, neglecting the weak interlayer contribution. The method is implemented in the electron-phonon module of the all-electron full-potential code exciting, enabling efficient calculations of the electron-phonon self-energy. We demonstrate the approach for the phonon dispersion and spectral functions of bilayer WSe₂ and pyridine/MoS₂, in comparison with exact reference calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 根据第一原理计算界面处的电子声子耦合的一个主要挑战是由于涉及大型超级电池而导致计算成本过高。在这里，我们提出了一种有效的方法，它根据隔离层的特性构建弱束缚异质结构的电子声子矩阵。动态矩阵和电位响应这两个关键要素是分两步构建的。在展开步骤中，这些量通过精确的傅里叶映射从晶胞折叠到超晶胞上。在添加步骤中，异质结构的原子间力常数和潜在响应是根据隔离层的相应量按块组装的，忽略了弱层间的贡献。该方法在全电子全势码激励的电子声子模块中实现，实现了电子声子自能的高效计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 根据第一原理计算界面处的电子声子耦合的一个主要挑战是由于涉及大型超级电池而导致计算成本过高。在这里，我们提出了一种有效的方法，它根据隔离层的特性构建弱束缚异质结构的电子声子矩阵。动态矩阵和电位响应这两个关键要素是分两步构建的。在展开步骤中，这些量通过精确的傅里叶映射从晶胞折叠到超晶胞上。在添加步骤中，异质结构的原子间力常数和潜在响应是根据隔离层的相应量按块组装的，忽略了弱层间的贡献。该方法在全电子全势码激励的电子声子模块中实现，实现了电子声子自能的高效计算。我们展示了双层 WSe2 和吡啶/MoS2 的声子色散和光谱函数的方法，并与精确的参考计算进行了比较。

articles.title: Quantum Oscillations across Hole Crystallization in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯中跨孔结晶的量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27134v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent quantum-oscillation measurements in rhombohedral graphene reveal an abrupt increase in the dominant frequency and the emergence of additional frequencies as the carrier density is lowered toward superconductivity. Noninteracting band models can account for multiple frequencies but do not explain the upward jump. We show that these features can arise from two competing fates of the inner hole pocket in an annular Fermi sea: collapse into a simply connected Fermi liquid or crystallization into an anticrystal, in which localized holes coexist with itinerant electrons. Pocket collapse contracts the outer Fermi contour at fixed density, whereas hole crystallization preserves a larger contour that supports magnetic-breakdown orbits. This contrast provides a possible explanation for the frequency jump, while additional reconstructed orbits produce a multitone spectrum. Our results support the anticrystal as a candidate normal state near superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近对菱面体石墨烯的量子振荡测量表明，随着载流子密度向超导降低，主频率突然增加，并出现附加频率。非相互作用频带模型可以解释多个频率，但不能解释向上跳跃。我们证明，这些特征可能源于环形费米海中内空穴袋的两种相互竞争的命运：塌缩成简单连接的费米液体或结晶成反晶体，其中局域空穴与流动电子共存。袋塌陷以固定密度收缩费米外轮廓，而空穴结晶则保留了支持磁击穿轨道的更大轮廓。这种对比为频率跳跃提供了可能的解释，同时额外的重建轨道产生了多音频谱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近对菱面体石墨烯的量子振荡测量表明，随着载流子密度向超导降低，主频率突然增加，并出现附加频率。非相互作用频带模型可以解释多个频率，但不能解释向上跳跃。我们证明，这些特征可能源于环形费米海中内空穴袋的两种相互竞争的命运：塌缩成简单连接的费米液体或结晶成反晶体，其中局域空穴与流动电子共存。袋塌陷以固定密度收缩费米外轮廓，而空穴结晶则保留了支持磁击穿轨道的更大轮廓。这种对比为频率跳跃提供了可能的解释，同时额外的重建轨道产生了多音频谱。我们的结果支持反晶作为菱面体石墨烯中超导附近的候选正常态。

articles.title: Ballistic transport and crystallographic control in altermagnetic quantum rings
articles.title_zh: 互磁量子环中的弹道输运和晶体控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study coherent two-terminal transport through a finite-width d-wave altermagnetic quantum ring with nonmagnetic leads. A confined Aharonov--Bohm flux remains exactly h/e periodic and, in the symmetric one-mode geometry, produces an exact half-flux transmission zero. A perpendicular field shifts the interference pattern according to an effective area Aᵣₘ ₑff=1.0342,π r₀² and the altermagnetic splitting resolves the common zero into nearby spin-dependent nodes. Rotating the crystal reverses the transmitted spin, whereas the mirror orientation θ_A=π/4 is exactly spin degenerate. For a 50~nm reference ring, sub-tesla fields yield windows with |P_T|>0.99, the most accessible of which requires a uniform field alone and no confined flux. Finite-bias, thermal, disorder, Zeeman, and spin-conserving voltage-probe calculations show that the polarization is appreciably more stable than individual coherent-resonance amplitudes. These results identify interference-node positions, flux periodicity, and crystal-controlled spin polarization as experimentally useful signatures of an altermagnetic mesoscopic interferometer.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究通过具有非磁性引线的有限宽度 d 波交磁量子环的相干两端传输。受限的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量完全保持 h/e 周期性，并且在对称单模几何结构中，产生精确的半通量传输零。垂直场根据有效面积 Aᵣₘ ₑff=1.0342,π r₀² 移动干涉图案，并且交变磁分裂将公共零分解为附近的自旋相关节点。旋转晶体会反转传输的自旋，而镜子方向 θ_A=π/4 恰好是自旋简并。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究通过具有非磁性引线的有限宽度 d 波交磁量子环的相干两端传输。受限的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量完全保持 h/e 周期性，并且在对称单模几何结构中，产生精确的半通量传输零。垂直场根据有效面积 Aᵣₘ ₑff=1.0342,π r₀² 移动干涉图案，并且交变磁分裂将公共零分解为附近的自旋相关节点。旋转晶体会反转传输的自旋，而镜子方向 θ_A=π/4 恰好是自旋简并。对于 50 nm 参考环，亚特斯拉场产生 |P_T|>0.99 的窗口，其中最容易获得的窗口需要单独的均匀场且没有受限通量。有限偏置、热、无序、塞曼和自旋守恒电压探针计算表明，极化明显比单个相干共振振幅更稳定。这些结果将干涉节点位置、通量周期性和晶体控制的自旋极化确定为交变介观干涉仪在实验上有用的特征。

articles.title: Fully Automated Wannier Disentanglement via Projectability Selection in Gaussian and Augmented Plane-Wave Frameworks
articles.title_zh: 通过高斯和增强平面波框架中的可投影性选择实现全自动 Wannier 解缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constructing the frozen manifold for entangled bands requires balancing exact reproduction of the target bands with sufficient variational freedom to build a well-localized subspace from the broader Bloch pool. We present a workflow that systematically determines the energy ceiling for a target number of selected Wannier projections, freezing every Bloch state below this threshold across the sampled k-mesh. By measuring projectability, the spectral weight of each Bloch state projected onto the target localized basis, the workflow detects missing conduction channels and quantifies discrepancies between orbital character and energy-based freezing. In comparisons where we controlled the extent of the energy ceiling, freezing all sub-ceiling states is generally favored over projectability-based frozen states. Of the seven materials we tested, freezing all sub-ceiling states lowers the band error on four from between 11 meV and 1.2 eV to 18 meV or less, and matches the projectability-based choice to within about 2 meV on the remaining three. In each of the four, projectability-based frozen states give the lower spread, showing that spread alone cannot identify the better model. With the frozen states held fixed, the workflow minimizes the gauge-invariant spread, constructs the gauge from density-matrix columns on atomic orbitals, and passes an isolated set of bands to Wannier90 for localization. The workflow is implemented in two programs for seamless high-throughput Wannierization with WIEN2k (wien2wannier) and CRYSTAL (LCAO2Wannier). Using a single set of calibrated defaults, the CRYSTAL implementation with analytic overlaps produces models that reproduce the reference bands of five cells, from bulk h-BN in a joint valence-and-conduction model to a magnetic framework with 1424 orbitals. The WIEN2k implementation produces eight such models from seven calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 构建纠缠带的冻结流形需要平衡目标带的精确再现与足够的变分自由度，以便从更广泛的布洛赫池构建良好定位的子空间。我们提出了一个工作流程，系统地确定选定 Wannier 投影目标数量的能量上限，将采样的 k 网格中的每个 Bloch 状态冻结在该阈值以下。通过测量可投影性，即每个布洛赫态的光谱权重投影到目标局部基础上，工作流程可以检测缺失的传导通道，并量化轨道特征和基于能量的冻结之间的差异。与我们控制能量上限范围的情况相比，冻结所有低于上限的状态通常优于基于可投影性的冻结状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 构建纠缠带的冻结流形需要平衡目标带的精确再现与足够的变分自由度，以便从更广泛的布洛赫池构建良好定位的子空间。我们提出了一个工作流程，系统地确定选定 Wannier 投影目标数量的能量上限，将采样的 k 网格中的每个 Bloch 状态冻结在该阈值以下。通过测量可投影性，即每个布洛赫态的光谱权重投影到目标局部基础上，工作流程可以检测缺失的传导通道，并量化轨道特征和基于能量的冻结之间的差异。与我们控制能量上限范围的情况相比，冻结所有低于上限的状态通常优于基于可投影性的冻结状态。在我们测试的七种材料中，冻结所有亚天花板状态可将四种材料的带误差从 11 meV 到 1.2 eV 之间降低到 18 meV 或更小，并将其余三种材料的基于可投影性的选择匹配到约 2 meV 以内。在这四个中，基于可投影性的冻结状态给出了较低的分布，表明仅靠分布无法识别更好的模型。在冻结状态保持固定的情况下，工作流程可最大限度地减少规范不变扩展，根据原子轨道上的密度矩阵列构建规范，并将一组隔离的能带传递给 Wannier90 进行定位。该工作流程通过 WIEN2k (wien2wannier) 和 CRYSTAL (LCAO2Wannier) 两个程序实现无缝高通量 Wannierization。使用一组校准默认值，带有分析重叠的 CRYSTAL 实现生成的模型可以重现五个单元的参考带，从联合价和传导模型中的块状 h-BN 到具有 1424 个轨道的磁性框架。 WIEN2k 实现通过七次计算生成八个这样的模型。

articles.title: Learning the Geometry of Materials Space with Trained Neural Tangent Kernels
articles.title_zh: 使用训练有素的神经正切核学习材料空间的几何形状
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks trained to predict materials properties learn representations whose physical content can be difficult to extract. We use the neural tangent kernel (NTK), evaluated at trained parameters, to recover the geometry learned by a network that predicts superconducting transition temperatures from elemental composition alone. Kernel ridge regression with the trained NTK closely reproduces the network's predictive performance and substantially outperforms regression with the initial kernel. Spectral analysis and multidimensional scaling reveal a geometry dominated by a small number of directions. Clustering and local neighborhood analysis organize compounds into recognizable superconducting families and connect materials with related chemical and correlated-electron properties despite substantial differences in T_c. These results establish trained tangent kernels as practical probes of learned materials representations, connecting property prediction with the exploration of materials space.
articles.abstract_zh: 经过训练来预测材料属性的神经网络学习其物理内容可能难以提取的表示。我们使用神经正切核（NTK），在训练参数下进行评估，来恢复网络学习到的几何形状，该网络仅根据元素组成来预测超导转变温度。使用经过训练的 NTK 进行的核岭回归可以很好地再现网络的预测性能，并且大大优于使用初始核进行的回归。谱分析和多维尺度揭示了由少数方向主导的几何形状。聚类和局部邻域分析将化合物组织成可识别的超导族，并将材料与相关化学和相关电子特性联系起来，尽管 T_c 存在显着差异。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经过训练来预测材料属性的神经网络学习其物理内容可能难以提取的表示。我们使用神经正切核（NTK），在训练参数下进行评估，来恢复网络学习到的几何形状，该网络仅根据元素组成来预测超导转变温度。使用经过训练的 NTK 进行的核岭回归可以很好地再现网络的预测性能，并且大大优于使用初始核进行的回归。谱分析和多维尺度揭示了由少数方向主导的几何形状。聚类和局部邻域分析将化合物组织成可识别的超导族，并将材料与相关化学和相关电子特性联系起来，尽管 T_c 存在显着差异。这些结果建立了经过训练的切线内核作为学习材料表示的实用探针，将属性预测与材料空间的探索联系起来。

articles.title: Chiral magnetic excitations in the RMn6Sn6 kagome metals (R=Tb, Ho, Er, and Y)
articles.title_zh: RMn6Sn6 kagome 金属（R=Tb、Ho、Er 和 Y）中的手性磁激发。
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent inelastic neutron scattering (INS) investigations of the kagome metal TbMn6Sn6 reveal novel chiral magnetic excitations associated with the kagome layer. These excitations appear to have an itinerant character with a large energy scale (> 100 meV) and heavy damping; however, the origin of these excitations, which are not predicted by local moment linear spin-wave theory, is not understood. Here, we use INS to show that chiral excitations are also found in RMn6Sn6 compounds with R=Tb, Ho, Er, and Y having uniaxial, tilted, planar ferrimagnet, and planar double-spiral magnetic structures, respectively. Thus, the chiral excitations exist regardless of the magnetic structure. Additionally, R=Er and Y demonstrate that the chiral mode intensity is weaker in planar magnetic structures, suggesting that excitations are transverse to the local Mn moment direction. The chiral excitations appear only at L=odd positions in the Brilloun zone, and correspond to chiral spin exciations of the same handedness within each kagome layer, and pi out-of-phase between layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近对 kagome 金属 TbMn6Sn6 的非弹性中子散射 (INS) 研究揭示了与 kagome 层相关的新型手性磁激发。这些激励似乎具有大能量尺度（> 100 meV）和强阻尼的巡回特征；然而，这些激发的起源尚不清楚，而局部矩线性自旋波理论并未预测到这些激发的起源。在这里，我们使用 INS 表明，在 R=Tb、Ho、Er 和 Y 的 RMn6Sn6 化合物中也发现了手性激发，这些化合物分别具有单轴、倾斜、平面亚铁磁体和平面双螺旋磁结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近对 kagome 金属 TbMn6Sn6 的非弹性中子散射 (INS) 研究揭示了与 kagome 层相关的新型手性磁激发。这些激励似乎具有大能量尺度（> 100 meV）和强阻尼的巡回特征；然而，这些激发的起源尚不清楚，而局部矩线性自旋波理论并未预测到这些激发的起源。在这里，我们使用 INS 表明，在 R=Tb、Ho、Er 和 Y 的 RMn6Sn6 化合物中也发现了手性激发，这些化合物分别具有单轴、倾斜、平面亚铁磁体和平面双螺旋磁结构。因此，无论磁结构如何，手性激发都存在。此外，R=Er 和 Y 表明平面磁结构中的手性模式强度较弱，表明激励横向于局部 Mn 矩方向。手性激发仅出现在布里永区中的 L=奇数位置，并且对应于每个 kagome 层内相同旋向的手性自旋激发，以及层之间的 pi 异相。

articles.title: Magnetic-Field-Induced Darkening of Bright Excitons in a MoWSe₂ Monolayer Alloy
articles.title_zh: MoWSe2 单层合金中磁场诱导亮激子暗化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic fields are widely used to brighten spin-forbidden dark excitons, but the inverse effect on an optically bright exciton has remained largely unexplored. We demonstrate the complementary phenomenon of magnetic-field-induced darkening of a bright exciton in Mo₀.₆₈W₀.₃₂Se₂. At 4.2 K, an in-plane magnetic field up to 25 T activates a dark-exciton line 14.2±1.3 meV below the bright exciton while suppressing the bright-exciton emission by about 85%. A bright-dark mixing model quantitatively captures the coupled energy and intensity evolution with an effective in-plane g factor of |gₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ|=5.2±0.2. Alloying is crucial to the effect, as it brings the system close to the bright-dark crossover, where a small bright-dark splitting is combined with unusually strong in-plane magnetic coupling. This places the system in a regime where field-induced level repulsion raises the bright-like branch and strongly depletes its thermal population. These results identify a general route to magnetic control of exciton populations through engineering of the bright-dark hierarchy.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁场被广泛用于使自旋禁止的暗激子变亮，但对光学亮激子的相反影响仍未被探索。我们证明了 Mo0.68W00.32Se2 中亮激子磁场引起的暗化的互补现象。在 4.2 K 时，高达 25 T 的面内磁场会激活亮激子下方 14.2±1.3 meV 的暗激子线，同时抑制亮激子发射约 85%。明暗混合模型定量捕获耦合能量和强度演化，有效面内 g 因子为 |gₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ|=5.2±0.2。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁场被广泛用于使自旋禁止的暗激子变亮，但对光学亮激子的相反影响仍未被探索。我们证明了 Mo0.68W00.32Se2 中亮激子磁场引起的暗化的互补现象。在 4.2 K 时，高达 25 T 的面内磁场会激活亮激子下方 14.2±1.3 meV 的暗激子线，同时抑制亮激子发射约 85%。明暗混合模型定量捕获耦合能量和强度演化，有效面内 g 因子为 |gₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ|=5.2±0.2。合金化对于这种效果至关重要，因为它使系统接近明暗交叉，其中小的明暗分裂与异常强的面内磁耦合相结合。这使得系统处于一种状态，其中场引起的能级排斥使明亮的分支升高并强烈耗尽其热粒子数。这些结果确定了通过明暗等级工程对激子群进行磁控制的一般途径。

articles.title: Rashba-controlled emergence and reversal of critical-field anisotropy in p-wave magnet--superconductor hybrids
articles.title_zh: P波磁体-超导混合体中Rashba控制的临界场各向异性的出现和反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that tuning Rashba spin-orbit coupling can change the in-plane field direction along which an s-wave superconductor is most susceptible to Zeeman depairing. We consider a two-dimensional s-wave superconductor subject to an odd-parity exchange field induced by a p-wave magnet. Without Rashba coupling, the out-of-plane exchange field enhances the in-plane critical field but leaves its angular response exactly isotropic, despite the anisotropic magnetic spin texture. Minimizing the Bogoliubov--de Gennes grand potential over uniform singlet pairing, we find that increasing Rashba coupling first generates and then reverses the principal-axis critical-field contrast, switching the minimum-critical-field direction by 90cⁱrc. Equal principal-axis fields at the intervening compensation point coexist with residual angular modulation. We interpret the reversal through competing momentum-dependent depairing contributions from the magnetic and Rashba spin textures, while the on-site singlet pairing channel remains unchanged. Direction-dependent discontinuous collapses of the order parameter further shape the critical-field curves. These results identify a tunable directional paramagnetic response within the uniform-pairing sector. In heterostructures with sufficient electrostatic tunability of interfacial Rashba coupling, this reversal would enable gate control of the easy-depairing axis without reorienting the magnetic texture.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们表明，调整 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合可以改变面内场方向，s 波超导体最容易受到塞曼脱配对的影响。我们考虑二维 s 波超导体，它受到 p 波磁体感应的奇宇称交换场的影响。如果没有 Rashba 耦合，面外交换场会增强面内临界场，但尽管存在各向异性磁自旋纹理，但其角度响应完全是各向同性的。最小化均匀单重态配对上的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 大势，我们发现增加 Rashba 耦合首先产生然后反转主轴临界场对比度，将最小临界场方向切换 90cⁱrc。
