articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，调整 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合可以改变面内场方向，s 波超导体最容易受到塞曼脱配对的影响。我们考虑二维 s 波超导体，它受到 p 波磁体感应的奇宇称交换场的影响。如果没有 Rashba 耦合，面外交换场会增强面内临界场，但尽管存在各向异性磁自旋纹理，但其角度响应完全是各向同性的。最小化均匀单重态配对上的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 大势，我们发现增加 Rashba 耦合首先产生然后反转主轴临界场对比度，将最小临界场方向切换 90cⁱrc。中间补偿点处的相等主轴场与残余角度调制共存。我们通过来自磁性和 Rashba 自旋纹理的竞争性动量依赖性脱配对贡献来解释这种逆转，而现场单线态配对通道保持不变。阶次参数与方向相关的不连续塌陷进一步塑造了临界场曲线。这些结果确定了均匀配对区域内的可调谐定向顺磁响应。在具有足够的界面 Rashba 耦合静电可调性的异质结构中，这种反转将能够实现对易脱配轴的栅极控制，而无需重新定向磁性纹理。

articles.title: Magnetic-Field Effects on the Electronic States of the K₄ Lattice
articles.title_zh: 磁场对 K₄ 晶格电子态的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the electronic states of the K₄ lattice in a uniform magnetic field within a nearest-neighbor tight-binding model. The K₄ lattice is a rev{noncentrosymmetric three-dimensional network with triple-Dirac cones at the Γ and H points}. By fixing the Bloch momentum component parallel to the field, the Peierls-substituted tight-binding problem reduces to an effective two-dimensional problem and yields a Hofstadter spectrum rev{whose self-similar subpatterns reflect the geometry of the lattice projected onto the plane perpendicular to the field}. A square-like substructure emerges on the flux scale φ = 1/8 for bmBparallel[100], and honeycomb- and triangular-like substructures emerge on the finer scale φ = 1/32 for bmBparallel[111]rev{. Here φ is the flux through the elementary plaquette of the projected lattice, and these scales correspond to one flux quantum per projected unit cell. Owing to the screw axes of the chiral K₄ network, the field-parallel momentum acts as an additional flux, which, for commensurate values of this momentum, shifts the spectrum along the flux axis and brings the second triple-Dirac cone at the H point into the magnetic spectrum}. In the weak-field limit, we derive the Landau-level structure from a low-energy effective Hamiltonian around the Γ point. The three-component nature of the triple-Dirac cone gives rise to a cubic secular equation, whose solutions describe how a pseudospin-flat branch coexists with two relativistic Landau ladders rev{and a single chiral n=0 level dispersing linearly along the field, in agreement with the lattice calculation}.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了最近邻紧束缚模型中均匀磁场中 K₄ 晶格的电子态。 K₄ 晶格是一个 rev非中心对称三维网络，在 Γ 和 H 点处具有三狄拉克锥。通过将布洛赫动量分量固定为平行于场，佩尔斯取代的紧束缚问题简化为有效的二维问题，并产生霍夫施塔特谱 rev其自相似子模式反映了投影到垂直于场的平面上的晶格的几何形状。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了最近邻紧束缚模型中均匀磁场中 K₄ 晶格的电子态。 K₄ 晶格是一个 rev非中心对称三维网络，在 Γ 和 H 点处具有三狄拉克锥。通过将布洛赫动量分量固定为平行于场，佩尔斯取代的紧束缚问题简化为有效的二维问题，并产生霍夫施塔特谱 rev其自相似子模式反映了投影到垂直于场的平面上的晶格的几何形状。对于 bmBparallel[100]，在通量尺度 φ = 1/8 上出现方形子结构，对于 bmBparallel[111]rev{，在更精细的尺度 φ = 1/32 上出现蜂窝状和三角形子结构。这里 φ 是通过投影晶格的基本小板的通量，这些尺度对应于每个投影晶胞的一个通量量子。由于手性 K₄ 网络的螺旋轴，场平行动量充当附加磁通，对于该动量的相应值，该磁通沿磁通轴移动频谱，并将 H 点处的第二个三狄拉克锥带入磁频谱}。在弱场极限下，我们从 Γ 点周围的低能有效哈密顿量推导出朗道能级结构。三狄拉克锥的三分量性质产生了一个三次世俗方程，其解描述了赝自旋平坦分支如何与两个相对论性朗道梯 rev 共存和沿场线性分散的单个手性 n=0 能级，与晶格计算一致。

articles.title: Orbital Magnetization within Self-Consistent Hartree-Fock via an Envelope Theorem
articles.title_zh: 通过包络定理自洽 Hartree-Fock 内的轨道磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbital magnetization is an elementary thermodynamic response function of a quantum system: the derivative of the grand potential with respect to magnetic field. However, naive perturbation theory is fraught with difficulties, as even infinitesimal magnetic fields shatter any bands into a Hofstadter butterfly spectrum. Even at the self-consistent Hartree-Fock (mean field) level, rigorous formulas for the orbital magnetization have only become available within the last year. This work provides a straightforward derivation of orbital magnetization at the mean field level using a completely real-space approach. The key tools used are the magnetic perturbation theory developed in the 1960s and an envelope theorem, which is a standard result in the calculus of variations. For simplicity, we restrict to insulating states at zero temperature on the infinite plane. We also discuss the natural connections to projected position operators and quantum geometry, as well as practical numerical computations.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道磁化强度是量子系统的基本热力学响应函数：大势能相对于磁场的导数。然而，朴素的微扰理论充满了困难，因为即使是无穷小的磁场也会将任何能带粉碎成霍夫施塔特蝴蝶谱。即使在自洽的 Hartree-Fock（平均场）水平上，轨道磁化强度的严格公式也是在去年才出现的。这项工作使用完全实空间的方法提供了平均场水平上轨道磁化强度的直接推导。使用的关键工具是 20 世纪 60 年代开发的磁扰动理论和包络定理，这是变分法的标准结果。为简单起见，我们限制无限平面上零温度下的绝缘状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道磁化强度是量子系统的基本热力学响应函数：大势能相对于磁场的导数。然而，朴素的微扰理论充满了困难，因为即使是无穷小的磁场也会将任何能带粉碎成霍夫施塔特蝴蝶谱。即使在自洽的 Hartree-Fock（平均场）水平上，轨道磁化强度的严格公式也是在去年才出现的。这项工作使用完全实空间的方法提供了平均场水平上轨道磁化强度的直接推导。使用的关键工具是 20 世纪 60 年代开发的磁扰动理论和包络定理，这是变分法的标准结果。为简单起见，我们限制无限平面上零温度下的绝缘状态。我们还讨论了与投影位置算子和量子几何的自然联系，以及实际的数值计算。

articles.title: Lattice symmetry breaking and strain control of single-q magnetism in Na₃Co₂SbO₆
articles.title_zh: Na₃Co2SbO₆中单q磁性的晶格对称性破缺与应变控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distinguishing single-q from multi-q magnetism constrains microscopic spin Hamiltonians. Here we determine the ground state of the candidate Kitaev magnet Na₃Co₂SbO₆ through its coupling to the lattice. High-resolution neutron diffraction reveals a spontaneous monoclinic-to-triclinic distortion at the magnetic transition, in contrast to the absence of detectable lattice-symmetry breaking in triple-q Na₂Co₂TeO₆. Together with strain-selective magnetic responses, this identifies single-q order in Na₃Co₂SbO₆ over the proposed symmetry-preserving double-q state. Uniaxial compression along a low-symmetry in-plane direction achieves the domain selection that magnetic-field training could not, revealing the intrinsic field-induced phase boundaries of the dominant domain. These results establish strain as a symmetry-conjugate field for magnetic domains and highlight magnetoelastic coupling as a route to diagnose, manipulate, and potentially tune magnetic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 区分单 q 与多 q 磁性限制了微观自旋哈密顿量。在这里，我们通过与晶格的耦合确定了候选基塔耶夫磁体 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 的基态。高分辨率中子衍射揭示了磁转变时自发的单斜晶向三斜晶畸变，与三q Na2Co2TeO6 中不存在可检测到的晶格对称性破缺相反。与应变选择性磁响应一起，这确定了 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 中所提出的对称性保持双 q 态的单 q 级。沿低对称性面内方向的单轴压缩实现了磁场训练无法实现的域选择，揭示了主域的固有场感应相边界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 区分单 q 与多 q 磁性限制了微观自旋哈密顿量。在这里，我们通过与晶格的耦合确定了候选基塔耶夫磁体 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 的基态。高分辨率中子衍射揭示了磁转变时自发的单斜晶向三斜晶畸变，与三q Na2Co2TeO6 中不存在可检测到的晶格对称性破缺相反。与应变选择性磁响应一起，这确定了 Na₃Co2SbO₆ 中所提出的对称性保持双 q 态的单 q 级。沿低对称性面内方向的单轴压缩实现了磁场训练无法实现的域选择，揭示了主域的固有场感应相边界。这些结果将应变确立为磁域的对称共轭场，并强调磁弹性耦合作为诊断、操纵和潜在调整磁状态的途径。

articles.title: Pressure-induced superconductivity in a bilayer metal
articles.title_zh: 双层金属中的压力诱导超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a model that explains the mechanism of pressure-induced superconductivity in a bilayer metal. Four types of pair potentials are assumed for a Cooper pair consisting of two electrons on different layers. Absence of local inversion symmetry gives rise to the spin-orbit coupling which is antisymmetric in the two layers. We assume that external pressure enhances the hybridization between the two layers. The stability of the superconducting states is well explained by the frequency symmetry of the induced pairing correlations by these potentials. Pressure-induced superconductivity emerges when the following two conditions are realized. (i) The spin-orbit coupling induces the odd-frequency pairing correlations and suppresses superconductivity at ambient pressure. (ii) The interplay between the spin-orbit coupling and the hybridization induces the additional pairing correlation that belongs to an even-frequency symmetry class. We briefly discuss the relevance of our model to real materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个模型来解释双层金属中压力诱导超导的机制。对于由不同层上的两个电子组成的库珀对，假设有四种类型的对电势。局部反演对称性的缺失导致了两层中反对称的自旋轨道耦合。我们假设外部压力增强了两层之间的杂交。超导态的稳定性可以通过这些电势引起的配对相关性的频率对称性得到很好的解释。当满足以下两个条件时，就会出现压力诱导超导性。 （i）自旋轨道耦合引起奇数频率配对相关性并抑制环境压力下的超导性。 （ii）自旋轨道耦合和杂交之间的相互作用引起了属于偶频对称类的附加配对相关性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个模型来解释双层金属中压力诱导超导的机制。对于由不同层上的两个电子组成的库珀对，假设有四种类型的对电势。局部反演对称性的缺失导致了两层中反对称的自旋轨道耦合。我们假设外部压力增强了两层之间的杂交。超导态的稳定性可以通过这些电势引起的配对相关性的频率对称性得到很好的解释。当满足以下两个条件时，就会出现压力诱导超导性。 （i）自旋轨道耦合引起奇数频率配对相关性并抑制环境压力下的超导性。 （ii）自旋轨道耦合和杂交之间的相互作用引起了属于偶频对称类的附加配对相关性。我们简要讨论我们的模型与真实材料的相关性。

articles.title: Spin fluctuations and nearly isotropic quasiparticles in the doped three-dimensional Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 掺杂三维哈伯德模型中的自旋涨落和近各向同性准粒子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Away from half filling and above its Neel temperature, the three-dimensional Hubbard model is a paramagnetic metal with antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations, where controlled momentum-resolved results have been lacking. Using connected-determinant diagrammatic Monte Carlo, we compute the momentum-resolved self-energy for n = 0.4-0.95, T/t = 0.05-0.33 and U/t = 4-8, and the full-zone spin susceptibility at twelve of these points, focusing on U/t = 4. At U/t = 4 and toward half filling the spin fluctuations become strong: for n = 0.7-0.9 at T/t = 0.14 they enhance the susceptibility peak up to sevenfold and raise the momentum-dependent part of the scattering rate to four to five times its second-order value. They are driven by an effective spin interaction screened to about 2U/3 and nearly uniform over the zone. Yet the peak height is set by the slightly smaller value of this interaction at the peak wave vector, and near magnetic order this small difference changes the height by a large factor. Two-particle self-consistent theory reproduces the peak because its sum rule fixes its single constant interaction near this value, but for n = 0.7-0.9 at T/t = 0.14 its self-energy overestimates the local scattering rate and underestimates the momentum-dependent part. Though strong, the fluctuations are short ranged, with a correlation length of at most about two lattice spacings, and for n = 0.7-0.9 and T/t >= 0.14 the scattering rate near the Fermi surface varies by at most about 1% at fixed band energy, without hot spots. At U/t = 4 dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) reproduces the local scattering rate and quasiparticle weight within a few percent, and the nonlocal part it misses is approximately a function of the band energy. Strong spin fluctuations thus coexist with nearly isotropic quasiparticles, and the results provide a benchmark for extensions of DMFT and for spin-fluctuation theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 远离半填充且高于尼尔温度，三维哈伯德模型是一种具有反铁磁自旋涨落的顺磁性金属，其中缺乏受控动量解析结果。使用连通行列式蒙特卡罗图，我们计算了 n = 0.4-0.95、T/t = 0.05-0.33 和 U/t = 4-8 的动量分辨自能，以及其中 12 个点的全区自旋敏感性，重点关注 U/t = 4。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 远离半填充且高于尼尔温度，三维哈伯德模型是一种具有反铁磁自旋涨落的顺磁性金属，其中缺乏受控动量解析结果。使用连通行列式蒙特卡罗图，我们计算了 n = 0.4-0.95、T/t = 0.05-0.33 和 U/t = 4-8 的动量分辨自能，以及其中 12 个点的全区自旋敏感性，重点关注 U/t = 4。在 U/t = 4 和接近半填充时，自旋涨落变得很强：对于 T/t 处的 n = 0.7-0.9 = 0.14 它们将磁化率峰值增强至七倍，并将散射率的动量相关部分提高至其二阶值的四到五倍。它们由有效的自旋相互作用驱动，该自旋相互作用筛选至约 2U/3 并且在整个区域上几乎均匀。然而，峰值高度是由峰值波矢量处的这种相互作用的稍小的值决定的，并且在磁阶附近，这种微小的差异会以很大的系数改变高度。双粒子自洽理论再现了峰值，因为它的求和规则将其单一常数相互作用固定在该值附近，但对于 n = 0.7-0.9，T/t = 0.14，其自能高估了局部散射率并低估了动量相关部分。虽然波动很强，但波动范围很短，相关长度最多约为两个晶格间距，并且对于 n = 0.7-0.9 且 T/t >= 0.14，费米表面附近的散射率在固定带能量下最多变化约 1%，没有热点。当 U/t = 4 时，动态平均场理论 (DMFT) 在百分之几内重现了局部散射率和准粒子重量，并且它错过的非局部部分大约是能带能量的函数。因此，强自旋涨落与近各向同性准粒子共存，其结果为 DMFT 的扩展和自旋涨落理论提供了基准。

articles.title: Suppression and reemergence of directional transport across the ferromagnetic transition in SrRuO₃
articles.title_zh: SrRuO₃ 中铁磁转变方向定向输运的抑制和重新出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: SrRuO₃ is a canonical itinerant ferromagnet that continues to serve as a fertile platform for exploring spin-orbit coupled transport and topological responses in correlated oxide metals. Here, we investigate a (110)-oriented epitaxial SrRuO3 thin film on DyScO₃, where crystallographic anisotropy allows for symmetry-resolved charge transport along orthogonal in-plane directions. We uncover two principal findings. First, the resistance above the Curie temperature Tc,ₒₙapprox 165 K exhibits strong anisotropy, consistent with directionally dependent spin-fluctuation scattering. Below Tc,ₒₙ, this anisotropy nearly vanishes, despite persistent structural inequivalence, due to isotropic electron-magnon and electron-electron scattering processes. Second, the application of a magnetic field reveals a striking directional contrast in the linear magnetoresistance (MR): it remains negative and saturates along [001], but changes sign and becomes positive along [1bar10] below T₀=145 K. In contrast, the quadratic MR term is identical for both directions and peaks near TOHE^*=155 K, where the ordinary Hall coefficient crosses zero, consistent with carrier compensation under a two-band scenario. A sign change in the anomalous Hall signal at TAHE^*=150 K is consistent with a temperature-dependent redistribution of Berry-curvature contributions near the Fermi level. These results establish ferromagnetic ordering as the primary driver of the observed directional magnetotransport in SrRuO₃.
articles.abstract_zh: SrRuO₃ 是一种典型的流动铁磁体，它继续作为探索相关氧化物金属中自旋轨道耦合输运和拓扑响应的丰富平台。在这里，我们研究了 DyScO₃ 上的 (110) 取向外延 SrRuO3 薄膜，其中晶体各向异性允许沿正交面内方向对称解析电荷传输。我们发现了两个主要发现。首先，高于居里温度 Tc（约 165 K）的电阻表现出很强的各向异性，与方向相关的自旋涨落散射一致。在 Tc,ₒₙ 以下，尽管由于各向同性电子-磁振子和电子-电子散射过程而导致结构持续不平等，但这种各向异性几乎消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: SrRuO₃ 是一种典型的流动铁磁体，它继续作为探索相关氧化物金属中自旋轨道耦合输运和拓扑响应的丰富平台。在这里，我们研究了 DyScO₃ 上的 (110) 取向外延 SrRuO3 薄膜，其中晶体各向异性允许沿正交面内方向对称解析电荷传输。我们发现了两个主要发现。首先，高于居里温度 Tc（约 165 K）的电阻表现出很强的各向异性，与方向相关的自旋涨落散射一致。在 Tc,ₒₙ 以下，尽管由于各向同性电子-磁振子和电子-电子散射过程而导致结构持续不平等，但这种各向异性几乎消失。其次，磁场的应用揭示了线性磁阻 (MR) 中显着的方向对比：它保持负值并沿 [001] 饱和，但在 T₀=145 K 下改变符号并沿 [1bar10] 变为正值。相比之下，二次 MR 项对于两个方向和 TOHE^*=155 K 附近的峰值是相同的，其中普通霍尔系数过零，与双频带情况下的载波补偿一致。 TAHE^*=150 K 处异常霍尔信号的符号变化与费米能级附近贝里曲率贡献的温度依赖性重新分布一致。这些结果确立了铁磁有序性是 SrRuO₃ 中观察到的定向磁输运的主要驱动力。

articles.title: Accelerating real-time hybrid-functional calculations with learned ACE and symmetry-based FFT reuse
articles.title_zh: 通过学习的 ACE 和基于对称的 FFT 重用加速实时混合功能计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time hybrid-functional calculations require repeated reconstruction of nonlocal exchange, whose cost grows rapidly with Brillouin-zone sampling. We develop two methods to improve the efficiency of time evolution and spatial processing. The first learns the time evolution of adaptively compressed exchange (ACE) factors and predicts their updates, reducing the frequency of explicit reconstruction. The second uses crystal symmetry to reuse exchange fast Fourier transforms (FFTs) among equivalent real-space points. This symmetry-based FFT reuse (SBFR) reduces the number of FFTs while retaining the full bm k-point sum. The methods can be used with a variety of hybrid functionals, and we use HSE06 in this work. Relative to an ACE reference using full-row mesh FFTs, learned prediction provides more than fivefold acceleration, SBFR more than fourteenfold, and their combination more than sixty-threefold. The combined method shows efficient parallel scaling. After learning, propagation takes less than 0.5 s per step. The reduced computational cost allows us to study nonlinear and nonequilibrium electron dynamics with hybrid functionals and to examine the role of excitonic effects in semiconductors and insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 实时混合功能计算需要重复重建非局域交换，其成本随着布里渊区采样而迅速增长。我们开发了两种方法来提高时间演化和空间处理的效率。第一个学习自适应压缩交换（ACE）因子的时间演化并预测它们的更新，从而减少显式重建的频率。第二种利用晶体对称性在等效的实空间点之间重复使用交换快速傅立叶变换 (FFT)。这种基于对称性的 FFT 重用 (SBFR) 减少了 FFT 的数量，同时保留了完整的 bm k 点和。这些方法可以与各种混合泛函一起使用，我们在这项工作中使用 HSE06。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实时混合功能计算需要重复重建非局域交换，其成本随着布里渊区采样而迅速增长。我们开发了两种方法来提高时间演化和空间处理的效率。第一个学习自适应压缩交换（ACE）因子的时间演化并预测它们的更新，从而减少显式重建的频率。第二种利用晶体对称性在等效的实空间点之间重复使用交换快速傅立叶变换 (FFT)。这种基于对称性的 FFT 重用 (SBFR) 减少了 FFT 的数量，同时保留了完整的 bm k 点和。这些方法可以与各种混合泛函一起使用，我们在这项工作中使用 HSE06。相对于使用全行网格 FFT 的 ACE 参考，学习预测提供了超过五倍的加速，SBFR 超过十四倍，它们的组合超过六十三倍。组合方法显示了高效的并行缩放。学习后，每步传播时间不到 0.5 秒。计算成本的降低使我们能够利用混合泛函研究非线性和非平衡电子动力学，并研究激子效应在半导体和绝缘体中的作用。

articles.title: Collective Hall quantization in 3D Chern vector systems
articles.title_zh: 3D Chern 矢量系统中的集体霍尔量化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the three-dimensional (3D) quantum Hall effect, characterized by a Chern vector rather than a single Chern number, has been a central pursuit in topological physics. While quantized Hall transport is established for the special case with one nonzero Chern component, recent realizations of more general Chern-vector states raise a fundamental question: how does such topology protect quantized transport? Here, we predict a distinct 3D quantized Hall effect protected by C=(0,m,n). For samples with dimensions L_y and L_z, global topology enforces collective quantization of mL_y+nL_z, despite the fragility of individual edge modes to disorder. This reveals a novel transport regime in which robust quantization emerges as a holistic property of a unified chiral network,rather than of its constituent modes. Crucially, this collective response manifests as a quantized Hall conductance Gₓy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h, with a distinctive dependence on both Chern-vector components and sample dimensions. We propose candidate materials to facilitate experimental observation.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解三维 (3D) 量子霍尔效应（以陈矢量而不是单个陈数为特征）一直是拓扑物理学的核心追求。虽然量化霍尔传输是针对具有一个非零陈组件的特殊情况建立的，但最近对更一般的陈矢量状态的实现提出了一个基本问题：这种拓扑如何保护量化传输？在这里，我们预测受 C=(0,m,n) 保护的独特 3D 量化霍尔效应。对于尺寸为 L_y 和 L_z 的样本，全局拓扑强制执行 mL_y+nL_z 的集体量化，尽管各个边缘模式对无序的脆弱性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解三维 (3D) 量子霍尔效应（以陈矢量而不是单个陈数为特征）一直是拓扑物理学的核心追求。虽然量化霍尔传输是针对具有一个非零陈组件的特殊情况建立的，但最近对更一般的陈矢量状态的实现提出了一个基本问题：这种拓扑如何保护量化传输？在这里，我们预测受 C=(0,m,n) 保护的独特 3D 量化霍尔效应。对于尺寸为 L_y 和 L_z 的样本，全局拓扑强制执行 mL_y+nL_z 的集体量化，尽管各个边缘模式对无序的脆弱性。这揭示了一种新颖的传输机制，其中鲁棒量子化作为统一手性网络的整体属性出现，而不是其组成模式的整体属性。至关重要的是，这种集体响应表现为量化霍尔电导 Gₓy=±(mL_y+nL_z)e²/h，对陈矢量分量和样本尺寸具有独特的依赖性。我们提出候选材料以促进实验观察。

articles.title: On the origin of nonreciprocal charge transport in topological insulator BiSbTeSe2
articles.title_zh: 拓扑绝缘体 BiSbTeSe2 中不可逆电荷传输的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27849v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport provides an effective approach for probing direction dependent charge dynamics and spin-momentum-locked electronic states. Here, we report highly gate-tunable nonreciprocal charge transport in dual-gated BiSbTeSe2 topological insulator device. The second-harmonic longitudinal resistance is linear in both current and magnetic field. The nonreciprocal response reaches its maximum near the charge neutrality point, exhibits sign reversals on either side, and is strongly suppressed once the Fermi level enters the bulk states. We suggest that the nonreciprocal response is attributed to the inhomogeneity of spin-momentum locking in the topological surface states. The nonreciprocal signal near the charge neutrality point is about one order of magnitude larger than that without gate modulation and remains robust up to 300 K, highlighting BiSbTeSe2 as a promising platform for room-temperature nonlinear electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 非互易电荷传输为探测方向依赖的电荷动力学和自旋动量锁定电子态提供了一种有效的方法。在这里，我们报告了双栅极 BiSbTeSe2 拓扑绝缘体器件中的高度栅极可调的不可逆电荷传输。二次谐波纵向电阻在电流和磁场中都是线性的。不可逆响应在电荷中性点附近达到最大值，在两侧表现出符号反转，并且一旦费米能级进入体态，就会受到强烈抑制。我们认为不可逆响应归因于拓扑表面态中自旋动量锁定的不均匀性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非互易电荷传输为探测方向依赖的电荷动力学和自旋动量锁定电子态提供了一种有效的方法。在这里，我们报告了双栅极 BiSbTeSe2 拓扑绝缘体器件中的高度栅极可调的不可逆电荷传输。二次谐波纵向电阻在电流和磁场中都是线性的。不可逆响应在电荷中性点附近达到最大值，在两侧表现出符号反转，并且一旦费米能级进入体态，就会受到强烈抑制。我们认为不可逆响应归因于拓扑表面态中自旋动量锁定的不均匀性。电荷中性点附近的不可逆信号比没有栅极调制的信号大大约一个数量级，并且在高达 300 K 的温度下仍然保持鲁棒性，这凸显了 BiSbTeSe2 作为室温非线性电子器件的一个有前途的平台。

articles.title: Classical-to-Quantum Transition in Blackbody Radiation Thermodynamics: Planck's Law without Statistical Assumptions
articles.title_zh: 黑体辐射热力学中的经典到量子转变：没有统计假设的普朗克定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inspired by Fermi's model of radiation-matter interaction, we investigate the classical dynamics of a closed, finite-energy system, in which matter is coupled to an electromagnetic field. We find that energy is progressively transferred to increasingly high-frequency field modes, so that the effective temperature of both matter and radiation approaches zero in the long-time limit - in sharp contradiction with the finite-temperature equilibrium assumed by classical blackbody thermodynamics. Requiring consistency with the Stefan-Boltzmann and Wien laws identifies a characteristic time t_L, at which both laws are simultaneously satisfied. Strikingly, classical spectra obtained for different energies and cavity sizes collapse onto the universal Planck distribution at t_L. We conjecture that quantum dynamical localization arrests the classical energy cascade at t_L, and that the Planck distribution emerges as a dynamical consequence of this arrest - without invoking any a priori statistical assumption.
articles.abstract_zh: 受费米辐射与物质相互作用模型的启发，我们研究了封闭有限能量系统的经典动力学，其中物质与电磁场耦合。我们发现能量逐渐转移到越来越高频的场模式，使得物质和辐射的有效温度在长时间极限内接近于零——这与经典黑体热力学假设的有限温度平衡形成鲜明矛盾。要求与斯蒂芬-玻尔兹曼定律和维恩定律保持一致，确定了两个定律同时满足的特征时间 t_L。引人注目的是，针对不同能量和腔尺寸获得的经典光谱在 t_L 处崩溃到通用普朗克分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受费米辐射与物质相互作用模型的启发，我们研究了封闭有限能量系统的经典动力学，其中物质与电磁场耦合。我们发现能量逐渐转移到越来越高频的场模式，使得物质和辐射的有效温度在长时间极限内接近于零——这与经典黑体热力学假设的有限温度平衡形成鲜明矛盾。要求与斯蒂芬-玻尔兹曼定律和维恩定律保持一致，确定了两个定律同时满足的特征时间 t_L。引人注目的是，针对不同能量和腔尺寸获得的经典光谱在 t_L 处崩溃到通用普朗克分布。我们推测，量子动力学局域化将经典能量级联抑制在 t_L 处，并且普朗克分布作为这种抑制的动力学结果而出现——无需调用任何先验统计假设。

articles.title: Effect of interfacial water structure on the adsorption of weakly hydrated anions
articles.title_zh: 界面水结构对弱水合阴离子吸附的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weakly hydrated anions tend to partition to macromolecular surfaces, leading to salting-in at low salt concentrations. Recent studies have linked this partitioning to disruption of the interfacial water network. Here, we investigate the role of interfacial-water-network disruption as an indirect driving force for the adsorption of weakly hydrated anions and its interplay with direct solute-anion and anion-cation interactions using computer simulations. We study the adsorption of SCN⁻ and I⁻ ions on a model extended solute that interacts with water and ions only via van der Waals interactions. To probe the indirect contribution, we increase the effective solute size while simultaneously decreasing the attractive solute-water and solute-ion interactions, resulting in progressively greater disorder in the interfacial water network in pure aqueous solutions. Our results show that iodide adsorption increases despite weaker direct solute-iodide interactions and correlates with greater disruption of the interfacial water network, although iodide remains depleted overall. In contrast, preferential adsorption of SCN⁻ decreases, but the rate of decrease becomes smaller at higher levels of interfacial-water-network disorder. This suggests that the indirect contribution associated with interfacial-water-network disruption partly compensates for the decrease in SCN⁻ adsorption caused by weaker direct solute-SCN⁻ interactions. Our results highlight that the indirect contribution associated with interfacial-water-network disruption promotes the adsorption of weakly hydrated anions on macromolecular surfaces, while the extent of adsorption also depends on direct solute-ion interactions and anion-cation pairing. This interplay may be particularly important in mixed-salt solutions, where the presence of strongly hydrated anions can also disrupt the interfacial water network.
articles.abstract_zh: 弱水合阴离子倾向于分配到大分子表面，导致低盐浓度下的盐析。最近的研究将这种分配与界面水网络的破坏联系起来。在这里，我们使用计算机模拟研究了界面水网络破坏作为弱水合阴离子吸附的间接驱动力的作用及其与直接溶质阴离子和阴离子阳离子相互作用的相互作用。我们研究了 SCN⁻ 和 I⁻ 离子在模型扩展溶质上的吸附，该溶质仅通过范德华相互作用与水和离子相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 弱水合阴离子倾向于分配到大分子表面，导致低盐浓度下的盐析。最近的研究将这种分配与界面水网络的破坏联系起来。在这里，我们使用计算机模拟研究了界面水网络破坏作为弱水合阴离子吸附的间接驱动力的作用及其与直接溶质阴离子和阴离子阳离子相互作用的相互作用。我们研究了 SCN⁻ 和 I⁻ 离子在模型扩展溶质上的吸附，该溶质仅通过范德华相互作用与水和离子相互作用。为了探究间接贡献，我们增加了有效溶质尺寸，同时减少了有吸引力的溶质-水和溶质-离子相互作用，导致纯水溶液中界面水网络的无序性逐渐增大。我们的结果表明，尽管直接溶质-碘化物相互作用较弱，但碘化物吸附仍增加，并且与界面水网络的更大破坏相关，尽管碘化物总体上仍处于耗尽状态。相反，SCN⁻的优先吸附减少，但在界面水网络无序程度较高时，减少的速率变得更小。这表明与界面水网络破坏相关的间接贡献部分补偿了由较弱的直接溶质-SCN⁻相互作用引起的SCN⁻吸附的减少。我们的结果强调，与界面水网络破坏相关的间接贡献促进了弱水合阴离子在大分子表面上的吸附，而吸附程度还取决于直接的溶质离子相互作用和阴离子阳离子配对。这种相互作用在混合盐溶液中可能特别重要，其中强水合阴离子的存在也会破坏界面水网络。

articles.title: Generalized Spin Groups and Applications to Magnons
articles.title_zh: 广义自旋群及其在磁振子中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin groups provide the natural symmetry framework for the isotropic Heisenberg model, in which spin and lattice degrees of freedom are separable. They have recently found broad applications in describing electronic band structure, magnon band topology, and transport phenomena. However, a typical spin Hamiltonian describing magnons contains not only isotropic Heisenberg exchange but also anisotropic interactions induced by spin-orbit coupling (SOC), including the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, the Gamma exchange, and the single-ion anisotropy (SIA), which strongly influence magnon properties. More recently, some studies have also revealed relativistic magnon transport phenomena in altermagnets. Such systems typically exhibit partial spin-lattice locking, but are commonly assumed to be described by conventional magnetic groups. Here, we develop a systematic symmetry framework, generalized spin groups, for magnons. We first classify the symmetries of Heisenberg, DM, Gamma, and SIA interactions. The resulting classification contains 6 spin-only groups, together with a total of 161 nontrivial spin groups. The symmetries of magnetically ordered phases are then obtained through spontaneous symmetry breaking of the corresponding parent groups for spin Hamiltonians. We also identify 6 spin-only groups for ordered states, which generate 90, 264, 157, 264, 387, and 598 nontrivial spin groups, respectively. Finally, we apply generalized spin groups to the magnon thermal conductivity and spin conductivity tensors and derive all the symmetry-allowed forms. Our results provide a unified symmetry framework for analyzing magnon transport both with and without SOC, yielding more refined constraints on magnon responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋群为各向同性海森堡模型提供了自然对称框架，其中自旋和晶格自由度是可分离的。他们最近在描述电子能带结构、磁振子能带拓扑和输运现象方面发现了广泛的应用。然而，描述磁振子的典型自旋哈密顿量不仅包含各向同性海森堡交换，还包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）引起的各向异性相互作用，包括Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用、伽玛交换和单离子各向异性（SIA），这些相互作用强烈影响磁振子性质。最近，一些研究还揭示了交流磁体中的相对论磁振子输运现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋群为各向同性海森堡模型提供了自然对称框架，其中自旋和晶格自由度是可分离的。他们最近在描述电子能带结构、磁振子能带拓扑和输运现象方面发现了广泛的应用。然而，描述磁振子的典型自旋哈密顿量不仅包含各向同性海森堡交换，还包含自旋轨道耦合（SOC）引起的各向异性相互作用，包括Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用、伽玛交换和单离子各向异性（SIA），这些相互作用强烈影响磁振子性质。最近，一些研究还揭示了交流磁体中的相对论磁振子输运现象。此类系统通常表现出部分自旋晶格锁定，但通常假设由常规磁性基团描述。在这里，我们为磁振子开发了一个系统的对称框架，即广义自旋群。我们首先对 Heisenberg、DM、Gamma 和 SIA 相互作用的对称性进行分类。生成的分类包含 6 个仅自旋组，以及总共 161 个非平凡自旋组。然后通过自旋哈密顿量的相应母群的自发对称破缺获得磁有序相的对称性。我们还确定了有序态的 6 个仅自旋群，它们分别生成 90、264、157、264、387 和 598 个非平凡自旋群。最后，我们将广义自旋群应用于磁振子热导率和自旋电导率张量，并导出所有对称允许的形式。我们的结果提供了一个统一的对称框架，用于分析有和没有 SOC 的磁振子输运，从而对磁振子响应产生更精细的约束。

articles.title: Rare-earth tuning of magnetic entropy and interaction scales in K₃Ln(PO₄)₂ (Ln = Yb, Gd) for adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration
articles.title_zh: 用于绝热退磁制冷的 K₃Ln(PO₄)2 (Ln = Yb, Gd) 中磁熵和相互作用尺度的稀土调谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) based on frustrated rare-earth magnets provides a promising route toward helium-free sub-Kelvin cooling, while balancing magnetic entropy and interaction scales is essential for optimizing the ADR functionalities. Here we investigate the low-temperature magnetic and ADR properties of the alkali rare-earth double phosphates K₃Ln(PO₄)₂ (Ln = Yb, Gd), which crystallize in a monoclinic P2₁/m structure containing distorted isosceles triangular lattices of rare-earth ions. Magnetization and specific heat measurements confirm the absence of long-range magnetic ordering down to 0.1 K in both compounds. Direct quasi-ADR measurements demonstrate strongly contrasting refrigeration behaviors: K₃Yb(PO₄)₂ reaches a minimum temperature of 29.8 mK from an initial state of 2 K and 6 T, whereas K₃Gd(PO₄)₂ exhibits extended hold times below 150 mK associated with its larger magnetic entropy reservoir. Crystal-electric-field calculations confirm a Jₑff = 1/2 ground-state doublet in K₃Yb(PO₄)₂, while thermodynamic analysis based on magnetic entropy and interaction scales accounts for the distinct ADR performance of the two compounds. These results identify K₃Ln(PO₄)₂ as a chemically robust platform for rare-earth-tunable solid-state ADR.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于受挫稀土磁体的绝热退磁制冷（ADR）为无氦亚开尔文冷却提供了一条有前途的途径，同时平衡磁熵和相互作用尺度对于优化 ADR 功能至关重要。在这里，我们研究了碱稀土双磷酸盐 K₃Ln(PO4)2 (Ln = Yb, Gd) 的低温磁性和 ADR 特性，该磷酸盐以单斜晶系 P2₁/m 结构结晶，含有稀土离子的扭曲等腰三角形晶格。磁化强度和比热测量证实两种化合物不存在低至 0.1 K 的长程磁有序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于受挫稀土磁体的绝热退磁制冷（ADR）为无氦亚开尔文冷却提供了一条有前途的途径，同时平衡磁熵和相互作用尺度对于优化 ADR 功能至关重要。在这里，我们研究了碱稀土双磷酸盐 K₃Ln(PO4)2 (Ln = Yb, Gd) 的低温磁性和 ADR 特性，该磷酸盐以单斜晶系 P2₁/m 结构结晶，含有稀土离子的扭曲等腰三角形晶格。磁化强度和比热测量证实两种化合物不存在低至 0.1 K 的长程磁有序。直接准 ADR 测量显示出强烈对比的制冷行为：K₃Yb(PO₄)2 从 2 K 和 6 T 的初始状态达到 29.8 mK 的最低温度，而 K₃Gd(PO₄)2 表现出低于 150 mK 的延长保持时间，这与其较大的磁熵库相关。晶体电场计算证实了 K₃Yb(PO₄)2 中存在 Jₑff = 1/2 基态双峰，而基于磁熵和相互作用尺度的热力学分析则解释了两种化合物不同的 ADR 性能。这些结果表明 K₃Ln(PO₄)2 是稀土可调谐固态 ADR 的化学稳健平台。

articles.title: Contrasting Crystal-Field and Dipolar Anisotropies in the Triangular Antiferromagnet NaBaEr(BO₃)₂
articles.title_zh: 对比三角形反铁磁体 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 中的晶体场和偶极各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The magnetic ground states of rare-earth frustrated magnets can be governed by competing energy scales arising from crystal-field anisotropy, exchange interactions, and long-range dipolar interactions. Here we investigate this interplay in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet NaBaEr(BO₃)₂ by combining magnetization, specific heat, and neutron scattering measurements. Neutron powder diffraction resolves rotations of the ErO₆ octahedra and supports the lower-symmetry Rbar3 structure over the previously proposed Rbar3m model. Magnetization measurements and inelastic neutron scattering establish an effective spin-1/2 description of its low-temperature magnetism with pronounced easy-axis anisotropy, arising from a well-isolated Kramers ground-state doublet separated from the first excited crystal-electric-field level by approximately 4 meV. Below Tᵣₘ N=0.1 K, single-crystal neutron diffraction reveals A-type antiferromagnetic order with the ordered moment predominantly oriented within the ab plane, despite the pronounced paramagnetic easy-axis anisotropy. The estimated dipolar interaction scale is comparable to Tᵣₘ N, and classical dipolar-energy calculations for the observed stacking pattern favor an in-plane moment orientation. These results reveal contrasting crystal-field and dipolar anisotropies in determining the magnetic ground state of NaBaEr(BO₃)₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土受挫磁体的磁基态可以通过晶体场各向异性、交换相互作用和长程偶极相互作用产生的竞争能级来控制。在这里，我们通过结合磁化强度、比热和中子散射测量来研究三角晶格反铁磁体 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 中的这种相互作用。中子粉末衍射解析了 ErO₆ 八面体的旋转，并支持先前提出的 Rbar3m 模型的低对称性 Rbar3 结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土受挫磁体的磁基态可以通过晶体场各向异性、交换相互作用和长程偶极相互作用产生的竞争能级来控制。在这里，我们通过结合磁化强度、比热和中子散射测量来研究三角晶格反铁磁体 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 中的这种相互作用。中子粉末衍射解析了 ErO₆ 八面体的旋转，并支持先前提出的 Rbar3m 模型的低对称性 Rbar3 结构。磁化测量和非弹性中子散射建立了对其低温磁性的有效自旋 1/2 描述，具有明显的易轴各向异性，源于与第一激发晶体电场水平分离约 4 meV 的良好隔离的克莱默基态双峰。在 Tᵣₘ N=0.1 K 以下，单晶中子衍射揭示了 A 型反铁磁序，尽管顺磁易轴各向异性明显，但有序矩主要定向在 ab 平面内。估计的偶极相互作用尺度与 Tᵣₘ N 相当，观察到的堆积模式的经典偶极能量计算有利于面内力矩方向。这些结果揭示了在确定 NaBaEr(BO₃)2 的磁性基态时对比的晶体场和偶极各向异性。

articles.title: Polarity-selective domain wall propagation driven by spin-orbit torque
articles.title_zh: 自旋轨道扭矩驱动的极性选择性畴壁传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial variations in magnetic anisotropy impede the spin-orbit-torque-driven motion of chiral domain walls in perpendicularly magnetized nanowires. We show that the local geometry of a two-dimensional anisotropy landscape can select which wall polarity propagates under a given current. Micromagnetic simulations of spatially correlated random anisotropy landscapes generated by diffusion-based smoothing reveal different propagation outcomes for up--down and down--up walls within the same disorder realization. A single inclined anisotropy boundary isolates the mechanism: in the presence of the Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction, opposite wall polarities develop opposite current-induced tilts, producing different alignment with the boundary and hence different pinning strengths. Reversing the boundary inclination interchanges the pinned and propagating polarities. An extended collective-coordinate model captures this geometric selection and distinguishes the propagation threshold from the static pinning limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁各向异性的空间变化阻碍了垂直磁化纳米线中手性畴壁的自旋轨道扭矩驱动的运动。我们证明，二维各向异性景观的局部几何形状可以选择在给定电流下传播哪种壁极性。通过基于扩散的平滑生成的空间相关随机各向异性景观的微磁模拟揭示了在相同无序实现中上下和向下墙壁的不同传播结果。单个倾斜各向异性边界隔离了该机制：在存在 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的情况下，相反的壁极性会产生相反的电流引起的倾斜，从而产生与边界的不同对准，从而产生不同的钉扎强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁各向异性的空间变化阻碍了垂直磁化纳米线中手性畴壁的自旋轨道扭矩驱动的运动。我们证明，二维各向异性景观的局部几何形状可以选择在给定电流下传播哪种壁极性。通过基于扩散的平滑生成的空间相关随机各向异性景观的微磁模拟揭示了在相同无序实现中上下和向下墙壁的不同传播结果。单个倾斜各向异性边界隔离了该机制：在存在 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的情况下，相反的壁极性会产生相反的电流引起的倾斜，从而产生与边界的不同对准，从而产生不同的钉扎强度。反转边界倾角会互换固定极性和传播极性。扩展的集体坐标模型捕获这种几何选择，并将传播阈值与静态固定限制区分开来。

articles.title: Time-Reversal Symmetry in Artificial Topological Graphene Rings
articles.title_zh: 人工拓扑石墨烯环的时间反演对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study an artificial graphene ring described by the low-energy two-valley Dirac Hamiltonian with a uniform mass term. When the ring is threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm flux, the problem reduces to a second-order radial equation solved by Bessel functions. We give the exact secular equation and, for narrow rings, closed expressions for the spectrum and the persistent current. We then add a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the plane. The radial problem is solved with confluent hypergeometric functions, and the persistent current and magnetization are written as derivatives of a secular determinant from which the spurious roots have been removed. Besides the usual orbital coupling, the field enters through a valley-dependent term that comes from the Dirac structure and lifts the valley degeneracy. A weak-field expansion, accurate up to corrections of order B⁴, gives this valley splitting explicitly and separates the diamagnetic and paramagnetic contributions to the susceptibility. Finally, we work out what time reversal implies for the spectrum. Physical time reversal, which exchanges the valleys, leads to an exact relation between levels at opposite fields. The effective single-valley time reversal, on the other hand, is broken by the mass term and by the boundary conditions, yet leaves no trace in the zero-field spectrum. Numerical results for the spectrum, the persistent current, and the magnetization illustrate the analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由具有均匀质量项的低能双谷狄拉克哈密顿量描述的人造石墨烯环。当环上有阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量时，问题简化为由贝塞尔函数求解的二阶径向方程。我们给出了精确的世俗方程，并且对于窄环，给出了频谱和持续电流的闭合表达式。然后我们添加一个垂直于平面的均匀磁场。径向问题通过汇合超几何函数来解决，并且持续电流和磁化强度被写为长期行列式的导数，其中杂散根已被删除。除了通常的轨道耦合之外，场还通过来自狄拉克结构的谷相关项进入并提升谷简并性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了由具有均匀质量项的低能双谷狄拉克哈密顿量描述的人造石墨烯环。当环上有阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量时，问题简化为由贝塞尔函数求解的二阶径向方程。我们给出了精确的世俗方程，并且对于窄环，给出了频谱和持续电流的闭合表达式。然后我们添加一个垂直于平面的均匀磁场。径向问题通过汇合超几何函数来解决，并且持续电流和磁化强度被写为长期行列式的导数，其中杂散根已被删除。除了通常的轨道耦合之外，场还通过来自狄拉克结构的谷相关项进入并提升谷简并性。精确到 B⁴ 阶校正的弱场展开明确地给出了该谷分裂，并将抗磁和顺磁对磁化率的贡献分开。最后，我们计算出时间反转对频谱意味着什么。物理时间反转，交换山谷，导致相反领域的水平之间的精确关系。另一方面，有效的单谷时间反演被质量项和边界条件破坏，但在零场谱中没有留下任何痕迹。频谱、持续电流和磁化强度的数值结果说明了分析。

articles.title: Neural Network Fractional Quantum Hall States with Learnable Orbital Pair Matrix Factors: Balancing Physical Priors and Flexibility
articles.title_zh: 具有可学习轨道对矩阵因子的神经网络分数量子霍尔态：平衡物理先验和灵活性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural network fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states offer a promising alternative for capturing Landau level (LL) mixing and for understanding FQH physics, yet the incorporation of physical priors has so far been limited to the minimal exact constraints built into the ansatz. Working in spherical geometry, we show that the network's flexibility suffers both when only minimal additional physical priors are supplied and when priors such as flux attachment are imposed rigidly. In the former case, the monopole harmonic product orbital (MHPO) ansatz is difficult to optimize, whereas in the latter, the expressivity of the neural network is restricted. We therefore propose the orbital pair matrix factor MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz, which balances physical priors against flexibility by not only replacing the fixed Laughlin structure with learnable pair factors but also making them dependent on both the electron configurations and the orbitals. Across ν=1/5, 1/3, and 2/5, MHPO-M achieves the lowest variational energy among the tested variants, and a factorized orbital readout based on it enables scaling to 35 electrons, with energies competitive with trends inferred from three-LL exact-diagonalization results. These results demonstrate that physical priors can be appropriately incorporated without sacrificing the flexibility of neural network wavefunctions, opening a promising path toward accurate, scalable modeling of FQH systems with LL mixing.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经网络分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 态为捕获朗道级 (LL) 混合和理解 FQH 物理提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但迄今为止，物理先验的结合仅限于 ansatz 中内置的最小精确约束。在球面几何中，我们表明，当仅提供最小的附加物理先验时，以及当严格地施加诸如通量附加之类的先验时，网络的灵活性都会受到影响。在前一种情况下，单极子谐波积轨道（MHPO）模拟很难优化，而在后一种情况下，神经网络的表达能力受到限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经网络分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 态为捕获朗道级 (LL) 混合和理解 FQH 物理提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但迄今为止，物理先验的结合仅限于 ansatz 中内置的最小精确约束。在球面几何中，我们表明，当仅提供最小的附加物理先验时，以及当严格地施加诸如通量附加之类的先验时，网络的灵活性都会受到影响。在前一种情况下，单极子谐波积轨道（MHPO）模拟很难优化，而在后一种情况下，神经网络的表达能力受到限制。因此，我们提出了轨道对矩阵因子 MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz，它不仅用可学习的对因子替换固定的 Laughlin 结构，而且使它们依赖于电子构型和轨道，从而平衡物理先验与灵活性。在 ν=1/5、1/3 和 2/5 范围内，MHPO-M 在测试的变体中实现了最低的变分能量，并且基于它的因式分解轨道读数可以扩展到 35 个电子，其能量与从 3-LL 精确对角化结果推断出的趋势具有竞争力。这些结果表明，可以在不牺牲神经网络波函数灵活性的情况下适当地合并物理先验，从而为具有 LL 混合的 FQH 系统的精确、可扩展建模开辟了一条有希望的道路。

articles.title: Finite-size spin fluctuations and fixed-index sweeps in a ferromagnetic spinor condensate
articles.title_zh: 铁磁旋量凝聚中的有限尺寸自旋涨落和固定折射率扫描
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We find a dip in the optimized rotation quantum Fisher information of a zero-magnetization ferromagnetic spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate near the excited-state quantum phase transition. Its displacement from ϵ_c=-q decreases on an inverse-size scale. At q=0.6,0.8,1.0,1.2, the dip value of Fₘₐₓ equals 2langle S²rangle for N up to 3840, linking it to total-spin fluctuations. A semiclassical orbit average normalized by the classical density of states describes the dip over N=120--3840 with maximum relative residual below 0.028; a small power law fits comparably. Inserting the measured energy offsets directly into the semiclassical formula leaves residuals of 17--30%, so κ acts as an effective cutoff. Among retained states, spin-nematic squeezing occurs at the spectral edges. Separately, fixed-index excited-state sweeps have half-excitation times between 11.2 and 13.1 times their ground-state counterparts, with local size exponents increasing across the four sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们发现零磁化铁磁自旋 1 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的优化旋转量子费希尔信息在激发态量子相变附近出现了下降。它从 ϵ_c=-q 的位移按反尺寸减小。在 q=0.6,0.8,1.0,1.2 处，Fₘₐₓ 的倾角值等于 2langle S²rangle（N 最大为 3840），将其与总自旋波动联系起来。由经典状态密度归一化的半经典轨道平均值描述了 N=120--3840 上的倾角，最大相对残差低于 0.028；小幂律也同样适用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发现零磁化铁磁自旋 1 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的优化旋转量子费希尔信息在激发态量子相变附近出现了下降。它从 ϵ_c=-q 的位移按反尺寸减小。在 q=0.6,0.8,1.0,1.2 处，Fₘₐₓ 的倾角值等于 2langle S²rangle（N 最大为 3840），将其与总自旋波动联系起来。由经典状态密度归一化的半经典轨道平均值描述了 N=120--3840 上的倾角，最大相对残差低于 0.028；小幂律也同样适用。将测得的能量偏移直接插入半经典公式会留下 17--30% 的残差，因此 κ 充当有效的截止值。在保留态中，自旋向列挤压发生在光谱边缘。另外，固定折射率激发态扫描的半激发时间是其基态对应物的 11.2 至 13.1 倍，并且局部尺寸指数在四种尺寸中增加。

articles.title: Crucial role of magnetic dipole and anomalous field dependence in NiPS₃
articles.title_zh: 磁偶极子和反常场依赖性在 NiPS₃ 中的关键作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NiPS₃ has attracted considerable attention, yet the origin of its intriguing magnetic behaviors remains elusive due to limited insight into its low-energy anisotropy. Here, high-field torque magnetometry measurements are performed, revealing a previously unrecognized anisotropic spin response that reflects interaction terms beyond the standard XY or XXZ models. In combination with relativistic density functional theory calculations and magnetic force response theory, an effective low-energy spin Hamiltonian is constructed, elucidating not only the observed anomalous magnetic behavior but also other recent experiments. Remarkably, the magnetic dipole interaction and the associated spin-flop transition play a crucial role in driving the deviation from two-dimensional spin alignment, providing direct insight into the underlying anisotropic energy hierarchy. The generalized Hamiltonian can serve as the important fundamental ground for future study, and our approach adopted here will hopefully be relevant to many other related material systems.
articles.abstract_zh: NiPS₃ 引起了相当大的关注，但由于对其低能各向异性的了解有限，其有趣的磁性行为的起源仍然难以捉摸。在这里，进行高场扭矩磁力测量，揭示了以前未被识别的各向异性自旋响应，该响应反映了超出标准 XY 或 XXZ 模型的相互作用项。结合相对论密度泛函理论计算和磁力响应理论，构建了有效的低能自旋哈密顿量，不仅阐明了观察到的异常磁行为，而且阐明了其他最近的实验。
articles.abstract_zh_full: NiPS₃ 引起了相当大的关注，但由于对其低能各向异性的了解有限，其有趣的磁性行为的起源仍然难以捉摸。在这里，进行高场扭矩磁力测量，揭示了以前未被识别的各向异性自旋响应，该响应反映了超出标准 XY 或 XXZ 模型的相互作用项。结合相对论密度泛函理论计算和磁力响应理论，构建了有效的低能自旋哈密顿量，不仅阐明了观察到的异常磁行为，而且阐明了其他最近的实验。值得注意的是，磁偶极子相互作用和相关的自旋翻转跃迁在驱动二维自旋排列的偏差中发挥着至关重要的作用，提供了对潜在的各向异性能量层次结构的直接洞察。广义哈密顿量可以作为未来研究的重要基础，我们在这里采用的方法有望与许多其他相关材料系统相关。

articles.title: Classical spin liquids in the kagome Ising model, and their link with magnetoelasticity
articles.title_zh: Kagome Ising 模型中的经典自旋液体及其与磁弹性的联系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate a nearest-neighbor Ising model on the kagome lattice coupled to elastic lattice distortions. By integrating out the lattice degrees of freedom, we derive an approximate spin-only description in terms of a kagome (J₁)-(J₂)-(J₃) Ising model with interactions extending to third nearest-neighbors. Using tensor network methods complemented by classical Monte Carlo simulations, we revisit its zero-temperature phase diagram and characterize the ground states studied more than thirty years ago. We discover three phases with extensive zero-temperature entropy and algebraically decaying spin correlations. Importantly, these states are not confined to fine-tuned points or frontiers between phases, but occupy extended areas of parameter space. Their quasi long-range order is reflected in Bragg-like peaks in the structure factors; we relate this, and other properties, to diverse phases found in Ising and Heisenberg models. Finally, we trace the trajectories generated by the magnetoelastic coupling through the effective-model phase diagram, explaining the emergence of self-frustration for the unfrustrated magnetoelastic model with ferromagnetic interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与弹性晶格畸变耦合的 kagome 晶格上的最近邻 Ising 模型。通过积分晶格自由度，我们根据 kagome (J₁)-(J2)-(J₃) Ising 模型推导出近似的仅自旋描述，其相互作用延伸到第三个最近邻。使用张量网络方法并辅以经典蒙特卡罗模拟，我们重新审视了其零温度相图并表征了三十多年前研究的基态。我们发现了具有广泛的零温熵和代数衰减自旋相关性的三个阶段。重要的是，这些状态并不局限于阶段之间的微调点或边界，而是占据参数空间的扩展区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了与弹性晶格畸变耦合的 kagome 晶格上的最近邻 Ising 模型。通过积分晶格自由度，我们根据 kagome (J₁)-(J2)-(J₃) Ising 模型推导出近似的仅自旋描述，其相互作用延伸到第三个最近邻。使用张量网络方法并辅以经典蒙特卡罗模拟，我们重新审视了其零温度相图并表征了三十多年前研究的基态。我们发现了具有广泛的零温熵和代数衰减自旋相关性的三个阶段。重要的是，这些状态并不局限于阶段之间的微调点或边界，而是占据参数空间的扩展区域。它们的准长程有序性反映在结构因子中的类布拉格峰中；我们将这一特性以及其他特性与伊辛和海森堡模型中发现的不同相联系起来。最后，我们通过有效模型相图追踪磁弹性耦合产生的轨迹，解释了具有铁磁相互作用的无受挫磁弹性模型的自我受挫的出现。

articles.title: Electronic driving of torsional modes in carbon nanotubes via orbital-phonon coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过轨道声子耦合电子驱动碳纳米管扭转模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate electronic driving of a torsional mode in a suspended carbon nanotube quantum dot. The valley states in a nanotube carry opposite orbital magnetic moments along the tube axis, and intervalley mixing forms valley-mixed eigenstates whose splitting can be controlled by an axial magnetic field. We formulate an orbital-rotation coupling between the torsional angular velocity and the valley orbital angular momentum. Using a master equation for sequential tunneling through normal-metal electrodes, we calculate the steady-state current and the phonon distribution of the torsional mode. When the valley-state splitting matches the torsional phonon energy, orbital transitions can drive the mode out of equilibrium. The contacts control both phonon pumping and its electrical readout, allowing substantial excitation with a positive, vanishing, or negative current response. The mechanism requires no intrinsic spin or valley polarization of the electrodes, but uses state-dependent tunneling at the contacts.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了悬浮碳纳米管量子点中扭转模式的电子驱动。纳米管中的谷态沿着管轴携带相反的轨道磁矩，并且间隔混合形成谷混合本征态，其分裂可以通过轴向磁场控制。我们制定了扭转角速度和谷轨道角动量之间的轨道-旋转耦合。使用通过普通金属电极的顺序隧道效应的主方程，我们计算了扭转模式的稳态电流和声子分布。当谷态分裂与扭转声子能量匹配时，轨道跃迁可以使模式失去平衡。触点控制声子泵浦及其电读数，从而允许以正电流、消失电流或负电流响应进行大量激发。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了悬浮碳纳米管量子点中扭转模式的电子驱动。纳米管中的谷态沿着管轴携带相反的轨道磁矩，并且间隔混合形成谷混合本征态，其分裂可以通过轴向磁场控制。我们制定了扭转角速度和谷轨道角动量之间的轨道-旋转耦合。使用通过普通金属电极的顺序隧道效应的主方程，我们计算了扭转模式的稳态电流和声子分布。当谷态分裂与扭转声子能量匹配时，轨道跃迁可以使模式失去平衡。触点控制声子泵浦及其电读数，从而允许以正电流、消失电流或负电流响应进行大量激发。该机制不需要电极的固有自旋或谷极化，但在接触处使用状态相关的隧道效应。

articles.title: Spin-wave circulation in unbounded ferromagnetic film
articles.title_zh: 无界铁磁薄膜中的自旋波循环
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A key challenge in spin-wave computing is steering spin waves through circuits without wave distortion or reflections. This often results in 1D propagation scenarios, which hinder applicability in 2D magnonic circuits. We demonstrate experimentally a novel approach using a hard magnetic spherical microparticle to guide spin-waves onto a closed path in a plain thin YIG film. The particle stray field induces a radially symmetrical magnetization landscape, which allows spin-waves to loop around. In parallel, we conducted micromagnetic simulations reproducing the experimental conditions, which confirm the circulation of spin-waves over several loops around the particle. This work demonstrates the possibility to steer spin-waves onto a circular path using inhomogeneous magnetic landscape, as well as advancing scalable spin-wave-based information processing technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋波计算的一个关键挑战是引导自旋波通过电路而不发生波畸变或反射。这通常会导致一维传播场景，从而阻碍了二维磁路的适用性。我们通过实验证明了一种新方法，使用硬磁球形微粒将自旋波引导到平面 YIG 薄膜中的闭合路径上。粒子杂散场会产生径向对称的磁化景观，从而允许自旋波循环。与此同时，我们进行了微磁模拟，重现了实验条件，证实了自旋波在粒子周围的几个环上的循环。这项工作展示了利用非均匀磁景观将自旋波引导到圆形路径上的可能性，以及先进的基于可扩展的自旋波的信息处理技术。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋波计算的一个关键挑战是引导自旋波通过电路而不发生波畸变或反射。这通常会导致一维传播场景，从而阻碍了二维磁路的适用性。我们通过实验证明了一种新方法，使用硬磁球形微粒将自旋波引导到平面 YIG 薄膜中的闭合路径上。粒子杂散场会产生径向对称的磁化景观，从而允许自旋波循环。与此同时，我们进行了微磁模拟，重现了实验条件，证实了自旋波在粒子周围的几个环上的循环。这项工作展示了利用非均匀磁景观将自旋波引导到圆形路径上的可能性，以及先进的基于可扩展的自旋波的信息处理技术。

articles.title: Initial-State-Dictated Dynamical Universality Classes in Quantum Criticality
articles.title_zh: 量子临界性中初始状态决定的动力学普遍性类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The concept of universality class lies at the core of phase transition physics, with each class uniquely characterized by a dedicated set of critical exponents. Here, we introduce the concept of initial-state-dictated dynamical universality classes in nonequilibrium quantum critical dynamics. By studying the imaginary-time relaxation dynamics of the dimerized Heisenberg model, we demonstrate that distinct kinds of initial states can give rise to different dynamical universality classes within the same equilibrium universality class. Specifically, we find that "classical'' paramagnetic (random-spin) and "quantum'' paramagnetic (dimerized and antidimerized) initial states yield drastically different critical initial slip exponents in the bulk. This initial-state dependence also extends to boundary critical dynamics, where different initial states yield different surface critical initial slip exponents even within the same boundary universality class. Remarkably, for the antidimerized initial state, we uncover an anomalous scaling law violating the conventional relation between the bulk and surface critical initial slip exponents. Our results establish an initial-state-controlled dynamical classification of quantum criticality that extends beyond the conventional equilibrium universality paradigm.
articles.abstract_zh: 普适性类的概念是相变物理学的核心，每个类都有一组专用的关键指数。在这里，我们引入非平衡量子临界动力学中初始状态决定的动力学普遍性类的概念。通过研究二聚海森堡模型的虚数时间弛豫动力学，我们证明不同种类的初始状态可以在同一平衡普遍性类别中产生不同的动力学普遍性类别。具体来说，我们发现“经典”顺磁（随机自旋）和“量子”顺磁（二聚和反二聚）初始状态在整体上产生截然不同的临界初始滑移指数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 普适性类的概念是相变物理学的核心，每个类都有一组专用的关键指数。在这里，我们引入非平衡量子临界动力学中初始状态决定的动力学普遍性类的概念。通过研究二聚海森堡模型的虚数时间弛豫动力学，我们证明不同种类的初始状态可以在同一平衡普遍性类别中产生不同的动力学普遍性类别。具体来说，我们发现“经典”顺磁（随机自旋）和“量子”顺磁（二聚和反二聚）初始状态在整体上产生截然不同的临界初始滑移指数。这种初始状态依赖性也扩展到边界临界动力学，其中不同的初始状态即使在相同的边界普遍性类别内也会产生不同的表面临界初始滑移指数。值得注意的是，对于反二聚化的初始状态，我们发现了一个反常的标度定律，违反了体相临界初始滑移指数和表面临界初始滑移指数之间的常规关系。我们的结果建立了量子临界性的初始状态控制的动力学分类，超出了传统的平衡普遍性范式。

articles.title: Quantum Formulation of the Spinterface Model
articles.title_zh: 旋转面模型的量子公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a fully quantum formulation of the spinterface model for the chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect, implemented within the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism. The model consists of a gold atom hosting a localised magnetic moment, coupled to a chiral molecular chain with Rashba spin-orbit coupling, and contacted by two non-magnetic leads. The magnetic moment is determined self-consistently from the non-equilibrium electronic distribution, and the spin-resolved transmission is computed from the mean-field Hamiltonian. We show that the interfacial magnetic moment and the chiral Rashba term cooperate to produce large current polarisations that reproduce the key experimental signatures of CISS: high polarisation, a threshold emergence at four total sites followed by interference-modulated growth with chain length, thermal suppression, and sign reversal upon chirality inversion. The central new result of this work is a clean separation of the CISS effect into an even (achiral) and an odd (chiral) contribution to the spin current, IS_z(φ) = IS_zrm eveⁿ(φ) + IS_zrm odd(φ). We demonstrate that IS_zrm odd vanishes exactly at fixed m_z for chains of fewer than four sites and becomes non-zero for chains of four or more sites, with the smallest junction exhibiting a non-zero odd part being the four-site geometry (one gold atom plus three molecular sites). The odd part arises from reciprocity breaking in a device that is simultaneously chiral, magnetically asymmetric (moment on the gold end only), and long enough to support two or more Rashba-active bonds. This provides a direct, parameter-free test of whether an observed spin signal is genuinely chiral or arises from an achiral spin-valve mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应的自旋界面模型的完全量子公式，该模型在非平衡格林函数（NEGF）形式中实现。该模型由具有局域磁矩的金原子组成，通过 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合与手性分子链耦合，并通过两条非磁性引线接触。磁矩由非平衡电子分布自洽确定，自旋分辨传输由平均场哈密顿量计算。我们表明，界面磁矩和手性 Rashba 项配合产生大电流极化，再现 CISS 的关键实验特征：高极化、总共四个位点出现阈值，然后是链长干扰调制生长、热抑制和手性反转时的符号反转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应的自旋界面模型的完全量子公式，该模型在非平衡格林函数（NEGF）形式中实现。该模型由具有局域磁矩的金原子组成，通过 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合与手性分子链耦合，并通过两条非磁性引线接触。磁矩由非平衡电子分布自洽确定，自旋分辨传输由平均场哈密顿量计算。我们表明，界面磁矩和手性 Rashba 项配合产生大电流极化，再现 CISS 的关键实验特征：高极化、总共四个位点出现阈值，然后是链长干扰调制生长、热抑制和手性反转时的符号反转。这项工作的核心新成果是将 CISS 效应清楚地分为对自旋电流的偶（非手性）和奇（手性）贡献，IS_z(φ) = IS_zrm eveⁿ(φ) + IS_zrm odd(φ)。我们证明，对于少于四个位点的链，IS_zrm odd 在固定 m_z 处完全消失，对于四个或更多位点的链则变为非零，其中表现出非零奇数部分的最小连接点是四位点几何结构（一个金原子加三个分子位点）。奇怪的部分来自于装置中的互易断裂，该装置同时具有手性、磁不对称（仅在金端的力矩），并且足够长以支持两个或多个 Rashba 活性键。这提供了一种直接的、无参数的测试，来测试观察到的自旋信号是否真正是手性的，还是由非手性自旋阀机制产生的。

articles.title: Grain-Boundary Scattering between Chiral Domains in Chiral Topological Semimetal CoSi
articles.title_zh: 手性拓扑半金属 CoSi 中手性域之间的晶界散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We evaluate the electron scattering properties in CoSi thin films having either twin (heterochiral) or non-twin (homochiral) grain boundaries using first-principles quantum transport calculations. We find that scattering across a twin grain boundary is more resistive than scattering across a non-twin grain boundary and that non-twin grain boundaries have a greater percentage of surface conduction than twin grain boundaries. This is corroborated by the transmission eigenstate profiles, which show that the surface Fermi-arc electrons can transmit past the non-twin grain boundaries between homochiral domains on the same surface without significant backscattering. In contrast, these surface electrons get scattered along the twin grain boundaries between heterochiral domains to the opposite surface, resulting in partial forward transmission and partial backscattering that yields higher grain-boundary resistivity. This work helps elucidate the complexities of electron transport in chiral topological semimetals for potential application in next-generation nano-interconnects.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用第一原理量子输运计算来评估具有孪晶（异手性）或非孪晶（同手性）晶界的 CoSi 薄膜中的电子散射特性。我们发现，跨越孪晶晶界的散射比跨越非孪晶晶界的散射更具电阻性，并且非孪晶晶界比孪晶晶界具有更大的表面传导百分比。传输本征态分布证实了这一点，该分布表明表面费米弧电子可以传输穿过同一表面上同手性域之间的非孪晶晶界，而不会产生明显的反向散射。相反，这些表面电子沿着异手性域之间的孪生晶界散射到相反的表面，导致部分前向传输和部分后向散射，从而产生更高的晶界电阻率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用第一原理量子输运计算来评估具有孪晶（异手性）或非孪晶（同手性）晶界的 CoSi 薄膜中的电子散射特性。我们发现，跨越孪晶晶界的散射比跨越非孪晶晶界的散射更具电阻性，并且非孪晶晶界比孪晶晶界具有更大的表面传导百分比。传输本征态分布证实了这一点，该分布表明表面费米弧电子可以传输穿过同一表面上同手性域之间的非孪晶晶界，而不会产生明显的反向散射。相反，这些表面电子沿着异手性域之间的孪生晶界散射到相反的表面，导致部分前向传输和部分后向散射，从而产生更高的晶界电阻率。这项工作有助于阐明手性拓扑半金属中电子传输的复杂性，以用于下一代纳米互连的潜在应用。

articles.title: Ubiquitous Flat Bands in Edge-Inflated Random Graphs
articles.title_zh: 边缘膨胀随机图中普遍存在的平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flat bands are usually associated with periodic lattice geometries, where destructive interference or chiral-symmetry constraints produce macroscopically degenerate eigenstates. Here we show that flat bands arise generically in a broad class of nonperiodic random networks through a simple edge-inflation procedure. Starting from random regular, Voronoi tessellation, Delaunay triangulation, scale-free, small-world, and Erdös-Rényi seed graphs, each edge is replaced by a finite one-dimensional tight-binding chain, either with fixed length L or with random lengths of mean bar L. Although the original random graphs typically have adjacency matrices of full rank and therefore few or no zero eigenstates, their inflated counterparts exhibit extensive flat bands. The flat-band energies are determined by the eigenstates residing on the chains or, more generally, by the eigenvalues of identical loopless motifs replacing the seed bonds. The corresponding eigenstates are states supported on subsets of the inflated chains formed by destructive interference at the original seed vertices. For zero-energy flat bands, we relate the degeneracy to the graph nullity η(G) and the maximum matching number ν(G). The numerical results support the correspondence η(G)=N-2ν(G), up to small deviations, across the random graph ensembles studied. The fraction of degenerate zero-energy states in inflated random graphs is controlled primarily by the average degree of the seed graph. We further show that the flat bands exhibit characteristic robustness to disorder: disorder on the seed sites and random magnetic flux leave the flat bands essentially unchanged, while bond disorder and disorder on the chain or motif sites broaden them. These results show that flat bands do not require crystalline order, but can emerge as robust consequences of local graph inflation and motif substitution.
articles.abstract_zh: 平带通常与周期性晶格几何形状相关，其中相消干涉或手性对称约束产生宏观简并本征态。在这里，我们展示了通过简单的边缘膨胀过程，平带通常出现在广泛的非周期性随机网络中。从随机正则、Voronoi 细分、Delaunay 三角剖分、无标度、小世界和 Erdös-Rényi 种子图开始，每条边都被有限的一维紧束缚链替换，要么具有固定长度 L，要么具有随机长度的均值条 L。尽管原始随机图通常具有满秩邻接矩阵，因此很少或没有零本征态，但它们的膨胀对应物表现出广泛的平带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平带通常与周期性晶格几何形状相关，其中相消干涉或手性对称约束产生宏观简并本征态。在这里，我们展示了通过简单的边缘膨胀过程，平带通常出现在广泛的非周期性随机网络中。从随机正则、Voronoi 细分、Delaunay 三角剖分、无标度、小世界和 Erdös-Rényi 种子图开始，每条边都被有限的一维紧束缚链替换，要么具有固定长度 L，要么具有随机长度的均值条 L。尽管原始随机图通常具有满秩邻接矩阵，因此很少或没有零本征态，但它们的膨胀对应物表现出广泛的平带。平带能量由链上的本征态决定，或更一般地，由取代种子键的相同无环基序的本征值决定。相应的本征态是由原始种子顶点处的相消干涉形成的膨胀链的子集支持的状态。对于零能量平带，我们将简并性与图无效性 η(G) 和最大匹配数 ν(G) 联系起来。数值结果支持在所研究的随机图集合中存在较小偏差的对应关系 η(G)=N-2ν(G)。膨胀随机图中简并零能量态的比例主要由种子图的平均度控制。我们进一步表明，平带表现出对无序的鲁棒性：种子位点上的无序和随机磁通量使平带基本上保持不变，而键无序和链或基序位点上的无序使平带变宽。这些结果表明，平带不需要晶体顺序，但可以作为局部图膨胀和基序替换的强大后果而出现。

articles.title: Sum-over-poles framework for quantum embedding to approach the real-frequency axis
articles.title_zh: 用于接近真实频率轴的量子嵌入的极点求和框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a real-frequency framework for the quantum embedding of solids, based on sum-over-poles (SOP) representations. We partition the lattice into periodically repeated interacting fragments and derive an embedded Dyson equation for the fragment, to be solved self-consistently. The resulting scheme generalizes the algorithmic-inversion method of our previous work to interacting Hamiltonians and is closely related to dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), especially when an extended impurity problem is introduced. By exploiting the compact pole expansion of the embedding potential, we carry out the self-consistent procedure close to the real axis, which avoids ill-posed analytic continuation. In addition, the SOP representation allows us to introduce a pole-and-residue dynamics, which we use to reach the self-consistent solution. After deriving the method, we benchmark it against exact-diagonalization implementations of DMFT on the one-dimensional Hubbard ring at half filling. The framework offers a natural route to real-space dynamical quantum embedding, for periodic systems as well as for strongly correlated defects in materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了基于极点和（SOP）表示的固体量子嵌入的实频框架。我们将晶格划分为周期性重复的相互作用的片段，并导出该片段的嵌入式戴森方程，以自洽地求解。由此产生的方案将我们之前工作的算法反演方法推广到相互作用的哈密顿量，并且与动态平均场理论（DMFT）密切相关，特别是当引入扩展的杂质问题时。通过利用嵌入势的紧极展开，我们在接近实轴的地方执行了自洽过程，这避免了不适定的分析连续。此外，SOP 表示允许我们引入极点和残差动力学，我们用它来达到自洽的解决方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了基于极点和（SOP）表示的固体量子嵌入的实频框架。我们将晶格划分为周期性重复的相互作用的片段，并导出该片段的嵌入式戴森方程，以自洽地求解。由此产生的方案将我们之前工作的算法反演方法推广到相互作用的哈密顿量，并且与动态平均场理论（DMFT）密切相关，特别是当引入扩展的杂质问题时。通过利用嵌入势的紧极展开，我们在接近实轴的地方执行了自洽过程，这避免了不适定的分析连续。此外，SOP 表示允许我们引入极点和残差动力学，我们用它来达到自洽的解决方案。推导该方法后，我们将其与半填充一维哈伯德环上的 DMFT 精确对角化实现进行基准测试。该框架为周期性系统以及材料中强相关缺陷提供了实空间动态量子嵌入的自然途径。

articles.title: Multiscale Modeling of Zr Corrosion: Predicting Microstructures of Oxide Films
articles.title_zh: Zr 腐蚀的多尺度建模：预测氧化膜的微观结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A first-principles-informed multiscale modeling approach is reported for oxide formation during corrosion of zirconium. The present simulations reproduce the columnar corrosion film microstructure and grain size distribution seen in micrographs of oxidized Zr surfaces. This structural feature emerges from a hexagonal ZrO layer adjacent to the α-Zr/ZrO₂₋ₓ interface, which is dynamically stabilized by continuous heterogeneous grain nucleation and grain boundary mass diffusion. This ZrO layer is identified as a significant oxygen diffusion barrier and a potential contributor to sub-parabolic pretransition corrosion kinetics. The simulations also reproduce the undulatory nature of the metal/oxide interface, leading to regions with tensile stress components capable of nucleating cracks, despite the overall state of compressive hydrostatic stress within the oxide film. First principles density functional theory (DFT) computations of fundamental ZrOₓ properties were combined with molecular dynamics simulations using a machine-learned potential based on a DFT training set to provide extensive input to an advanced phase field model for oxide formation and its microstructure, as implemented in the new MedeA PhaseField module. The phase field simulations reported herein incorporated computed stoichiometry-dependent thermochemical data, anisotropic elastic properties, interface energies, bulk and grain boundary mass transport processes, multiphase heterogeneous grain nucleation, and strain energy-dependent phase stabilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 据报道，针对锆腐蚀过程中氧化物的形成，采用了基于第一原理的多尺度建模方法。本模拟再现了氧化 Zr 表面显微照片中看到的柱状腐蚀膜微观结构和晶粒尺寸分布。这种结构特征源自与 α-Zr/ZrO2₋ₓ 界面相邻的六方 ZrO 层，该层通过连续异质晶粒成核和晶界质量扩散而动态稳定。该 ZrO 层被认为是重要的氧扩散屏障，并且是亚抛物线转变前腐蚀动力学的潜在贡献者。模拟还再现了金属/氧化物界面的波动性质，导致具有能够使裂纹成核的拉应力分量的区域，尽管氧化膜内的压静水应力的整体状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 据报道，针对锆腐蚀过程中氧化物的形成，采用了基于第一原理的多尺度建模方法。本模拟再现了氧化 Zr 表面显微照片中看到的柱状腐蚀膜微观结构和晶粒尺寸分布。这种结构特征源自与 α-Zr/ZrO2₋ₓ 界面相邻的六方 ZrO 层，该层通过连续异质晶粒成核和晶界质量扩散而动态稳定。该 ZrO 层被认为是重要的氧扩散屏障，并且是亚抛物线转变前腐蚀动力学的潜在贡献者。模拟还再现了金属/氧化物界面的波动性质，导致具有能够使裂纹成核的拉应力分量的区域，尽管氧化膜内的压静水应力的整体状态。 ZrOₓ 基本性质的第一原理密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算与分子动力学模拟相结合，使用基于 DFT 训练集的机器学习势来为氧化物形成及其微观结构的高级相场模型提供广泛的输入，如新的 MedeA PhaseField 模块中所实现的那样。本文报道的相场模拟结合了计算的化学计量相关的热化学数据、各向异性弹性性质、界面能、体和晶界质量传输过程、多相异质晶粒成核和应变能相关的相稳定性。

articles.title: Symmetry-Guided Machine Learning of Spin-Dependent Nonlinear Hall Response
articles.title_zh: 自旋相关非线性霍尔响应的对称引导机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Berry-curvature dipole can produce a nonlinear Hall current even when the linear Hall response vanishes, but symmetry alone does not determine its magnitude or magnetic tunability. The interplay of structural symmetry, moment orientation, and carrier occupation is examined in a honeycomb model. Curvature maps and the band-summed dipole integrand reveal how velocity and the occupation window near the Fermi level select signed contributions. Removing threefold rotation permits a nonmagnetic dipole perpendicular to the surviving mirror. Generic magnetic reorientation activates the second component and tunes both components through positive and negative values. Global reversal preserves the dipole while reversing the intrinsic linear Hall conductivity, allowing a finite bulk dipole contribution from equally populated reversed domains under uniform-field averaging.A symmetry-constrained polynomial model predicts both dipole components for 256 held-out spin configurations, achieving coefficients of determination R² > 0.9995 at the reference chemical potential. At fixed carrier density, orientation-dependent shifts of the chemical potential modify the response and yield slightly larger prediction errors for the chosen model. Across the chemical-potential sweep,the prediction accuracy decreases more strongly for D_y,revealing an energy dependence of the surrogate's performance. Within semiclassical transport with a constant relaxation time, the calculated dipole determines the angular dependence of the quadratic current and its rectified and second-harmonic components. These results provide a quantitative representation of magnetic-orientation-dependent Berry-curvature dipoles and show how carrier occupation influences both the response and its predictability.
articles.abstract_zh: 即使线性霍尔响应消失，贝里曲率偶极子也可以产生非线性霍尔电流，但仅对称性并不能决定其大小或磁可调谐性。在蜂窝模型中检查结构对称性、力矩方向和载流子占据的相互作用。曲率图和能带求和偶极子被积函数揭示了费米能级附近的速度和占据窗口如何选择符号贡献。消除三重旋转允许非磁性偶极子垂直于幸存的镜子。通用磁重定向激活第二个组件并通过正值和负值调整两个组件。全局反转保留了偶极子，同时反转了固有的线性霍尔电导率，从而允许在均匀场平均下来自同等数量的反转域的有限体偶极子贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 即使线性霍尔响应消失，贝里曲率偶极子也可以产生非线性霍尔电流，但仅对称性并不能决定其大小或磁可调谐性。在蜂窝模型中检查结构对称性、力矩方向和载流子占据的相互作用。曲率图和能带求和偶极子被积函数揭示了费米能级附近的速度和占据窗口如何选择符号贡献。消除三重旋转允许非磁性偶极子垂直于幸存的镜子。通用磁重定向激活第二个组件并通过正值和负值调整两个组件。全局反转保留了偶极子，同时反转了固有的线性霍尔电导率，从而允许在均匀场平均下来自同等数量的反转域的有限体偶极子贡献。对称约束多项式模型可以预测 256 个保留自旋配置的两个偶极子分量，在参考化学势下实现确定系数 R² > 0.9995。在固定载流子密度下，化学势的方向相关变化会修改响应，并为所选模型产生稍大的预测误差。在化学势扫描过程中，D_y 的预测精度下降得更厉害，揭示了替代物性能的能量依赖性。在具有恒定弛豫时间的半经典输运中，计算出的偶极子确定了二次电流及其整流和二次谐波分量的角度依赖性。这些结果提供了磁取向相关的贝里曲率偶极子的定量表示，并显示了载流子占据如何影响响应及其可预测性。

articles.title: Acceleration of CTQMC via Denoising Diffusion Models with Auxiliary Spectral Functions
articles.title_zh: 通过具有辅助谱函数的去噪扩散模型加速 CTQMC
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous-time Quantum Monte Carlo (CTQMC) impurity solvers are a numerically exact, but expensive, option for solving the Dynamical Mean Field Theory (DMFT) equations, with statistical noise from undersampling presenting a major challenge to low temperature studies. This noise is especially egregious within the sampled self-energy, which can destabilize the self-consistency loop upon insertion into the Dyson equation. In this work, we introduce a neural denoiser for fermionic imaginary time Green's functions based on the diffusion model architecture trained on synthetic data. The network predicts positive and normalized auxiliary spectral functions consistent with the noisy imaginary axis CTQMC data, which is then refined via autodifferentiation to match the measured self-energy, its first two high-frequency moments, and impurity occupation similar to the Constrained Residual Minimization (CRM) method. This leads to Green's functions and self-energies that are causal by design. Through this denoising framework we are able to reduce the required CTQMC measurement steps by a factor of 10-100. We benchmark our method with a half-filled Hubbard model on a Bethe lattice, a two-patch Dynamical Cluster Approximation (DCA) of the two-dimensional Hubbard model, and the SrVO₃ system. We reproduce the Mott transition upon increasing Coulomb interaction for the half-filled Hubbard model with only 5000 CTQMC measurements, the pseudogap transition for the DCA two-dimensional Hubbard model with only 5×10⁵ measurements, and match the spectral function of SrVO₃ with 50 times fewer measurements than the reference. Since we generate auxiliary spectral functions, we recover the approximate spectral functions of the systems for free without performing analytic continuation.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续时间量子蒙特卡罗 (CTQMC) 杂质求解器是求解动态平均场理论 (DMFT) 方程的数值精确但昂贵的选择，欠采样产生的统计噪声给低温研究带来了重大挑战。这种噪声在采样的自能中尤其严重，在插入戴森方程时可能会破坏自洽环的稳定性。在这项工作中，我们基于在合成数据上训练的扩散模型架构，引入了费米子虚数时间格林函数的神经降噪器。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 连续时间量子蒙特卡罗 (CTQMC) 杂质求解器是求解动态平均场理论 (DMFT) 方程的数值精确但昂贵的选择，欠采样产生的统计噪声给低温研究带来了重大挑战。这种噪声在采样的自能中尤其严重，在插入戴森方程时可能会破坏自洽环的稳定性。在这项工作中，我们基于在合成数据上训练的扩散模型架构，引入了费米子虚数时间格林函数的神经降噪器。该网络预测与噪声虚轴 CTQMC 数据一致的正和归一化辅助谱函数，然后通过自微分进行细化，以匹配测量的自能、前两个高频矩以及类似于约束残差最小化 (CRM) 方法的杂质占据。这导致了格林函数和自能是设计上的因果关系。通过这个去噪框架，我们能够将所需的 CTQMC 测量步骤减少 10-100 倍。我们使用 Bethe 晶格上的半填充 Hubbard 模型、二维 Hubbard 模型的两面片动态聚类逼近 (DCA) 以及 SrVO₃ 系统对我们的方法进行基准测试。我们通过仅 5000 个 CTQMC 测量的半填充 Hubbard 模型再现了增加库仑相互作用的莫特跃迁，仅用 5×10⁵ 测量的 DCA 二维 Hubbard 模型的赝能隙跃迁，并以比参考少 50 倍的测量来匹配 SrVO₃ 的谱函数。由于我们生成辅助谱函数，因此我们可以免费恢复系统的近似谱函数，而无需执行解析延拓。

articles.title: GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery
articles.title_zh: GBClaw：用于原子晶界研究和机制发现的代理人工智能框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigations remains challenging. Here, we present GBClaw, an agentic AI framework for investigating the structure and deformation of general grain boundaries (GBs). Although general GBs constitute the vast majority of real-world interfaces in polycrystalline materials, they remain understudied because their structural complexity and interfacial mismatch complicate experimental and modeling research. GBClaw integrates large language models (LLMs) into a modular architecture comprising an orchestrator, specialized agents, domain-specific tools, simulation interfaces, and hierarchical memory. Through dynamic replanning and iterative workflow refinement, the framework effectively connects systematic simulations with targeted mechanistic analysis. Applied to 14 general asymmetric tilt GBs in nickel, GBClaw characterized interfacial defect structures and identified diverse deformation modes across these incommensurate boundaries. Comparing boundary sliding with and without secondary GB misfit dislocations revealed substantial differences in shear strength, underscoring the critical role of defect hierarchies in sliding resistance. Furthermore, researcher-guided follow-up calculations traced an anomalously high shear resistance to metastable boundary structures. This work demonstrates that combining agentic AI with domain expertise bridges high-throughput computational screening with deep physical understanding of complex material interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 代理人工智能（AI）系统在材料发现和设计中复杂工作流程自动化方面具有巨大潜力，但将其扩展到领域密集型机械研究仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 GBClaw，一种用于研究一般晶界 (GB) 结构和变形的代理人工智能框架。尽管一般晶界构成了多晶材料中绝大多数现实世界的界面，但由于其结构复杂性和界面失配使实验和建模研究变得复杂，因此它们仍然未被充分研究。 GBClaw 将大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成到模块化架构中，其中包括协调器、专用代理、特定领域工具、模拟接口和分层内存。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 代理人工智能（AI）系统在材料发现和设计中复杂工作流程自动化方面具有巨大潜力，但将其扩展到领域密集型机械研究仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 GBClaw，一种用于研究一般晶界 (GB) 结构和变形的代理人工智能框架。尽管一般晶界构成了多晶材料中绝大多数现实世界的界面，但由于其结构复杂性和界面失配使实验和建模研究变得复杂，因此它们仍然未被充分研究。 GBClaw 将大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成到模块化架构中，其中包括协调器、专用代理、特定领域工具、模拟接口和分层内存。通过动态重新规划和迭代工作流程细化，该框架有效地将系统模拟与有针对性的机制分析联系起来。 GBClaw 应用于镍中的 14 个一般不对称倾斜晶界，描述了界面缺陷结构，并识别了这些不相称边界上的不同变形模式。比较有和没有二次晶界错配位错的边界滑动揭示了剪切强度的显着差异，强调了缺陷层次在滑动阻力中的关键作用。此外，研究人员引导的后续计算发现亚稳态边界结构具有异常高的抗剪力。这项工作表明，将代理人工智能与领域专业知识相结合，可以将高通量计算筛选与对复杂材料界面的深入物理理解联系起来。

articles.title: Floquet Instability of Photon-Axion Conversion
articles.title_zh: 光子-轴子转换的Floquet不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26908v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The discovery of axions would provide evidence for physics beyond the Standard Model. In this work, we investigate axion-photon conversion in the presence of a background magnetic field with simultaneous spatial and temporal periodicity. By performing a Lorentz transformation, the coupled axion-photon system is mapped onto a time-periodic linear system that can be analyzed using Floquet theorem. We find unstable modes associated with resonant crossing between Floquet replicas. The resulting complex Floquet exponents lead to exponentially growing modes, which we identify as a Floquet instability. Then, we determine the parameter regions in which this instability appears in a perturbative analysis. We further show that the Floquet instability enhances the axion-field amplitude generated from an initial photon field. Our results demonstrate that spatiotemporally periodic magnetic backgrounds provide a distinct mechanism for modifying axion-photon conversion through Floquet instability.
articles.abstract_zh: 轴子的发现将为标准模型之外的物理学提供证据。在这项工作中，我们研究了在具有同时空间和时间周期性的背景磁场存在下的轴子-光子转换。通过执行洛伦兹变换，耦合轴子-光子系统被映射到可以使用 Floquet 定理进行分析的时间周期线性系统。我们发现与 Floquet 复制品之间的共振交叉相关的不稳定模式。由此产生的复杂 Floquet 指数导致指数增长模式，我们将其识别为 Floquet 不稳定性。然后，我们确定在微扰分析中出现这种不稳定性的参数区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轴子的发现将为标准模型之外的物理学提供证据。在这项工作中，我们研究了在具有同时空间和时间周期性的背景磁场存在下的轴子-光子转换。通过执行洛伦兹变换，耦合轴子-光子系统被映射到可以使用 Floquet 定理进行分析的时间周期线性系统。我们发现与 Floquet 复制品之间的共振交叉相关的不稳定模式。由此产生的复杂 Floquet 指数导致指数增长模式，我们将其识别为 Floquet 不稳定性。然后，我们确定在微扰分析中出现这种不稳定性的参数区域。我们进一步表明，Floquet 不稳定性增强了初始光子场生成的轴子场振幅。我们的结果表明，时空周期性磁背景提供了一种通过 Floquet 不稳定性修改轴子-光子转换的独特机制。

articles.title: Ammonia-Hydrogen Phase Equilibria in Planetary Envelopes from First-Principles-Based Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的机器学习分子动力学研究行星包层中的氨-氢相平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27136v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ammonia and hydrogen are major constituents of planets within and beyond the solar system, yet how they interact in planetary envelopes is poorly known. We perform large-scale two-phase coexistence simulations of the ammonia-hydrogen system from 500 to 4000 K and 0.1 to 100 GPa, driven by machine-learning interatomic potentials trained on density functional theory calculations. From these we map the compositions of coexisting hydrogen-rich and ammonia-rich phases, and the critical curve that separates conditions of complete miscibility from those of phase separation. The critical temperature increases with pressure, from 500 K at 0.1 GPa to 2000 K near 30 GPa, and we find no phase separation at 3000 and 4000 K up to 100 GPa. The slope of the critical curve decreases substantially between 0.3 and 30 GPa, and the curve nearly flattens above about 30 GPa and 2000 K, where molecules begin to give way to atomic species. The coexistence curves are asymmetric with an ammonia-rich critical composition. For the expected envelope compositions, the phase boundary lies close to, and intersects, published thermal profiles of Uranus and Neptune, implying ammonia may be raining out in these planets today. In contrast, in warm sub-Neptunes such as TOI-270 d, ammonia and hydrogen are likely miscible in all proportions. Together with previous studies, our results suggest that silicates, water and ammonia separate from hydrogen in sequence as planets cool, with implications for their compositional, thermal and structural evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们在经过密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势的驱动下，对 500 至 4000 K 和 0.1 至 100 GPa 的氨-氢系统进行大规模两相共存模拟。根据这些，我们绘制了共存的富氢相和富氨相的组成，以及区分完全混溶条件和相分离条件的临界曲线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们在经过密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势的驱动下，对 500 至 4000 K 和 0.1 至 100 GPa 的氨-氢系统进行大规模两相共存模拟。根据这些，我们绘制了共存的富氢相和富氨相的组成，以及区分完全混溶条件和相分离条件的临界曲线。临界温度随着压力的增加而增加，从 0.1 GPa 时的 500 K 到接近 30 GPa 的 2000 K，并且我们发现在 3000 和 4000 K 直至 100 GPa 时没有相分离。临界曲线的斜率在 0.3 至 30 GPa 之间大幅下降，并且在约 30 GPa 和 2000 K 以上，曲线几乎变平，此时分子开始让位于原子物种。共存曲线与富含氨的临界成分不对称。对于预期的包络成分，相界位于天王星和海王星已发表的热剖面附近并与之相交，这意味着今天这些行星上可能会下雨。相比之下，在TOI-270 d等温暖的亚海王星中，氨和氢可能以任何比例混溶。结合之前的研究，我们的结果表明，当行星冷却时，硅酸盐、水和氨会依次与氢分离，这对其成分、热和结构演化产生影响。

articles.title: The optical force on a dielectric slab
articles.title_zh: 电介质板上的光力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27254v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Radiation-pressure forces on transmissive optics, including dynamical backaction, are usually computed from the momentum flux of the external fields. For a dielectric of finite thickness, this omits the time dependence of the electromagnetic momentum stored inside. We compute the force on a lossless dielectric slab of arbitrary thickness Lₛ submerged in a dielectric fluid, proceeding from both Lorentz force on its bound charges and from the external momentum fluxes for arbitrary carrier and sideband fields. We treat the surrounding medium through a prescribed linear dielectric response and do not model the accompanying mechanical response of the fluid, including pressure and electrostriction. These two methods both recover the expected force in the limit of a thin reflector, but differ in the more general case by the rate of change of the field momentum stored in the slab. This storage term vanishes for static fields and at low frequencies reduces to (Lₛ/c²),dP/dt, where P is the net power through the slab. In a cavity, where P depends on the slab position, the storage term produces a velocity-dependent force. The Abraham and Minkowski momentum formulations applied to the storage term are reconciled to give an unambiguous force on the dielectric in the case of an exterior vacuum environment, where there is no fluid response to model.
articles.abstract_zh: 透射光学器件上的辐射压力（包括动态反作用）通常根据外部场的动量通量计算。对于有限厚度的电介质，这忽略了内部存储的电磁动量的时间依赖性。我们根据其束缚电荷上的洛伦兹力以及任意载流子和边带场的外部动量通量，计算浸没在介电流体中的任意厚度 Lₛ 的无损电介质板上的力。我们通过规定的线性介电响应来处理周围介质，并且不对流体的伴随机械响应（包括压力和电致伸缩）进行建模。这两种方法都恢复了薄反射器极限内的预期力，但在更一般的情况下，其不同之处在于板中存储的场动量的变化率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 透射光学器件上的辐射压力（包括动态反作用）通常根据外部场的动量通量计算。对于有限厚度的电介质，这忽略了内部存储的电磁动量的时间依赖性。我们根据其束缚电荷上的洛伦兹力以及任意载流子和边带场的外部动量通量，计算浸没在介电流体中的任意厚度 Lₛ 的无损电介质板上的力。我们通过规定的线性介电响应来处理周围介质，并且不对流体的伴随机械响应（包括压力和电致伸缩）进行建模。这两种方法都恢复了薄反射器极限内的预期力，但在更一般的情况下，其不同之处在于板中存储的场动量的变化率。该存储项对于静态场消失，并且在低频时减少到 (Lₛ/c²),dP/dt，其中 P 是通过平板的净功率。在空腔中，P 取决于板的位置，存储项会产生与速度相关的力。应用于存储项的亚伯拉罕和闵可夫斯基动量公式经过协调，在外部真空环境（模型没有流体响应）的情况下对电介质施加明确的力。

articles.title: Nonlocality effects on fermions confined within a hard-wall potential
articles.title_zh: 限制在硬壁势内的费米子的非局域性效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27349v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate nonlocality effects on the energy spectrum of spin-1/2 fermions confined by hard-wall potentials. Starting from a nonlocal Dirac theory with a modified kinetic term, we formulate the associated field equation in flat spacetime using cylindrical coordinates. By exploiting the eigenvalue spectrum of the squared Dirac operator, the original infinite-order equation is reduced to a finite-order problem. We also show that on the branch continuously connected to the local Dirac theory the nonlocal corrections can be encoded in an effective fermion mass. We then find analytical energy spectra for two confining geometries: a cylindrical hard wall and a quantum ring defined by two concentric cylindrical boundaries. In both cases, the radial equations reduce to Bessel equations and the boundary conditions quantize the allowed modes. The local hard-wall spectra are recovered for Λ→infty, whereas finite nonlocality shifts the mass contribution and, consequently, the particle--antiparticle energy separation. These results provide a direct characterization of nonlocal effects in quantum-confined fermionic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了硬壁势限制的自旋 1/2 费米子能谱的非局域性效应。从具有修正动力学项的非局域狄拉克理论出发，我们使用柱坐标系在平坦时空中制定了相关的场方程。通过利用平方狄拉克算子的特征值谱，将原始无限阶方程简化为有限阶问题。我们还表明，在与局部狄拉克理论连续连接的分支上，非局部校正可以编码在有效的费米子质量中。然后，我们找到了两种限制几何形状的分析能谱：圆柱形硬壁和由两个同心圆柱形边界定义的量子环。在这两种情况下，径向方程都简化为贝塞尔方程，并且边界条件量化了允许的模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了硬壁势限制的自旋 1/2 费米子能谱的非局域性效应。从具有修正动力学项的非局域狄拉克理论出发，我们使用柱坐标系在平坦时空中制定了相关的场方程。通过利用平方狄拉克算子的特征值谱，将原始无限阶方程简化为有限阶问题。我们还表明，在与局部狄拉克理论连续连接的分支上，非局部校正可以编码在有效的费米子质量中。然后，我们找到了两种限制几何形状的分析能谱：圆柱形硬壁和由两个同心圆柱形边界定义的量子环。在这两种情况下，径向方程都简化为贝塞尔方程，并且边界条件量化了允许的模式。局部硬壁光谱恢复为 Λ→infty，而有限非定域性改变了质量贡献，从而改变了粒子-反粒子能量分离。这些结果提供了量子限制费米子系统中非局域效应的直接表征。

articles.title: Generation of non-Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions during thermalization of interacting baths
articles.title_zh: 相互作用浴热化过程中非麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27369v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We report on numerical experiments of thermalization between two reservoirs in which interspecies interactions are mediated via a Hamiltonian with a Gaussian dependence upon the distance between the particles. By using relatively high statistics, we are able to study deviations from the initially imprinted Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distributions as a function of the range and strength of the interaction, as well as the parameters of the two baths such as masses, trapping frequencies, that strongly affect the spatial overlap of the two species. At large interaction strengths and for any range, deviations are attributable to the sudden conversion of latent interaction energy into kinetic energy of the particles. In addition, long range interactions generate deviations even for interaction strengths in the weak regime, and non-uniform confinement introduces a further source of deviation from the Maxwell-Boltzmann energy distribution. This latter results in transient two temperature Maxwell-Boltzmann distributions suggestive of an inverse cascading route from inter-particle dynamics to thermalization. In the weakly-interacting regime, a simple expression for the equilibrium temperature is also obtained and discussed. These findings may be of relevance in the dynamics of exothermic chemical reactions, in the physics of ultracold atomic mixtures, and in self-sustained burning plasmas.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了两个储层之间热化的数值实验，其中种间相互作用是通过哈密顿量介导的，其高斯依赖于粒子之间的距离。通过使用相对较高的统计数据，我们能够研究与最初印记的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的偏差，作为相互作用的范围和强度的函数，以及两个浴的参数，例如质量、捕获频率，这些参数强烈影响两个物种的空间重叠。在大相互作用强度和任何范围内，偏差可归因于潜在相互作用能突然转换为粒子的动能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了两个储层之间热化的数值实验，其中种间相互作用是通过哈密顿量介导的，其高斯依赖于粒子之间的距离。通过使用相对较高的统计数据，我们能够研究与最初印记的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的偏差，作为相互作用的范围和强度的函数，以及两个浴的参数，例如质量、捕获频率，这些参数强烈影响两个物种的空间重叠。在大相互作用强度和任何范围内，偏差可归因于潜在相互作用能突然转换为粒子的动能。此外，即使对于弱状态下的相互作用强度，长程相互作用也会产生偏差，并且非均匀限制引入了与麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼能量分布的偏差的进一步来源。后者导致瞬态两个温度麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼分布，暗示从粒子间动力学到热化的逆级联路线。在弱相互作用状态下，还获得并讨论了平衡温度的简单表达式。这些发现可能与放热化学反应的动力学、超冷原子混合物的物理学以及自持燃烧等离子体有关。

articles.title: Systematic Truncated Wigner Approximation for Open Spin Systems Reveals Long-Range Order Far from Equilibrium
articles.title_zh: 开放自旋系统的系统截断维格纳近似揭示了远离平衡的长程有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27462v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-range interactions can protect dissipative order against fluctuations, but determining when they do so in two dimensions remains out of reach for existing many-body methods. We develop a continuous SU(2)-covariant truncated-Wigner framework that maps the problem onto stochastic dynamics with one Bloch sphere per site.
