Increasing nanoparticle size strengthens plasmon-interband coupling, enhances extinction intensity, induces a red shift, and produces local electric field enhancement up to ~ 1000 times the incident field. Embedding Cu nanospheres in ZnO to form a core-shell structure improves hot-electron utilization, suppresses corrosion, and tunes the dominant plasmonic response. Structure A shows LSPR peaks at 585nm (normal incidence) and 577nm (parallel incidence), with a three fold higher electric field under normal illumination. Structure B exhibits a peak at 594nm for both directions, indicating reduced angular sensitivity. Increasing ZnO radius (30–50nm) results in red shifts of 22nm, 23nm, and 47nm for structures A, B, and C, respectively. LSPR response depends on refractive index (1.333–2.25), with all structures converging to 658nm at n = 1.7843. PDOS analysis indicates strong Cu/ZnO orbital hybridization, leading to charge redistribution, Schottky barrier formation, and an upward shift of the Fermi level. Interfacial coupling enhances hot-electron transfer and contributes to LSPR strengthening and red-shift behavior, particularly in core-shell structures with larger contact areas. These results inform plasmonic heterostructure design for photocatalytic and plasmon-enhanced solar energy conversion applications.

articles.title: Mechanistic modeling of colloidal rust particles deposition on coated optical surfaces in single-beam spectrophotometric systems
articles.abstract: During the prolonged operation of optical systems used for liquid-consistency inspection, their surfaces inevitably become contaminated. Among the most persistent contaminants are micrometer-scale rust particles, colloidal in nature and inclined to agglomerate, which gradually accumulate on the optical elements. To elucidate the mechanisms governing this deposition, numerical modeling was conducted to evaluate particle adhesion on a functional coating, both with and without an additional protective layer. The analysis incorporates the principal forces shaping particle behavior: adhesion, Hertzian elastic response, electrostatic double-layer interactions, and the hydrodynamic drag imposed by the surrounding liquid. From these components, the total interaction force, particle velocity, displacement, and their temporal evolution were derived. Taken together, the results offer a coherent physical picture of how rust particles engage with coated optical surfaces and how protective layers may mitigate this persistent form of contamination.

articles.title: A 159-step auditable open-quantum-system chain links cerebral metabolism to a coherence-protected information channel in the myelinated axon at 310 K (V148)
articles.abstract: Background. The myelin sheath is increasingly described as an optical waveguide, yet whether a warm, wet biological structure can sustain a coherence-protected information channel remains contested. Methods. We present V148, a fully auditable 159-step open-quantum-system chain that links cerebral metabolism (CMRO2 3.5 ml/100g/min; P_met = 17.23 W) to ultra-weak photon emission (lambda = 500 nm; 2.5e5 phot/s; 134x the Landauer limit per photon at 310.15 K), a myelin Casimir cavity (L = 200 um, a = 500 nm, Q = 100), six THz phononic harmonics (n_th = 1.48–11.15), photon-phonon optomechanical phase conversion (g = 0.02; C = 32; F = 0.9697), phonon-coherent-water coupling (g = 0.18; C = 25920; F = 0.99996), Dicke triads, a 2:1 phase-locking dial (eps* = 0.012 inside a +/-0.041 window), a coherence-gated conditional gate, and a perfect-state-transfer channel (F = 0.999888; t* = 1.77 ms, delta band). Dynamics were integrated with RK45 (rtol 1e-9); entanglement was probed with QuTiP. Results. The chain closes with global efficiency 0.9697 and an ON/OFF vacuum bit ratio of 10.33 (simulated 10.3289). Steady states reproduce the declared anchors (nph ON 0.1063 vs 0.1060; vac ON 0.6189 vs 0.612). Trace conservation holds at < = 4.4e-16 with positivity maintained. Photon-water negativity (7.0e-9) and mutual information (1.3e-6 bits) show the operative resource is phase coherence, not bipartite entanglement. Coherent stock is 4e12 bits, with a 1e9-bit fill time of 9.05 ms. Conclusions. A myelinated axon can operate as a thermodynamically funded, coherence-protected information channel at physiological temperature. Every step, dataset and script is open for inspection and refutation.

articles.title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics and Assess of Ecological Quality in Sylhet Metropolitan Area amid Rapid Urbanization: A Remote Sensing Approach
articles.abstract: The rapid urbanization of Sylhet, a major city in Bangladesh, has led to significant ecological challenges. This study evaluates the spatiotemporal dynamics of ecological quality in the Sylhet Metropolitan Area from 2003 to 2023 using a Comprehensive Ecological Evaluation Index (CEEI) derived from remote sensing data. The CEEI incorporates multiple remote sensing-based parameters such as the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Land Surface Temperature (LST), and Vegetative Health Index (VHI), which together provide a robust assessment of the region's ecological conditions. The results indicate a general decline in ecological quality over the study period, with significant degradation occurring in urban areas. Despite some areas showing signs of ecological recovery, the overall trend suggests that the environmental pressures associated with urbanization are outpacing efforts to mitigate them. The results revealed that the changes in ecological quality displayed a pattern of improvement from 2003 to 2011, then degraded from 2011 to 2023, and the regions with poor and fair ecological quality gradually shifted from suburbs to urban areas. The urbanization process and policy variation mainly drove the changes in ecological quality, and these results may provide helpful information for ecological conservation and sustainable development of Sylhet.

articles.title: Outram Park Part II: Agentic Verification, Validation and Documentation as a Human Review Gate for Nuclear Data and Neutronics Software
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.15258v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: NJOY21 is part of a modernisation effort for NJOY2016, but mostly consists of C++ wrappers. Agentic coding represents a unique opporunity for NJOY modernisation in Rust, but agents require human expert supervision, which may be in short supply. Moreover, expert human review is the bottleneck in agentic software development as human resources are limited in this context. This work describes a methodology for how a human manager of AI agents can reasonably translate and refactor scientific software with limited domain expertise using principles borrowed from nuclear quality assurance documents. Moreover, it presents a methodology for when to allocate limited human resources for reviewing the agentically generated code. This methodology centres on agentic V&V and documentation, and it is demonstrated via construction of Monte Carlo web demos for the Rust fork of NJOY an Outram Monte Carlo (OutramMC), Rust ports of NJOY2016 and OpenMC, in Outram Park. In this work, an integrated pipeline for the Rust port of NJOY and OutramMC was demonstrated in web demos, and code to code verification and validation was performed with ICSBEP benchmarks for Godiva, HST009 and LCT008. ACE files produced with Outram Park's NJOY port were identical for more than 30 ACE files. These web demos also served as part of agentic documentation, which prepared the codebase for human review.

articles.title: Deep Generative Crystal Structure Prediction: A Benchmark Study and a Controlled Test of Prototype Dependence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.26502v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Deep generative models are widely reported to enable de novo crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their capability has not been measured consistently against template-based methods. We evaluate 12 representative generative CSP models, spanning latent-variable, diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive, and manifold random-walk architectures, against TCSP 2.0 on 180 test structures and a leakage-controlled subset of 46. All methods use identical structure-matching, symmetry, and consensus criteria. Template retrieval is the strongest single method, reaching 68.3% top-1 success; symmetry-aware EquiCSP (66.4%) and Uni-3DAR (62.9%) form the next tier. However, comparison with TCSP 2.0 shows that most structures correctly predicted by generative models are also correctly predicted by template substitution. Thus, the set of structures uniquely reachable by generation is small, limiting its practical advantage for discovering structures outside existing prototype libraries. To test the source of this performance, we removed entire stoichiometric prototype families from the training set and retrained the strongest generative model. Accuracy declined by 50-78% across four families, establishing that performance is substantially prototype-dependent. A small minority of structures survived removal of their prototype family, demonstrating a real but limited retrieval-independent predictive capacity. Present generative CSP models therefore function largely as implicit, softer-edged prototype libraries rather than genuinely de novo predictors. Enlarging this residual capacity, rather than aggregate match rate alone, is the central open problem.

articles.title: Qudit-based scalable quantum algorithm for solving the integer programming problem
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.13906v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Integer programming (IP) is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem that is widely used to represent a diverse set of real-world problems spanning multiple fields, such as finance, engineering, logistics, and operations research. It is a hard problem to solve using classical algorithms, as its complexity increases with problem size. Most quantum algorithms for solving IP are highly resource-inefficient because they encode integers into qubits. In [1], the issue of resource inefficiency was addressed by mapping integer variables to qudits. However, [1] has limited practical value due to a lack of scalability to multiple qudits to encode larger problems. In this work, by extending upon the ideas of [1], a circuit-based scalable quantum algorithm is presented using multiple interacting qudits for which we show a quantum speed-up for solving the integer programming problem. The quantum algorithm consists of a distillation function that efficiently separates the feasible from the infeasible regions, a phase-amplitude encoding for the cost function, and a quantum phase estimation coupled with a multi-controlled single-qubit rotation for optimization. We prove that our algorithm yields the optimal solution with the maximum measurement probability. The time complexity for the quantum algorithm is shown to be O(r_P(mn²log d + dⁿ/²/Ny_ₛ¹/² + n ϵQPE⁻¹)) for a problem with the number of variables n taking d integer values, satisfying m constraints with a precision of ϵQPE and r_P repetitions required for reaching a success probability P. Compared to the classical time complexity of brute force O(dⁿ) and the classical exact algorithm O((logn)O⁽ⁿ⁾), it incurs a reduction of sim dⁿ/² in the time complexity (for a polynomial number of repetitions and precision requirements) for solving a general polynomial IP problem.

articles.title: Purely equatorial lasing in spherical liquid crystal polymer microlasers with bipolar refractive index profile
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12673v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Liquid crystal whispering gallery mode (WGM) microlasers show high sensitivity to external stimuli and distinct spectral features, rendering them ideally suited for various sensing applications. They also offer intrinsic anisotropic optical properties, which can be used to shape and manipulate light even inside spatially highly symmetric structures. Here, we report the fabrication of a spherical bipolar liquid crystal polymer microlaser that tightly confines the optical path of WGMs to the equatorial plane. By controlled anchoring of the liquid crystal mesogens followed by polymerization, a fixed refractive index profile is formed within the spherical microcavity. Consequently, only transverse electric (TE) modes oscillating in the equatorial plane experience the high extraordinary refractive index, allowing to confine lasing into a single plane. Furthermore, we observe a characteristic splitting into sub-modes. By combining hyperspectral imaging, optical modeling, and theoretical calculations, we show that the observed sub-modes originate from the lifting of the energy degeneracy of azimuthal WGMs. The unique ability to confine lasing into a single plane makes these spherical microlasers independent of the exact position of the pump beam, which allows consistent localized sensing especially in combination with fast point scanning microscopes or inside highly dynamic biological environments.

articles.title: Physics-informed data-driven inference of an interpretable equivariant LES model of two-dimensional incompressible fluid turbulence
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15743v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Restrictive phenomenological assumptions limit the accuracy and generality of subgrid-scale models of fluid turbulence, especially in flows where coherent structures and bidirectional energy transfer play an important dynamical role. This paper introduces a symbolic, physically-informed data-driven subgrid-scale closure for two-dimensional incompressible turbulence. The closure is inferred from filtered direct numerical simulation data using symmetry-constrained sparse regression, together with dimensional-consistency constraints on the inferred coefficients. While the model is inferred using LES-style spatial coarse-graining, its structure is found to be more similar to RANS models, as it employs an additional field to describe the dynamics of unresolved scales. For the range of two-dimensional benchmark flows considered here, the inferred model substantially improves upon widely used LES models, yielding accurate predictions of subgrid-scale stresses, local and global fluxes between different scales, and other key quantities in both a priori and a posteriori benchmarks.

articles.title: Qudit Implementation of the Rodeo Algorithm for Quantum Spectral Filtering
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.16049v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Qudits, the multi-level generalization of qubits, provide a natural extension of the binary paradigm in quantum computation and offer new opportunities to enhance algorithmic performance. Beyond their direct applicability to the simulation of multi-level quantum systems, higher-dimensional ancillae can improve sampling efficiency in quantum algorithms by enabling the simultaneous implementation of multiple control operations, thereby reducing circuit complexity. In this work, we pursue three main objectives. First, we present a formulation of the Rodeo algorithm employing a general d-level ancilla qudit. Second, we introduce the concept of the emphRodeo kernel, defined as a two-frequency interferometer, which acts as a spectral filter in the energy domain. Finally, we propose a microcanonical protocol for the Rodeo algorithm. This protocol enables the estimation of entropic quantities through a single energy sweep and admits a natural interpretation as a Gaussian convolution of the density of states. To support the theoretical analysis, we perform numerical evaluations of the corresponding quantum circuit using ancilla qudits of dimensions three, four, and five. The simulations are performed for the one-dimensional Ising model, considering both spin-sfrac12 and spin-1 particles. The ancilla qutrit implementation exhibits an 18% reduction in fluctuations compared to the qubit implementation. Our results show that qudits provide a framework for spectral analysis and thermodynamic characterization of multi-level quantum systems.

articles.title: runner 2.0 : A software suite for high-dimensional neural network potentials
articles.abstract: We present runner 2.0 , the “Ruhr University Neural Network energy representation,” a highly optimized software suite for training and evaluating high-dimensional neural network potentials (HDNNPs) of the second, third, and fourth generations. Long-range electrostatics and charge equilibration (QEq) for the description of non-local charge transfer in fourth-generation (4G) HDNNPs are accelerated by quasi-linear-scaling plane wave methods, reducing QEq computational complexity from O(N3) to O(N⁡log2⁡N) such that linear or quasi-linear scaling is achieved across all HDNNP generations. An optimized memory management strategy eliminates the training overhead traditionally associated with long-range interactions, allowing 4G-HDNNPs to be trained with the same efficiency as their local counterparts. Developed in modern Fortran (2003/2008 standards), combined with a hybrid Message Passing Interface (MPI)/Open Multi-Processing (OpenMP) parallelization scheme, runner 2.0 has been designed to run efficiently in any central processing unit (CPU) environment, from cost-effective local workstations to massive high-performance computing (HPC) clusters. Its modular library architecture facilitates straightforward binding to external simulation software; native interfaces to the Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator (LAMMPS) and the atomic simulation environment (ASE) provide full access to all its features, including built-in committee-based uncertainty quantification. The high efficiency and scalability of the runner 2.0 ecosystem are demonstrated through detailed benchmarks.

articles.title: Growth mechanisms of body-centered cubic and quasi-crystalline Ta
articles.abstract: Compared with the growth of periodic crystals, the growth of aperiodic quasi-crystals remains elusive in many respects, particularly regarding their underlying growth mechanisms. Here, we perform molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the growth behavior of the body-centered cubic phase and the quasi-crystalline metastable phase in tantalum (Ta). The results show that both phases can be described by a diffusion-limited growth model, yet they exhibit fundamentally distinct atomistic mechanisms. The crystalline phase grows via a continuous mechanism, in which atoms can simultaneously propagate across multiple unit cells on a rough interface. In contrast, the quasi-crystalline metastable phase grows through a screw dislocation-mediated mechanism on a smooth interface, where atomic attachment is restricted to approximately a single unit cell. As a result, the growth rate of quasi-crystals is several times slower than that of crystals under comparable conditions. The distinct growth mechanisms of crystals and quasi-crystals are closely related to the type and characteristics of the locally ordered atomic species at their respective interfaces. These findings offer new physical insights into the correlation between crystal and quasi-crystal growth mechanisms and provide a fresh perspective on the underlying origin of the remarkable glass-forming ability of elemental Ta.

articles.title: The std2 package: A computationally efficient program to calculate molecular response properties and excited states using simplified quantum chemistry methods
articles.abstract: The std2 modular program package is dedicated to the computation of excited states and molecular response properties using simplified quantum chemistry approaches. The framework involves several variants of the simplified time-dependent density functional theory, including sTDA, sTD-DFT, SF-sTD-DFT, XsTDA, XsTD-DFT, and SF-XsTD-DFT methods. Combining controlled approximations with efficient implementations, the std2 program enables routine calculations on systems containing thousands of atoms while retaining a favorable balance between computational cost and predictive accuracy. Therefore, the framework supports all-atom quantum mechanics (AQM) methodologies for the treatment of surrounding and dynamical structural effects considering realistic systems. In this contribution, the capabilities of the std2 package are illustrated for spectroscopic observables, such as one- and two-photon absorption, electronic circular dichroism, optical rotation, second-harmonic generation, and excited-state absorption. Among results, benchmark calculations show that the recent XsTD-DFT scheme improves the description of excited states relative to sTD-DFT especially, for charge-transfer excitations while preserving a speedup of two to three orders of magnitude compared to standard TD-DFT. Applications of AQM methodologies to explicitly solvated systems and ultra-large systems are also highlighted, showing the adequacy of the std2 program to treat such systems. Overall, std2 provides an efficient platform for large-scale excited-state and spectroscopic simulations, especially in AQM protocols.

articles.title: Defect organization in coexisting hexagonal and square lattices on ellipsoids
articles.abstract: Curvature and topology jointly organize defects in two-dimensional crystals, but their combined role remains unresolved when competing lattice symmetries coexist with spatially varying curvature. We use simulated-annealing Langevin dynamics to study Hertzian particles forming coexisting hexagonal (Hex) and square (Sq) lattices on prolate and oblate ellipsoids. Mapping reduced density and aspect ratio reveals a broad sequence of scar- and domain-based morphologies in both Hex-dominant and Sq-dominant backgrounds. Latitude-resolved comparisons show that Gaussian curvature biases defects toward its maxima under weak deformation. Strong prolateness, however, confines high curvature to small polar caps that cannot independently accommodate all defect motifs. Defects then spread toward lower-curvature latitudes to relieve defect crowding and elastic repulsion. In the Hex-dominant regime, this competition drives vertex-contacted domains with neutralized corner contacts, and compensating positive defects locate away from the poles. The Sq-dominant regime features Hex-rich triangular domains, bridged states, and linear or open scars similarly reorganized by curvature anisotropy. On oblate ellipsoids, the extended equatorial high-curvature belt allows defects to separate azimuthally while remaining curvature-localized. This work elucidates that nonuniform curvature can engineer rich defect patterns by selecting the spatial distribution of topological charge and the connectivity of finite defect motifs.

articles.title: Investigation of surface and subsurface defects of Cu(111) surface by scanning tunneling microscopy
articles.abstract: Various types of surface defects are observed using scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) on a clean Cu(111) surface. Detailed STM images of defects show an asymmetric structure comprised of a bright protrusion inside a hexagonal depression. Protrusions are consistently aligned in the same direction, Cu[001], on the surface. The defects are observed to interact with one another, as each defect is separated by an integer multiple of half the Fermi wavelength, evident from the quasiparticle interference oscillations resulting from the defects. This interaction is also suspected to dictate the orientation of the defects, resulting in their uniform alignment. Ab initio density functional theory methods are used to investigate Cu(111) surface defects and adatoms. Simulated STM images using the Tersoff–Hamann scheme are compared to STM images. Results are also discussed in the context of existing literature on similar structures.

articles.title: QMBL: the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard. A live record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: QMBL：量子多体排行榜。已发表的晶格哈密顿量基态能量的实时记录
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In condensed matter physics, scientists explore phase diagrams of matter through various methods (analysis, numerics, experiment) and achieve consensus when enough methods agree. The quality of variational results for quantum many-body ground states is mainly judged by energy values and respective errors. Here, we present QMBL, the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard (https://www.qmbl.org), serving as the energy layer of the scientific consensus. It is a maintained, interactive record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians. The latest release v0.4.0 holds 1434 energies on 395 instances of six model families and collects all of the community's efforts into one view. Of those instances 153 have no exact solution and any new record serves as a direct improvement to an open science problem. They are the targets of a companion benchmark, QMBL: Open Problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 在凝聚态物理学中，科学家通过各种方法（分析、数值、实验）探索物质的相图，并在足够多的方法一致时达成共识。量子多体基态变分结果的好坏主要通过能量值和各自的误差来判断。在这里，我们介绍 QMBL，量子多体排行榜 (https://www.qmbl.org)，作为科学共识的能量层。它是已发布的晶格哈密顿量基态能量的维护的交互式记录。最新版本 v0.4.0 在六个模型系列的 395 个实例上拥有 1434 个能量，并将社区的所有努力收集到一个视图中。

articles.title: Thermodynamics of coupled electromagnetic and mass fields
articles.title_zh: 电磁场和质量场耦合的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22391v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a unified thermodynamic framework for chemical, mechanical, and electromagnetic transport by extending the Gibbs--Duhem relation to include kinetic free-energy contributions associated with material and field motion. The resulting kinetic Gibbs--Duhem relation establishes a thermodynamic connection between free-energy variations, generalized chemical potentials, pressure, and transport momentum, while preserving the invariance of the system free energy under changes of reference frame. Within a Lagrangian formulation of free-energy evolution, the relation provides a common structure for diffusion, momentum transport, and electromagnetic dynamics. For nonuniform chemical systems, the framework recovers the coupling between Cahn--Hilliard dynamics and the Korteweg stress arising from composition gradients. Its extension to electromagnetic systems incorporates electric, magnetic, charge, and mechanical contributions into the same thermodynamic formulation, yielding a unified description of electromagnetic and momentum evolution. The framework further separates dissipative from nondissipative transport and establishes a common thermodynamic form for mechanical and electromagnetic propagation. In the isentropic limit, the characteristic propagation velocity is determined by the derivative of the thermodynamic pressure with respect to density, yielding the speed of sound for mechanical systems and the speed of light for electromagnetic systems. These results show that kinetic contributions can be incorporated consistently into the Gibbs--Duhem framework, providing a common thermodynamic basis for coupled chemical, mechanical, and electromagnetic transport without introducing separate thermodynamic principles for each mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过扩展吉布斯-迪昂关系以包括与材料和场运动相关的动能自由能贡献，为化学、机械和电磁传输制定了统一的热力学框架。由此产生的动力学吉布斯-迪昂关系在自由能变化、广义化学势、压力和输运动量之间建立了热力学联系，同时保持了系统自由能在参考系变化下的不变性。在自由能演化的拉格朗日公式中，该关系为扩散、动量传输和电磁动力学提供了通用结构。对于非均匀化学系统，该框架恢复了 Cahn-Hilliard 动力学与成分梯度产生的 Korteweg 应力之间的耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过扩展吉布斯-迪昂关系以包括与材料和场运动相关的动能自由能贡献，为化学、机械和电磁传输制定了统一的热力学框架。由此产生的动力学吉布斯-迪昂关系在自由能变化、广义化学势、压力和输运动量之间建立了热力学联系，同时保持了系统自由能在参考系变化下的不变性。在自由能演化的拉格朗日公式中，该关系为扩散、动量传输和电磁动力学提供了通用结构。对于非均匀化学系统，该框架恢复了 Cahn-Hilliard 动力学与成分梯度产生的 Korteweg 应力之间的耦合。其对电磁系统的扩展将电、磁、电荷和机械贡献纳入相同的热力学公式中，从而产生电磁和动量演化的统一描述。该框架进一步将耗散传输与非耗散传输分开，并为机械和电磁传播建立了通用的热力学形式。在等熵极限下，特征传播速度由热力学压力相对于密度的导数决定，从而产生机械系统的声速和电磁系统的光速。这些结果表明，动力学贡献可以一致地纳入吉布斯-杜赫姆框架中，为耦合化学、机械和电磁传输提供共同的热力学基础，而无需为每种机制引入单独的热力学原理。

articles.title: Synergistic Self-Driven Nanoconfinement and Dynamical Heterogeneity in Deeply Supercooled "No Man's Land" Water
articles.title_zh: 深度过冷“无人区”水中的协同自驱动纳米约束和动态异质性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The 150--235 K ``no man's land'' (NML) of deeply supercooled water is a highly debated regime where rapid crystallization hinders experimental observation of the hypothesized liquid-liquid phase transition. Using TIP4P/2005 molecular dynamics simulations, we uncover a structurally and dynamically heterogeneous state at ambient pressure that exhibits novel physical features. Our results demonstrate that this low-density state (ρ approx 0.925 g/cm³) is a unique supercooled liquid, distinct from both glassy and spinodal states. Specifically, it emerges as a stable, structurally arrested phase driven by a self-generated ``soft skeleton'' of nanoclusters. This network forms an intrinsic nanoporous structure that imposes nanoconfinement on the remaining fluid, proving that NML confinement can be an entirely self-driven phenomenon. Finally, we resolve the temperature-dependent, nonlinear behavior of density and compressibility, highlighting a structurally driven anomaly that clarifies the thermodynamics of deep supercooling. Collectively, this work provides a transformative structural framework for understanding the anomalous nature of water within the NML.
articles.abstract_zh: 150--235 K 的“无人区”(NML) 深度过冷水是一个备受争议的区域，其中快速结晶阻碍了对假设的液-液相变的实验观察。使用 TIP4P/2005 分子动力学模拟，我们发现了环境压力下的结构和动态异质状态，该状态表现出新颖的物理特征。我们的结果表明，这种低密度态（ρ 约 0.925 g/cm3）是一种独特的过冷液体，与玻璃态和旋节线态不同。具体来说，它表现为一种稳定的、结构上停滞的相，由纳米团簇自生的“软骨架”驱动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 150--235 K 的“无人区”(NML) 深度过冷水是一个备受争议的区域，其中快速结晶阻碍了对假设的液-液相变的实验观察。使用 TIP4P/2005 分子动力学模拟，我们发现了环境压力下的结构和动态异质状态，该状态表现出新颖的物理特征。我们的结果表明，这种低密度态（ρ 约 0.925 g/cm3）是一种独特的过冷液体，与玻璃态和旋节线态不同。具体来说，它表现为一种稳定的、结构上停滞的相，由纳米团簇自生的“软骨架”驱动。该网络形成了一种内在的纳米多孔结构，对剩余流体施加纳米限制，证明 NML 限制可以是一种完全自驱动的现象。最后，我们解决了密度和压缩性的与温度相关的非线性行为，突出了结构驱动的异常，阐明了深度过冷的热力学。总的来说，这项工作为理解 NML 内水的异常性质提供了一个变革性的结构框架。

articles.title: Comment on "Skyrmion Hall Effect in Altermagnets"
articles.title_zh: 对“交变磁铁中的斯格明子霍尔效应”的评论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22486v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In their Letter, Jin et al. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 196701 (2024)] predict a transverse velocity v_y for skyrmions driven by spin-transfer torque (STT), known as skyrmion Hall effect (SkHE), in d-wave altermagnets. Usually, the SkHE emerges from the skyrmion's topological charge which here cancels between sublattices. Instead, Jin et al. attribute the SkHE to the dimensionless quadrupole tensor Aᵢⱼ. The result in their Eq. (12) is fitted to micromagnetic simulations, yielding a finite value for Aₓy. However, via the divergence theorem, Aᵢⱼ simplifies to a boundary integral that vanishes for a sufficiently smooth and localized texture. In this Comment, we substantiate our claim from Ref. [2] that the numerically observed SkHE by Jin et al. for a micromagnetic model with standard Zhang-Li STT in the individual sublattices is merely a discretization artefact.
articles.abstract_zh: Jin 等人在信中。 [物理。莱特牧师。 133, 196701 (2024)] 预测 d 波交变磁体中由自旋转移矩 (STT) 驱动的斯格明子的横向速度 v_y，称为斯格明子霍尔效应 (SkHE)。通常，SkHE 源自斯格明子的拓扑电荷，此处在子晶格之间相互抵消。相反，金等人。将 SkHE 归因于无量纲四极张量 Aᵢⱼ。他们的方程的结果。 (12) 适合微磁模拟，产生 Aₓy 的有限值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Jin 等人在信中。 [物理。莱特牧师。 133, 196701 (2024)] 预测 d 波交变磁体中由自旋转移矩 (STT) 驱动的斯格明子的横向速度 v_y，称为斯格明子霍尔效应 (SkHE)。通常，SkHE 源自斯格明子的拓扑电荷，此处在子晶格之间相互抵消。相反，金等人。将 SkHE 归因于无量纲四极张量 Aᵢⱼ。他们的方程的结果。 (12) 适合微磁模拟，产生 Aₓy 的有限值。然而，通过散度定理，Aᵢⱼ 简化为边界积分，该边界积分对于足够平滑和局部化的纹理而言消失。在这篇评论中，我们证实了参考文献的主张。 [2] Jin 等人数值观测到的 SkHE。对于单个子晶格中具有标准张李 STT 的微磁模型来说，这只是一个离散化的人工制品。

articles.title: Attraction from repulsion in an interacting Chern band: chiral superconductivity, generalized Hall crystals, and competing fractional Chern insulators
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的陈氏能带中的排斥力：手性超导性、广义霍尔晶体和竞争分数陈氏绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experiments realizing strong interactions in partially filled Chern bands have observed fractional Chern insulators (FCIs), superconductors, and topological crystals in close proximity. Yet the microscopic relation between them remains poorly understood. Here, we use tensor network simulations to study repulsively interacting spinless fermions in a tunable topological band of the checkerboard lattice. We characterize the competing phases and identify key features of the experimental phenomenology. FCIs from the Jain sequence transition into chiral p-wave superconductivity both below and above half filling as the band dispersion is enhanced. By contrast, at half filling, a generalized Hall crystal with quantized Hall conductance and a doubled unit cell forms for sufficiently strong coupling. Surprisingly, a weak-coupling approach starting from a metallic parent state captures the nature of both ordered phases at intermediate coupling. We find that fluctuations in the metal generate longer-range attraction, which we analyze within the random-phase approximation. This approach captures the pairing symmetry as well as the radial form factors of the Cooper pairs, and incorporating this attraction into Hartree-Fock selects the observed Hall crystal. Together, these results identify fluctuation-induced attraction from repulsion as a common microscopic ingredient of ordering, while our tensor network computations establish the direct competition of both phases with FCIs.
articles.abstract_zh: 在部分填充的陈能带中实现强相互作用的实验已经观察到分数陈绝缘体（FCI）、超导体和拓扑晶体非常接近。然而它们之间的微观关系仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用张量网络模拟来研究棋盘晶格的可调拓扑带中排斥相互作用的无自旋费米子。我们描述了竞争阶段并确定了实验现象学的关键特征。随着能带色散的增强，来自 Jain 序列的 FCI 在半填充以下和以上都转变为手性 p 波超导。相比之下，在半填充时，具有量子化霍尔电导的广义霍尔晶体和双晶胞形成，以实现足够强的耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在部分填充的陈能带中实现强相互作用的实验已经观察到分数陈绝缘体（FCI）、超导体和拓扑晶体非常接近。然而它们之间的微观关系仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用张量网络模拟来研究棋盘晶格的可调拓扑带中排斥相互作用的无自旋费米子。我们描述了竞争阶段并确定了实验现象学的关键特征。随着能带色散的增强，来自 Jain 序列的 FCI 在半填充以下和以上都转变为手性 p 波超导。相比之下，在半填充时，具有量子化霍尔电导的广义霍尔晶体和双晶胞形成，以实现足够强的耦合。令人惊讶的是，从金属母态开始的弱耦合方法捕获了中间耦合时两个有序相的性质。我们发现金属的波动会产生更远距离的吸引力，我们在随机相位近似中对此进行了分析。这种方法捕获了库珀对的配对对称性以及径向形状因子，并将这种吸引力合并到 Hartree-Fock 中，选择了观察到的霍尔晶体。总之，这些结果将排斥引起的波动吸引力视为有序的常见微观成分，而我们的张量网络计算建立了两个相与 FCI 的直接竞争。

articles.title: Magnetic flux ring splitting near a Navier-Stokes singularity
articles.title_zh: 纳维-斯托克斯奇点附近的磁通环分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22510v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: OpenAI reports a forced Navier-Stokes flow that becomes singular in finite time, raising the question of its physical consequences. Magnetic reconnection offers a test through the splitting and merging of flux structures. We use resistive magnetohydrodynamics to simulate a magnetic ring driven by an imposed, regularized flow that reproduces the geometry and scaling of the collapsing core. At the nominal singular time, we remove the imposed drive and allow the system to evolve freely. Reconnections before and after release split the ring into two or more daughter rings through bifurcations of the poloidal flux function, with Lorentz feedback selecting the bifurcation type. Unequal winding by the swirl above and below the midplane produces asymmetric toroidal magnetic stresses, unfolding the kinematic pitchfork-like transition into a fold. For single-island splits, the cusp normal form predicts the asymmetry of the daughter rings without adjustable parameters. Three-dimensional simulations retain the splits and merger, confirming that approach to hydrodynamic blow-up can trigger magnetic restructuring.
articles.abstract_zh: OpenAI 报告了一种受迫纳维斯托克斯流，该流在有限时间内变得奇异，引发了其物理后果的问题。磁重联通过通量结构的分裂和合并提供测试。我们使用电阻磁流体动力学来模拟由强加的规则化流动驱动的磁环，该磁环再现了塌缩核心的几何形状和缩放比例。在名义奇异时间，我们去除强加的驱动力并允许系统自由演化。释放前后的重新连接通过极向通量函数的分叉将环分裂成两个或多个子环，洛伦兹反馈选择分叉类型。中平面上方和下方的涡流产生的不均匀缠绕会产生不对称的环形磁应力，将运动干草叉状的过渡展开为折叠。
articles.abstract_zh_full: OpenAI 报告了一种受迫纳维斯托克斯流，该流在有限时间内变得奇异，引发了其物理后果的问题。磁重联通过通量结构的分裂和合并提供测试。我们使用电阻磁流体动力学来模拟由强加的规则化流动驱动的磁环，该磁环再现了塌缩核心的几何形状和缩放比例。在名义奇异时间，我们去除强加的驱动力并允许系统自由演化。释放前后的重新连接通过极向通量函数的分叉将环分裂成两个或多个子环，洛伦兹反馈选择分叉类型。中平面上方和下方的涡流产生的不均匀缠绕会产生不对称的环形磁应力，将运动干草叉状的过渡展开为折叠。对于单岛分裂，尖点范式预测子环的不对称性，无需调整参数。三维模拟保留了分裂和合并，证实了流体动力爆炸的方法可以触发磁重组。

articles.title: Valley-Selective Transport through Structural Domain Walls in Rhombohedral Graphene Quarter Metals
articles.title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯季金属中结构畴壁的谷选择性传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22521v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Domain walls separating quarter metals with opposite valley polarizations have recently been imaged in rhombohedral graphene multilayers. Depending on their formation mechanism, these walls respond in distinct ways to external magnetic probes. Therefore, understanding their behaviors is critical to the interpretation of experimental results. In this work, we examine domain walls formed from strain-induced one-dimensional structural defects that separate domains with complementary rhombohedral stacking orders. We show that while transport across such domain walls is controlled by the valley degree of freedom, the coupling to a magnetic field is dictated by the momentum-space chirality encoded in the Hamiltonian. As a consequence, structural domain walls are rendered electronically opaque by an applied magnetic field, while intrinsic domain walls formed by spontaneous valley symmetry breaking are unstable in the presence of such an ordering field and can be eliminated. This dichotomy allows the two types of domain walls to be distinguished in a magnetotransport experiment.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在菱面体石墨烯多层中成像了将具有相反谷极化的四分之一金属分开的畴壁。根据它们的形成机制，这些壁以不同的方式响应外部磁探针。因此，了解它们的行为对于解释实验结果至关重要。在这项工作中，我们检查了由应变引起的一维结构缺陷形成的畴壁，这些缺陷将具有互补菱面体堆叠顺序的畴分开。我们表明，虽然穿过这种畴壁的传输是由谷自由度控制的，但与磁场的耦合是由哈密顿量中编码的动量空间手性决定的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近在菱面体石墨烯多层中成像了将具有相反谷极化的四分之一金属分开的畴壁。根据它们的形成机制，这些壁以不同的方式响应外部磁探针。因此，了解它们的行为对于解释实验结果至关重要。在这项工作中，我们检查了由应变引起的一维结构缺陷形成的畴壁，这些缺陷将具有互补菱面体堆叠顺序的畴分开。我们表明，虽然穿过这种畴壁的传输是由谷自由度控制的，但与磁场的耦合是由哈密顿量中编码的动量空间手性决定的。因此，结构畴壁通过施加的磁场而变得电子不透明，而由自发谷对称破缺形成的本征畴壁在存在这种有序场的情况下是不稳定的并且可以被消除。这种二分法允许在磁输运实验中区分两种类型的畴壁。

articles.title: Bulk-Defect Correspondence in Algebraic Classical Spin Liquids
articles.title_zh: 代数经典自旋液体中的体缺陷对应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local constraints in algebraic classical spin liquids give rise to singular momentum-space correlations. This so called pinch-point singularity carries a momentum-space winding number that determines the low-energy structure of the algebraic spin liquid. We show that nonmagnetic vacancies in two dimensions reveal this topological invariant in the real-space winding of the surrounding spin textures. Under explicit conditions, we prove this bulk-defect correspondence for rank-n U(1) spin liquids and verify it numerically for the Coulomb spin liquids of the kagome and checkerboard lattices and the rank-2 U(1) spin liquid of the honeycomb-snowflake model. In this way we show that vacancies can be used as general probes for distinguishing the emergent gauge theories of strongly correlated classical disordered magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 代数经典自旋液体中的局部约束引起奇异动量空间相关性。这种所谓的夹点奇点带有动量空间缠绕数，它决定了代数自旋液体的低能结构。我们证明，二维非磁性空位揭示了周围自旋纹理的真实空间缠绕中的拓扑不变量。在显式条件下，我们证明了 n 级 U(1) 自旋液体的体缺陷对应关系，并针对 kagome 和棋盘晶格的库仑自旋液体以及蜂窝雪花模型的 2 级 U(1) 自旋液体进行了数值验证。通过这种方式，我们表明空位可以用作区分强相关经典无序磁体的新兴规范理论的通用探针。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 代数经典自旋液体中的局部约束引起奇异动量空间相关性。这种所谓的夹点奇点带有动量空间缠绕数，它决定了代数自旋液体的低能结构。我们证明，二维非磁性空位揭示了周围自旋纹理的真实空间缠绕中的拓扑不变量。在显式条件下，我们证明了 n 级 U(1) 自旋液体的体缺陷对应关系，并针对 kagome 和棋盘晶格的库仑自旋液体以及蜂窝雪花模型的 2 级 U(1) 自旋液体进行了数值验证。通过这种方式，我们表明空位可以用作区分强相关经典无序磁体的新兴规范理论的通用探针。

articles.title: Zeta potential of magnetic-field-controlled silver nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 磁场控制银纳米颗粒的 Zeta 电位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic-field-dependent nanoparticle size does not by itself determine zeta potential, which also depends on interfacial charge, electrolyte screening, and the location of the slipping plane. We extend the sphere-packing description of silver nanoparticles by distinguishing the structural surface, the effective charge plane, and the hydrodynamic slipping plane. The model uses structural radii of SI20nm and SI5nm at zero field and SI250mT, with reported zeta potentials of SI-13.2mV and SI-10.0mV. Effective charge is related to the defective-shell atom count. For field-independent interfacial parameters, the linear response without additional charge weighting decreases with decreasing radius. Its normalized form depends on three electrokinetic lengths through only two sums, preventing their independent determination from a field-dependent zeta curve. At ((κ⁻¹,tₗᵢg,δₛₗᵢₚ)=(3,0,1),nm), nonlinear Poisson--Boltzmann electrostatics changes the fitted shell coefficient from 0.316 to 0.299. Constant total charge still predicts an increase in zeta magnitude, opposite to the observed trend in the evaluated scenarios. Independently calibrated shell and area charge laws differ by less than SI0.05mV, so the endpoint agreement does not distinguish these mechanisms. Propagating the initial size frequencies gives a narrower endpoint size distribution than measured. With charge parameters determined from the measured size populations, its predicted mean zeta potential is SI-9.131mV, with standard deviation SI0.994mV. Imposing the measured mean by charge recalibration does not remove the discrepancy in size width. The combined structural and electrokinetic model thus identifies both the size-dependent contribution to zeta potential and the interfacial information needed to interpret it.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁场依赖性纳米颗粒尺寸本身并不决定 zeta 电位，zeta 电位还取决于界面电荷、电解质筛选和滑移平面的位置。我们通过区分结构表面、有效电荷平面和流体动力滑移平面来扩展银纳米颗粒的球堆积描述。该模型在零场和 SI250mT 下使用 SI20nm 和 SI5nm 的结构半径，报告的 zeta 电位为 SI-13.2mV 和 SI-10.0mV。有效电荷与缺陷壳层原子数有关。对于与场无关的界面参数，没有额外电荷加权的线性响应随着半径的减小而减小。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁场依赖性纳米颗粒尺寸本身并不决定 zeta 电位，zeta 电位还取决于界面电荷、电解质筛选和滑移平面的位置。我们通过区分结构表面、有效电荷平面和流体动力滑移平面来扩展银纳米颗粒的球堆积描述。该模型在零场和 SI250mT 下使用 SI20nm 和 SI5nm 的结构半径，报告的 zeta 电位为 SI-13.2mV 和 SI-10.0mV。有效电荷与缺陷壳层原子数有关。对于与场无关的界面参数，没有额外电荷加权的线性响应随着半径的减小而减小。其归一化形式仅通过两个总和取决于三个动电长度，从而阻止了它们根据场相关 zeta 曲线的独立确定。在 ((κ⁻1,tₗᵢg,δₛₗᵢₚ)=(3,0,1),nm) 处，非线性泊松-玻尔兹曼静电学将拟合壳系数从 0.316 更改为 0.299。恒定的总电荷仍然预测 zeta 幅度的增加，这与评估场景中观察到的趋势相反。独立校准的壳层和区域电荷定律相差小于 SI0.05mV，因此端点协议不区分这些机制。传播初始尺寸频率给出比测量的更窄的端点尺寸分布。根据测量的群体大小确定的电荷参数，其预测的平均 zeta 电位为 SI-9.131mV，标准差为 SI0.994mV。通过电荷重新校准施加测量平均值并不能消除尺寸宽度的差异。因此，组合的结构和电动模型确定了对 zeta 电位的尺寸依赖性贡献以及解释它所需的界面信息。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Response Tensors in Crystalline Magnets: Application to Kagome Metals
articles.title_zh: 晶体磁体响应张量的物理信息机器学习：在 Kagome 金属中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The prediction of response tensors from magnetic textures is a crucial challenge in the study of noncollinear magnets. Existing methods for constructing descriptors of a given response tensor are limited to first-order multipole expansions or restricted to simple magnetic structures. In this work, we construct a complete symmetry-invariant descriptor basis for arbitrary crystal structures and magnetic textures, providing interpretable features for machine learning modeling of response tensors. We modify the standard principal component analysis framework and derive uncorrelated order parameters that are hierarchically stable: extending the order parameter space to include higher-degree spin order introduces additional order parameters that are uncorrelated to the previous ones. We apply this framework to regression and classification of the anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in a magnetic kagome lattice. In particular, in the regime where AHC is well modeled by linear regression of the symmetry-invariant order parameters, we find that the squared regression coefficients, ranked by their magnitude, obey a Zipf-like power law: βᵣ² propto r⁻α. Our method provides a systematic route to construct interpretable order parameters of all spin orders that connect the symmetry of a magnetic crystal to its response tensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 从磁性纹理预测响应张量是非共线磁体研究中的一个关键挑战。用于构造给定响应张量的描述符的现有方法仅限于一阶多极展开或仅限于简单的磁结构。在这项工作中，我们为任意晶体结构和磁性纹理构建了完整的对称不变描述符基础，为响应张量的机器学习建模提供了可解释的特征。我们修改标准主成分分析框架并导出层次稳定的不相关阶次参数：扩展阶次参数空间以包含更高阶的自旋阶次引入与先前的阶次参数不相关的额外阶次参数。我们将该框架应用于磁 kagome 晶格中反常霍尔电导率 (AHC) 的回归和分类。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从磁性纹理预测响应张量是非共线磁体研究中的一个关键挑战。用于构造给定响应张量的描述符的现有方法仅限于一阶多极展开或仅限于简单的磁结构。在这项工作中，我们为任意晶体结构和磁性纹理构建了完整的对称不变描述符基础，为响应张量的机器学习建模提供了可解释的特征。我们修改标准主成分分析框架并导出层次稳定的不相关阶次参数：扩展阶次参数空间以包含更高阶的自旋阶次引入与先前的阶次参数不相关的额外阶次参数。我们将该框架应用于磁 kagome 晶格中反常霍尔电导率 (AHC) 的回归和分类。特别是，在 AHC 通过对称不变阶参数的线性回归很好地建模的情况下，我们发现平方回归系数（按其大小排序）服从类似 Zipf 的幂律：βᵣ² propto r⁻α。我们的方法提供了一种系统的途径来构造所有自旋顺序的可解释的顺序参数，这些参数将磁性晶体的对称性与其响应张量联系起来。

articles.title: Coexistence of Griffiths phase and superparamagnetic-like behavior in La-doped antiferromagnetic CaMnO3
articles.title_zh: La 掺杂反铁磁 CaMnO3 中格里菲斯相与超顺磁行为的共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coexistence of a Griffiths phase and superparamagnetic-like short range interaction in a single-phase homogeneous manganite is of particular interest because it reveals multiple levels of magnetic clustering generated by disorder and competing exchange interactions. In bulk La₀.₁₉Ca₀.₈₁MnO₃, this unusual magnetic state develops in the antiferromagnetic regime, where A-site disorder strongly modifies the local magnetic landscape. Rietveld analysis confirms a single-phase orthorhombic structure, while magnetic measurements establish a Griffiths phase below TG = 280 K through the deviation from Curie-Weiss behavior. Superparamagnetic-like behavior persisting from 280 to 370 K further indicates that isolated magnetic clusters remain stable well into the nominally paramagnetic region. The presence of both phenomena highlights the crucial role of disorder-induced exchange randomness in stabilizing complex magnetic states in correlated perovskite oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 单相均质亚锰矿中格里菲斯相和类超顺磁性短程相互作用的共存特别令人感兴趣，因为它揭示了由无序和竞争性交换相互作用产生的多级磁性聚集。在块体 La₀.₁₉Ca₀.₈₁MnO₃ 中，这种不寻常的磁态在反铁磁态中发展，其中 A 位无序强烈改变了局部磁景观。 Rietveld 分析证实了单相正交结构，而磁测量则通过与居里-魏斯行为的偏差建立了低于 TG = 280 K 的格里菲斯相。从 280 到 370 K 持续存在的类超顺磁行为进一步表明，孤立的磁簇在名义上的顺磁区域中保持稳定。
authors: N. N. S. V. Rama Raju
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单相均质亚锰矿中格里菲斯相和类超顺磁性短程相互作用的共存特别令人感兴趣，因为它揭示了由无序和竞争性交换相互作用产生的多级磁性聚集。在块体 La₀.₁₉Ca₀.₈₁MnO₃ 中，这种不寻常的磁态在反铁磁态中发展，其中 A 位无序强烈改变了局部磁景观。 Rietveld 分析证实了单相正交结构，而磁测量则通过与居里-魏斯行为的偏差建立了低于 TG = 280 K 的格里菲斯相。从 280 到 370 K 持续存在的类超顺磁行为进一步表明，孤立的磁簇在名义上的顺磁区域中保持稳定。这两种现象的存在凸显了无序诱导的交换随机性在稳定相关钙钛矿氧化物中复杂磁态方面的关键作用。

articles.title: Interplay between high-entropy effects and the superionic transition in fluorite oxides: A liquid-like perspective
articles.title_zh: 萤石氧化物中高熵效应与超离子转变之间的相互作用：类液体视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Minor actinide (MA)-bearing mixed oxide (MOX), a prominent high-entropy ceramic (HEC), is a promising candidate for advanced fast reactor fuels. Using a hybrid Monte Carlo/Molecular Dynamics (MC/MD) approach, we reveal that Np and Am segregation establishes a distinct short-range order (SRO) that induces severe lattice distortion. We uncover a competitive mechanism between localized high-entropy blocking effects and collective superionic dynamics, where the anionic kinetic and structural evolution within the 2000-2800 K range is partitioned and governed by the Tammann crossover temperature and superionic transition temperature. In the low-temperature regime, severe lattice distortions induced by the SRO structures create localized electrostatic and strain-coupled potential wells, which spatially confine the O-ions and lead to their sluggish diffusion. The system exhibits increased dynamical heterogeneity as thermal activation alleviates these structural constraints. Crucially, these localized traps spontaneously transform into a highly interconnected, string-like polyhedral topological network. Driven by the maximization of configurational entropy, this structural change creates low-viscosity transport pathways that trigger confinement-enhanced diffusion. Consequently, a dramatic kinetic inversion occurs, where the O-ion mobility of SRO model surpasses that of random solid solution (RSS) model via an entropy-driven compensation mechanism. Finally, through Gibbs free energy minimization and defect analysis, structural and thermodynamic origins of the superionic transition in HEC are elucidated. This study unveils how local chemical ordering regulates ion transport under extreme conditions, providing theoretical support for the design of high-performance nuclear fuels with both superior radiation tolerance and optimized mass transfer capabilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 含有次锕系元素（MA）的混合氧化物（MOX）是一种著名的高熵陶瓷（HEC），是先进快堆燃料的有希望的候选者。使用混合蒙特卡罗/分子动力学 (MC/MD) 方法，我们揭示了 Np 和 Am 偏析建立了明显的短程有序 (SRO)，从而引起严重的晶格畸变。我们揭示了局部高熵阻塞效应和集体超离子动力学之间的竞争机制，其中 2000-2800 K 范围内的阴离子动力学和结构演化由塔曼交叉温度和超离子转变温度划分和控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 含有次锕系元素（MA）的混合氧化物（MOX）是一种著名的高熵陶瓷（HEC），是先进快堆燃料的有希望的候选者。使用混合蒙特卡罗/分子动力学 (MC/MD) 方法，我们揭示了 Np 和 Am 偏析建立了明显的短程有序 (SRO)，从而引起严重的晶格畸变。我们揭示了局部高熵阻塞效应和集体超离子动力学之间的竞争机制，其中 2000-2800 K 范围内的阴离子动力学和结构演化由塔曼交叉温度和超离子转变温度划分和控制。在低温状态下，SRO结构引起的严重晶格畸变会产生局部静电和应变耦合势阱，从而在空间上限制O离子并导致其扩散缓慢。由于热激活减轻了这些结构限制，该系统表现出增加的动力学异质性。至关重要的是，这些局部陷阱会自发地转变为高度互连的弦状多面体拓扑网络。在构型熵最大化的驱动下，这种结构变化产生了低粘度传输路径，从而触发限制增强扩散。因此，发生了戏剧性的动力学反转，其中 SRO 模型的 O 离子迁移率通过熵驱动补偿机制超越了随机固溶体 (RSS) 模型。最后，通过吉布斯自由能最小化和缺陷分析，阐明了HEC中超离子转变的结构和热力学起源。这项研究揭示了极端条件下局域化学有序性如何调节离子输运，为设计具有优越辐射耐受性和优化传质能力的高性能核燃料提供理论支持。

articles.title: Pressure-Dependent hcp-to-fcc Phase Transition Path Derived from Exact Lattice Summations over Inverse Power Law Potentials
articles.title_zh: 由逆幂律势的精确晶格求和得出的压力相关的 hcp 到 FCC 相变路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the phase transition between hexagonal close-packed (hcp) and face-centered cubic (fcc) structures along the Burgers-Bain transformation path at pressures up to several hundred gigapascals. We consider a hierarchy of interatomic potentials, from (n,m)-Lennard-Jones potentials to extended Lennard-Jones two-body interactions in terms of inverse-power expansions and the Axilrod-Teller-Muto three-body term, alongside density functional theory (DFT) calculations for solid argon. For inverse-power potentials, free energies are evaluated through exact lattice sums and efficient integral representations based on generalizations of the Epstein zeta function to anisotropic interaction kernels, followed by lattice-parameter optimization. This methodology enables an accurate determination of the pressure-dependent Burgers-Bain minimum-energy path and the associated activation barrier for the phase transition. The transformation exhibits pronounced symmetry breaking connecting the Burgers and Bain paths, a feature confirmed by DFT calculations. At high pressure, the hcp-to-fcc activation barrier increases approximately linearly with pressure, owing to the dominant pressure-volume contribution. Including entropy and anharmonic effects yields excellent agreement with experimental temperature-dependent volumes up to the melting point. DFT results also highlight the increasing importance of many-body interactions under compression. Whereas two-body potentials predict that the path passes through the body-centered cubic (bcc) structure only at very high pressures, DFT generally predicts a pathway that bypasses bcc. The Axilrod-Teller-Muto term slightly reduces this discrepancy. Furthermore, DFT performs better at high pressures, where dispersion forces become less important.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在高达数百吉帕的压力下，六方密堆积 (hcp) 和面心立方 (fcc) 结构之间沿着伯格斯-贝恩变换路径的相变。我们考虑了原子间势的层次结构，从 (n,m)-Lennard-Jones 势到以逆幂展开和 Axilrod-Teller-Muto 三体项形式扩展的 Lennard-Jones 二体相互作用，以及固体氩的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在高达数百吉帕的压力下，六方密堆积 (hcp) 和面心立方 (fcc) 结构之间沿着伯格斯-贝恩变换路径的相变。我们考虑了原子间势的层次结构，从 (n,m)-Lennard-Jones 势到以逆幂展开和 Axilrod-Teller-Muto 三体项形式扩展的 Lennard-Jones 二体相互作用，以及固体氩的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算。对于反幂势，通过精确的晶格和和基于 Epstein zeta 函数到各向异性相互作用核的有效积分表示来评估自由能，然后进行晶格参数优化。该方法能够准确确定压力相关的 Burgers-Bain 最小能量路径和相关的相变激活势垒。该变换表现出连接 Burgers 和 Bain 路径的明显对称性破缺，这一特征已被 DFT 计算证实。在高压下，由于主要的压力-体积贡献，hcp-to-FCC 活化势垒随压力近似线性增加。包括熵和非谐波效应，与直到熔点的实验温度相关体积都非常一致。 DFT 结果还强调了压缩下多体相互作用的重要性。二体势预测路径仅在非常高的压力下穿过体心立方 (bcc) 结构，而 DFT 通常预测绕过 bcc 的路径。 Axilrod-Teller-Muto 项稍微缩小了这种差异。此外，DFT 在高压下表现更好，此时色散力变得不那么重要。

articles.title: Chirality-resolved imaging of spin waves with a quantum spin
articles.title_zh: 具有量子自旋的自旋波的手性分辨成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22867v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin waves carry their propagation direction in the handedness of their circularly polarized stray field, a property inaccessible to scalar magnetometers. In the Damon-Eshbach surface wave of an in-plane magnetized film, the dipolar field above the film rotates with a handedness fixed by the direction of travel. The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre in diamond is an intrinsic polarization analyser: a right-handed field about the NV axis drives one spin transition, and a left-handed field drives the other, in both the ground and the excited state. Here, we exploit the two excited-state transitions, which lie inside the spin-wave band of yttrium iron garnet (YIG), as a pair of chirality channels and image Damon-Eshbach waves in both directions. Because reflection from an etched boundary reverses the handedness, the incident and reflected waves appear as two lines in one spectrum and are imaged separately. In the ground state, the same rule applies, and the selected field drives Rabi oscillations, a route to chirality-selective control of the NV spin by magnons. Reading the two channels gives the direction of a spin wave at one point, without a phase reference. This advances chirality-resolved quantum sensing and provides insight into chiral spin-wave dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋波以其圆极化杂散场的旋向性传播其传播方向，这是标量磁力计无法获得的特性。在面内磁化薄膜的达蒙-埃什巴赫表面波中，薄膜上方的偶极场以由行进方向固定的旋向旋转。金刚石中的氮空位 (NV) 中心是一种本征偏振分析仪：围绕 NV 轴的右手场驱动一个自旋跃迁，左手场驱动另一个自旋跃迁，无论是在基态还是激发态。在这里，我们利用位于钇铁石榴石 (YIG) 自旋波段内的两个激发态跃迁作为一对手性通道，并对两个方向的 Damon-Eshbach 波进行成像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋波以其圆极化杂散场的旋向性传播其传播方向，这是标量磁力计无法获得的特性。在面内磁化薄膜的达蒙-埃什巴赫表面波中，薄膜上方的偶极场以由行进方向固定的旋向旋转。金刚石中的氮空位 (NV) 中心是一种本征偏振分析仪：围绕 NV 轴的右手场驱动一个自旋跃迁，左手场驱动另一个自旋跃迁，无论是在基态还是激发态。在这里，我们利用位于钇铁石榴石 (YIG) 自旋波段内的两个激发态跃迁作为一对手性通道，并对两个方向的 Damon-Eshbach 波进行成像。由于蚀刻边界的反射会反转旋向，因此入射波和反射波在一个光谱中显示为两条线，并分别成像。在基态下，同样的规则适用，并且选定的场驱动拉比振荡，这是磁振子对 NV 自旋进行手性选择性控制的途径。读取两个通道可给出某一点的自旋波方向，无需相位参考。这推进了手性分辨的量子传感，并提供了对手性自旋波动力学的深入了解。

articles.title: From Surface Reactions to Inhibitor Coverage: A Machine-Learning-Assisted Computational Study of Area-Selective Atomic Layer Deposition
articles.title_zh: 从表面反应到抑制剂覆盖：区域选择性原子层沉积的机器学习辅助计算研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22911v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Area-selective atomic layer deposition (AS-ALD) enables selective material growth for the fabrication of nanoscale semiconductor devices. Predicting inhibitor coverage is essential for understanding and optimizing surface blocking in AS-ALD. Here, we present a computational workflow combining a pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potential with off-lattice grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations and apply it to inhibitor adsorption and precursor blocking on amorphous SiO2. Realistic surface models reveal substantial site-dependent variations in reaction energies and activation barriers, with silanol groups serving as the primary adsorption sites for aminosilane and related inhibitors and metal precursors. Coverage simulations show that inhibitors producing identical adsorbed fragments can yield different coverages because the intact molecules impose distinct steric constraints, leading to different accessible site densities and blocking capabilities. Beyond coverage, we highlight the importance of the reactivity of adsorbed inhibitor fragments toward precursors in determining inhibitor stability and blocking performance. Together, these findings demonstrate the need to consider both steric effects and chemical reactivity on realistic amorphous surfaces. Our calculations connect local reaction chemistry with inhibitor coverage and provide a computational basis for understanding inhibition mechanisms and selecting suitable inhibitor-precursor combinations for AS-ALD.
articles.abstract_zh: 区域选择性原子层沉积 (AS-ALD) 能够实现选择性材料生长，用于制造纳米级半导体器件。预测抑制剂覆盖率对于理解和优化 AS-ALD 中的表面封闭至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种计算工作流程，将预训练的通用机器学习原子间势与晶格外正则蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，并将其应用于非晶 SiO2 上的抑制剂吸附和前体阻断。真实的表面模型揭示了反应能量和活化势垒的显着位点依赖性变化，其中硅烷醇基团充当氨基硅烷和相关抑制剂和金属前体的主要吸附位点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 区域选择性原子层沉积 (AS-ALD) 能够实现选择性材料生长，用于制造纳米级半导体器件。预测抑制剂覆盖率对于理解和优化 AS-ALD 中的表面封闭至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种计算工作流程，将预训练的通用机器学习原子间势与晶格外正则蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，并将其应用于非晶 SiO2 上的抑制剂吸附和前体阻断。真实的表面模型揭示了反应能量和活化势垒的显着位点依赖性变化，其中硅烷醇基团充当氨基硅烷和相关抑制剂和金属前体的主要吸附位点。覆盖模拟表明，产生相同吸附片段的抑制剂可以产生不同的覆盖范围，因为完整的分子施加不同的空间限制，导致不同的可接近位点密度和阻断能力。除了覆盖范围之外，我们还强调了吸附的抑制剂片段对前体的反应性在确定抑制剂稳定性和阻断性能方面的重要性。总之，这些发现表明需要考虑现实非晶表面上的空间效应和化学反应性。我们的计算将局部反应化学与抑制剂覆盖率联系起来，并为理解抑制机制和为 AS-ALD 选择合适的抑制剂-前体组合提供计算基础。

articles.title: Fully Gapped Superconductivity in the Nonsymmorphic Centrosymmetric Superconductor In2Bi
articles.title_zh: 非对称中心对称超导体 In2Bi 中的全能隙超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nature of superconductivity in nonsymmorphic In2Bi remains an open question, with ongoing debate over whether it exhibits conventional (BCS-like) or unconventional superconductivity. Here we report the physical characteristics and superconducting properties of polycrystalline In2Bi. Measurements of electrical resistivity, magnetization, penetration depth, and specific heat demonstrate the superconducting transition temperature about 6 K, with a sharp transition in resistivity (Delta_Tc = 0.1 K) and RRR = 57.32, reflecting the high quality of the sample. The upper critical field Hc2(0) obtained from resistivity and magnetization measurements are in good agreement with each other and are smaller than the Pauli limit, suggesting orbital limited mechanism. The coherence length = 35.43 nm, penetration depth = 101.9 nm and electron-phonon coupling constant = 1.05 suggest strongly coupled type-II superconductivity. For T
articles.abstract_zh: 非对称 In2Bi 的超导性质仍然是一个悬而未决的问题，关于它是否表现出传统（类似 BCS）或非常规超导性的争论仍在继续。在这里，我们报道了多晶 In2Bi 的物理特性和超导性能。电阻率、磁化强度、穿透深度和比热的测量表明，超导转变温度约为6 K，电阻率急剧转变（Delta_Tc = 0.1 K），RRR = 57.32，反映了样品的高质量。由电阻率和磁化强度测量获得的上临界场Hc2(0)彼此吻合良好，并且小于泡利极限，表明轨道限制机制。

articles.title: Hidden Staggered Superconducting Order in V2Se2O-Family Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: V2Se2O 系列交替磁体中隐藏的交错超导序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: η pairing describes a staggered superconducting condensate whose order parameter changes sign between neighboring unit cells while maintaining a uniform magnitude. Nearly four decades after its theoretical proposal by C. N. Yang, a material platform for stabilizing η pairing has remained elusive. Here, we reveal that altermagnetism, despite being pair breaking for conventional BCS pairing, naturally favors η-like pairing in V₂Se₂O-family altermagnets. Their valley-contrasting spin structure gives rise to oppositely spin-polarized, symmetry-related valleys centered at X=(π,0) and Y=(0,π), which form spin-singlet pairing partners separated by the commensurate momentum mathbf Q=(π,π), thereby favoring an η-like condensate. Self-consistent calculations demonstrate that the resulting η-like state remains robust over broad variations of chemical potential, hopping parameters, and Fermi-surface topology. To detect this hidden staggered order, we propose a phase-sensitive Josephson measurement with a uniform superconductor, where destructive interference suppresses single-Cooper-pair tunneling while preserving two-Cooper-pair processes. This constitutes a charge-4e-like Josephson response despite a bulk condensate composed of charge-2e Cooper pairs, providing a direct phase-sensitive signature of the otherwise elusive η-like condensate in V₂Se₂O-family altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: η配对描述了一种交错的超导凝聚体，其有序参数在相邻晶胞之间改变符号，同时保持均匀的大小。在杨振宁提出理论近四十年后，稳定 η 配对的材料平台仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了交变磁力，尽管对于传统的 BCS 配对来说是断对的，但它自然有利于 V2Se2O 族交变磁体中的类 η 配对。
articles.abstract_zh_full: η配对描述了一种交错的超导凝聚体，其有序参数在相邻晶胞之间改变符号，同时保持均匀的大小。在杨振宁提出理论近四十年后，稳定 η 配对的材料平台仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了交变磁力，尽管对于传统的 BCS 配对来说是断对的，但它自然有利于 V2Se2O 族交变磁体中的类 η 配对。它们的谷对比自旋结构产生了以 X=(π,0) 和 Y=(0,π) 为中心的相反自旋极化、对称相关的谷，形成由相应动量 mathbf Q=(π,π) 分隔的自旋单重态配对伙伴，从而有利于形成类似 η 的凝聚态。自洽计算表明，所得到的类 η 态在化学势、跳跃参数和费米表面拓扑的广泛变化中保持稳健。为了检测这种隐藏的交错顺序，我们提出了一种具有均匀超导体的相敏约瑟夫森测量方法，其中相消干涉抑制了单库珀对隧道效应，同时保留了两库珀对过程。尽管大量凝聚态由电荷 2e 库珀对组成，但这仍构成电荷 4e 型约瑟夫森响应，为 V2Se2O 族交流磁体中难以捉摸的 η 型凝聚态提供了直接相敏特征。

articles.title: Kitaev, semi-Dirac, and spinon quantum spin Hall liquids on the square-hexagon-dodecagon lattice: A parent projective symmetry group classification
articles.title_zh: 正方形-六边形-十二边形晶格上的基塔耶夫、半狄拉克和自旋量子自旋霍尔液体：父射影对称群分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The square-hexagon-dodecagon (SHD) lattice hosts an exactly solvable Kitaev spin liquid, while further-neighbor couplings frustrate its Heisenberg magnet into classically degenerate lines where quantum fluctuations can melt the Néel order. To place this state among the lattice's spin liquids, we classify fermionic parton mean-field states with singlet and spin-orbit-coupled triplet amplitudes by their projective symmetry groups (PSGs). As SHD sites lack site symmetry, its Z₂ PSGs are the projective classes of p6mm with time reversal, from which those of every single-orbit p6mm lattice follow. In the idealized Kitaev model, where lattice operations do not rotate spins, these liquids carry a single Z₂ PSG descending from the SU(2) Lieb-flux state, and their projections are exact eigenstates. The PSG's sixfold-rotation sign, fixed by the dodecagon flux, doubles all Majorana bands, and the mirrors exclude a chiral phase in any uniform field, so only a sublattice-staggered three-spin term drives the non-Abelian Ising phase. Beyond the Kitaev state, we find a critical semi-Dirac spin liquid, with mean-field correlations propto r⁻³ along three directions and r⁻⁶ otherwise, and extended Dirac phases with up to 48 fermion flavors, among them an N_f=12 state whose PSG forbids every singlet mass. Out-of-plane Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya couplings gap the Dirac states of its U(1) class into a mean-field spinon counterpart of the Kane-Mele quantum spin Hall insulator, with spin Chern number 1 or 3 and spin-carrying monopoles. Chiral states imply Kalmeyer-Laughlin, semion×semion, and three-fermion orders, rotation-breaking ones show q→ -q asymmetric neutron spectra, and sign-alternating fluxes break time reversal alone. Masses and monopoles in these many-flavor phases and the energetics of frustrated SHD Heisenberg models are natural next steps.
articles.abstract_zh: 方形六边形十二边形（SHD）晶格拥有完全可解的基塔耶夫自旋液体，而更邻近的耦合将其海森堡磁体抑制成经典简并线，其中量子涨落可以熔化尼尔级。为了将该状态置于晶格的自旋液体中，我们根据射影对称群（PSG）对具有单重态和自旋轨道耦合三重态振幅的费米子部分子平均场态进行分类。由于SHD位点缺乏位点对称性，其Z2 PSG是具有时间反转的p6mm的投影类，每个单轨道p6mm晶格的投影类都遵循该类。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 方形六边形十二边形（SHD）晶格拥有完全可解的基塔耶夫自旋液体，而更邻近的耦合将其海森堡磁体抑制成经典简并线，其中量子涨落可以熔化尼尔级。为了将该状态置于晶格的自旋液体中，我们根据射影对称群（PSG）对具有单重态和自旋轨道耦合三重态振幅的费米子部分子平均场态进行分类。由于SHD位点缺乏位点对称性，其Z2 PSG是具有时间反转的p6mm的投影类，每个单轨道p6mm晶格的投影类都遵循该类。在理想化的 Kitaev 模型中，晶格运算不会旋转自旋，这些液体携带从 SU(2) Lieb 通量态下降的单个 Z2 PSG，并且它们的投影是精确的本征态。 PSG 的六重旋转符号由十二边形通量固定，使所有马约拉纳能带加倍，并且镜子排除了任何均匀场中的手征相，因此只有亚晶格交错的三自旋项驱动非阿贝尔伊辛相。除了基塔耶夫态之外，我们还发现了一种临界的半狄拉克自旋液体，其平均场相关性沿三个方向为 r⁻3，否则为 r⁻⁶，并且具有多达 48 种费米子风味的扩展狄拉克相，其中 N_f=12 态的 PSG 禁止每个单重态质量。面外 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 耦合将其 U(1) 类的狄拉克态间隙为 Kane-Mele 量子自旋霍尔绝缘体的平均场自旋子对应物，具有自旋陈数 1 或 3 和自旋承载单极子。手性态意味着卡尔迈耶-劳克林、半子×半子和三费米子级，旋转破坏态显示 q→ -q 不对称中子谱，而符号交替通量仅破坏时间反转。这些多风味相中的质量和单极子以及受挫的 SHD 海森堡模型的能量学是自然的下一步。

articles.title: Transport Signatures of a Kinetically Self-Trapped Nagaoka Polaron
articles.title_zh: 动力学自陷长冈极化子的输运特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nagaoka polarons are canonical examples of kinetic magnetism. Although their spin structure is well understood, their transport remains unexplored. We compute the dynamical mobility of a single hole in the square-lattice t-model using resummation-based quantum Monte Carlo and analytic continuation. Upon cooling, an incoherent Drude-like response gives way to a finite-frequency peak as the dc mobility vanishes. The peak signals an internal mode of a hole confined by its ferromagnetic cloud. Our results establish transport as an incisive probe of polaron formation and kinetic self-trapping.
articles.abstract_zh: 长冈极化子是动磁的典型例子。尽管它们的自旋结构已被充分了解，但它们的传输仍未被探索。我们使用基于恢复的量子蒙特卡罗和解析延拓计算方格 t 模型中单孔的动态迁移率。冷却后，随着直流迁移率消失，不相干的德鲁德式响应让位于有限频率峰值。该峰值表示受铁磁云限制的空穴的内部模式。我们的结果将传输确立为极化子形成和动力学自捕获的尖锐探针。

articles.title: Nonergodicity from Hilbert-Subspace Cloning
articles.title_zh: 希尔伯特子空间克隆的非遍历性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify a class of nonintegrable quantum many-body systems composed of single Pauli strings that possess an extensive number of noncommuting local conserved quantities and exhibit partial ergodicity breaking due to exponentially degenerate energy spectra. We show that such systems exhibit a novel mechanism, Hilbert-subspace cloning, where the identical chaotic Hamiltonian acts on each of exponentially many disconnected Hilbert subspaces. Although the dynamics within each clone thermalizes, quantum coherence between clones remains protected and detectable by local observables. Consequently, the long-time behavior of local observables is described by a coherence-preserving partial Gibbs ensemble, where the hidden subsystem retains its initial quantum coherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们确定了一类由单个泡利弦组成的不可积量子多体系统，该系统拥有大量非交换局部守恒量，并由于指数简并能谱而表现出部分遍历性破坏。我们证明，此类系统表现出一种新颖的机制，即希尔伯特子空间克隆，其中相同的混沌哈密顿量作用于指数级多个不连通的希尔伯特子空间中的每一个。尽管每个克隆内的动力学都会热化，但克隆之间的量子相干性仍然受到保护，并且可以通过局部可观测值检测到。因此，局部可观测量的长期行为由保持相干性的部分吉布斯系综来描述，其中隐藏子系统保留其初始量子相干性。

articles.title: Field-induced incommensurate--commensurate transitions in anisotropic magnets
articles.title_zh: 各向异性磁体中场致不相称-相称转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study field-induced incommensurate--commensurate transitions (ICTs) in classical spin chains with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) D, strong easy-plane anisotropy, and weak easy-axis anisotropy A within the easy plane. This model describes systems with ferromagnetic layers coupled by exchange interaction with DMI. The magnetic field bf H is applied in the easy plane at an arbitrary angle δ to the easy axis stabilizing a soliton lattice in the ground state. We consider ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic in-chain exchange interactions within the continuum limit and show that the easy-axis anisotropy leads to qualitatively different effects in these two cases: the ferromagnetic chain is described by a double-sine-Gordon-type equation with phase-shifted harmonics, whereas the antiferromagnetic chain reduces to a sine-Gordon equation. For the latter case, phase boundaries between incommensurate and commensurate states are found analytically in (H,A,D,δ) space and confirmed by numerical calculations for certain D and δ values. Close to all ICTs, results of the continuum consideration become invalid due to a stochastic destruction of near-separatrix solutions which either make an ICT a first-order transition or stabilize states with spatially irregular soliton and antisoliton arrangements.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究经典自旋链中场诱导的不公度-公度跃迁 (ICT)，其中包括 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) D、易平面内的强易平面各向异性和弱易轴各向异性 A。该模型描述了具有通过与 DMI 交换相互作用耦合的铁磁层的系统。磁场 bf H 以与易轴成任意角度 δ 的方式施加在易平面上，从而使孤子晶格稳定在基态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究经典自旋链中场诱导的不公度-公度跃迁 (ICT)，其中包括 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI) D、易平面内的强易平面各向异性和弱易轴各向异性 A。该模型描述了具有通过与 DMI 交换相互作用耦合的铁磁层的系统。磁场 bf H 以与易轴成任意角度 δ 的方式施加在易平面上，从而使孤子晶格稳定在基态。我们考虑连续体极限内的铁磁和反铁磁链内交换相互作用，并表明易轴各向异性在这两种情况下会导致性质不同的效应：铁磁链由具有相移谐波的双正弦戈登型方程描述，而反铁磁链则简化为正弦戈登方程。对于后一种情况，在 (H,A,D,δ) 空间中分析地找到不相称状态和相称状态之间的相边界，并通过某些 D 和 δ 值的数值计算来确认。接近所有 ICT，连续统考虑的结果由于近分离线解的随机破坏而变得无效，这使得 ICT 成为一阶跃迁或稳定具有空间不规则孤子和反孤子排列的状态。

articles.title: Light-induced local control of magnetic anisotropy and domain pattern in Co/Pt multilayers
articles.title_zh: Co/Pt 多层膜中磁各向异性和磁畴图案的光致局部控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Control of magnetic anisotropy is essential for the fabrication of next-generation devices in spintronics and magnetic memory. While conventional approaches such as material composition, thermal annealing, and ion bombardment are widely used, achieving spatially resolved, continuous control remains a challenge. Herein, we demonstrate a dual-regime, localized control over both transient magnetic states and permanent intrinsic properties in perpendicularly magnetized Co/Pt multilayers using ultra-short laser pulses. By employing a multi-scale approach combining Kerr microscopy, magnetic force microscopy, and vibrating sample magnetometry, we reveal that low-fluence irradiation enables a reversible, helicity-dependent accumulation of magnetic phases without altering the intrinsic quasistatic properties. Conversely, high-fluence exposure acts as localized thermal annealing that permanently hardens the magnetic system. This structural relaxation leads to a substantial enhancement of the effective perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, driving a twofold increase in the local coercive field and expanding the equilibrium stripe domain width. By offering both reversible spin manipulation and deterministic engineering of 2D magnetic landscapes, this work paves the way towards flexible, lithography-free anisotropy structuring for advanced spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁各向异性的控制对于自旋电子学和磁存储器中下一代器件的制造至关重要。虽然材料成分、热退火和离子轰击等传统方法被广泛使用，但实现空间分辨、连续控制仍然是一个挑战。在此，我们展示了使用超短激光脉冲对垂直磁化 Co/Pt 多层膜中的瞬态磁态和永久本征特性进行双态局部控制。通过采用结合克尔显微镜、磁力显微镜和振动样品磁力测量的多尺度方法，我们揭示了低通量照射能够实现可逆的、螺旋性相关的磁相积累，而不会改变固有的准静态特性。相反，高通量暴露起到局部热退火的作用，使磁系统永久硬化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁各向异性的控制对于自旋电子学和磁存储器中下一代器件的制造至关重要。虽然材料成分、热退火和离子轰击等传统方法被广泛使用，但实现空间分辨、连续控制仍然是一个挑战。在此，我们展示了使用超短激光脉冲对垂直磁化 Co/Pt 多层膜中的瞬态磁态和永久本征特性进行双态局部控制。通过采用结合克尔显微镜、磁力显微镜和振动样品磁力测量的多尺度方法，我们揭示了低通量照射能够实现可逆的、螺旋性相关的磁相积累，而不会改变固有的准静态特性。相反，高通量暴露起到局部热退火的作用，使磁系统永久硬化。这种结构弛豫导致有效垂直磁各向异性的显着增强，推动局部矫顽场增加两倍并扩大平衡带域宽度。通过提供二维磁景观的可逆自旋操纵和确定性工程，这项工作为先进自旋电子应用的灵活、无光刻的各向异性结构铺平了道路。

articles.title: Confinement-induced toughening in delignified wood-polyacrylamide composite hydrogels
articles.title_zh: 脱木质素木材-聚丙烯酰胺复合水凝胶中的约束诱导增韧
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23147v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With growing interest in environmental conservation, polymer composites incorporating wood-derived materials have attracted significant attention. While research has focused extensively on hard composites utilizing delignified wood or cellulose nanofibers (CNF) and soft composites reinforced with CNF, there have been a limited number of studies on the development of soft composites that utilize the porous cellular structure of wood, with few exceptions. In this study, we fabricated soft composites by infiltrating delignified wood with polyacrylamide hydrogel and subjected them to uniaxial compression tests. The results demonstrated that these materials exhibited far superior strength and toughness compared to either delignified wood or polyacrylamide hydrogel alone. Through systematic investigation and theoretical analysis, we identified the mechanisms underlying these enhancements in strength and toughness. Specifically, in addition to the sacrificial bond breakage known to enhance toughness in double-network hydrogels, we propose that mechanical confinement, arising from the soft, incompressible hydrogel filling the hollow cell lumens, generates excess stress and acts to resist compressive deformation. This approach, which utilizes the cellular structure as a filler, suggests the potential for creating a new class of high-toughness composite materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着人们对环境保护的兴趣日益浓厚，采用木材衍生材料的聚合物复合材料引起了人们的广泛关注。虽然研究广泛集中在利用脱木质素木材或纤维素纳米纤维 (CNF) 的硬质复合材料和用 CNF 增强的软质复合材料上，但除了少数例外，关于开发利用木材多孔细胞结构的软质复合材料的研究数量有限。在这项研究中，我们通过用聚丙烯酰胺水凝胶渗透脱木素木材来制造软复合材料，并对其进行单轴压缩测试。结果表明，与单独的脱木质素木材或聚丙烯酰胺水凝胶相比，这些材料表现出远远优越的强度和韧性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着人们对环境保护的兴趣日益浓厚，采用木材衍生材料的聚合物复合材料引起了人们的广泛关注。虽然研究广泛集中在利用脱木质素木材或纤维素纳米纤维 (CNF) 的硬质复合材料和用 CNF 增强的软质复合材料上，但除了少数例外，关于开发利用木材多孔细胞结构的软质复合材料的研究数量有限。在这项研究中，我们通过用聚丙烯酰胺水凝胶渗透脱木素木材来制造软复合材料，并对其进行单轴压缩测试。结果表明，与单独的脱木质素木材或聚丙烯酰胺水凝胶相比，这些材料表现出远远优越的强度和韧性。通过系统研究和理论分析，我们确定了强度和韧性增强的机制。具体来说，除了已知的牺牲键断裂可以增强双网络水凝胶的韧性之外，我们还提出，填充空心细胞腔的柔软、不可压缩的水凝胶产生的机械限制会产生过量的应力并起到抵抗压缩变形的作用。这种利用多孔结构作为填料的方法表明了创造新型高韧性复合材料的潜力。

articles.title: Non-Adiabatic Spin-Induced Currents in Magnetic Weyl Semimetals
articles.title_zh: 磁性韦尔半金属中的非绝热自旋感应电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically study dc electric currents induced by rapid spin precession in noncentrosymmetric magnetic Weyl semimetals using the Floquet--Keldysh Green's-function formalism. The spin dynamics act as a time-dependent chiral gauge field and the geometric structure of electric currents is expressed in terms of the Berry curvature, the quantum metric, and the shift vector. For an isotropic Weyl cone, only an injection current is generated. This current scales quadratically with the driving frequency and linearly with the relaxation time associated with coupling to a fermionic bath. We further show that a finite Weyl-cone tilt modifies the available interband-transition phase space, smooths the frequency dependence of the current, and allows for a shift current and another type of injection current, both of which flow in directions determined by the tilt and the direction of the precession. A finite net current can remain after summing contributions from Weyl nodes of opposite chiralities when their transition phase spaces are inequivalent.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用 Floquet--Keldysh Green 函数形式从理论上研究了非中心对称磁性 Weyl 半金属中快速自旋进动引起的直流电流。自旋动力学充当与时间相关的手性规范场，电流的几何结构用贝里曲率、量子度量和位移矢量表示。对于各向同性韦尔锥，仅产生注入电流。该电流与驱动频率成二次方关系，并与与费米子浴耦合相关的弛豫时间成线性关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用 Floquet--Keldysh Green 函数形式从理论上研究了非中心对称磁性 Weyl 半金属中快速自旋进动引起的直流电流。自旋动力学充当与时间相关的手性规范场，电流的几何结构用贝里曲率、量子度量和位移矢量表示。对于各向同性韦尔锥，仅产生注入电流。该电流与驱动频率成二次方关系，并与与费米子浴耦合相关的弛豫时间成线性关系。我们进一步表明，有限的外尔锥倾斜修改了可用的带间跃迁相空间，平滑了电流的频率依赖性，并允许移动电流和另一种类型的注入电流，这两种电流都沿由倾斜和进动方向确定的方向流动。当过渡相空间不等时，对具有相反手性的 Weyl 节点的贡献进行求和后，可以保留有限的净电流。

articles.title: Equal-spin pairing at finite Cooper-pair momentum in p-wave magnets
articles.title_zh: p波磁体中有限库珀对动量下的等自旋配对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The realization of Fulde-Ferrell (FF) superconducting states has long been pursued but remains challenging because of the large Zeeman splitting required. Here, we demonstrate that p-wave magnets can host equal-spin finite-pair-momentum states with p-wave symmetry, termed FF states, at arbitrarily weak fields. Our Bogoliubov-de Gennes analysis shows that, owing to the displacement of the Fermi surface, two equal-spin electrons in the FF states pair at the same energy, just as in the opposite-spin zero-pair-momentum states of the same gap symmetry. At zero field, the FF states are therefore exactly degenerate with these zero-pair-momentum counterparts. An arbitrarily weak Zeeman field lifts this degeneracy and makes the FF states the superconducting ground state, since they remain stable owing to their equal-spin nature, whereas their counterparts are suppressed by the formation of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. These findings identify the fermiology of p-wave magnets as a promising route toward long-sought finite-momentum superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 长期以来，人们一直在追求富尔德-费雷尔（FF）超导态的实现，但由于需要大量的塞曼分裂，因此仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明 p 波磁体可以在任意弱场下具有具有 p 波对称性的等自旋有限对动量态，称为 FF 态。我们的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 分析表明，由于费米面的位移，FF 态中的两个等自旋电子以相同的能量配对，就像在相同能隙对称性的相反自旋零对动量态中一样。因此，在零场处，FF 态与这些零对动量对应物完全简并。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长期以来，人们一直在追求富尔德-费雷尔（FF）超导态的实现，但由于需要大量的塞曼分裂，因此仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明 p 波磁体可以在任意弱场下具有具有 p 波对称性的等自旋有限对动量态，称为 FF 态。我们的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 分析表明，由于费米面的位移，FF 态中的两个等自旋电子以相同的能量配对，就像在相同能隙对称性的相反自旋零对动量态中一样。因此，在零场处，FF 态与这些零对动量对应物完全简并。任意弱的塞曼场会解除这种简并性，并使 FF 态成为超导基态，因为它们由于其等自旋性质而保持稳定，而它们的对应物则受到 Bogoliubov 费米面的形成的抑制。这些发现表明，p 波磁体的费米学是实现长期寻求的有限动量超导性的一条有希望的途径。

articles.title: The effect of oxygen on the surface tension of AlTi metallic alloys
articles.title_zh: 氧对AlTi金属合金表面张力的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of AlTi metallic alloy melts, with a specific focus on surface properties and the effect of oxygen. The simulations use a machine-learned inter- action potential (MLIP) that has recently been tested through experimental data for the statical and dynamical properties of AlTi melts in the bulk [Kato et al. (2026)]. We find that the surface- tension response to oxygen depends strongly on the AlTi composition. Element-resolved density profiles show that oxygen enrichment near the interface is accompanied by a suppression of the Al surface segregation observed in the oxygen-free liquid. The results are compared to experimental values obtained using levitation techniques in microgravity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对 AlTi 金属合金熔体进行分子动力学 (MD) 模拟，特别关注表面特性和氧的影响。模拟使用机器学习的相互作用势（MLIP），最近通过实验数据测试了大块 AlTi 熔体的静态和动态特性 [Kato 等人，2017]。 （2026）]。我们发现，表面张力对氧的响应很大程度上取决于 AlTi 的成分。元素分辨密度分布表明，界面附近的氧富集伴随着无氧液体中观察到的铝表面偏析的抑制。将结果与在微重力下使用悬浮技术获得的实验值进行比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对 AlTi 金属合金熔体进行分子动力学 (MD) 模拟，特别关注表面特性和氧的影响。模拟使用机器学习的相互作用势（MLIP），最近通过实验数据测试了大块 AlTi 熔体的静态和动态特性 [Kato 等人，2017]。 （2026）]。我们发现，表面张力对氧的响应很大程度上取决于 AlTi 的成分。元素分辨密度分布表明，界面附近的氧富集伴随着无氧液体中观察到的铝表面偏析的抑制。将结果与在微重力下使用悬浮技术获得的实验值进行比较。

articles.title: Termination-dependent surface Fermiology in the intercalated altermagnet CoNb₄Se₈
articles.title_zh: 插层交流磁体 CoNb₄Se₈ 中终止相关的表面费米学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets have recently gained attention for hosting symmetry-enforced spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. Angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES) offers direct access to their electronic structure. However, the intrinsic surface sensitivity of this technique complicates the identification of the observed features: Surface states can be misinterpreted as the spin-split counterpart of bulk bands. This issue becomes particularly relevant for layered intercalated systems, where micrometer-sized domains with distinct terminations often coexist on a cleaved surface. We discuss this scenario for CoNb₄Se₈, one of the first established layered altermagnets. Supported by density functional theory calculations, we employ micro-ARPES to probe individual domains and reveal two contrasting surface terminations. We identify Co- and Se-terminated domains with characteristic surface states arising from bulk-surface connectivity of the material. Our work shows that termination-dependent surface contributions are essential for the reliable spectroscopic identification of altermagnetism and for assessing its presence across the family of layered materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交变磁体最近仍因其具有对称性强制自旋分裂能带而受到关注。角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）可以直接了解它们的电子结构。然而，该技术固有的表面敏感性使观察到的特征的识别变得复杂：表面态可能被误解为体带的自旋分裂对应物。这个问题对于层状插层系统尤其重要，其中具有不同终端的微米大小的域通常共存于劈裂表面上。我们讨论 CoNb₄Se₈ 的这种情况，CoNb₄Se₈ 是最早建立的层状交流磁体之一。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交变磁体最近仍因其具有对称性强制自旋分裂能带而受到关注。角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）可以直接了解它们的电子结构。然而，该技术固有的表面敏感性使观察到的特征的识别变得复杂：表面态可能被误解为体带的自旋分裂对应物。这个问题对于层状插层系统尤其重要，其中具有不同终端的微米大小的域通常共存于劈裂表面上。我们讨论 CoNb₄Se₈ 的这种情况，CoNb₄Se₈ 是最早建立的层状交流磁体之一。在密度泛函理论计算的支持下，我们采用微型 ARPES 来探测各个域并揭示两个对比的表面终端。我们通过材料的体表面连接性来识别具有特征表面状态的 Co 和 Se 封端域。我们的工作表明，终止相关的表面贡献对于可靠的交变磁性光谱识别以及评估其在层状材料家族中的存在至关重要。

articles.title: Stability and Nonlinear Dynamics of Field-Driven Extended Domain Walls with Interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的场驱动扩展畴壁的稳定性和非线性动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analyze the stability and non-linear dynamics of extended domain walls (DWs) with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) driven by an external magnetic field in the clean limit (i.e., in the absence of disorder and thermal fluctuations). We show that for moderate DMI strengths, the dynamics in both the low- and high-field regimes are accurately described by a rigid-wall Walker model that neglects flexural degrees of freedom. At intermediate fields, however, the system undergoes a transition into a non-trivial spatio-temporally chaotic regime characterized by dynamically roughened domain walls displaying single- or multi-valued profiles.
