Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent KD of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.

articles.title: Structural and Representational Agency in LLM-Driven Timbre Generation and Interpolation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12532v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative creative interfaces routinely report the user's position within a space of possibilities. Such displays imply that the quantities shown were measured from the artefact; in a growing class of systems they are instead predicted by a language model describing its own output, and the two are indistinguishable on screen. Most creative domains lack an agreed measurement against which such a self-report can be checked; audio admits one. In a measurement study of a working LLM-driven timbre interface, what a user can cause proves separable from what the interface reports. The first is exactly characterisable: the reachable set is a zonotope whose dimension increases by one per sound placed, so the space the model may act within is demonstrably the user's own. The second is inaccurate. The displayed position differs from measurement by approximately three times the width of that region, and the error has two independent sources: model-predicted coordinates, whose accuracy varies twofold between the two models evaluated, and the interpolation step, which arises from combining synthesiser parameters and is unaffected by model quality. End to end, 26 of 36 refinement instructions produced no perceptible change, and under the weaker model the facility performed no action while reporting convergence. Effective agency (what a user can cause) and epistemic agency (whether they can know it) are therefore separable and independently engineered: structurally enforced constraints survive model failure, whereas guarantees resting on the model's own report do not. The failure mode that remains is silence presented as success. We close with a short protocol for building and auditing such displays.

articles.title: Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12542v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. All arms receive an identical budget - the same number of candidate schedules built and evaluated: an MCTS scheduling method, preregistered as the main arm; a randomized-restart list scheduler with no search tree as the control; and a textbook-UCT MCTS arm as a registered follow-up on the same domain. The analysis plan was locked before data collection; an independent checker confirmed all 768 confirmation-stage schedules valid with correct finish times. At the main budget of 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than the restarts (95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]; the 72 of 96 held-out instances with positive baseline-relative headroom). The deficit is not budget starvation: on the separate exploration pool restarts self-improve by 1.85% where MCTS gains 0.24%, and 700 of 720 of MCTS's first results are merely the warm start it was handed. The studied selection rule locks deterministically onto the first-expanded child, keeping its trials correlated while restarts draw gains from the tails; the causal link to makespan remains an inference. A structural map locates where the tree stops paying: restarts win on sparse irregular workflows, no difference is detectable on regular layered ones, and dense ones leave no room to improve. Swapping the rule for textbook UCT removes most of the deficit (-0.26%, 95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]) without reversing its sign. Results are confined to a controlled synthetic domain (N in 8,16,32 tasks, 2-8 processors, budgets up to 2048); we make no claim about larger budgets.

articles.title: A Distributional Framework for Behavioral Characterization and Risk Management of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12718v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models are stochastic by nature. Repeated executions under the same experimental conditions may produce different responses. We propose a framework that can be applied across the model lifecycle, from task design to residual behavior and continuous monitoring. The method consists of building an empirical response distribution estimated through Monte Carlo simulation. Semantic interventions are introduced to study how these distributions change. We illustrate the framework with two different tasks, borrower classification and music album recommendation, and quantify the resulting distributional changes. The framework is linked to model risk management and governance by measuring robustness and control effectiveness, and characterizing residual behavior. Since it relies only on observed responses, it can also be applied to black-box models accessed through commercial APIs.

articles.title: Constrained Probabilistic Numerics: Gaussian Process Solvers for Linear PDEs under Linear Inequality Constraints
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gaussian process solvers for linear partial differential equations (PDEs) return posteriors rather than point estimates, but they condition only on equality information: the PDE residual, boundary data, and measurements. Many solutions of interest also obey inequality constraints, including nonnegativity, monotonicity, and absence of arbitrage, which equality conditioning cannot enforce. We prove that conditioning a Gaussian process prior jointly on linear equality observations and a finite-dimensional inequality event is equivalent to conditioning sequentially in terms of Borel measures on the solution space. The physics-informed posterior is therefore a valid prior for the inequality update at virtual points. The combined law is non-Gaussian yet computable through truncated-Gaussian moments, and neither the PDE conditioning nor the inequality update requires modification. We evaluated the construction on a Poisson benchmark, option-price surfaces, and air-quality fields. Under incomplete boundary data, a monotonicity constraint lowered the error of a two-dimensional Poisson reconstruction by 63%. On a real S&P 500 option chain thinned to 20 retained quotes, no-arbitrage constraints reduced held-out extrapolation error by 22% and cut the calendar-arbitrage rate from 10% to 1%. On four real air-quality snapshots, nonnegativity reduced a Gaussian moment-based sub-zero-tail proxy by 74% at the sparsest monitor count. Changes in mean accuracy and constraint diagnostics differed across data regimes. The probability of the noisy virtual constraint event under the equality posterior measures agreement with the specified bounds before the update. The construction turns admissibility from a post-processing step into conditioning information for probabilistic PDE solvers.

articles.title: Beyond Discrepancy: Oracle Drift in Nonstationary Weighted Risk Minimization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13598v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We analyze distributional drift in nonstationary weighted risk minimization by decomposing the excess risk into estimation, drift, and approximation components. The drift error is commonly bounded through discrepancy-type quantities that control changes of the risk over classes of predictors. We instead relate the drift error directly to the movement of the best predictor within the model class and analyze its behavior in parametrized regression models. Our analysis shows that discrepancy-type quantities can be overly conservative: unlike our oracle drift, they may scale at a larger order than the resulting excess-risk contribution and can respond to changes in the risk surface that do not affect the optimal predictor. For linear regression, we characterize this gap sharply and combine the resulting drift bounds with estimation guarantees. We further extend the analysis to nonparametric regression.

articles.title: Approximation of differential entropy in Bayesian optimal experimental design
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.00734v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bayesian optimal experimental design provides a principled framework for selecting experimental configurations that maximize obtained information. In this work, we consider settings where the likelihood entropy is independent of the design or can be evaluated explicitly, which applies, e.g. to additive noise models with design-independent or explicitly computable noise entropy. This reduces the problem to maximum entropy estimation, where the nested integral defining the expected information gain collapses into a single integral. Our study is motivated by large-scale inference problems, such as inverse problems, where the computational cost is dominated by expensive likelihood evaluations. Under additive Gaussian noise model, we propose a computational approach in which the evidence density is approximated by a Monte Carlo or quasi-Monte Carlo surrogate, while the differential entropy is evaluated using standard methods without additional likelihood evaluations. We prove that this strategy achieves convergence rates that are comparable to, or better than, state-of-the-art methods for full expected information gain estimation, particularly when the cost of entropy evaluation is negligible. Our approach relies only on mild smoothness of the forward map and avoids stronger technical assumptions required in earlier work. We also present numerical experiments, which confirm some of our theoretical findings.

articles.title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Finite-Beam Reachability and Continuous-Query Generation in Generative Recommendation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12977v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) of social media platforms commonly retrieves items by autoregressively decoding discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) with finite-width beam search. This work examines how this output interface constrains whether held-out targets enter finite returned lists, while distinguishing catalog-wide scoreability from empirical top-K support. We introduce two continuous-query paradigms: CQG-Single generates one retrieval query in a single pass, and CQG-AR autoregressively generates continuous residual updates, retaining step-wise decoding while removing the SID item-token vocabulary, code lookup, and discrete beam expansion. These designs thereby eliminate the SID-specific reachability constraint induced by finite-beam decoding and avoid the technical challenge of aligning a discrete SID vocabulary with the pretrained backbone's vector space. Both methods make every encoded item directly scoreable through dense or approximate-nearest-neighbor retrieval. Under a unified protocol with valid-prefix constrained decoding, CQG-Single exceeds the TIGER-style baseline in all seven runs while using 55.3% as many trainable parameters. CQG-AR remains comparable on ML-1M and is numerically stronger on Beauty and Sports datasets. A controlled depth ablation further shows that additional continuous refinement does not monotonically improve shallow accuracy. These findings motivate decoupling output representation, autoregressive modeling, and retrieval budget when evaluating generative recommendation systems.

articles.title: Webhell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Webhell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Webhell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Webhell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.

articles.title: MAGMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Embodied Agents under Dynamic Tasks and Execution Failures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13534v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon embodied agents must maintain task-relevant information, coordinate heterogeneous robots, and adapt their decisions as execution unfolds. Existing benchmarks investigate dynamic task execution and embodied multi-agent coordination, but provide limited evaluation of their intersection. We introduce MAGMA-Bench, an architecture-agnostic benchmark for persistent task reasoning in dynamic multi-robot environments. MAGMA-Bench evaluates agents across increasing task horizons and controlled online perturbations, including execution failures, task interruptions, and mission updates, with scenarios requiring coordination across robots with heterogeneous capabilities. It uses a structured skill-level interface to separate task-level reasoning from perception and low-level control. We evaluate locally deployable open-weight planners, multi-agent state-tracking strategies, and frontier models. Even the strongest evaluated models fail on a substantial fraction of clean episodes, and their success rates decrease further under online perturbations. Supervised adaptation greatly improves a small model, but performance remains substantially lower on longer and multi-robot missions. We release the benchmark, 261,646 task-level training examples, and an architecture-agnostic expert-trace generation pipeline.

articles.title: Localized Generative Design of Ship Hulls with Diffusion Models and High-Fidelity Assessment
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12870v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Practical ship design requires localized refinement and performance evaluation. This paper presents a reward-directed diffusion framework for localized hull optimization. Parametric masking during dataset generation restricts geometric changes to selected variables, including the bulbous bow and forebody, while preserving full-hull continuity. Surrogate-assisted sequential Monte Carlo sampling targets reduced predicted calm-water resistance, with stability retained through training data and displacement matched during screening. An automated viscous free-surface CFD pipeline, validated against measurements for two benchmark container ships, evaluates a generated variant and GenHull E, a hull refined by a naval architect within the same representation. At matched KRISO Container Ship (KCS) displacement, the generated variant has comparable total resistance at Fₙ=0.195 but 45-50% higher resistance at Fₙ=0.250 and 0.260, missed by empirical screening. GenHull E achieves 6-8% lower total resistance up to Fₙ=0.240 but higher resistance above Fₙ=0.250 as opposing friction and pressure trends reverse the gains. Aggregating resistance across this crossover can conceal tradeoffs that emerge when friction and pressure components are evaluated separately. The assessment reveals an inability to represent a faired bulbous bow and a reward lacking viscous pressure and stability terms. These findings show how high-fidelity assessment informs improved representations and objectives for physically realizable generative designs.

articles.title: Mid-to-Late Holocene Hydroenvironmental Constraints on Human Adaptation at Fenghuangzui Site, Hanjiang River Basin, Central China
articles.abstract: Human responses to hydroclimatic variability are difficult to resolve where natural and anthropogenic sedimentary archives are conflated. We integrate OSL-constrained sedimentological and geochemical records from a natural palaeochannel adjacent to the Fenghuangzui site with moat sediments, archaeological evidence, regional pollen records and site distributions. The palaeochannel records progressive shallowing during 5.3–4.2 ka BP, renewed ponding around 4.2–3.9 ka BP and subsequent low-energy infilling with episodic sediment inputs. These hydrological changes were not synchronous with subsistence decline: rice-based production persisted as communities modified drainage, occupation surfaces and settlement organisation. Comparison of natural and engineered water bodies indicates that local water management mediated, rather than simply tracked, regional hydroclimatic change. Fenghuangzui therefore provides evidence for flexible adaptation within a long-lived ecological and cultural interface linking the middle Yangtze and Central Plains.

articles.title: Centrosymmetric imidazolium hydrogen squarate structure: Catalytic properties, chemical reactivity and electronic structure
articles.abstract: The catalytic performance, chemical reactivity and electronic structure of the centrosymmetric ion pair imidazolium hydrogen squarate ([C3H5N2]+[C4O4H]–) were investigated experimentally and theoretically in this paper for the first time. This comprehensive evaluation was carried out using Hammett acidity (H₀) measurements, MEP analysis, FMO theory, Fukui function and NPA analysis. DFT calculations were performed at the B3LYP/6-311 + + G(2d,2p) level of theory. The catalytic activity of [C3H5N2]+[C4O4H]– was assessed in the butyl acetate synthesis. The reaction kinetics, thermodynamic parameters, as well as the effects of reaction temperature (60–80°C) and catalyst content (5–12 wt%) were methodically inspected. Intrinsic reaction coordinate (IRC) calculations were made and a catalytic cycle for butyl acetate synthesis was proposed. The nucleophilic and electrophilic reactivity of [C3H5N2]+[C4O4H]– is associated with the cation and anion, respectively. The positively charged site within the [C3H5N2]+ was denoted the compound's Brønsted acidity (H₀ = 1.909). Moieties in the hydrogen squarate anion were found to govern the catalytic performance of the ion pair [C3H5N2]+[C4O4H]– in butyl acetate synthesis. The reaction proceeded through the formation of an activated complex, as confirmed by the IRC calculations.

articles.title: First-Principles Calculation of FE1-X SX Liquid Alloys at Conditions of Earth’s Outer Core
articles.abstract: The composition and properties of the Earth's terrestrial outer core cannot be directly probed, however, indirect information of density and sound velocity from seismic measurements of the outer core, suggests that liquid iron is the most abundant element, alloyed with other lighter elements. Among these elements, sulphur has been suggested to be present. In this study, we investigate the effects of sulphur on the dynamical and structural properties of liquid Fe-S alloys with varying S content under conditions similar to those of Earth's outer core, providing a systematic atomic-scale characterization including structural, diffusion, and thermodynamic properties that has been largely absent from previous AIMD studies of this system. We examine compositions ranging from 0 to 14.9 wt% S (0 to 23.4 at% S). Our results demonstrate that the compressional wave velocity increases with sulphur concentration and pressure, with pressure having a more pronounced effect. We find that both Fe and S have similar diffusion coefficients at all concentrations studied. Our findings suggest that a concentration of S ranging between 10.2 and 11.4 wt%S could account for the density of the Earth's core but not for its sound velocity. This discrepancy indicates that sulphur cannot be the only light element present in the Earth's core. This dataset constrains the density-velocity mismatch with a full P-T grid and provides a self-consistent binary reference for ongoing work on ternary Fe-S-X systems.

articles.title: High Pressure Die Casting (HPDC) with Laser Additively Manufactured (LAM) Lattice Inserts: An Exploratory Study on Densification and Interfacial Microstructure
articles.abstract: The integration of additively manufactured (AM) inserts into High-Pressure Die Casting (HPDC) has to date focused predominantly on tailored conformal cooling channels of molds, while the use of AM lattice structures as functional inserts within HPDC components has received comparatively little attention. Such hybrid-manufactured parts are attractive for applications requiring low density, lightweight design, and high specific strength combined with energy-absorption capability. However, achieving adequate infiltration and densification of the lattice insert, together with robust mechanical bonding at the interface between the AM printed lattice insert and the HPDC alloy, remains an open challenge. In this study, AM-fabricated 316L stainless steel lattice structures of body-centered cubic (BCC) and Kelvin cell topologies, with different strut thicknesses (0.6 and 1.2 mm), were embedded as inserts in HPDC components cast from EN AC-43500 aluminum alloy, with and without intensification pressure to assess its effect on infiltration and densification behavior. The interfacial microstructure between the two dissimilar materials was characterized along with microhardness measurement across the interface. The results indicate that intensification pressure promotes high densification in both BCC and Kelvin hybrid composites, even at long flow lengths. Good and defect-free mechanical bonding was observed at the steel/aluminum interface while Fe-rich intermetallic phase formation was suppressed owing to the rapid solidification of conditions of the HPDC process.

articles.title: Topological Origin of Neutrino Mass and Mixing: From the SU(3)₃ Modular Tensor Category to the PMNS Matrix
articles.abstract: We propose a topological origin for neutrino masses and mixing: neutrinos are boundary topological flows of a string-net condensed phase, and their mass matrix is determined by boundary dynamics that inherits the hierarchical parameters of the bulk (:SUleft(3right)₃otimes:SUleft(2right)₂) modular tensor category. Using the conformal-weight spacing (:Δ:ℎ=1/3) and the topological temperature (:β:=π:²/14) of this category, we read the Cabibbo angle (:λ:=e⁻¹⁴/left⁽³π:rⁱght⁾approx:0.225), without any free parameters, in agreement with the experimental value to within 0.04%. On this basis, we propose a mass matrix whose coefficients are mapped directly to the S-matrix elements of the (:SUleft(3right)₃) modular tensor category, with diagonalization yielding mixing angles close to the experimental values. Further introducing the CP phase (:ϵ:=λ:²) arising from the quadratic effect of topological suppression, and reading the charged-lepton mixing parameters (α, β, γ) from the quantum-dimension ratios and conformal weights of the category, we can simultaneously fit the four observables of NuFIT 6.0. The parameters (:α:=-3λ:/5), (:β:=-λ:²/2), and (:γ:=2λ:/3) are read from (:d₈/(d₈+d₃)=3/5), (:ℎ₈=1/2), and (:ℎ₁₅=2/3) respectively. The CP phase (:η:=π:/10:)has a proposed reading mechanism (:η:=π:/Nₛᵢₘₚₗₑ), pending confirmation; we have systematically excluded several possible algebraic origins (T-matrix phases, R-matrix phases, topological entropy change) and leave its full derivation as an open problem.

articles.title: From Shelfmark to Platform: Provenance, Description, and Digital Access to Jawi Manuscripts in European Repositories
articles.abstract: Jawi manuscripts produced across the Malay-Indonesian world now circulate through European archival infrastructures as physical holdings, catalogue records, digitised surrogates, exhibitions, and curatorial narratives. This article examines how those infrastructures mediate provenance, description, and access. Using a focused archival netnography, it analyses a purposive corpus of publicly accessible digital artefacts from the British Library, Cambridge University Library, Leiden University Libraries, and the Bibliothèque nationale de France, supplemented by verified scholarship on Malay manuscript collections and digital archives. The analysis identifies four recurring patterns: provenance is often institutionally legible but locally thin; Jawi is described through uneven combinations of language, script, genre, and colonial collecting history; digitisation expands discoverability without eliminating technical and interpretive barriers; and curatorial essays can partially restore historical relationships that catalogue fields compress or omit. The article argues that digitised Jawi manuscripts should be treated not only as textual surrogates but as archival interfaces in which custodial histories and descriptive choices are continuously remade. It proposes a reciprocal-description model that preserves legacy metadata while adding source-community terminology, acquisition histories, transliteration support, linked provenance, and multilingual contextual notes. The findings contribute to archival debates on digital access, provenance, descriptive positionality, and decolonial archival praxis while offering practical recommendations for repositories stewarding Southeast Asian manuscript heritage outside its regions of origin.

articles.title: A retroviral late-domain promotes cell-surface expression, extracellular vesicle formation, and immunogenicity of a trimeric HIV-1 Env antigen
articles.abstract: The immunogenicity of membrane-associated antigens can be enhanced by addition of cytoplasmic-tail elements that promote release of extracellular vesicles (EVs). Here we explore whether these elements enhance humoral responses to SOSIP-TM, a stabilized form of the HIV-1 envelope glycoprotein (Env). We compared modifications designed to promote EV release by engaging the cellular Endosomal Sorting Complex Required for Transport (ESCRT). These modifications include viral late domains and the previously described EPM-EABR, which combines an endocytosis prevention motif (EPM) with the ESCRT- and ALG-2-interacting protein X-binding region (EABR) of the cellular protein CEP55. We observed that p2, an 18 amino-acid ESCRT-associated feline immunodeficiency virus (FIV) late domain, promoted higher SOSIP-TM expression and a stronger total antibody response than other EV-enhancing modifications. p2 also elicited significantly higher neutralizing responses to a quaternary Env epitope than did EPM-EABR. FIV p2 thus promotes humoral responses to Env-based transmembrane antigens more effectively than other ESCRT-engaging elements.

articles.title: Morphogenesis of a stratified cell mound at a vortex defect
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 12 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03427-9 In cell monolayers with a vortex-like orientation defect, cells converge towards the core of the defect and form a highly organized three-dimensional mound. This mechanism may be relevant for morphogenesis and tumorigenesis.

articles.title: Chip-mediated manipulation of photonic quantum skyrmions
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 12 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03487-x Although photonic quantum skyrmions can be generated as entangled or single-photon states, a means to switch between the two is required for quantum information processing. Now, entangled skyrmions and their manipulation on chip is realized.

articles.title: Antiferromagnetism and tightly bound Cooper pairs induced by kinetic frustration
articles.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 42, October 2026. SignificanceAntiferromagnetism and superconductivity are often viewed as competing orders in doped Mott insulators. In this work, we identify kinetic frustration as a microscopic mechanism that instead promotes their coexistence in the square-lattice ...

articles.title: Structural and energetic signatures of SO 2 and CH 4 incorporation in imidazolium-based ionic liquids
articles.abstract: A systematic molecular dynamics study of sulfur dioxide (SO 2 ) and methane (CH 4 ) incorporation in 24 imidazolium-based ionic liquids is presented, spanning different anion families and cation alkyl chain lengths. The two gases represent limiting cases of solvation behavior in ionic liquids: SO 2 exhibits strong electrostatic interactions and Lewis amphoteric character, whereas CH 4 is governed primarily by weak London dispersion forces. Radial distribution functions, coordination numbers, cluster-size distributions, and interaction energies were analyzed to elucidate the molecular organization of the mixtures. The results show that neither SO 2 nor CH 4 substantially disrupts the polar network of the ionic liquids. SO 2 partitions between the polar and nonpolar regions of the ionic liquid, leading to reduced self-association and more gas distributions, whereas CH 4 preferentially occupies alkyl-rich regions and exhibits only weak self-association with minimal dependence on cation chain length. Interaction energy decomposition highlights the dominant role of electrostatics in SO 2 solvation and the free volume-driven, weakly interacting nature of CH 4 incorporation. These findings provide a molecular-level framework for rationalizing incorporation trends and for guiding the design of ionic liquids for gas separation, highlighting how polarity, anion charge distribution, and cation alkyl chain length can be tuned to enhance specific SO 2 stabilization while controlling nonspecific CH 4 accommodation in alkyl-rich free-volume domains.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Symmetry-driven correlation patterns in one-dimensional periodic fermionic systems: Closed-form expressions and exact selection rules for correlation functions, entanglement entropies, and mutual information
articles.abstract: We present an analytical study of the spatial structure of correlations in periodic fermionic systems at the single Slater determinant level, focusing on the cyclic case. Exploiting cyclic symmetry, the transformation from localized orbitals to molecular orbitals is simultaneously a discrete Fourier transform, a Vandermonde matrix on the roots of unity, a complex Hadamard matrix, and the character table of the cyclic group C m . Within this framework, the spatial structure of correlations is fully determined by the occupied irreducible representations (Fourier modes), independently of the specific Hamiltonian generating them. In particular, the fermionic two-point correlator is expressed as a truncated Fourier sum over the occupied orbitals, leading to exact analytical expressions for symmetric occupation patterns of Fourier modes ( ℓ and − ℓ pairs), corresponding in quantum chemistry to aromatic fillings, i.e., fillings satisfying Hückel’s 4 n + 2 rule. For the half filling case, we derive exact spatial selection rules. In particular, the two-point correlator vanishes identically for all even distances along the ring. This property propagates to reduced density matrices and implies a complete absence of mutual information between the corresponding orbitals. These results reveal that, despite the global delocalization of molecular orbitals, the correlation structure in cyclic systems is highly non-uniform and governed by symmetry-induced interference. Although formulated in terms of cyclic lattice systems, the present results extend straightforwardly to one-dimensional fermionic chains with periodic conditions, reflecting the underlying translational symmetry of the problem. The framework, therefore, provides a Hamiltonian-independent and universal reference for understanding correlation patterns in one-dimensional periodic fermionic systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Inclusion of three-body corrections in the relativistic equation-of-motion coupled cluster method: Application to electron detachment
articles.abstract: We present the formulation and implementation of a triples-correction scheme for relativistic equation-of-motion coupled-cluster calculations of ionization potentials. Both full and partial triples-correction schemes are implemented using the exact two-component atomic mean-field (X2CAMF) Hamiltonian in combination with Cholesky decomposition (CD) of two-electron integrals and a frozen natural spinor (FNS) truncation scheme to reduce computational cost. Benchmark calculations on halide anions, noble-gas atoms, hydrogen halides, and dihalogen molecules demonstrate the importance of triple excitations for the quantitative prediction of ionization potentials. The CCSD(T)(a)* scheme achieves a mean absolute error of ∼0.01 eV relative to full CCSDT for halide anions and noble-gas atoms and ∼0.08 eV relative to the experiment for dihalogen molecules. The X2CAMF approximation reproduces four-component Dirac–Coulomb results with negligible deviations, while the CD-FNS strategy substantially reduces the computational cost. The resulting partial triples-correction scheme scales as O(n7) with storage comparable to CCSD, providing an accurate and practical approach for relativistic ionization-energy calculations in heavy-element systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Topological control of local electroneutrality in confined electrolytes
articles.abstract: Topology governs finite-size violations of local electroneutrality in confined electrolytes. Within Poisson–Boltzmann theory, we show that this topological control gives rise to a universal hierarchy of deviations in spherical, cylindrical, and planar confinement. We quantify this effect through an electroneutrality deviation ratio that captures the global electrostatic constraints associated with compactness and boundary multiplicity in Ω sph ≃ S 2 × [0, δ ], Ωcyl≃S1×R×[0,δ], and Ωslit≃R2×[0,δ]. Although local electroneutrality is asymptotically restored in the limit of infinite cavity size, finite-size deviations follow a robust topological hierarchy, being strongest in spherical cavities, weaker in cylindrical confinement, and weakest in planar slits. These results prove that topology is the organizing principle underlying confinement-induced charge redistribution and violations of local electroneutrality constitute a general electrostatic constraint governing overcharging, charge reversal, and long-range charge correlations. More fundamentally, they demonstrate that changing the topology modifies the global electrostatic constraints without altering the local Poisson–Boltzmann equations. As a counterintuitive manifestation of nonlinear confinement in a point-ion model, we report the existence of inside confinement charge reversal in charged hollow cylindrical and spherical nanoparticles. Since physically consistent, more general electrolyte theories must recover the Poisson–Boltzmann description in the appropriate limiting case, the present results establish a benchmark against which topological effects should be assessed beyond the Poisson–Boltzmann description.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Electronic spectroscopy of (N 2 O) n + ( n = 2–6): Competition between the charge resonance and charge transfer bands
articles.abstract: A hemibond (two-center three-electron bond), formed by a charge resonance interaction, is a characteristic structural motif in radical cation clusters. Hemibonded clusters exhibit strong absorption in the UV–visible region, which is attributed to the charge resonance (CR) transition and serves as a marker band for hemibond formation. Despite its significance, how microsolvation affects the CR transition of the hemibonded ion core remains unclear. In this study, we performed electronic spectroscopy for (N 2 O) n + ( n = 2–6) clusters containing the hemibonded (N 2 O) 2 + ion core to elucidate the microsolvation effect via clustering of N 2 O molecules. In the observed spectra, a charge transfer (CT) transition was detected in addition to the CR transition for n = 3. Our results reveal that the CR and CT transitions predominantly lead to the formation of N 2 O + and (N 2 O) 2 + fragments, respectively. As microsolvation proceeds, the CR band appears to exhibit a significant red shift. This is attributed to the contribution of the CT excitation to the N 2 O + fragment channel via the thermal dissociation pathway.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Gate-controlled optical bistability via tunable self-action feedback in a semiconductor quantum dot–graphene nanodisk hybrid
articles.abstract: We theoretically examine how electrostatic gating can tune the steady-state response of a semiconductor quantum dot (SQD)–graphene nanodisk hybrid between monostable and bistable regimes. The model combines the optical Bloch dynamics of a driven two-level SQD with a gate-dependent polarizability of the graphene nanodisk. Through this polarizability, the gate voltage controls the SQD self-action, represented by the complex feedback parameter G ( V g ) = G R ( V g ) + iG I ( V g ). The bistable response results from saturation of the SQD transition combined with graphene-mediated feedback. As V g is varied, G ( V g ) traces a trajectory in the complex feedback plane relative to the saddle-node boundary. Bistability occurs only along the part of this trajectory for which the steady-state input–output relation has two physical turning points. Within this segment, adiabatic sweeps of gate voltage or input intensity remain on a stable branch until a turning point is reached, giving a hysteresis loop. The stability of these branches is verified from the local Jacobian eigenvalues. The same turning-point criterion locates the gate–detuning domain for fixed-input branch switching and identifies the coupling–dephasing window in which the feedback trajectory can reach the bistable domain. These results identify gate-controlled complex self-action as the mechanism governing the opening and closing of the bistability window and the associated branch switching in the SQD–graphene nanodisk hybrid.

articles.title: Nonclassical condensation pathways revealed by the multivariable theory of nucleation
articles.abstract: Classical nucleation theory (CNT) provides a simple conceptual framework for nucleation but often fails to quantitatively reproduce experimental and numerical observations. In this work, we extend the theory by explicitly incorporating the multidimensional nature of nucleation and the coupled roles of kinetics and thermodynamics. Specifically, we treat the cluster density as an independent variable, within both sharp-interface and diffuse-interface descriptions. The kinetics are governed by dynamical density functional theory. Applied to liquid condensation in the Lennard-Jones system, our self-consistent, parameter-free two-variable (size–density) and three-variable (size–interface width–density) models reveal nonclassical nucleation mechanisms. At low supersaturation, both models recover the classical picture, in which clusters nucleate and grow at the equilibrium liquid density. As supersaturation increases, nonclassical behavior emerges: the critical cluster density decreases, and the nucleation pathway involves concomitant evolution in cluster size, density, and within the diffuse-interface description, interfacial width. Our diffuse-interface model reveals a rapid increase in interfacial diffuseness at high supersaturation. Near the spinodal limit, both models predict the critical cluster with diverging sizes, densities approaching that of the metastable initial phase, and vanishing work of formation, which provides a smooth connection between nucleation and spinodal decomposition. Comparison with molecular dynamics simulations demonstrates that both models substantially outperform CNT. However, the weak nonmonotonic dependence of the critical cluster density observed at very low supersaturation is captured only by diffuse-interface models. Overall, our findings indicate that CNT should be applied only in the low-supersaturation regime, and our work provides a robust foundation for its refinement beyond this limit.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: High-performance parallel implementation of spin-free high-order coupled-cluster theories
articles.abstract: High-order coupled-cluster theories with iterative triples (CCSDT), perturbative quadruples [CCSDT(Q)], and iterative quadruples (CCSDTQ) provide benchmark-quality correlation energies, but their steep computational scalings, O ( N 8 ), O ( N 9 ), and O ( N 10 ), together with the large memory requirements of high-order amplitude tensors, have historically limited their application to small molecules. In this work, we develop efficient open-source implementations of spin-restricted CCSDT (RCCSDT), RCCSDT(Q), and RCCSDTQ within the pyscf package and a Message Passing Interface (MPI)-based extension, distributed-cc . The shared-memory implementation combines compact triangular storage of the highest-order amplitude tensors with the multithreaded tensor contraction backend pytblis , enabling efficient use of modern many-core central processing unit (CPU) architectures. This design delivers near-ideal thread scaling up to 90 cores and achieves wall times shorter than or comparable to existing single-node implementations for representative benchmark molecules. We further extend RCCSDT, RCCSDT(Q), and RCCSDTQ to distributed-memory architectures using MPI-based algorithms. By distributing compact high-order amplitudes across MPI ranks and overlapping communication with computation through nonblocking data transfers, the distributed implementation achieves near-ideal strong scaling on up to 32 nodes, corresponding to ∼3000 CPU cores. These developments substantially extend the practical reach of canonical high-order coupled-cluster theory, enabling CCSDT and CCSDT(Q) calculations on systems with ∼100 correlated electrons in 450 orbitals and CCSDTQ calculations on systems with ∼50 correlated electrons in 115 orbitals. Applications to π -stacked noncovalent dimers, the CO dissociation energy of Cr(CO) 6 , and the Cope rearrangement of semibullvalene demonstrate that canonical high-order coupled-cluster benchmarks are now feasible for chemically realistic molecular systems.

articles.title_zh: 紫外激光脉冲选择性地设计金刚石缺陷，使量子比特完好无损
articles.abstract: When we think about a diamond, we often think about a material whose value comes from its perfection. In my research, however, I am interested in something almost opposite: the tiny imperfections inside diamonds. These atomic-scale defects can give diamonds new optical and electronic properties, and some of them can serve as quantum systems. The challenge is learning how to control these defects without disturbing the others.

articles.abstract: Every black hole hides a question at its center. Einstein's theory predicts that whatever falls in is crushed into a singularity, a point of infinite density where the theory itself breaks down. Most physicists expect quantum gravity to replace that point with something finite. But the center lies hidden behind the horizon. How could we ever learn what is there?

articles.title_zh: 部分可观测性和自适应干扰下认知无人机群的可解释的基于图的元强化学习
articles.abstract: Multi-agent deep reinforcement learning frameworks for cognitiveunmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms increasingly bundle graph coordination,meta-learning and explainability, yet it is rarely shown when that machineryactually helps. We present XM-MADRL, an explainable meta-learning graphframework for UAV swarms in contested electromagnetic environments, togetherwith a controlled study that isolates when its components pay off. Under fullobservability against a predictable jammer, coordination and meta-adaptationgive no measurable benefit: the framework merely ties a vanilla proximal policyoptimisation (PPO) baseline. Under partial observability against an adaptive,reactive jammer, the same framework is better on every spectrum metric, raisingpacket delivery ratio sixfold (16.8% versus 2.5%; Cohen's d of 4.45),anti-jamming from approximately 0% to 11.1%, and meansignal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio from ((-3.7)) to ((-1.3)) dB, allsignificant after Holm--Bonferroni correction (adjusted P below0.0001) over ten seeds. A recurrent control that adds memory but notcommunication fails as badly as PPO, and a component ablation shows the gain isnot due to graph message passing. Meta-learning improves zero-shotgeneralisation to unseen jammers (packet delivery 32.0% versus 4.2%).Coordination and meta-adaptation are conditional capabilities, not universalimprovements.
articles.abstract_zh: 用于认知无人机（UAV）群的多智能体深度强化学习框架越来越多地捆绑图协调、元学习和可解释性，但很少显示该机制何时真正有帮助。我们提出了 XM-MADRL，这是一种可解释的元学习图框架，适用于有争议的电磁环境中的无人机群，以及一项可隔离其组件何时发挥作用的对照研究。在针对可预测干扰的完全可观察性下，协调和元适应不会带来任何可衡量的好处：该框架仅与普通的近端策略优化（PPO）基线相关联。

articles.title: Bio-based benzoxazine electrically conductive adhesives for sustainable and epoxy-free hybrid printed electronics
articles.title_zh: 用于可持续、无环氧树脂混合印刷电子产品的生物基苯并恶嗪导电粘合剂
articles.abstract: Electrically conductive adhesives (ECAs) are critical for the assembly of surface-mounted devices in printed and hybrid electronics; however, conventional epoxy-based systems are associated with toxicity and limited working life. In this work, we present a benzoxazine-based anisotropic conductive adhesive (ACA) derived from a bio-based diphenolic acid benzoxazine (DPA-Bz) copolymerized with 1,12-diaminododecane (DIADO), combined with environmentally preferable metallic fillers. The developed system enables reduced curing temperatures (~ 150°C) compared to conventional benzoxazines, improving compatibility with temperature-sensitive substrates. From an electrical standpoint, the optimized Cu-based ACA exhibits low contact resistance and clear anisotropic conductivity with electrical performance comparable to a commercial epoxy-based adhesive. Furthermore, the ACA maintains stable electrical behavior under accelerated aging (85°C / 85% RH) and thermal shock testing, indicating robust reliability under environmental stress. Finally, life cycle assessment reveals a reduced global warming potential (5.48 kg CO₂/kg) compared to a reference Ni-based adhesive (6.27 kg CO₂/kg), with further reduction potential through solvent-free formulations and increased recycled copper content. The presented benzoxazine-based ACA achieves comparable electrical and mechanical performance to commercial systems while delivering improved environmental performance and reduced toxicity, highlighting its potential as a sustainable alternative for next-generation electronic assembly and opening the path towards greener electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 导电粘合剂 (ECA) 对于印刷和混合电子产品中表面安装器件的组装至关重要；然而，传统的环氧基系统具有毒性且使用寿命有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于苯并恶嗪的各向异性导电粘合剂（ACA），其源自生物基二酚酸苯并恶嗪（DPA-Bz）与1,12-二氨基十二烷（DIADO）的共聚，并结合了环保的金属填料。与传统的苯并恶嗪相比，开发的系统能够降低固化温度（~ 150°C），从而提高与温度敏感基材的相容性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 导电粘合剂 (ECA) 对于印刷和混合电子产品中表面安装器件的组装至关重要；然而，传统的环氧基系统具有毒性且使用寿命有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于苯并恶嗪的各向异性导电粘合剂（ACA），其源自生物基二酚酸苯并恶嗪（DPA-Bz）与1,12-二氨基十二烷（DIADO）的共聚，并结合了环保的金属填料。与传统的苯并恶嗪相比，开发的系统能够降低固化温度（~ 150°C），从而提高与温度敏感基材的相容性。从电气角度来看，优化的铜基 ACA 具有低接触电阻和明显的各向异性导电性，其电气性能可与商用环氧基粘合剂相媲美。此外，ACA 在加速老化（85°C / 85% RH）和热冲击测试下保持稳定的电气行为，表明在环境压力下具有强大的可靠性。最后，生命周期评估显示，与参考镍基粘合剂（6.27 千克二氧化碳/千克）相比，全球变暖潜力降低（5.48 千克二氧化碳/千克），并且通过无溶剂配方和增加回收铜含量进一步降低了减排潜力。所提出的基于苯并恶嗪的 ACA 实现了与商业系统相当的电气和机械性能，同时改善了环境性能并降低了毒性，凸显了其作为下一代电子组装的可持续替代品的潜力，并为绿色电子产品开辟了道路。

articles.title: Unsteady MHD flow of Heat generating / absorbing fluid through porous plate with variable temperature and concentration in a slip flow regime
articles.title_zh: 发热/吸热流体通过多孔板的不稳定 MHD 流动，温度和浓度在滑流状态下变化
articles.abstract: The present study investigates the unsteady magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) free convective heat and mass transfer flow via an infinite vertical porous plate immersed in a porous material under slip flow circumstances of a viscous, incompressible, electrically conducting fluid. The plate is subjected to a consistent transverse magnetic field. The perturbation approach provides an analytical solution to the non-dimensional governing equations. Physical parameters that affect velocity, temperature, and concentration distributions are graphically analyzed and thoroughly discussed. These parameters include thermal Grashof number, modified Grashof number, magnetic parameter, permeability parameter, radiation parameter, heat generation/absorption, Prandtl number, Schmidt number, chemical reaction parameter, as well as Soret number. According to the findings, the velocity profile rises as the buoyancy and permeability parameters increase, while it falls with the magnetic parameter and slip effects due to the resistive Lorentz force. Thermal radiation and heat source significantly enhance the temperature distribution and thermal boundary layer thickness, while higher Prandtl number reduces the temperature field because of lower thermal diffusivity. The concentration profile decreases with increasing Schmidt number and chemical reaction parameter, whereas it increases with increasing Soret number due to enhanced thermal diffusion effects. The effects of the governing parameters on engineering quantities such as skin friction coefficient, Nusselt number, and Sherwood number are also discussed. The present investigation provides valuable insight into radiative MHD transport phenomena through porous media and has potential applications in geothermal engineering, chemical reactors, nuclear reactor cooling systems, petroleum engineering, energy transport systems, and thermal insulation technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究研究了在粘性、不可压缩、导电流体的滑流情况下，通过浸入多孔材料中的无限垂直多孔板进行的非定常磁流体动力学（MHD）自由对流传热和传质。该板受到一致的横向磁场的作用。扰动方法为无量纲控制方程提供了解析解。对影响速度、温度和浓度分布的物理参数进行了图形分析和深入讨论。这些参数包括热格拉霍夫数、修正格拉霍夫数、磁参数、磁导率参数、辐射参数、热量产生/吸收、普朗特数、施密特数、化学反应参数以及索雷特数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究研究了在粘性、不可压缩、导电流体的滑流情况下，通过浸入多孔材料中的无限垂直多孔板进行的非定常磁流体动力学（MHD）自由对流传热和传质。该板受到一致的横向磁场的作用。扰动方法为无量纲控制方程提供了解析解。对影响速度、温度和浓度分布的物理参数进行了图形分析和深入讨论。这些参数包括热格拉霍夫数、修正格拉霍夫数、磁参数、磁导率参数、辐射参数、热量产生/吸收、普朗特数、施密特数、化学反应参数以及索雷特数。根据研究结果，速度剖面随着浮力和磁导率参数的增加而上升，而随着磁参数和由于洛伦兹力的阻性滑移效应而下降。热辐射和热源显着增强了温度分布和热边界层厚度，而较高的普朗特数由于较低的热扩散率而减小了温度场。浓度分布随着施密特数和化学反应参数的增加而减小，而由于热扩散效应的增强，浓度分布随着索雷特数的增加而增加。还讨论了控制参数对表面摩擦系数、努塞尔数和舍伍德数等工程量的影响。目前的研究为通过多孔介质的辐射MHD传输现象提供了有价值的见解，并且在地热工程、化学反应堆、核反应堆冷却系统、石油工程、能量传输系统和隔热技术方面具有潜在的应用。

articles.title: Assessing Climate Change Impacts on Wetland Vegetation and Water Resources through Rainfall-Driven Ecohydrological Indices: Satellite-based evidence from the Kabartal Wetland Region, Bihar
articles.title_zh: 通过降雨驱动的生态水文指数评估气候变化对湿地植被和水资源的影响：来自比哈尔邦卡巴特尔湿地地区的卫星证据
articles.abstract: Wetlands are dynamic socio-ecological systems whose persistence and ecological functioning are strongly regulated by hydroclimatic variability. Changes in precipitation, surface-water availability, vegetation dynamics, and atmospheric evaporative demand can alter wetland hydrology, ecosystem productivity, and resilience, particularly under increasing climatic and anthropogenic pressures. This study evaluates the long-term ecohydrological transformation of the Kabartal Wetland Region (KWR) sBihar, India, by integrating climatic, hydrological, evapotranspiration, and satellite-derived ecological indicators. Long-term rainfall variability and trends were assessed for 1901–2024 using the Seasonality Index (SI), Rainfall Anomaly Index (RAI), 90% dependable rainfall, Modified Mann–Kendall (MMK) test, and Sen’s slope, while actual evapotranspiration (ET) and potential evapotranspiration (PET) were analysed for 2002–2024. Landsat-derived Modified Normalized Difference Water Index (MNDWI) and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) were used to quantify changes in surface-water extent and vegetation cover during pre- and post-monsoon periods between 1989 and 2024. The results reveal a substantial contraction of wetland surface-water extent, declining from 31 to 14 km² (54.83%) during pre-monsoon and from 44 to 19 km² (56.81%) during post-monsoon between 1989 and 2024. Rainfall exhibited strong seasonality, with SI values predominantly ranging from 0.8 to 1.4, indicating prolonged dry periods and concentration of precipitation within a short monsoonal window. RAI analysis indicates a progressive shift from predominantly wet conditions towards more frequent negative rainfall anomalies, particularly after 2000. Annual rainfall declined significantly across Begusarai, Samastipur, and Khagaria, with Sen’s slopes of − 1.54, − 1.72, and − 2.34 mm yr⁻¹, respectively, while monsoonal rainfall also exhibited significant decreasing trends. Historical mean annual rainfall of approximately 1,131, 1,170, and 1,154 mm in the three districts is projected to decline to about 1,025, 1,054, and 985 mm by 2044, respectively. Despite the region's generally humid, water-surplus character, the ET–PET relationship shows pronounced seasonal moisture limitation, with annual PET ranging from approximately 1,950–2,450 mm compared with ET of only 350–650 mm. Rainfall was positively correlated with ET (r = 0.5) and latent heat flux (r = 0.5) but negatively correlated with PET (r = − 0.5), demonstrating the sensitivity of ecosystem water use to precipitation availability and atmospheric demand. The convergence of declining rainfall, increasing rainfall variability, reduced surface-water extent, vegetation degradation, and persistent ET–PET disequilibrium indicates that KWR is undergoing a progressive transition from a predominantly water-surplus wetland system towards increasing seasonal hydro ecological stress. These findings highlight the need to restore river–wetland connectivity, protect wetland catchments and vegetation, regulate water extraction and land-use conversion, enhance monsoon-water retention, and strengthen community-based and climate-resilient wetland governance. Such integrated interventions are essential to maintain wetland ecological integrity, strengthen regional water security, and advance Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6) on sustainable water management.
articles.abstract_zh: 湿地是动态的社会生态系统，其持久性和生态功能受到水文气候变化的强烈调节。降水、地表水可用性、植被动态和大气蒸发需求的变化可以改变湿地水文、生态系统生产力和恢复力，特别是在气候和人为压力不断增加的情况下。本研究通过整合气候、水文、蒸散量和卫星衍生的生态指标，评估了印度比哈尔邦卡巴特尔湿地地区 (KWR) 的长期生态水文转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 湿地是动态的社会生态系统，其持久性和生态功能受到水文气候变化的强烈调节。降水、地表水可用性、植被动态和大气蒸发需求的变化可以改变湿地水文、生态系统生产力和恢复力，特别是在气候和人为压力不断增加的情况下。本研究通过整合气候、水文、蒸散量和卫星衍生的生态指标，评估了印度比哈尔邦卡巴特尔湿地地区 (KWR) 的长期生态水文转变。使用季节性指数（SI）、降雨异常指数（RAI）、90%可靠降雨量、修正曼-肯德尔（MMK）检验和森斜率评估了1901-2024年的长期降雨变化和趋势，同时分析了2002-2024年的实际蒸散量（ET）和潜在蒸散量（PET）。利用陆地卫星衍生的修正归一化水分指数 (MNDWI) 和归一化植被指数 (NDVI) 来量化 1989 年至 2024 年季风前后期间地表水范围和植被覆盖的变化。结果显示，湿地地表水范围大幅收缩，季风前从 31 平方公里减少到 14 平方公里（54.83%），季风期间从 44 平方公里减少到 19 平方公里1989年至2024年季风后期间，降雨量呈现较强的季节性，SI值主要分布在0.8至1.4之间，表明干旱期较长，降水集中在较短的季风窗口内。 RAI 分析表明，从以潮湿为主的条件逐步转变为更频繁的负降雨异常，特别是在 2000 年之后。贝古萨拉伊、萨马斯蒂普尔和卡加里亚的年降雨量显着下降，森斜率分别为 - 1.54、- 1.72 和 - 2.34 毫米年⁻1，而季风降雨也表现出显着减少的趋势。这三个地区的历史平均年降雨量约为 1,131、1,170 和 1,154 毫米，预计到 2044 年将分别下降至约 1,025、1,054 和 985 毫米。尽管该地区总体上潮湿、水过剩，但蒸散量与蒸发量之间的关系显示出明显的季节性湿度限制，年蒸发量约为 1,950–2,450 毫米，而蒸散量仅为 350–650 毫米。降雨量与 ET (r = 0.5) 和潜热通量 (r = 0.5) 呈正相关，但与 PET (r = − 0.5) 呈负相关，表明生态系统用水对降水可用性和大气需求的敏感性。降雨量减少、降雨量变率增加、地表水范围缩小、植被退化和持续的 ET-PET 不平衡的综合表明，KWR 正在经历从水过剩湿地系统向季节性水生态压力增加的逐步转变。这些发现强调需要恢复河流与湿地的连通性、保护湿地集水区和植被、规范取水和土地利用转换、加强季风水保留以及加强基于社区和气候适应能力的湿地治理。这种综合干预措施对于维护湿地生态完整性、加强区域水安全以及推进可持续水管理的可持续发展目标 6 (SDG 6) 至关重要。

articles.title: Hybrid quantum computer observes foundational quantum effect in a new setting
articles.title_zh: 混合量子计算机在新环境中观察基础量子效应
articles.abstract: Physicists in the Department of Physics at the University of Oxford have used a hybrid quantum computer, made up of qubits and quantum oscillators, to observe the Aharonov–Bohm effect in a quantum simulation. The effect is a quantum phenomenon in which a particle can acquire a measurable phase by traveling around a magnetic flux, even though it never passes through a region where a magnetic field is present.
articles.abstract_zh: 牛津大学物理系的物理学家使用由量子位和量子振荡器组成的混合量子计算机来观察量子模拟中的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应。这种效应是一种量子现象，其中粒子可以通过围绕磁通量运动来获得可测量的相位，即使它从未穿过存在磁场的区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 牛津大学物理系的物理学家使用由量子位和量子振荡器组成的混合量子计算机来观察量子模拟中的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应。这种效应是一种量子现象，其中粒子可以通过围绕磁通量运动来获得可测量的相位，即使它从未穿过存在磁场的区域。

articles.title: Quantum chip holds multiple photons at once, opening path to scalable memory
articles.title_zh: 量子芯片可同时容纳多个光子，为可扩展存储器开辟道路
articles.abstract: For highly fragile quantum information systems, the ability to store quantum information is vital—but also challenging. Quantum information is transported in particles of light called photons, which often must be temporarily paused (or "stored") while other, slower quantum operations catch up. This storage must be performed on microchips as small as 1 centimeter (0.4 inches)—a distance covered by light in a few trillionths of a second. Storing photons for a microsecond would represent a massive leap forward for the capabilities of quantum chips.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于高度脆弱的量子信息系统，存储量子信息的能力至关重要，但也具有挑战性。量子信息以称为光子的光粒子形式传输，光子通常必须暂时暂停（或“存储”），同时其他较慢的量子操作才能赶上。这种存储必须在小至 1 厘米（0.4 英寸）的微芯片上进行——光在几万亿分之一秒内覆盖的距离。将光子存储一微秒将代表量子芯片功能的巨大飞跃。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于高度脆弱的量子信息系统，存储量子信息的能力至关重要，但也具有挑战性。量子信息以称为光子的光粒子形式传输，光子通常必须暂时暂停（或“存储”），同时其他较慢的量子操作才能赶上。这种存储必须在小至 1 厘米（0.4 英寸）的微芯片上进行——光在几万亿分之一秒内覆盖的距离。将光子存储一微秒将代表量子芯片功能的巨大飞跃。

articles.title: Regulation mechanism of lanthanum chloride on germination
articles.title_zh: 氯化镧对发芽的调控机制
articles.abstract: The purpose of this study to investigate the regulatory effects of exogenous 18 lanthanum chloride (LaCl3) on wheat seed germination and seedling physiological 19 characteristics, in order to screen for the optimal treatment concentration that is most 20 conducive to its growth and development.Wheat seeds were used as experimental 21 materials, and a blank control group (CK) and six gradient treatment groups (T1 to T6) 22 were set up, with three biological replicates in each group. Inoculate 25 seeds into 23 each culture dish and apply 10 mL of LaCl3 solution at concentrations of 0 (CK), 60, 24 120, 180, 240, 300, and 360 mg·L⁻¹, respectively, while keeping the filter paper moist. After 3 days of germination, relevant indicators will be measured. In the pot experiment, when the seedling height reaches 5 cm, 10 mL of corresponding treatment solution is sprayed every 3 days. After 20 days of cultivation, the root length, number of fibrous roots, fresh weight, plant height, chlorophyll content, as well as key enzyme activities such as superoxide dismutase (SOD), peroxidase (POD), and catalase (CAT) are measured.The experiment showed that lanthanum chloride exhibited a dual effect of "Minimal stimulation and strong suppression" on wheat growth. Among them, the T4 to T6 groups suffered severe growth inhibition due to excessive concentration, and effective enzyme activity data could not be obtained. Physiological indicators testing showed that compared with the CK group, the low concentration T1 group (60 mg·L-1) significantly increased the activities of SOD, POD, and CAT by 31.43%, 71.82%, and 69.74%, respectively (P<0.05). The synergistic effect of the medium concentration T3 group (180 mg·L-1) was more significant, with the activities of the three enzymes increasing by 44%, 135.16%, and 114.47%, respectively. The chlorophyll content in T1, T2, and T3 groups also significantly increased by 39.84%, 20.86%, and 33.69%, respectively. Correlation analysis revealed that the activities of SOD, POD, and CAT were negatively correlated with seed germination rate, number of fibrous roots, and root length. There was also a significant negative correlation between chlorophyll content and number of fibrous roots. In summary, the optimal concentration for this experiment was 180 mg·L-1 LaCl3 treatment. Under these conditions, the germination rate of wheat seeds and the comprehensive physiological growth indicators of seedlings showed the best performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨外源~(18)氯化镧(LaCl3)对小麦种子萌发及幼苗生理特性的调节作用[20]，以筛选最有利于其生长发育的最佳处理浓度[20]。以小麦种子为实验材料[21]，设空白对照组(CK)和6个梯度处理组(T1~T6)[22]，每组设3个生物重复。每个培养皿 23 个，接种 25 粒种子，分别加入 10 mL 浓度为 0（CK）、60、24 120、180、240、300 和 360 mg·L-1 的 LaCl3 溶液，同时保持滤纸湿润。发芽3天后，测定相关指标。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究旨在探讨外源~(18)氯化镧(LaCl3)对小麦种子萌发及幼苗生理特性的调节作用[20]，以筛选最有利于其生长发育的最佳处理浓度[20]。以小麦种子为实验材料[21]，设空白对照组(CK)和6个梯度处理组(T1~T6)[22]，每组设3个生物重复。每个培养皿 23 个，接种 25 粒种子，分别加入 10 mL 浓度为 0（CK）、60、24 120、180、240、300 和 360 mg·L-1 的 LaCl3 溶液，同时保持滤纸湿润。发芽3天后，测定相关指标。盆栽试验中，当苗高达到5厘米时，每3天喷洒10毫升相应的处理液。培养20天后，测定根长、须根数、鲜重、株高、叶绿素含量以及超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化物酶（POD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）等关键酶活性。实验表明，氯化镧对小麦生长具有“微刺激、强抑制”的双重作用。其中，T4至T6组由于浓度过高，生长受到严重抑制，无法获得有效的酶活性数据。生理指标检测显示，与CK组相比，低浓度T1组（60 mg·L-1）SOD、POD、CAT活性分别显着升高31.43%、71.82%、69.74%（P<0.05）。中浓度T3组(180 mg·L-1)协同作用更显着，三种酶活性分别增加44%、135.16%和114.47%。 T1、T2和T3组的叶绿素含量也显着增加，分别增加了39.84%、20.86%和33.69%。相关分析表明，SOD、POD、CAT活性与种子发芽率、须根数、根长呈负相关。叶绿素含量与须根数量也呈显着负相关。综上所述，本实验的最佳浓度为180 mg·L-1 LaCl3处理。在此条件下，小麦种子的发芽率和幼苗的综合生理生长指标均表现出最好的表现。

articles.title: Cognitive Work and Interface Requirements in Autonomous Passenger Mobility: A Taxonomy-Based Analysis of Public Incident Reports
articles.title_zh: 自动乘客出行中的认知工作和界面要求：公共事件报告的基于分类的分析
articles.abstract: Autonomous passenger mobility changes the distribution of human work rather than removing it from transport operations. Driverless robotaxis, supervised passenger automated driving systems, autonomous shuttles, and remotely assisted mobility services create new cognitive work for passengers, in-vehicle operators, remote supervisors, emergency responders, and surrounding road users. This study analyzes public automated-driving incident records as traces of human-autonomy interaction and develops a taxonomy-based account of interface requirements. A curated corpus of 2,760 latest public report versions was filtered to 2,646 autonomous passenger mobility records and 1,411 interface-relevant report-level cases, aggregated into 1,158 incident clusters. The coding taxonomy links recurring incident patterns to ergonomics constructs including mode awareness, control authority, remote cognitive work, degraded-state communication, external legibility, passenger guidance, and operational boundary management. Results show that the most frequent primary interface families concern curbside, parking, or stop-state interaction; remote or shared supervision; control transfer; fallback or degraded operation; and operational-boundary stressors. The findings indicate that safety in autonomous passenger mobility depends on making system state, authority, fallback behavior, and expected human action legible across multiple actors and interface layers. The study contributes a requirements-oriented framework for designing and verifying human-autonomy interfaces in autonomous passenger mobility operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 自主乘客流动改变了人类工作的分配，而不是将其从运输业务中移除。无人驾驶机器人出租车、受监督的乘客自动驾驶系统、自动班车和远程辅助移动服务为乘客、车内操作员、远程监管人员、应急响应人员和周围道路使用者创造了新的认知工作。这项研究分析了公共自动驾驶事件记录作为人类与自主交互的痕迹，并开发了基于分类的界面需求帐户。包含 2,760 个最新公开报告版本的精选语料库被过滤为 2,646 个自动乘客移动记录和 1,411 个与界面相关的报告级案例，汇总为 1,158 个事件集群。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自主乘客流动改变了人类工作的分配，而不是将其从运输业务中移除。无人驾驶机器人出租车、受监督的乘客自动驾驶系统、自动班车和远程辅助移动服务为乘客、车内操作员、远程监管人员、应急响应人员和周围道路使用者创造了新的认知工作。这项研究分析了公共自动驾驶事件记录作为人类与自主交互的痕迹，并开发了基于分类的界面需求帐户。包含 2,760 个最新公开报告版本的精选语料库被过滤为 2,646 个自动乘客移动记录和 1,411 个与界面相关的报告级案例，汇总为 1,158 个事件集群。编码分类将重复发生的事件模式与人体工程学结构联系起来，包括模式意识、控制权限、远程认知工作、降级状态通信、外部可读性、乘客引导和操作边界管理。结果表明，最常见的主要界面系列涉及路边、停车或停车状态交互；远程或共享监督；控制转移；回退或降级操作；和操作边界压力源。研究结果表明，自动乘客出行的安全性取决于系统状态、权限、后备行为和预期的人类行为在多个参与者和接口层之间的清晰性。该研究为设计和验证自动乘客移动操作中的人机界面提供了一个以需求为导向的框架。

articles.title: Carbonylation of Glycerol with CO2 to Glycerol Carbonate over Zinc Hydroxystannate
articles.title_zh: 羟基锡酸锌上甘油与 CO2 羰基化生成甘油碳酸酯
articles.abstract: This study investigates the direct carbonylation of glycerol with CO2 over zinc hydroxystannate (ZHS) catalysts for the synthesis of glycerol carbonate (GLC) under relatively milder reaction conditions. Reactions were conducted in a semi-batch reactor at 120 °C and 5 bar CO2 for 6 h. ZHS catalysts were prepared by Zn2+–Sn4+ coprecipitation with NaOH (ZSCP), ZSCP by further hydrothermal treatment, or by alkaline-assisted surface treatment (CPAST), and their catalytic performances were compared. Among the catalysts examined, ZHS prepared by CPAST afforded the highest GLC yield of 17.1%, compared with 15.9% for ZSCP-derived ZHS. XPS analysis indicated that the surface basicity of ZHS is associated with partial reduction of Sn4+ to Sn2+ and the concomitant formation of surface oxygen vacancies. In the absence of ZHS, glycerol predominantly underwent oligomerization, whereas ZHS promoted the activation and incorporation of CO2 into glycerol to form GLC. Notably, the GLC yield exhibited a strong linear correlation with the surface basicity of the ZHS catalysts determined by the Hammett indicator method, demonstrating that surface basicity is a key descriptor governing catalytic activity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究研究了在羟基锡酸锌 (ZHS) 催化剂上甘油与 CO2 的直接羰基化反应，在相对温和的反应条件下合成碳酸甘油酯 (GLC)。反应在半间歇式反应器中在 120°C 和 5 bar CO2 下进行 6 小时。采用Zn2+–Sn4+与NaOH共沉淀(ZSCP)、ZSCP进一步水热处理或碱辅助表面处理(CPAST)制备ZHS催化剂，并比较其催化性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究研究了在羟基锡酸锌 (ZHS) 催化剂上甘油与 CO2 的直接羰基化反应，在相对温和的反应条件下合成碳酸甘油酯 (GLC)。反应在半间歇式反应器中在 120°C 和 5 bar CO2 下进行 6 小时。采用Zn2+–Sn4+与NaOH共沉淀(ZSCP)、ZSCP进一步水热处理或碱辅助表面处理(CPAST)制备ZHS催化剂，并比较其催化性能。在所检查的催化剂中，由 CPAST 制备的 ZHS 提供了最高的 GLC 产率，为 17.1%，而 ZSCP 衍生的 ZHS 为 15.9%。 XPS分析表明ZHS的表面碱度与Sn4+部分还原为Sn2+以及随之形成的表面氧空位有关。在没有 ZHS 的情况下，甘油主要发生低聚，而 ZHS 则促进 CO2 活化并掺入甘油中形成 GLC。值得注意的是，GLC 产率与哈米特指示剂法测定的 ZHS 催化剂的表面碱度表现出很强的线性相关性，表明表面碱度是控制催化活性的关键描述符。

articles.title: Reading the Reader: When Do News Interactions Reveal Momentary Viewpoint Openness?
articles.title_zh: 阅读读者：新闻互动什么时候会表现出短暂的观点开放性？
articles.abstract: What does a news interaction show about a reader's willingness to engage with politically different sources? Selecting an opposing-side article records a choice, opening it records access, and a trustworthiness rating records judgment. We examine viewpoint openness using three datasets: trustworthiness ratings in NewsLens, choices from a displayed list in NeMig, and openings of recommended articles in IDEA. Each covers one period, interface, and action, so none can establish a lasting disposition. We call the time-bounded inference emphmomentary viewpoint openness: how favorably a reader responds to opposing-side sources relative to same-side sources during the observed period. We test whether early responses improve prediction of later ones after accounting for what was offered, political side, and the reader's usual response level. In NewsLens, readers consistently differ in how much political alignment between themselves and the outlet changes their trustworthiness ratings, beyond article differences and usual scoring; this supports momentary viewpoint openness in trustworthiness judgments. In NeMig, political position and the sources in each list predict which side is chosen, while earlier choices and migration attitudes do not identify an additional preference that repeats across rounds. In IDEA, readers differ consistently in overall political-news opening frequency, but not in which side they open more often across weeks. The NeMig history therefore supports prediction from the choice situation, and the IDEA history supports an overall opening tendency; neither reveals a recurring personal source-side difference. A reader model should preserve these differences rather than label every opposing-side interaction as openness.
articles.abstract_zh: 新闻互动如何表明读者愿意与不同政治来源互动？选择对方文章记录选择，打开记录访问，可信度记录判断。我们使用三个数据集检查观点开放性：NewsLens 中的可信度评级、NeMig 中显示列表中的选择以及 IDEA 中推荐文章的开篇率。每一个都涵盖一个时期、一个界面、一个动作，因此没有一个能够建立持久的性格。我们将限时推理称为强调观点开放性：在观察期间，相对于同方来源，读者对对方来源的反应如何。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 新闻互动如何表明读者愿意与不同政治来源互动？选择对方文章记录选择，打开记录访问，可信度记录判断。我们使用三个数据集检查观点开放性：NewsLens 中的可信度评级、NeMig 中显示列表中的选择以及 IDEA 中推荐文章的开篇率。每一个都涵盖一个时期、一个界面、一个动作，因此没有一个能够建立持久的性格。我们将限时推理称为强调观点开放性：在观察期间，相对于同方来源，读者对对方来源的反应如何。在考虑了所提供的内容、政治方面和读者通常的反应水平后，我们测试早期的反应是否可以改善对后来的反应的预测。在 NewsLens 中，除了文章差异和通常的评分之外，读者与媒体之间的政治联盟对他们的可信度评级的影响程度始终存在差异；这支持了可信度判断中的暂时观点开放性。在 NeMig 中，政治立场和每个列表中的来源预测选择哪一方，而早期的选择和移民态度并不能确定在各轮中重复的额外偏好。在 IDEA 中，读者在总体政治新闻打开频率上存在差异，但在几周内他们打开哪一边的频率没有差异。因此，NeMig 历史支持从选择情况进行预测，IDEA 历史支持整体开放趋势；两者都没有揭示出反复出现的个人来源差异。读者模型应该保留这些差异，而不是把每一个对立面的互动都标记为开放性。

articles.title: Investigation of Stress Analysis on Copper Material in Slurry Erosion Wear
articles.title_zh: 铜材料浆料侵蚀磨损应力分析研究
articles.abstract: In erosion wear the impacting particles called as erodent are responsible to generate stress on target specimen significantly. The severity of contact stress depends on erodent size and shape, erodent velocity, etc. In present work mild steel erodent impacted on copper specimen. The impact energy of mild steel erodent kept constant by varying their velocities. The optical microscope is used to determine the diameter of indentation craters on copper specimen due to impact of mild steel spherical shape particles. Hertz equation is used to calculate contact area and stress concentration at target material surface. Similar conditions are simulated in ANSYSY software.  Stress concentration findings with experimental method almost in line with the ANSYS explicit dynamics software results. Finally it is concluded that stress concentration is dominant factor in erosion wear which needs to investigate further in detail by investigators.
articles.abstract_zh: 在侵蚀磨损中，称为侵蚀剂的冲击颗粒会在目标样本上产生显着的应力。接触应力的严重程度取决于侵蚀物的大小和形状、侵蚀物的速度等。在目前的工作中，低碳钢侵蚀物撞击铜样本。低碳钢侵蚀剂的冲击能量通过改变其速度保持恒定。光学显微镜用于测定铜样品上由于低碳钢球形颗粒的撞击而产生的压痕坑的直径。赫兹方程用于计算目标材料表面的接触面积和应力集中。 ANSYSY 软件模拟了类似的条件。  用实验方法得到的应力集中结果与ANSYS显式动力学软件的结果几乎一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在侵蚀磨损中，称为侵蚀剂的冲击颗粒会在目标样本上产生显着的应力。接触应力的严重程度取决于侵蚀物的大小和形状、侵蚀物的速度等。在目前的工作中，低碳钢侵蚀物撞击铜样本。低碳钢侵蚀剂的冲击能量通过改变其速度保持恒定。光学显微镜用于测定铜样品上由于低碳钢球形颗粒的撞击而产生的压痕坑的直径。赫兹方程用于计算目标材料表面的接触面积和应力集中。 ANSYSY 软件模拟了类似的条件。  用实验方法得到的应力集中结果与ANSYS显式动力学软件的结果几乎一致。最后得出结论，应力集中是侵蚀磨损的主导因素，需要研究人员进一步详细研究。

articles.title: In Vitro Evaluation of Activated Bentonite and Biochar: T-2 Toxin and Zearalenone Adsorption and Intestinal Barrier Protection
articles.title_zh: 活化膨润土和生物炭的体外评价：T-2 毒素和玉米赤霉烯酮吸附和肠道屏障保护
articles.abstract: Mycotoxin adsorbents are usually evaluated solely by toxin-binding capacity. However, adsorption alone does not reflect binding stability under gastrointestinal conditions or biological protection of the intestinal epithelium. This study compared commercial and experimental bentonite- and biochar-based adsorbents against T-2 toxin and zearalenone (ZEN) using an integrated physicochemical and biological approach. Seven materials were tested: one commercial activated bentonite, two experimental bentonites and their NaCl-activated variants, and two experimental biochars. The evaluation combined physicochemical characterization, sequential adsorption-desorption (simulating gastric-to-intestinal transitions), and biological efficacy assessment using continuous transepithelial electrical resistance (ECIS-TEER) monitoring in IPEC-J2 cells. NaCl activation altered bentonite surface properties depending on the parent material without disrupting the smectite framework. Sequential testing revealed differences in toxin retention hidden by initial adsorption alone. Experimental biochar 1 showed complete binding efficiency for both toxins, while commercial activated bentonite exceeded 93%. Physicochemical binding did not reliably predict biological protection. Commercial bentonite protected barrier function against both toxins. Experimental bentonite 2 and biochar 1 protected against T-2 toxin, whereas experimental bentonite 1 best supported protection against ZEN, with its activated form altering barrier-response kinetics. These findings demonstrate that adsorption capacity, binding stability, and preservation of epithelial barrier function represent complementary dimensions of adsorbent efficacy. Integrating sequential adsorption–desorption with continuous ECIS-TEER monitoring provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating mycotoxin adsorbents.
articles.abstract_zh: 霉菌毒素吸附剂通常仅通过毒素结合能力来评价。然而，单独的吸附并不能反映胃肠道条件下的结合稳定性或肠上皮的生物保护。本研究采用综合物理化学和生物学方法，比较了基于膨润土和生物炭的商业和实验吸附剂对 T-2 毒素和玉米赤霉烯酮 (ZEN) 的影响。测试了七种材料：一种商业活化膨润土，两种实验膨润土及其 NaCl 活化变体，以及两种实验生物炭。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 霉菌毒素吸附剂通常仅通过毒素结合能力来评价。然而，单独的吸附并不能反映胃肠道条件下的结合稳定性或肠上皮的生物保护。本研究采用综合物理化学和生物学方法，比较了基于膨润土和生物炭的商业和实验吸附剂对 T-2 毒素和玉米赤霉烯酮 (ZEN) 的影响。测试了七种材料：一种商业活化膨润土，两种实验膨润土及其 NaCl 活化变体，以及两种实验生物炭。该评估结合了物理化学表征、连续吸附-解吸（模拟胃到肠的转变）以及使用 IPEC-J2 细胞中的连续跨上皮电阻 (ECIS-TEER) 监测的生物功效评估。氯化钠活化根据母体材料改变膨润土表面特性，而不破坏蒙皂石框架。后续测试揭示了仅通过初始吸附隐藏的毒素保留差异。实验生物炭 1 显示出对两种毒素的完全结合效率，而商业活性膨润土则超过 93%。物理化学结合不能可靠地预测生物保护。商业膨润土可保护两种毒素的屏障功能。实验膨润土 2 和生物炭 1 可防止 T-2 毒素，而实验膨润土 1 则能最好地支持对 ZEN 的保护，其活化形式会改变屏障反应动力学。这些发现表明，吸附能力、结合稳定性和上皮屏障功能的保留代表了吸附剂功效的互补维度。将顺序吸附-解吸与连续 ECIS-TEER 监测相结合，为评估霉菌毒素吸附剂提供了一个全面的框架。

articles.title: Multiscale mechanical performance of plant-based and hybrid yarns for biodegradable fishing Net
articles.title_zh: 用于可生物降解渔网的植物基和混合纱的多尺度机械性能
articles.abstract: Marine plastic pollution from abandoned fishing gear has intensified the search for lower-persistence netting materials that retain adequate mechanical performance. This study investigated how yarn composition and twisting influence plant-based and polyester-containing two-ply yarns across three structural scales: yarns, double-weaver knots, and nets. Six yarn systems were produced at 200–500 TPM. Two-way ANOVA confirmed significant effects of composition, twist, and their interaction, whereas Grey Relational Analysis identified 400 TPM as the most suitable common twist condition. At the yarn scale, PALF/PALF showed the highest breaking force, whereas PES/PES exhibited the greatest extensibility. At the knot scale, PALF/PALF achieved the highest knot load and substantial geometric rearrangement, while PES/HF showed the greatest proportional strength retention. At the net scale, PALF/PALF maintained the strongest overall load-bearing response and was mechanically competitive with the PES/PES reference, although the polyester retained advantage. The numerical comparison favored the 10 cm over the 5 cm mesh-bar configuration under the adopted conditions. Seawater exposure caused greater surface deterioration in PALF and hemp than polyester. Overall, the results demonstrate that material ranking changes across structural scales and identify PALF-containing systems as promising candidates for further lower-persistence fishing-net development
articles.abstract_zh: 废弃渔具造成的海洋塑料污染加剧了对保留足够机械性能的低持久性渔网材料的寻找。本研究研究了纱线成分和捻度如何在三种结构尺度上影响植物基和含聚酯的双层纱线：纱线、双织结和网。在200–500 TPM下生产六种纱线系统。双向方差分析证实了成分、扭曲及其相互作用的显著影响，而灰色关联分析确定400 TPM是最常见的扭曲条件。在纱线尺度上， PALF/PALF表现出最高的断裂力，而PES/PES表现出最大的延展性。

articles.title: Layered semiconductor unlocks magnetic control of light emitted by quantum condensates
articles.title_zh: 层状半导体解锁了对量子凝聚体发出的光的磁控制
articles.abstract: Quantum technologies are considered key technologies of the future. However, research in this field requires not only scientific expertise but sometimes also highly specialized laboratory conditions. Bose–Einstein condensates are a remarkable example, in which atoms move in lockstep, making quantum-mechanical effects visible not only at the level of individual atoms but also on a macroscopic scale. The first Bose–Einstein condensates were observed in ultracold atomic gases at temperatures close to absolute zero. The cooling required to achieve this was technically demanding, costly and restricted to specialized laboratories.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子技术被认为是未来的关键技术。然而，这一领域的研究不仅需要科学专业知识，有时还需要高度专业化的实验室条件。玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚就是一个显着的例子，其中原子同步运动，使得量子力学效应不仅在单个原子水平上可见，而且在宏观尺度上也可见。第一个玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚是在接近绝对零温度的超冷原子气体中观察到的。实现这一目标所需的冷却技术要求高、成本高并且仅限于专业实验室。

articles.title: Liquid-crystal-like magnetism explains puzzling properties in a rare-earth compound
articles.title_zh: 类液晶磁性解释了稀土化合物中令人费解的特性
articles.abstract: In some materials, physical properties don't emerge from their individual particles, but from the collective behavior of their quantum spins. Now, researchers led by Pengcheng Dai at Rice University in the U.S. have discovered that in one compound containing the rare-earth element ytterbium, these spins can behave much like the molecules in a liquid crystal: favoring a certain direction without lining up to create magnetism on larger scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 在某些材料中，物理特性并不是来自其单个粒子，而是来自其量子自旋的集体行为。现在，美国莱斯大学戴鹏程领导的研究人员发现，在一种含有稀土元素镱的化合物中，这些自旋的行为与液晶中的分子非常相似：偏向某个方向，而不是排列起来以在更大范围内产生磁性。
