Measurement and analysis files are stored in the cloud-based ARIM-mdx data system, while OMNES manages metadata describing samples, preparation procedures, measurement conditions, instrument settings, data locations, and analysis histories. Tabular and JavaScript Object Notation formats are used according to the metadata structure, with numerical values stored separately from units to facilitate machine processing. OMNES organizes these records based on causal relationships among experimental and analytical processes, linking samples, measurements, raw data, processed data, and analysis results through a relational data model and visualizing their relationships as a graph. This causality-based organization preserves experimental and analytical provenance and clarifies how each result was derived from the preceding processes and data. The accumulated spectra can subsequently be processed using ML methods, including dimensionality reduction and materials classification, and the resulting data can be registered back into OMNES. Previously reported ML analysis of BN XAS spectra is presented as an example of the analytical workflow that can be applied to data acquired at the beamline.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能正在迅速改变材料探索，但可靠的人工智能辅助研究依赖于保留其背景、来源和机器可读结构的实验数据。因此，高通量同步加速器测量需要的不仅仅是自动数据采集：数据生成、积累和利用必须在连续的工作流程中连接起来。在这里，我们提出了一个以数据为中心的研究框架，集成了 PIONEER 系统、OMNES 和 ML 分析。 PIONEER 系统可在 NanoTerasu 的 BL08U 软 X 射线束线上自动执行样品处理、真空传输和 XAS 扫描，系统地生成大量空间分辨光谱数据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工智能正在迅速改变材料探索，但可靠的人工智能辅助研究依赖于保留其背景、来源和机器可读结构的实验数据。因此，高通量同步加速器测量需要的不仅仅是自动数据采集：数据生成、积累和利用必须在连续的工作流程中连接起来。在这里，我们提出了一个以数据为中心的研究框架，集成了 PIONEER 系统、OMNES 和 ML 分析。 PIONEER 系统可在 NanoTerasu 的 BL08U 软 X 射线束线上自动执行样品处理、真空传输和 XAS 扫描，系统地生成大量空间分辨光谱数据。测量和分析文件存储在基于云的 ARIM-mdx 数据系统中，而 OMNES 管理描述样品、制备程序、测量条件、仪器设置、数据位置和分析历史的元数据。根据元数据结构使用表格和JavaScript对象表示法格式，将数值与单位分开存储，以方便机器处理。 OMNES 根据实验和分析过程之间的因果关系来组织这些记录，通过关系数据模型将样本、测量结果、原始数据、处理数据和分析结果链接起来，并将它们的关系可视化为图表。这种基于因果关系的组织保留了实验和分析的来源，并阐明了每个结果是如何从前面的过程和数据中得出的。随后可以使用机器学习方法处理累积的光谱，包括降维和材料分类，并将所得数据重新注册到 OMNES 中。先前报道的 BN XAS 光谱的 ML 分析是作为分析工作流程的一个示例，该工作流程可应用于在光束线采集的数据。

articles.title: From band reconstruction to Bogoliubov dispersion: How dz2-band enhances iron-based superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 从能带重建到 Bogoliubov 色散：dz2 能带如何增强铁基超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional understanding of iron-based superconductivity is usually established based on electronic bands at the Fermi level, leaving deeper bands overlooked as potential factor. Here, we expand this view by demonstrating that a deep-lying dz2 band below the Fermi level can be employed to enhance the superconducting paring strength. By using scanning tunneling microscope to mechanically change the crystal lattice of an iron-based superconductor, we observe an upward shift of the deep-lying dz2 band related feature, leading to hybridization with the primary superconducting bands at the Fermi level. We visualize the novel evidence of this band hybridization and resulting enhanced superconducting gap through quasiparticle interference imaging, providing conclusive evidence that engineering such correlations between deep and pairing-active bands is a potent mechanism for amplifying the superconducting gap. This work refines the conventional view of pairing-relevant electronic structures and establishes band hybridization as an effective way to optimize superconducting materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 对铁基超导性的传统理解通常是基于费米能级的电子能带而建立的，而更深的能带作为潜在因素被忽视。在这里，我们通过证明费米能级以下的深层 dz2 能带可用于增强超导配对强度来扩展这一观点。通过使用扫描隧道显微镜机械地改变铁基超导体的晶格，我们观察到深层dz2带相关特征的向上移动，导致与费米能级的初级超导带杂化。我们通过准粒子干涉成像可视化了这种能带杂化的新证据以及由此产生的增强的超导能隙，提供了确凿的证据，表明设计深能带和配对活性能带之间的这种相关性是放大超导能隙的有效机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对铁基超导性的传统理解通常是基于费米能级的电子能带而建立的，而更深的能带作为潜在因素被忽视。在这里，我们通过证明费米能级以下的深层 dz2 能带可用于增强超导配对强度来扩展这一观点。通过使用扫描隧道显微镜机械地改变铁基超导体的晶格，我们观察到深层dz2带相关特征的向上移动，导致与费米能级的初级超导带杂化。我们通过准粒子干涉成像可视化了这种能带杂化的新证据以及由此产生的增强的超导能隙，提供了确凿的证据，表明设计深能带和配对活性能带之间的这种相关性是放大超导能隙的有效机制。这项工作完善了配对相关电子结构的传统观点，并将能带杂化确立为优化超导材料的有效方法。

articles.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
articles.title_zh: 氯取代对CrSBr磁光性质的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of x=56% the mathrmCrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们系统地研究了氯取代对范德华层状半导体 CrSBr 磁光特性的影响。我们的研究表明，即使在 x=56% 的取代水平下，mathrmCrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ 材料也表现出与纯 CrSBr 晶体中观察到的相同的清晰磁光耦合。研究表明，相关参数的值在不同的取代水平上平滑变化，从而为该系列二维磁性材料提供了有前景的可调性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们系统地研究了氯取代对范德华层状半导体 CrSBr 磁光特性的影响。我们的研究表明，即使在 x=56% 的取代水平下，mathrmCrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ 材料也表现出与纯 CrSBr 晶体中观察到的相同的清晰磁光耦合。研究表明，相关参数的值在不同的取代水平上平滑变化，从而为该系列二维磁性材料提供了有前景的可调性。

articles.title: Demonstration of ultrafast coherent sub-picosecond magnon pulses
articles.title_zh: 超快相干亚皮秒磁振子脉冲演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11550v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast magnonics explores routes towards energy-efficient information processing by replacing electrons with pulses of terahertz magnons. The critical, but so far elusive, requirement on the magnon pulses is the combination of high-speed and a long-range propagation while maintaining a well-defined narrow waveform of the pulses. Here, we demonstrate the launching of 0.4-picosecond magnon pulses in the altermagnetic insulator α-Fe₂O₃ (hematite) using broadband terahertz spin-orbit torques by an adjacent platinum layer. Phase-resolved terahertz transmission reveals that these sub-picosecond pulses travel ballistically, coherently and non-dispersively at a constant velocity of 23 nm/ps, transport angular momentum and retain their temporal waveform shape over 160 nm, with an inferred relaxation length in hundreds of nanometers or more. Beyond establishing α-Fe₂O₃ as an optimal platform for ultrafast magnonics, our technique introduces a high-resolution, tabletop method to directly extract dispersion relations up to high wavevectors, and explore ultrafast magnon dynamics in altermagnets and other magnetic materials with teraherz-range dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 超快磁振子学通过用太赫兹磁振子脉冲代替电子来探索节能信息处理的途径。对磁振子脉冲的关键但迄今为止难以捉摸的要求是高速和长距离传播的结合，同时保持明确的窄脉冲波形。在这里，我们演示了利用相邻铂层的宽带太赫兹自旋轨道扭矩在交变磁绝缘体 α-Fe2O3（赤铁矿）中发射 0.4 皮秒磁振子脉冲。相位分辨太赫兹传输表明，这些亚皮秒脉冲以 23 nm/ps 的恒定速度以弹道、相干和非色散方式传播，传输角动量并在 160 nm 以上保持其时间波形形状，推断的弛豫长度为数百纳米或更长。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超快磁振子学通过用太赫兹磁振子脉冲代替电子来探索节能信息处理的途径。对磁振子脉冲的关键但迄今为止难以捉摸的要求是高速和长距离传播的结合，同时保持明确的窄脉冲波形。在这里，我们演示了利用相邻铂层的宽带太赫兹自旋轨道扭矩在交变磁绝缘体 α-Fe2O3（赤铁矿）中发射 0.4 皮秒磁振子脉冲。相位分辨太赫兹传输表明，这些亚皮秒脉冲以 23 nm/ps 的恒定速度以弹道、相干和非色散方式传播，传输角动量并在 160 nm 以上保持其时间波形形状，推断的弛豫长度为数百纳米或更长。除了将 α-Fe2O₃ 建立为超快磁振子的最佳平台之外，我们的技术还引入了一种高分辨率的桌面方法，可以直接提取高达高波矢量的色散关系，并探索交流磁体和其他具有太赫兹范围动力学的磁性材料中的超快磁振子动力学。

articles.title: Multipolar fluctuations in localized 4f²-electron systems from dynamical mean-field theory: application to PrCdNi₄
articles.title_zh: 动态平均场理论中局域 4f² 电子系统的多极涨落：在 PrCdNi₄ 中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11562v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multipolar-fluctuation analysis based on density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory is extended from 4f¹- to 4f²-electron systems. Two methodological developments are presented. First, many-particle states are constructed within the j-j coupling scheme in the j=5/2 subspace, so as to reproduce the crystalline-electric-field splitting of the 4f² Hund's-rule ground-state multiplet. Second, multipolar susceptibilities and interactions between 4f² multiplets are derived through a mapping from single-particle to many-particle bases. We apply this framework to PrCdNi₄, which has a non-Kramers Γ₃ doublet ground state, and propose a (3z²-r²)-type antiferroquadrupolar order at boldsymbolq=(2π,π,0) driven by the competition between nearest- and fourth-nearest-neighbor interactions. The formalism developed here is applicable to general 4fⁿ-electron systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于密度泛函理论与动态平均场理论相结合的多极涨落分析从4f1电子系统扩展到4f2电子系统。提出了两种方法论的发展。首先，在 j=5/2 子空间中的 j-j 耦合方案中构造多粒子态，以再现 4f² Hund 规则基态多重态的晶体电场分裂。其次，多极磁化率和 4f² 多重态之间的相互作用是通过从单粒子基础到多粒子基础的映射得出的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于密度泛函理论与动态平均场理论相结合的多极涨落分析从4f1电子系统扩展到4f2电子系统。提出了两种方法论的发展。首先，在 j=5/2 子空间中的 j-j 耦合方案中构造多粒子态，以再现 4f² Hund 规则基态多重态的晶体电场分裂。其次，多极磁化率和 4f² 多重态之间的相互作用是通过从单粒子基础到多粒子基础的映射得出的。我们将此框架应用于具有非 Kramers γ₃ 双态基态的 PrCdNi₄，并提出了由最近邻和第四最近邻相互作用之间的竞争驱动的 (3z²-r²) 型反铁四极级顺序，其粗体符号 q=(2π,π,0)。这里开发的形式适用于一般的 4fⁿ 电子系统。

articles.title: The role of density in shaping electron trapping in amorphous silicon nitride
articles.title_zh: 密度在塑造非晶氮化硅电子俘获中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic properties of amorphous silicon nitride vary with processing, which often changes stoichiometry and density together. Separating their contributions is essential to connect film structure with electron trapping. Across 499 stoichiometric configurations spanning 2.86-3.19g cm⁻³, porosity controls the trapping mixture. Lower density increases accessible void fraction from 8.4 to 12.6%, expands internal surface and more than triples the supply of free three-coordinate Si precursors. Capture at pre-existing Si dangling bonds (K centres) rises from 9 to 29%, while induced-K and polaronic trapping decline. A neutral precursor fingerprint predicts the trapping mixture in held-out configurations and reproduces its density dependence. Local compensation controls K-centre activation, electronic competition selects capture, and bond strain predicts polaronic relaxation or induced-K formation. Routes involve distinct network volumes but retain their characteristic depths and relaxation energies across the density range. At fixed stoichiometry, density controls the trapping mixture through porosity and precursor availability.
articles.abstract_zh: 非晶氮化硅的电子特性随着加工而变化，这通常会同时改变化学计量和密度。分离它们的贡献对于将薄膜结构与电子捕获联系起来至关重要。在 2.86-3.19g cm-3 的 499 种化学计量配置中，孔隙率控制着捕获混合物。较低的密度将可接近的空隙率从 8.4% 增加到 12.6%，扩大了内表面，并将游离三配位 Si 前驱体的供应量增加了三倍以上。预先存在的 Si 悬挂键（K 中心）的捕获率从 9% 上升至 29%，而诱导 K 和极化子捕获则下降。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非晶氮化硅的电子特性随着加工而变化，这通常会同时改变化学计量和密度。分离它们的贡献对于将薄膜结构与电子捕获联系起来至关重要。在 2.86-3.19g cm-3 的 499 种化学计量配置中，孔隙率控制着捕获混合物。较低的密度将可接近的空隙率从 8.4% 增加到 12.6%，扩大了内表面，并将游离三配位 Si 前驱体的供应量增加了三倍以上。预先存在的 Si 悬挂键（K 中心）的捕获率从 9% 上升至 29%，而诱导 K 和极化子捕获则下降。中性前体指纹预测保留配置中的捕获混合物并重现其密度依赖性。局部补偿控制 K 中心激活，电子竞争选择捕获，键应变预测极化弛豫或诱导 K 形成。路线涉及不同的网络体积，但在整个密度范围内保留其特征深度和弛豫能量。在固定的化学计量下，密度通过孔隙率和前体可用性控制捕获混合物。

articles.title: Robust skyrmion nucleation and transport via composition gradient in rare earth-transition metal ferrimagnets
articles.title_zh: 稀土-过渡金属亚铁磁体中通过成分梯度实现稳健的斯格明子成核和传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions are typically nucleated via localized excitation methods, such as laser heating, spin-orbit torques, or engineered defects, and their controlled transport is often limited by the skyrmion Hall effect. Here, we demonstrate that spatial gradients in rare-earth--transition-metal alloys, achievable through patterned laser writing, enable both deterministic nucleation and controlled transport. The strategy leverages engineered compositional gradient to cross the magnetization compensation point, defining regions with opposite magnetization. An out-of-plane magnetic field selectively reverses the magnetization, generating a skyrmion. Crucially, the same compositional design enables a channel tuned to the spin angular momentum compensation point, where skyrmions are driven by spin-orbit torques at high velocity with vanishing skyrmion Hall effect. Local composition variations act as pinning sites, enabling threshold-controlled trapping and release.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性斯格明子通常通过局部激发方法成核，例如激光加热、自旋轨道扭矩或工程缺陷，并且它们的受控传输通常受到斯格明子霍尔效应的限制。在这里，我们证明了稀土过渡金属合金中的空间梯度可以通过图案化激光写入实现，从而实现确定性成核和受控输运。该策略利用工程成分梯度穿过磁化补偿点，定义具有相反磁化的区域。面外磁场选择性地反转磁化，产生斯格明子。至关重要的是，相同的组合设计使得通道能够调谐到自旋角动量补偿点，其中斯格明子由高速自旋轨道扭矩驱动，并且斯格明子霍尔效应消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性斯格明子通常通过局部激发方法成核，例如激光加热、自旋轨道扭矩或工程缺陷，并且它们的受控传输通常受到斯格明子霍尔效应的限制。在这里，我们证明了稀土过渡金属合金中的空间梯度可以通过图案化激光写入实现，从而实现确定性成核和受控输运。该策略利用工程成分梯度穿过磁化补偿点，定义具有相反磁化的区域。面外磁场选择性地反转磁化，产生斯格明子。至关重要的是，相同的组合设计使得通道能够调谐到自旋角动量补偿点，其中斯格明子由高速自旋轨道扭矩驱动，并且斯格明子霍尔效应消失。局部成分变化充当固定位点，实现阈值控制的捕获和释放。

articles.title: Mode-selective electron-phonon coupling drives charge density waves in the kagome metals YRu₃Si₂ and LaRu₃Si₂
articles.title_zh: 模式选择性电子声子耦合驱动 Kagome 金属 YRu₃Si 和 LaRu₃Si 中的电荷密度波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11689v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: YRu₃Si₂ and LaRu₃Si₂ host the highest charge density wave (CDW) transition temperatures ever reported in kagome metals, TCDWapprox 800 and 400~K, with propagation vectors QCDWapprox(1/2,0,0) and (1/4,0,0), respectively. The microscopic mechanism behind these record values has remained unresolved. Here, we combine anharmonic phonon renormalization extracted from molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned force field with mode-resolved electron-phonon coupling (EPC) analysis to identify this mechanism. The CDW is driven by mode-selective EPC: the Ru out-of-plane phonon modes couple the Ru-dₓz/dyz and Si-pₓ/p_y orbitals, and the phonon linewidth peaks sharply at QCDW, while the featureless electronic susceptibility rules out Fermi-surface nesting. Phonon anharmonicity melts the CDW, and the anharmonic phonon spectra reproduce both QCDW and TCDW in good agreement with experiments. Molecular dynamics simulations also visualize the CDW melting in real space. Chemical bonding analysis further shows that the smaller Y³⁺ radius strengthens the Ru-Ru bonds, enhancing lattice rigidity and accounting for the factor-of-two higher TCDW of YRu₃Si₂. Our results establish a unified microscopic picture of CDW formation and melting in kagome metals YRu₃Si₂ and LaRu₃Si₂.
articles.abstract_zh: YRu3Si2 和 LaRu3Si2 具有 Kagome 金属中报道的最高电荷密度波 (CDW) 转变温度，TCDWapprox 800 和 400~K，传播矢量分别为 QCDWapprox(1/2,0,0) 和 (1/4,0,0)。这些记录值背后的微观机制仍未解决。在这里，我们将从机器学习力场驱动的分子动力学中提取的非谐波声子重正化与模式分辨电子声子耦合（EPC）分析结合起来，以确定这种机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: YRu3Si2 和 LaRu3Si2 具有 Kagome 金属中报道的最高电荷密度波 (CDW) 转变温度，TCDWapprox 800 和 400~K，传播矢量分别为 QCDWapprox(1/2,0,0) 和 (1/4,0,0)。这些记录值背后的微观机制仍未解决。在这里，我们将从机器学习力场驱动的分子动力学中提取的非谐波声子重正化与模式分辨电子声子耦合（EPC）分析结合起来，以确定这种机制。 CDW 由模式选择性 EPC 驱动：Ru 面外声子模式耦合 Ru-dₓz/dyz 和 Si-pₓ/p_y 轨道，声子线宽在 QCDW 处急剧峰值，而无特征的电子磁化率排除了费米表面嵌套。声子非谐性融化了 CDW，非谐声子谱再现了 QCDW 和 TCDW，与实验非常吻合。分子动力学模拟还可以可视化真实空间中 CDW 的熔化。化学键分析进一步表明，较小的 Y3⁺ 半径增强了 Ru-Ru 键，提高了晶格刚性，并导致 YRu₃Si2 的 TCDW 提高了两倍。我们的结果建立了 Kagome 金属 YRu₃Si2 和 LaRu₃Si2 中 CDW 形成和熔化的统一显微图像。

articles.title: Predicting plasmonic pole representations of complex dielectric spectra using convolutional neural networks
articles.title_zh: 使用卷积神经网络预测复杂介电谱的等离子体极表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extracting spectral properties such as energy position, broadening, and spectral weight from dielectric spectra is critical for interpreting collective electronic excitations in many-body physics. Conventional approaches typically rely on nonlinear fitting procedures that can be computationally demanding and highly sensitive to initialization and fitting choices. In this work, we develop a convolutional neural-network framework for the direct inversion of dielectric spectra into their underlying plasmonic pole structures using a multipole-Padé representation. Rather than training on a constrained database of spectra associated with a specific set of materials, the network is trained entirely on synthetic spectra generated from the analytical multipole-Padé expression with randomized parameters. This enables the network to learn the general mapping between the spectra and their features in an unbiased way, without requiring large, material-specific datasets derived from real materials. We demonstrate that the synthetically trained network generalizes to complex first-principles and experimental dielectric spectra, extracting the underlying pole parameters with high accuracy in a single forward pass. This approach provides an efficient and robust alternative to conventional nonlinear fitting, enabling high-throughput, automated analysis of dielectric spectra across diverse materials and applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 从介电谱中提取能量位置、展宽和光谱权重等光谱特性对于解释多体物理学中的集体电子激发至关重要。传统方法通常依赖于非线性拟合过程，该过程可能需要大量计算，并且对初始化和拟合选择高度敏感。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个卷积神经网络框架，用于使用多极帕德表示将介电谱直接反演为其底层等离子体极结构。该网络不是在与一组特定材料相关的受限光谱数据库上进行训练，而是完全根据具有随机参数的分析多极-Padé 表达式生成的合成光谱进行训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从介电谱中提取能量位置、展宽和光谱权重等光谱特性对于解释多体物理学中的集体电子激发至关重要。传统方法通常依赖于非线性拟合过程，该过程可能需要大量计算，并且对初始化和拟合选择高度敏感。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个卷积神经网络框架，用于使用多极帕德表示将介电谱直接反演为其底层等离子体极结构。该网络不是在与一组特定材料相关的受限光谱数据库上进行训练，而是完全根据具有随机参数的分析多极-Padé 表达式生成的合成光谱进行训练。这使得网络能够以公正的方式学习光谱及其特征之间的一般映射，而不需要从真实材料中派生的大型、特定于材料的数据集。我们证明，经过综合训练的网络可推广到复杂的第一原理和实验介电谱，在单次前向传递中高精度地提取基础极参数。这种方法为传统非线性拟合提供了一种高效、稳健的替代方案，能够对不同材料和应用的介电谱进行高通量、自动化分析。

articles.title: Electric and Heat Transport in One-Dimensional SNS Junctions with Energy-Dependent Transmission
articles.title_zh: 一维 SNS 结点中具有能量依赖传输的电和热传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the phase-independent dc components of the electric and heat currents through a one-dimensional superconductor-normal-metal-superconductor (SNS) junction subject to chemical-potential and temperature differences between two superconducting reservoirs. Using a scattering approach based on the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations, we incorporate multiple Andreev reflections while retaining the energy dependence of transmission through the normal region. We compare energy-independent, quantum-dot-type, and quantum-point-contact transmission profiles. At low bias, both currents exhibit nonlinear features associated with the superconducting gap and multiple Andreev reflections. Their responses to a temperature difference depend remarkably on the transmission profile. At a small finite bias, the electric current depends weakly on the temperature difference for the energy-independent and quantum-dot-type profiles, whereas the quantum-point-contact profile produces a pronounced nonlinear response. The heat current depends nonlinearly on the temperature difference for all three profiles over the parameter range investigated. These results highlight the role of the transmission profile in nonlinear electric and heat transport through SNS junctions and provide a microscopic reference for related transport studies in mesoscopic fermionic superfluid junctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了通过一维超导体-普通金属-超导体（SNS）结的电流和热流的与相位无关的直流分量，该结受到两个超导储层之间的化学势和温度差的影响。使用基于 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程的散射方法，我们合并了多个 Andreev 反射，同时保留了通过法线区域的传输的能量依赖性。我们比较了能量无关型、量子点型和量子点接触型传输曲线。在低偏置下，两种电流都表现出与超导间隙和多次安德烈夫反射相关的非线性特征。它们对温差的响应很大程度上取决于传输曲线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了通过一维超导体-普通金属-超导体（SNS）结的电流和热流的与相位无关的直流分量，该结受到两个超导储层之间的化学势和温度差的影响。使用基于 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方程的散射方法，我们合并了多个 Andreev 反射，同时保留了通过法线区域的传输的能量依赖性。我们比较了能量无关型、量子点型和量子点接触型传输曲线。在低偏置下，两种电流都表现出与超导间隙和多次安德烈夫反射相关的非线性特征。它们对温差的响应很大程度上取决于传输曲线。在较小的有限偏置下，能量无关型和量子点型分布的电流对温差的依赖较弱，而量子点接触分布则产生明显的非线性响应。热流非线性地取决于所研究的参数范围内所有三个曲线的温差。这些结果突出了传输剖面在通过SNS结的非线性电和热传输中的作用，并为介观费米子超流结的相关传输研究提供了微观参考。

articles.title: Interlayer ferromagnetic order revealed through pressure-enhanced interlayer exchange coupling in Fe₃GaTe₂
articles.title_zh: 通过 Fe₃GaTe2 中压力增强层间交换耦合揭示层间铁磁序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Van der Waals ferromagnets possess finite interlayer magnetic coupling despite their layered crystal structures, and this coupling plays an important role in determining their magnetic properties. In this study, we performed magnetization measurements on high-quality Fe₃GaTe₂ single crystals while selectively tuning the interlayer coupling using hydrostatic pressure. We identified two characteristic temperatures, Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₁ and Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₂, below the Curie temperature with opposite pressure dependences: Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₁ is associated with thermally activated domain-wall depinning, whereas Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₂ reflects the formation of interlayer ferromagnetic order. Both temperatures exhibit pronounced pressure dependences, in sharp contrast to the nearly pressure-independent Curie temperature associated with intralayer ferromagnetic order. First-principles calculations revealed a substantial pressure-induced enhancement of the interlayer exchange interaction and reasonably reproduced Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₂ and its pressure dependence. These results demonstrate that the emergence of interlayer magnetic ordering can be predicted from the microscopic interlayer exchange coupling, establishing a predictive framework for understanding and designing interlayer coupling phenomena in layered magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华铁磁体尽管具有层状晶体结构，但仍具有有限的层间磁耦合，这种耦合在决定其磁性能方面起着重要作用。在这项研究中，我们对高质量 Fe₃GaTe2 单晶进行磁化测量，同时使用静水压力选择性地调整层间耦合。我们确定了两个低于居里温度且具有相反压力依赖性的特征温度 Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₁ 和 Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf2：Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₁ 与热激活磁畴壁脱钉相关，而 Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₂ 则反映了层间铁磁有序的形成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德华铁磁体尽管具有层状晶体结构，但仍具有有限的层间磁耦合，这种耦合在决定其磁性能方面起着重要作用。在这项研究中，我们对高质量 Fe₃GaTe2 单晶进行磁化测量，同时使用静水压力选择性地调整层间耦合。我们确定了两个低于居里温度且具有相反压力依赖性的特征温度 Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₁ 和 Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf2：Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₁ 与热激活磁畴壁脱钉相关，而 Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf₂ 则反映了层间铁磁有序的形成。两个温度都表现出明显的压力依赖性，与与层内铁磁有序相关的几乎与压力无关的居里温度形成鲜明对比。第一原理计算揭示了压力引起的层间交换相互作用的显着增强，并合理地再现了 Tᵣₘ ᵢₙf2 及其压力依赖性。这些结果表明，层间磁序的出现可以从微观层间交换耦合中预测，为理解和设计层状磁性材料中的层间耦合现象建立了预测框架。

articles.title: Can end-to-end learning from raw electronic structure explain magnetic anisotropy?
articles.title_zh: 从原始电子结构中进行端到端学习可以解释磁各向异性吗？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning models trained directly on electronic spectra can predict spin--orbit-driven properties, yet models with comparable predictive accuracy may learn different electronic dependencies. We examine this problem using magnetic anisotropy in atomic-scale magnets and a validation strategy designed to assess the physical relevance of learned spectral relationships. We compare a bidirectional gated recurrent unit and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network, both trained to predict magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) from spin- and orbital-resolved scalar-relativistic densities of states (SR-DOS). Despite comparable in-domain (ID) accuracy, the architectures learn only partly overlapping spectral dependencies. Shapley additive explanations identify spectral features shared between the two architectures that can be associated with plausible spin--orbit-coupling pathways consistent with second-order perturbation theory (PT2). Adding PT2-derived MAE contributions to the model inputs has little effect on ID performance but can improve transfer beyond the training domain, with gains differing between architectures. Controlled spectral perturbations further demonstrate that similar attribution patterns do not imply the same functional dependence of the predicted MAE on spectral weight. The contrasting responses provide a functional context for architecture-dependent out-of-domain transfer. End-to-end learning can identify candidate electronic signatures of magnetic anisotropy. Their credible microscopic interpretation, however, rests on convergent evidence from predictive performance, model comparison, physical theory, controlled spectral interventions, and evaluation under distribution shift.
articles.abstract_zh: 直接在电子光谱上训练的机器学习模型可以预测自旋轨道驱动的特性，而具有相当预测精度的模型可以学习不同的电子依赖性。我们使用原子级磁体中的磁各向异性和旨在评估所学习的光谱关系的物理相关性的验证策略来研究这个问题。我们比较了双向门控循环单元和一维卷积神经网络，两者都经过训练以根据自旋和轨道解析的标量相对论密度（SR-DOS）预测磁各向异性能量（MAE）。尽管域内 (ID) 精度相当，但这些架构仅学习部分重叠的频谱依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 直接在电子光谱上训练的机器学习模型可以预测自旋轨道驱动的特性，而具有相当预测精度的模型可以学习不同的电子依赖性。我们使用原子级磁体中的磁各向异性和旨在评估所学习的光谱关系的物理相关性的验证策略来研究这个问题。我们比较了双向门控循环单元和一维卷积神经网络，两者都经过训练以根据自旋和轨道解析的标量相对论密度（SR-DOS）预测磁各向异性能量（MAE）。尽管域内 (ID) 精度相当，但这些架构仅学习部分重叠的频谱依赖性。沙普利附加解释确定了两种架构之间共享的光谱特征，这些特征可能与符合二阶微扰理论 (PT2) 的合理自旋轨道耦合路径相关。将 PT2 派生的 MAE 贡献添加到模型输入对 ID 性能几乎没有影响，但可以改善训练域之外的传输，并且不同架构之间的增益不同。受控的光谱扰动进一步表明，相似的归因模式并不意味着预测的 MAE 对光谱权重具有相同的功能依赖性。对比响应为依赖于体系结构的域外传输提供了功能上下文。端到端学习可以识别磁各向异性的候选电子签名。然而，他们可信的微观解释依赖于来自预测性能、模型比较、物理理论、受控光谱干预和分布变化下评估的聚合证据。

articles.title: Photoinduced Odd- and Mixed-Parity Magnetism in Collinear Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 共线反铁磁体中的光致奇偶校验和混合奇偶校验磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism, characterized by compensated collinear magnetic moments in real space and momentum-dependent spin splitting with even-parity symmetry, has recently emerged as a distinct form of magnetic order beyond the conventional ferro- and antiferromagnetic paradigms. However, realizing odd- and mixed-parity magnetism in fully compensated collinear magnets remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that light irradiation can induce odd- and mixed-parity magnetism in conventional collinear antiferromagnets. Taking monolayer CoS and CoSe as representative systems, and combining Floquet theory with first-principles calculations, we show that circularly polarized light (CPL) induces odd-parity f-wave spin splitting, whereas elliptically polarized light (EPL) induces odd-parity p-wave spin splitting. Uniaxial strain combined with CPL provides an alternative route to realizing the p-wave state. More remarkably, applying an electric field together with CPL or EPL transforms the spin splitting into mixed-parity forms. The light-induced breaking of PT symmetry, together with spin-orbit coupling, further gives rise to a finite anomalous Hall response. Our work establishes a versatile strategy for engineering odd- and mixed-parity spin splitting in compensated antiferromagnets, offering a route toward light-controlled electronic and magnetic phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁学的特点是实空间中补偿的共线磁矩和具有偶宇称对称性的动量相关自旋分裂，最近已成为超越传统铁磁和反铁磁范式的独特磁序形式。然而，在完全补偿的共线磁体中实现奇偶校验和混合奇偶校验磁性仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明光照射可以在传统的共线反铁磁体中诱发奇偶校验和混合奇偶校验磁性。以单层CoS和CoSe为代表体系，结合Floquet理论和第一性原理计算，我们发现圆偏振光（CPL）会引发奇宇称f波自旋分裂，而椭圆偏振光（EPL）会引发奇宇称p波自旋分裂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁学的特点是实空间中补偿的共线磁矩和具有偶宇称对称性的动量相关自旋分裂，最近已成为超越传统铁磁和反铁磁范式的独特磁序形式。然而，在完全补偿的共线磁体中实现奇偶校验和混合奇偶校验磁性仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明光照射可以在传统的共线反铁磁体中诱发奇偶校验和混合奇偶校验磁性。以单层CoS和CoSe为代表体系，结合Floquet理论和第一性原理计算，我们发现圆偏振光（CPL）会引发奇宇称f波自旋分裂，而椭圆偏振光（EPL）会引发奇宇称p波自旋分裂。单轴应变与 CPL 相结合提供了实现 p 波态的替代途径。更值得注意的是，与 CPL 或 EPL 一起施加电场可将自旋分裂转化为混合宇称形式。光诱导的 PT 对称性破缺与自旋轨道耦合一起进一步产生有限的反常霍尔响应。我们的工作建立了一种通用策略，用于在补偿反铁磁体中设计奇数和混合奇偶校验自旋分裂，为光控电子和磁现象提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Magnon band splitting without altermagnetism in CuF2
articles.title_zh: CuF2 中无交变磁性的磁振子能带分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conclusive identification of an altermagnetic state requires going beyond mere symmetry arguments. We illustrate this in a combined computational and experimental study of the rutile-like material CuF₂, which is on the list of predicted altermagnets. Using ab initio and linear spin-wave calculations supplied by magnetization measurements, we show that CuF₂ in its experimental monoclinic structure can be described by a spin-frac12 model of weakly coupled square-lattice layers with the in-plane coupling J₁simeq 115 K and two synergistic antiferromagnetic interplane couplings amounting to 4% and 8% of J₁, respectively. Driven by long-range superexchange, these interlayer couplings are oblique to the square planes, resulting in the unit-cell doubling in the magnetically ordered state, thus effectively suppressing any altermagnetic band splitting. Concurrently, we identify unusually strong Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, |mathbf D|/J₁simeq 0.3, that produce spin canting and, together with order-by-disorder effect, pin the Néel vector to the crystallographic b-axis. Additionally, DM anisotropy promotes magnon band splitting, but these bands remain non-chiral. Our results highlight the importance of relativistic effects even in 3d magnets with altermagnetic symmetries.
articles.abstract_zh: 对交变磁态的最终识别需要超越单纯的对称性论证。我们通过对类金红石材料 CuF 的综合计算和实验研究来说明这一点，CuF 是预测的交变磁体之一。利用磁化测量提供的从头算和线性自旋波计算，我们表明实验单斜结构中的 CuF2 可以通过弱耦合方晶格层的自旋 frac12 模型来描述，面内耦合 J₁simeq 115 K 和两个协同反铁磁面间耦合分别相当于 J₁ 的 4% 和 8%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对交变磁态的最终识别需要超越单纯的对称性论证。我们通过对类金红石材料 CuF 的综合计算和实验研究来说明这一点，CuF 是预测的交变磁体之一。利用磁化测量提供的从头算和线性自旋波计算，我们表明实验单斜结构中的 CuF2 可以通过弱耦合方晶格层的自旋 frac12 模型来描述，面内耦合 J₁simeq 115 K 和两个协同反铁磁面间耦合分别相当于 J₁ 的 4% 和 8%。在长程超交换的驱动下，这些层间耦合与方形平面倾斜，导致晶胞在磁有序状态下加倍，从而有效抑制任何交变磁带分裂。同时，我们发现了异常强烈的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用，|mathbf D|/J₁simeq 0.3，它产生自旋倾斜，并与无序效应一起将 Néel 矢量固定到晶体 b 轴。此外，DM 各向异性促进磁振子带分裂，但这些带仍然是非手性的。我们的结果强调了相对论效应的重要性，即使是在具有交变磁对称性的 3D 磁体中也是如此。

articles.title: Tunable Ultrastrong Magnon-Magnon Coupling and Squeezed States in a Triaxial Van der Waals Antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 三轴范德华反铁磁体中的可调谐超强磁振子-磁振子耦合和压缩态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving and quantifying ultrastrong magnon-magnon coupling (USC) remains a key challenge for quantum magnonics. Here, we demonstrate widely tunable USC between chiral (right- and left-handed) and acoustic or optical magnon modes in the van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS₄. Using a full quantum model, we decompose the interaction into three microscopic interaction channels: the co-rotating term g₁ (mode hybridization), the counter-rotating term g₂ (two-mode squeezing), and, uniquely in the chiral regime, the self-squared term g₃ that mediates single-mode squeezing. The normalized coupling ratio reaches g/f_g sim 0.41, entering the USC regime. Most significantly, we establish a complete protocol linking these USC parameters to a measurable quantum phenomenon: a squeezed magnon vacuum state. Our simulations not only visualize the chirality and polarization evolution of the hybrid modes but also demonstrate how to directly extract quadrature fluctuations and a substantial squeezing factor (up to sim 9.7 dB) from thermal noise-driven magnetization dynamics. This work provides a material-specific quantum framework for USC and a practical pathway to detect and exploit non-classical magnon states in low-damping two-dimensional magnets, opening a route toward quantum-enhanced spintronics and hybrid quantum information platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现并量化超强磁振子-磁振子耦合（USC）仍然是量子磁振子学的一个关键挑战。在这里，我们展示了范德华反铁磁体 CrPS₄ 中手性（右手和左手）和声或光学磁振子模式之间广泛可调的 USC。使用完整的量子模型，我们将相互作用分解为三个微观相互作用通道：同向旋转项 g₁（模式杂化）、反向旋转项 g2（双模挤压），以及在手性区域中独特的介导单模挤压的自平方项 g₃。归一化耦合比达到g/f_g sim 0.41，进入USC状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现并量化超强磁振子-磁振子耦合（USC）仍然是量子磁振子学的一个关键挑战。在这里，我们展示了范德华反铁磁体 CrPS₄ 中手性（右手和左手）和声或光学磁振子模式之间广泛可调的 USC。使用完整的量子模型，我们将相互作用分解为三个微观相互作用通道：同向旋转项 g₁（模式杂化）、反向旋转项 g2（双模挤压），以及在手性区域中独特的介导单模挤压的自平方项 g₃。归一化耦合比达到g/f_g sim 0.41，进入USC状态。最重要的是，我们建立了一个完整的协议，将这些 USC 参数与可测量的量子现象：压缩磁振子真空态联系起来。我们的模拟不仅可视化混合模式的手性和偏振演化，还演示了如何从热噪声驱动的磁化动力学中直接提取正交波动和实质性压缩因子（高达 sim 9.7 dB）。这项工作为南加州大学提供了一个特定于材料的量子框架，以及检测和利用低阻尼二维磁体中的非经典磁振子态的实用途径，为量子增强自旋电子学和混合量子信息平台开辟了一条道路。

articles.title: Benchmarking Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials for Temperature-Dependent Elasticity of Binary and High-Entropy Refractory Carbides
articles.title_zh: 二元和高熵难熔碳化物温度相关弹性的通用机器学习原子间势的基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11878v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate prediction of temperature-dependent elasticity is important for assessing refractory carbides under high-temperature conditions, but the computational cost of ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) limits systematic investigations across compositions and temperatures. Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) offer an efficient alternative, yet their accuracy for this task remains insufficiently established. Here, we benchmark nine uMLIPs against consistent AIMD reference data for five binary and two high-entropy (HE) carbides between 300 and 1200 K. Elastic constants and the corresponding bulk, shear, and Young's moduli are obtained using stress-strain molecular dynamics, explicitly sampling thermal atomic motion and anharmonic effects beyond thermal expansion alone. We assess absolute elastic properties and normalized thermal softening separately. MACE-MH-1 achieves the lowest overall mean absolute percentage error (5.7%). MACE-MH-1 and DPA4-Mini reproduce thermal softening most accurately, with mean deviations of 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points, respectively. All models generally underestimate stiffness, with larger equilibrium volumes relative to the AIMD reference likely contributing to this trend for most models. C12 exhibits the largest model-dependent errors. The HE carbides are described with accuracy comparable to that of the binary carbides, indicating no apparent accuracy penalty from chemical complexity. Accuracy instead varies with transition-metal composition, with group-V carbides, particularly TaC, presenting the greatest challenge. These results identify promising pretrained models for finite-temperature elasticity in carbides and show why accurate absolute stiffness and thermal softening must be assessed independently.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确预测与温度相关的弹性对于评估高温条件下的难熔碳化物非常重要，但从头算分子动力学 (AIMD) 的计算成本限制了跨成分和温度的系统研究。通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIP）提供了一种有效的替代方案，但其对该任务的准确性尚未充分确定。在这里，我们将九个 uMLIP 与 300 至 1200 K 之间的五种二元碳化物和两种高熵 (HE) 碳化物的一致 AIMD 参考数据进行基准测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确预测与温度相关的弹性对于评估高温条件下的难熔碳化物非常重要，但从头算分子动力学 (AIMD) 的计算成本限制了跨成分和温度的系统研究。通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIP）提供了一种有效的替代方案，但其对该任务的准确性尚未充分确定。在这里，我们将九个 uMLIP 与 300 至 1200 K 之间的五种二元碳化物和两种高熵 (HE) 碳化物的一致 AIMD 参考数据进行基准测试。弹性常数和相应的体积模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量是使用应力应变分子动力学获得的，明确采样了热原子运动和超出热膨胀范围的非谐波效应。我们分别评估绝对弹性和标准化热软化。 MACE-MH-1 实现了最低的总体平均绝对百分比误差 (5.7%)。 MACE-MH-1 和 DPA4-Mini 能够最准确地再现热软化，平均偏差分别为 2.5 个百分点和 2.3 个百分点。所有模型通常都会低估刚度，相对于 AIMD 参考而言较大的平衡体积可能会导致大多数模型出现这种趋势。 C12 表现出最大的模型相关误差。 HE 碳化物的描述精度与二元碳化物相当，表明化学复杂性没有明显的精度损失。相反，精度随过渡金属成分的不同而变化，其中 V 族碳化物，特别是 TaC，带来了最大的挑战。这些结果确定了碳化物有限温度弹性的有前景的预训练模型，并说明了为什么必须独立评估准确的绝对刚度和热软化。

articles.title: Beyond special quasirandom structures: free energies from energy cumulants
articles.title_zh: 超越特殊的准随机结构：来自能量累积量的自由能量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11882v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting the finite-temperature stability of a disordered phase requires its free energy. It is traditionally approximated by combining the energy of a special quasirandom structure (a small cell mimicking a random alloy) with the ideal configurational entropy. This approximation neglects the short-range order that develops on cooling. In this study, we show that the conventional approximation is the first term of an infinite expansion of the free energy in energy cumulants. Higher-order cumulants are estimated from energies of random arrangements, without Monte Carlo or molecular dynamics. In a nine-element refractory system, adding the second cumulant reduced free energy errors by about an order of magnitude. The expansion gives phase diagrams with order--disorder transitions, defect concentrations, and short-range order. To demonstrate its utility, we used a foundation interatomic potential to screen lithium-excess rocksalt oxides across 26 elements for synthesizable disordered phases rich in the Li₄ clusters needed for lithium percolation. The approach applies to any lattice and chemistry, and brings disordered phases within reach of routine screening.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测无序相的有限温度稳定性需要其自由能。传统上，它是通过将特殊准随机结构（模仿随机合金的小单元）的能量与理想构型熵相结合来近似的。这种近似忽略了冷却时产生的短程有序。在这项研究中，我们证明传统近似是能量累积量中自由能无限展开的第一项。高阶累积量是根据随机排列的能量来估计的，无需蒙特卡罗或分子动力学。在九元耐火材料系统中，添加第二累积量可将自由能误差减少大约一个数量级。展开式给出了具有有序-无序转变、缺陷浓度和短程有序的相图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测无序相的有限温度稳定性需要其自由能。传统上，它是通过将特殊准随机结构（模仿随机合金的小单元）的能量与理想构型熵相结合来近似的。这种近似忽略了冷却时产生的短程有序。在这项研究中，我们证明传统近似是能量累积量中自由能无限展开的第一项。高阶累积量是根据随机排列的能量来估计的，无需蒙特卡罗或分子动力学。在九元耐火材料系统中，添加第二累积量可将自由能误差减少大约一个数量级。展开式给出了具有有序-无序转变、缺陷浓度和短程有序的相图。为了证明其实用性，我们使用基础原子间势来筛选 26 种元素的锂过量岩盐氧化物，以获得富含锂渗滤所需的 Li₄ 簇的可合成无序相。该方法适用于任何晶格和化学，并使无序相处于常规筛选的范围内。

articles.title: Comprehensive study of massively overlapping cascades in common elemental metals
articles.title_zh: 常见元素金属中大规模重叠级联的综合研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Massively overlapping cascades simulations were carried out in 21 elemental metals: Be, Al, Ti, V, Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zr, Nb, Mo, Rh, Pd, Ag, Hf, Ta, W, Pt, Au and Pb. These elements have simple FCC, BCC and HCP lattice structures. For each element, 2000 cumulative 5 keV cascades were simulated using molecular dynamics. The overlapping cascades were simulated using various classical analytical interatomic potentials as well as with machine-learning interatomic potentials for many of the elements. The general conclusion is that results from massively overlapping cascades simulations are very sensitive to the choice of interatomic potential across the periodic table. Furthermore, we see that FCC metals all form stacking fault tetrahedra due to irradiation, and also typically include interstitial type Shockley partial and Frank type dislocations. In BCC materials typically form interstitial 1/2langle1 1 1rangle dislocations, but vacancy type 1/2langle1 1 1rangle dislocations were also observed in V and Nb. HCP materials tend to form complex dislocation structures mainly consisting of a-type dislocations that can be of both vacancy or interstitial type. Correlations between saturated defect concentrations and fundamental underlying material properties are explored.
articles.abstract_zh: 对 21 种元素金属进行了大规模重叠级联模拟：Be、Al、Ti、V、Cr、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu、Zr、Nb、Mo、Rh、Pd、Ag、Hf、Ta、W、Pt、Au 和 Pb。这些元件具有简单的 FCC、BCC 和 HCP 晶格结构。对于每种元素，使用分子动力学模拟了 2000 个累积 5 keV 级联。使用各种经典分析原子间势以及许多元素的机器学习原子间势来模拟重叠级联。一般结论是，大规模重叠级联模拟的结果对整个周期表中原子间势的选择非常敏感。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对 21 种元素金属进行了大规模重叠级联模拟：Be、Al、Ti、V、Cr、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu、Zr、Nb、Mo、Rh、Pd、Ag、Hf、Ta、W、Pt、Au 和 Pb。这些元件具有简单的 FCC、BCC 和 HCP 晶格结构。对于每种元素，使用分子动力学模拟了 2000 个累积 5 keV 级联。使用各种经典分析原子间势以及许多元素的机器学习原子间势来模拟重叠级联。一般结论是，大规模重叠级联模拟的结果对整个周期表中原子间势的选择非常敏感。此外，我们看到FCC金属由于辐照而全部形成堆垛层错四面体，并且通常还包括间隙型肖克利部分位错和弗兰克型位错。在BCC材料中通常形成间隙型1/2langle1 1 1rangle位错，但在V和Nb中也观察到空位型1/2langle1 1 1rangle位错。 HCP材料往往形成复杂的位错结构，主要由a型位错组成，可以是空位型也可以是间隙型位错。探索了饱和缺陷浓度与基本材料特性之间的相关性。

articles.title: Mutual Linearity of Complexes in Chemical Reaction Networks
articles.title_zh: 化学反应网络中配合物的互线性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exact statements about how a system far from equilibrium responds to changes in its rate constants are scarce beyond linear response, yet they are central to the control of biochemical networks. A notable exception is mutual linearity: in a jump process, controlling the rates of a single transition makes any two stationary probabilities obey an exact affine relation, arbitrarily far from equilibrium. With nonlinear mass-action kinetics, and conservation laws in place of a normalization, chemical reaction networks seem to defy mutual linearity since species concentrations obey no such relation. We show that it was there all along, in the complexes' activities (mass-action monomials) rather than in the concentrations of species. For zero-deficiency networks with a single linkage class, controlling one reaction makes any three stationary activities obey a linear relation whose coefficients are independent of the controlled rate constants, the conserved quantities (hence the initial state), and even of the stoichiometry of complexes. This predicts hidden activities and bounds the activity ratios the control can reach, while a violation signals nonzero deficiency or multiple linkage classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 除了线性响应之外，关于远离平衡的系统如何响应其速率常数变化的精确陈述很少，但它们对于生化网络的控制至关重要。一个值得注意的例外是相互线性：在跳跃过程中，控制单个转变的速率使任何两个稳态概率服从精确的仿射关系，任意远离平衡。利用非线性质量作用动力学和守恒定律代替归一化，化学反应网络似乎违反了相互线性关系，因为物质浓度不遵守这种关系。我们证明它一直存在于复合体的活动（质量作用单项式）中，而不是存在于物种的浓度中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 除了线性响应之外，关于远离平衡的系统如何响应其速率常数变化的精确陈述很少，但它们对于生化网络的控制至关重要。一个值得注意的例外是相互线性：在跳跃过程中，控制单个转变的速率使任何两个稳态概率服从精确的仿射关系，任意远离平衡。利用非线性质量作用动力学和守恒定律代替归一化，化学反应网络似乎违反了相互线性关系，因为物质浓度不遵守这种关系。我们证明它一直存在于复合体的活动（质量作用单项式）中，而不是存在于物种的浓度中。对于具有单连接类别的零缺陷网络，控制一个反应使任何三个固定活性服从线性关系，其系数独立于受控速率常数、守恒量（因此是初始状态），甚至是复合物的化学计量。这可以预测隐藏的活动并限制控件可以达到的活动比率，而违规则表示非零缺陷或多个链接类别。

articles.title: Magnon dynamics driven by the symplectic quantum metric in a chiral soliton lattice
articles.title_zh: 手性孤子晶格中辛量子度量驱动的磁振子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the effects of quantum geometry on the motion of magnon wave packets in one-dimensional quantum spin chains. In contrast to fermionic systems, where transport phenomena driven by the quantum metric have been extensively studied, we show that the dynamics in bosonic magnon systems are strongly affected by the symplectic structure and the pseudo-unitarity of the transformation of the magnon Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian. A chiral soliton lattice provides a setting in which the symplectic quantum metric strongly influences the longitudinal magnon dynamics. We derive the semiclassical response of a magnon wave packet in such a system to a weak, slowly varying perturbation and demonstrate that the wave packet velocity acquires a geometric contribution proportional to the momentum derivative of the symplectic quantum metric, which dominates over the conventional group velocity for a nearly flat band. Solving the resulting equations of motion, we obtain a bounded trajectory in real time with a phase-space area determined by the symplectic quantum metric.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究量子几何对一维量子自旋链中磁振子波包运动的影响。与费米子系统相比，由量子度量驱动的输运现象已被广泛研究，我们表明，玻色磁子系统的动力学受到辛结构和磁子 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 哈密顿量变换的伪幺正性的强烈影响。手性孤子晶格提供了辛量子度量强烈影响纵向磁振子动力学的设置。我们推导了这种系统中磁振子波包对微弱、缓慢变化的扰动的半经典响应，并证明波包速度获得与辛量子度量的动量导数成正比的几何贡献，辛量子度量在近平带上优于传统的群速度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究量子几何对一维量子自旋链中磁振子波包运动的影响。与费米子系统相比，由量子度量驱动的输运现象已被广泛研究，我们表明，玻色磁子系统的动力学受到辛结构和磁子 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 哈密顿量变换的伪幺正性的强烈影响。手性孤子晶格提供了辛量子度量强烈影响纵向磁振子动力学的设置。我们推导了这种系统中磁振子波包对微弱、缓慢变化的扰动的半经典响应，并证明波包速度获得与辛量子度量的动量导数成正比的几何贡献，辛量子度量在近平带上优于传统的群速度。求解所得运动方程，我们实时获得有界轨迹，其相空间区域由辛量子度量确定。

articles.title: Multifunctional synaptic learning and neuromorphic computing using crystalline TiOₓ/NiOₓ heterojunction-based memory devices
articles.title_zh: 使用基于晶体 TiOₓ/NiOₓ 异质结的存储器件的多功能突触学习和神经形态计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11992v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An attempt is made here to mimic different properties of biological synapses using Ag/TiOₓ/NiOₓ/p⁺⁺-Si memristor structure by studying its different transport properties under dc and pulsed bias. The presence of crystalline NiOₓ with smaller gains is found to be helpful to get TiOₓ deposited on its top with crystalline properties and larger grains. The heterostructure offers stable bipolar forming free non-volatile resistive switching characteristics under reverse biased condition with gradual set and reset features. These devices are also able to successfully implement the classical Pavlov's learning, study artificial nociceptor and Morse code detection. While incorporating synaptic weights derived from the measured conductance programming pulse relationship, an artificial neural network achieves nearly 95% accuracy in MNIST digit recognition. In brief, NiOₓ/TiOₓ heterojunction plays the pivotal role in getting such reproducible I-V characteristics for mimicking different properties of biological synapses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文尝试通过研究 Ag/TiOₓ/NiOₓ/p⁺⁺-Si 忆阻器结构在直流和脉冲偏压下的不同传输特性来模拟生物突触的不同特性。研究发现，较小增益的结晶 NiOₓ 的存在有助于使 TiOₓ 沉积在其顶部，具有结晶特性和较大的晶粒。该异质结构在反向偏置条件下提供稳定的双极形成自由非易失性电阻开关特性，并具有逐渐置位和复位功能。这些设备还能够成功地实现经典巴甫洛夫学习、人工伤害感受器研究和摩尔斯电码检测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文尝试通过研究 Ag/TiOₓ/NiOₓ/p⁺⁺-Si 忆阻器结构在直流和脉冲偏压下的不同传输特性来模拟生物突触的不同特性。研究发现，较小增益的结晶 NiOₓ 的存在有助于使 TiOₓ 沉积在其顶部，具有结晶特性和较大的晶粒。该异质结构在反向偏置条件下提供稳定的双极形成自由非易失性电阻开关特性，并具有逐渐置位和复位功能。这些设备还能够成功地实现经典巴甫洛夫学习、人工伤害感受器研究和摩尔斯电码检测。在结合从测量的电导编程脉冲关系导出的突触权重时，人工神经网络在 MNIST 数字识别中实现了近 95% 的准确率。简而言之，NiOₓ/TiOₓ异质结在获得可重复的 I-V 特性以模仿生物突触的不同特性方面发挥着关键作用。

articles.title: Field-Free Reconfigurable Spin Logic in Compositionally Graded MnxCoAl Layer
articles.title_zh: 成分梯度 MnxCoAl 层中的无场可重构自旋逻辑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12018v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronic logic-in-memory provides a route to reducing data-transfer energy consumption and accelerating computation by integrating nonvolatile storage and logic functions within a single physical unit. Here, we investigate field-free spin-orbit-torque (SOT) switching and reconfigurable spin logic in a vertically composition-graded MnxCoAl/Pt heterostructure. In contrast to the uniform-composition Mn1.8CoAl/Pt and Mn2.5CoAl/Pt control devices, the Mn1.8-2.5CoAl gradient device exhibits deterministic SOT switching under zero external magnetic field. Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI)-related measurements reveal a finite characteristic effective-field scale, indicating the involvement of chiral magnetization-reversal processes. Meanwhile, the vertical composition gradient introduces magnetic inhomogeneity that can modify domain nucleation and propagation, and the combined effects are consistent with the observed field-free switching behavior. The composition-gradient device further exhibits accumulative multistate switching with stable intermediate Hall-resistance states under zero magnetic field, whereas the uniform-composition controls do not show comparable stable multistate behavior. By tailoring the amplitude, polarity, and sequence of current pulses, the device can be tuned between binary and multilevel switching modes, enabling the experimental realization of AND, OR, NAND, and NOR Boolean operations within the same Hall-bar device without any external magnetic field. These results extend Mn-Co-Al Heusler heterostructures from field-assisted SOT switching toward field-free magnetization control, multistate operation, and reconfigurable spin logic through vertical composition engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋电子内存逻辑通过将非易失性存储和逻辑功能集成在单个物理单元内，提供了一种减少数据传输能耗并加速计算的途径。在这里，我们研究了垂直成分分级的 MnxCoAl/Pt 异质结构中的无场自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT) 切换和可重构自旋逻辑。与均匀成分的 Mn1.8CoAl/Pt 和 Mn2.5CoAl/Pt 控制器件相比，Mn1.8-2.5CoAl 梯度器件在零外部磁场下表现出确定性的 SOT 开关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋电子内存逻辑通过将非易失性存储和逻辑功能集成在单个物理单元内，提供了一种减少数据传输能耗并加速计算的途径。在这里，我们研究了垂直成分分级的 MnxCoAl/Pt 异质结构中的无场自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT) 切换和可重构自旋逻辑。与均匀成分的 Mn1.8CoAl/Pt 和 Mn2.5CoAl/Pt 控制器件相比，Mn1.8-2.5CoAl 梯度器件在零外部磁场下表现出确定性的 SOT 开关。 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用（DMI）相关测量揭示了有限的特征有效场尺度，表明涉及手性磁化反转过程。同时，垂直成分梯度引入了磁不均匀性，可以改变磁畴成核和传播，并且综合效应与观察到的无场切换行为一致。成分梯度装置进一步表现出在零磁场下具有稳定的中间霍尔电阻状态的累积多态切换，而均匀成分控制没有表现出可比的稳定多态行为。通过定制电流脉冲的幅度、极性和序列，该器件可以在二进制和多级开关模式之间进行调整，从而能够在同一霍尔棒器件内实验性地实现 AND、OR、NAND 和 NOR 布尔运算，而无需任何外部磁场。这些结果将 Mn-Co-Al Heusler 异质结构从场辅助 SOT 切换扩展到无场磁化控制、多态操作以及通过垂直合成工程的可重构自旋逻辑。

articles.title: Symmetry-Dependent Polarity Reversal of Bulk Spin-Orbit Torque in Single-Layer MnCoGa
articles.title_zh: 单层 MnCoGa 中体自旋轨道扭矩的对称性相关极性反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12031v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling the magnitude and polarity of spin-orbit torque (SOT) is essential for manipulating magnetization in spintronic devices. Here, we realize bulk spin-orbit torque (SOT) in a single-layer Mn1.6Co1.4Ga (MCG) Heusler alloy and achieve lattice strain-controlled reversal of SOT polarity. SOT-driven magnetization switching is achieved over a thickness range of 3-20 nm, with the switching polarity reversed between the strongly strained ultrathin regime and thicker films. First-principles calculations reveal a sizable intrinsic spin Hall conductivity (SHC) in MCG originating from its topological band structure, which is enhanced by the tetragonal distortion without changing sign. Together with the thickness-dependent structural evolution, we demonstrate that the reversal of SOT polarity does not originate from a sign change of the SHC, but rather from lattice distortion induced symmetry breaking that modifies the conversion of spin current into a net bulk SOT, thereby controlling its polarity. These results establish strain-controlled structural symmetry as an additional degree of freedom for tuning bulk SOT in magnetic single layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 控制自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）的大小和极性对于操纵自旋电子器件中的磁化至关重要。在这里，我们在单层 Mn1.6Co1.4Ga (MCG) Heusler 合金中实现了体自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT)，并实现了晶格应变控制的 SOT 极性反转。 SOT 驱动的磁化强度切换在 3-20 nm 的厚度范围内实现，切换极性在强应变超薄区域和较厚的薄膜之间反转。第一性原理计算揭示了 MCG 中源自其拓扑能带结构的相当大的本征自旋霍尔电导率 (SHC)，该电导率通过四方畸变而不改变符号而增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 控制自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）的大小和极性对于操纵自旋电子器件中的磁化至关重要。在这里，我们在单层 Mn1.6Co1.4Ga (MCG) Heusler 合金中实现了体自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT)，并实现了晶格应变控制的 SOT 极性反转。 SOT 驱动的磁化强度切换在 3-20 nm 的厚度范围内实现，切换极性在强应变超薄区域和较厚的薄膜之间反转。第一性原理计算揭示了 MCG 中源自其拓扑能带结构的相当大的本征自旋霍尔电导率 (SHC)，该电导率通过四方畸变而不改变符号而增强。结合厚度相关的结构演化，我们证明 SOT 极性的反转并非源于 SHC 的符号变化，而是源于晶格畸变引起的对称性破缺，它改变了自旋电流向净体 SOT 的转换，从而控制了其极性。这些结果将应变控制的结构对称性确立为调整磁性单层体 SOT 的附加自由度。

articles.title: Emergent gold-induced interfacial magnetism in monolayer FePS₃
articles.title_zh: 单层 FePS₃ 中金诱导的界面磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Owing to their atomically clean interfaces and extreme thinness, two-dimensional (2D) materials are ideal hosts for strong proximity effects, whereby contact with an adjacent material reshapes their ground state. Here, we demonstrate such an effect within a hybrid heterostructure, between the 2D antiferromagnet FePS₃ and an ultrathin gold film. Rather than a passive support, the latter profoundly changes the nature of the magnetism in the 2D magnet, inducing a sizeable interfacial moment. Large-area flakes from Au-assisted exfoliation, combined with element-selective X-ray absorption mapping, enable a layer-by-layer study from monolayer to bulk, benchmarked against an inert SiO₂ substrate reference. At 9 T and 5 K, the monolayer on gold shows a three-fold enhanced X-ray magnetic circular dichroism relative to SiO₂, with a sim40% reduction of the orbital-to-spin moment ratio. Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering reveals a collapse of the crystal-field (d-d) excitations and a massive spectral-weight transfer to the charge-transfer region, unveiling the microscopic mechanism behind this change. Supported by atomic multiplet calculations, we identify interfacial charge transfer and Fe 3d-Au hybridization as the origin of these effects, which decay over the first three layers and vanish at the pentalayer, establishing layer number combined with substrate engineering as an atomically precise handle.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于其原子级清洁的界面和极薄的特性，二维 (2D) 材料是强邻近效应的理想主体，通过与邻近材料的接触重塑其基态。在这里，我们证明了二维反铁磁体 FePS₃ 和超薄金膜之间的混合异质结构中的这种效应。后者不是被动支撑，而是深刻改变了二维磁体的磁性性质，产生了相当大的界面力矩。 Au 辅助剥离产生的大面积薄片与元素选择性 X 射线吸收图谱相结合，能够以惰性 SiO2 基板为基准进行从单层到块体的逐层研究。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于其原子级清洁的界面和极薄的特性，二维 (2D) 材料是强邻近效应的理想主体，通过与邻近材料的接触重塑其基态。在这里，我们证明了二维反铁磁体 FePS₃ 和超薄金膜之间的混合异质结构中的这种效应。后者不是被动支撑，而是深刻改变了二维磁体的磁性性质，产生了相当大的界面力矩。 Au 辅助剥离产生的大面积薄片与元素选择性 X 射线吸收图谱相结合，能够以惰性 SiO2 基板为基准进行从单层到块体的逐层研究。在 9 T 和 5 K 下，金上的单分子层表现出相对于 SiO2 增强三倍的 X 射线磁圆二色性，轨道与自旋矩比降低了 sim40%。共振非弹性 X 射线散射揭示了晶体场 (d-d) 激发的崩溃以及向电荷转移区域的大量光谱权重转移，揭示了这种变化背后的微观机制。在原子多重计算的支持下，我们将界面电荷转移和 Fe 3d-Au 杂化确定为这些效应的根源，这些效应在前三层中衰减并在五层中消失，将层数与基底工程结合起来作为原子精确的处理。

articles.title: Field-resolved hierarchy of superconducting energy gaps in PdTe
articles.title_zh: PdTe 中超导能隙的场分辨层次
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resolving how multiple superconducting energy scales evolve under magnetic field is important for distinguishing multiband, anisotropic, and surface-sensitive superconducting responses. Here, we investigate the superconducting state of PdTe using low-temperature soft point-contact spectroscopy in a sealed ³He immersion environment. The resulting Andreev-reflection spectra reveal two characteristic superconducting energy scales near 0.5 and 1.1 meV that are not adequately described by a single-gap BTK model. Both energy scales are progressively suppressed upon warming toward the same superconducting transition temperature T_c. In contrast, their magnetic-field evolution reveals two distinct characteristic fields near 4.5 and 7.5 kG. The lower scale is associated with the loss of the zero-resistance superconducting state, whereas the higher-energy spectroscopic response persists to substantially larger fields. Independent field-dependent gap analysis yields suppression scales consistent with those identified from the zero-bias conductance. These results reveal a field-resolved hierarchy of superconducting energy scales in PdTe and indicate superconducting responses with distinct magnetic-field robustness.
articles.abstract_zh: 解决磁场下多个超导能尺度如何演化对于区分多带、各向异性和表面敏感的超导响应非常重要。在这里，我们在密封的氦气浸没环境中使用低温软点接触光谱研究了 PdTe 的超导状态。由此产生的安德烈夫反射光谱揭示了两个接近 0.5 和 1.1 meV 的特征超导能级，单能隙 BTK 模型无法充分描述这些能级。当升温至相同的超导转变温度 T_c 时，两个能级都逐渐受到抑制。相比之下，它们的磁场演化揭示了 4.5 kG 和 7.5 kG 附近的两个不同的特征场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 解决磁场下多个超导能尺度如何演化对于区分多带、各向异性和表面敏感的超导响应非常重要。在这里，我们在密封的氦气浸没环境中使用低温软点接触光谱研究了 PdTe 的超导状态。由此产生的安德烈夫反射光谱揭示了两个接近 0.5 和 1.1 meV 的特征超导能级，单能隙 BTK 模型无法充分描述这些能级。当升温至相同的超导转变温度 T_c 时，两个能级都逐渐受到抑制。相比之下，它们的磁场演化揭示了 4.5 kG 和 7.5 kG 附近的两个不同的特征场。较低的尺度与零电阻超导状态的丧失相关，而较高能量的光谱响应持续到更大的场。独立的场相关间隙分析产生的抑制尺度与从零偏置电导中确定的抑制尺度一致。这些结果揭示了 PdTe 中超导能量尺度的场分辨层次结构，并表明具有不同磁场鲁棒性的超导响应。

articles.title: A structure-preserving neural density functional for the ions of a polymer electrolyte
articles.title_zh: 聚合物电解质离子的结构保持神经密度函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting the structure and response of inhomogeneous polymer electrolytes requires a description of ion correlations that retains molecular-scale accuracy while remaining transferable across spatial scales and geometries. We develop a neural density functional for electrolytes that preserves spatial symmetries, thermodynamic integrability and the Noether identities, with perfect screening recovered in stable, noncritical bulk states. Its nonlinear density dependence captures the concentration-dependent correlations missed by a pair closure, including a crossover from enhanced to suppressed long-wavelength number fluctuations at strong coupling. The functional describes density profiles at an untrained salt concentration and predicts bulk structure factors and the long-wavelength number response. Trained solely on planar density and internal-force profiles from molecular dynamics, the functional predicts ionic structure in larger domains and in two-dimensional external fields. On the same ion data, it is more accurate than three other neural density-functional architectures and keeps its accuracy with a quarter of the training runs, where the errors of the best alternative grow by about two thirds. The spatial transferability provides a necessary foundation for connecting molecular correlations to continuum predictions at larger scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测非均质聚合物电解质的结构和响应需要对离子相关性的描述，该描述保留分子尺度的准确性，同时保持跨空间尺度和几何形状的可转移性。我们开发了一种适用于电解质的神经密度函数，可以保留空间对称性、热力学可积性和诺特恒等式，并在稳定、非临界的本体状态下恢复完美的筛选。其非线性密度依赖性捕获了对闭合所错过的浓度依赖性相关性，包括强耦合时从增强到抑制的长波长数波动的交叉。该函数描述了未经训练的盐浓度下的密度分布，并预测了体积结构因子和长波长数响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测非均质聚合物电解质的结构和响应需要对离子相关性的描述，该描述保留分子尺度的准确性，同时保持跨空间尺度和几何形状的可转移性。我们开发了一种适用于电解质的神经密度函数，可以保留空间对称性、热力学可积性和诺特恒等式，并在稳定、非临界的本体状态下恢复完美的筛选。其非线性密度依赖性捕获了对闭合所错过的浓度依赖性相关性，包括强耦合时从增强到抑制的长波长数波动的交叉。该函数描述了未经训练的盐浓度下的密度分布，并预测了体积结构因子和长波长数响应。仅根据分子动力学的平面密度和内力分布进行训练，该函数可以预测较大域和二维外部场中的离子结构。在相同的离子数据上，它比其他三种神经密度函数架构更准确，并且在四分之一的训练运行中保持其准确性，其中最佳替代方案的误差增长了约三分之二。空间可转移性为将分子相关性与更大尺度的连续预测联系起来提供了必要的基础。

articles.title: Direct Quantification of Molecular Helicity-Dependent Effective Magnetic Fields in Chiral Polypeptide/Ferromagnet Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 手性多肽/铁磁体异质结构中分子螺旋性相关有效磁场的直接定量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity (CISS) refers to structural chirality governing spin transport in chiral systems, with experimental signatures reported in both transport experiments and photoemission. Beyond influencing transport, recent experiments indicate that adsorbed chiral molecules can influence the magnetic state of adjacent ferromagnetic layers, suggesting the existence of chirality-induced effects whose origin and quantitative characterization remain lacking. Here, we investigate chirality-induced long-range magnetic interactions in a hybrid molecular/ferromagnetic multilayer beyond the conventional direct transport coupling. We demonstrate the long-range nature by decoupling the adsorbed chiral molecules from the magnet using an insulating spacer. We show that self-assembled monolayers of chiral polypeptides with a helical structure can act on a ferromagnetic multilayer via an enantiomer-dependent effective magnetic field that may be mediated by chiral phonons through the insulating layer. Using Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect (MOKE) microscopy with on-chip reference regions free of molecules, we directly quantify this field by measuring precisely the reproducible shifts of the local hysteresis loops. The extracted effective field reverses sign for opposite enantiomers and correlates with the enantiomeric excess. These results provide a direct and quantitative link between molecular chirality and magnetic response in hybrid heterostructures, establishing an experimentally accessible benchmark for a CISS-related effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）是指控制手性系统中自旋输运的结构手性，在输运实验和光电发射中报告了实验特征。除了影响传输之外，最近的实验表明，吸附的手性分子可以影响相邻铁磁层的磁性状态，这表明手性诱导效应的存在，其起源和定量表征仍然缺乏。在这里，我们研究了混合分子/铁磁多层中手性诱导的长程磁相互作用，超越了传统的直接传输耦合。我们通过使用绝缘垫片将吸附的手性分子与磁体解耦来证明长程性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）是指控制手性系统中自旋输运的结构手性，在输运实验和光电发射中报告了实验特征。除了影响传输之外，最近的实验表明，吸附的手性分子可以影响相邻铁磁层的磁性状态，这表明手性诱导效应的存在，其起源和定量表征仍然缺乏。在这里，我们研究了混合分子/铁磁多层中手性诱导的长程磁相互作用，超越了传统的直接传输耦合。我们通过使用绝缘垫片将吸附的手性分子与磁体解耦来证明长程性质。我们证明，具有螺旋结构的手性多肽的自组装单层可以通过对映异构体依赖的有效磁场作用于铁磁多层，该磁场可能由手性声子通过绝缘层介导。使用磁光克尔效应 (MOKE) 显微镜和不含分子的片上参考区域，我们通过精确测量局部磁滞回线的可重复位移来直接量化该场。提取的有效场反转相反对映体的符号，并与对映体过量相关。这些结果提供了混合异质结构中分子手性和磁响应之间的直接定量联系，为 CISS 相关效应建立了实验上可访问的基准。

articles.title: Specialized machine learning force fields for materials dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于材料动力学的专业机器学习力场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are transforming atomistic simulations by accessing unprecedented length and time scales. While pretrained equivariant graph neural networks achieve robust zero-shot performance for near-equilibrium properties across broad chemical spaces, their translation to complex materials dynamics remains fundamentally challenged by out-of-distribution reactive states, representation biases, and computational scaling limits. In this Review, we examine how physics-driven specialization extends the applicability of MLIPs to complex dynamical systems. We systematically evaluate the structural trade-offs in MLIP design: the undersampling of highly strained configurations, the prohibitive computational overhead of high-order message-passing architectures, and the necessity of nonlocal interactions for open and field-coupled systems. Through four demanding application contexts - electrified interfaces, compositionally fluctuating open systems, multiphase evolution, and large-scale fracture - we establish a framework for observable-specific validation. Highlighting the complementary roles of universal foundation models and task-specific potentials, we emphasize that targeted adaptations must be rigorously benchmarked against intended observables. We conclude with a roadmap for developing physically consistent, hardware-aware force fields that seamlessly connect electronic-structure accuracy to macroscopic materials phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）通过访问前所未有的长度和时间尺度正在改变原子模拟。虽然预训练的等变图神经网络在广泛的化学空间中实现了近平衡特性的鲁棒零样本性能，但它们向复杂材料动力学的转化仍然受到分布外反应状态、表示偏差和计算缩放限制的根本挑战。在这篇综述中，我们研究了物理驱动的专业化如何将 MLIP 的适用性扩展到复杂的动力系统。我们系统地评估了 MLIP 设计中的结构权衡：高度紧张配置的欠采样、高阶消息传递架构的令人望而却步的计算开销，以及开放和场耦合系统非局部交互的必要性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）通过访问前所未有的长度和时间尺度正在改变原子模拟。虽然预训练的等变图神经网络在广泛的化学空间中实现了近平衡特性的鲁棒零样本性能，但它们向复杂材料动力学的转化仍然受到分布外反应状态、表示偏差和计算缩放限制的根本挑战。在这篇综述中，我们研究了物理驱动的专业化如何将 MLIP 的适用性扩展到复杂的动力系统。我们系统地评估了 MLIP 设计中的结构权衡：高度紧张配置的欠采样、高阶消息传递架构的令人望而却步的计算开销，以及开放和场耦合系统非局部交互的必要性。通过四个要求严格的应用环境——电气化接口、成分波动的开放系统、多相演化和大规模断裂——我们建立了一个可观测特定验证的框架。我们强调通用基础模型和特定任务潜力的互补作用，强调有针对性的适应必须根据预期的可观察结果进行严格的基准测试。最后，我们提出了开发物理一致、硬件感知力场的路线图，将电子结构精度与宏观材料现象无缝连接。

articles.title: Orbital magnetic susceptibility and de Haas-van Alphen effect of a flat band from quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 量子几何中平带的轨道磁化率和德哈斯-范阿尔芬效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A band that is exactly flat at zero magnetic field has zero velocity, a divergent effective mass, and no Fermi surface, so the standard theory of orbital magnetism does not apply. We show that the magnetic field generates an effective dispersion. In the expansion organized by the Moyal algebra of the noncommutative kinetic momenta, the band energy acquires a first-order shift B,M(mathbf k), set by the orbital moment of the Bloch state, and a second-order shift tfrac12X(mathbf k)B², whose gauge-invariant coefficient we obtain in closed form. These two functions, together with the Berry curvature Ω, fix the entire orbital response. The susceptibility is purely geometric, and for a generic isolated flat band it reproduces the established gauge-invariant response formula. With the chemical potential pinned to the flat band, the M=0 contour becomes an emergent Fermi surface, and bosonizing excitations in its vicinity yields a modified Lifshitz--Kosevich formula with level spacing quadratic in B. The phase shift of the oscillations is given jointly by the Berry phase around the emergent Fermi surface and X. When the band is narrow rather than exactly flat, the oscillation frequency crosses over, with a parameter-free profile, from the zero-field Fermi-surface area to the area of the M=0 contour. We verify our analytical findings numerically by exactly diagonalizing a flattened Chern lattice model.
articles.abstract_zh: 在零磁场下完全平坦的能带具有零速度、发散的有效质量并且没有费米面，因此轨道磁性的标准理论不适用。我们证明磁场产生有效的色散。在由非交换动动量的 Moyal 代数组织的展开中，能带能量获得由布洛赫态的轨道矩设置的一阶位移 B,M(mathbf k) 和二阶位移 tfrac12X(mathbf k)B²，我们以封闭形式获得其规范不变系数。这两个函数与贝里曲率 Ω 一起确定了整个轨道响应。磁化率是纯几何的，对于通用的隔离平带，它再现了已建立的规范不变响应公式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在零磁场下完全平坦的能带具有零速度、发散的有效质量并且没有费米面，因此轨道磁性的标准理论不适用。我们证明磁场产生有效的色散。在由非交换动动量的 Moyal 代数组织的展开中，能带能量获得由布洛赫态的轨道矩设置的一阶位移 B,M(mathbf k) 和二阶位移 tfrac12X(mathbf k)B²，我们以封闭形式获得其规范不变系数。这两个函数与贝里曲率 Ω 一起确定了整个轨道响应。磁化率是纯几何的，对于通用的隔离平带，它再现了已建立的规范不变响应公式。当化学势固定在平带上时，M=0 等值线变成了涌现的费米面，其附近的玻色化激发产生了一个改进的 Lifshitz-Kosevich 公式，其能级间距在 B 中是二次的。振荡的相移由涌现的费米面周围的 Berry 相和 X 共同给出。当能带很窄而不是完全平坦时，振荡频率以无参数分布从零场费米面区域交叉到M=0 轮廓的面积。我们通过精确对角化展平陈晶格模型来验证我们的分析结果。

articles.title: A Universal Polybromide Melt Strategy for the Direct Conversion of Metals into Optoelectronic-Grade Bromide Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 将金属直接转化为光电级溴化物钙钛矿的通用多溴化物熔融策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Halide perovskite systems require specific metal oxidation states (M2+ or M+/M3+ pairs), limiting processing flexibility during traditional synthesis and posing stability challenges for multivalent metals like Sn, Cu, and Au. This work anchors a profound paradigm shift: a universal, single-step, organic-solvent free synthetic platform that directly converts stable elemental metal films into bromide perovskite and perovskite-related systems for a wide variety of (opto)electronic applications. The synthetic platform uses methylammonium polybromide melt (PBM) that reacts at room temperature with different elemental metals, including Pb, Sn, Au, and Cu, successfully transforming them into their respective Br-perovskite phases: MAPbBr3, MASnBr3, MA2Au2Br6, and MA2CuBr4. It is shown that the PBMs chemical activity can be tuned, and in situ X-ray diffraction captures in two cases transient intermediate phases during phase evolution. For Sn, which tends towards overoxidation to Sn4+ phase, changes in the PBMs composition coupled with a metallic Sn mediated comproportionation reaction allowed suppressing overoxidation, and formation of high quality MASnBr3 films under ambient conditions. Overall, oxidation and disproportionation potentials are found to be useful metrics for predicting M:PBM reaction outcomes. Industrially, this approach should be fully compatible with roll-to-roll infrastructure, providing a low-barrier pathway to scale next-generation optoelectronic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 卤化物钙钛矿体系需要特定的金属氧化态（M2+ 或 M+/M3+ 对），限制了传统合成过程中的加工灵活性，并对 Sn、Cu 和 Au 等多价金属提出了稳定性挑战。这项工作锚定了深刻的范式转变：一种通用、单步、无有机溶剂的合成平台，可直接将稳定的元素金属薄膜转化为溴化物钙钛矿和钙钛矿相关系统，用于各种（光）电子应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 卤化物钙钛矿体系需要特定的金属氧化态（M2+ 或 M+/M3+ 对），限制了传统合成过程中的加工灵活性，并对 Sn、Cu 和 Au 等多价金属提出了稳定性挑战。这项工作锚定了深刻的范式转变：一种通用、单步、无有机溶剂的合成平台，可直接将稳定的元素金属薄膜转化为溴化物钙钛矿和钙钛矿相关系统，用于各种（光）电子应用。该合成平台使用多溴化甲基铵熔体（PBM），在室温下与不同的元素金属（包括Pb、Sn、Au和Cu）反应，成功地将它们转化为各自的Br-钙钛矿相：MAPbBr3、MASnBr3、MA2Au2Br6和MA2CuBr4。结果表明，PBM 的化学活性可以调节，并且原位 X 射线衍射捕获了相演化过程中的两种瞬态中间相。对于容易过度氧化成 Sn4+ 相的 Sn，PBM 成分的变化加上金属 Sn 介导的歧化反应可以抑制过度氧化，并在环境条件下形成高质量的 MASnBr3 薄膜。总体而言，发现氧化和歧化电位是预测 M:PBM 反应结果的有用指标。在工业上，这种方法应该与卷对卷基础设施完全兼容，为扩展下一代光电技术提供低障碍途径。

articles.title: Transducing quantum-spin-ice correlations into Weyl Fermi-arc transport at a synthetic Kondo lattice interface
articles.title_zh: 将量子自旋冰相关性转换为合成近藤晶格界面处的韦尔费米弧输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum spin ice hosts collective excitations and quantum fluctuations that are largely electrically silent because the materials supporting them are insulating. Coupling this magnetic environment to surface-localized Weyl states offers a route to encode its correlations directly into Fermi-arc transport. Experimental access to this regime, however, has remained largely unexplored. Here, we realize a synthetic Kondo lattice interface between the Weyl semimetal Eu₂Ir₂O₇ and the quantum-spin-ice candidate Tb₂Ti₂O₇, and demonstrate that quantum-spin-ice correlations are imprinted on Weyl Fermi-arc transport. At ultra-low temperature, electronic transport evolves from a sixfold anisotropic response at low field into a twelvefold response over an intermediate field window, before entering a reentrant sixfold anisotropy at high field. No analogous twelvefold response occurs at the classical-spin-ice interface. The quantum--classical contrast shows that the same itinerant electronic channel acquires qualitatively different symmetry information when interacting with the quantum-fluctuating Tb moments, consistent with an interfacial coupling between the Weyl surface states and the transverse, multipolar degrees of freedom, in addition to the longitudinal, dipolar contribution. Our work establishes synthetic Kondo lattice interfaces as a route for transducing frustrated quantum magnetism with multipole correlations into distinct Weyl Fermi-arc transport responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子自旋冰具有集体激发和量子涨落，这些涨落在很大程度上是电安静的，因为支撑它们的材料是绝缘的。将这种磁性环境与表面局域外尔态耦合提供了一种将其相关性直接编码到费米弧输运中的途径。然而，对该制度的实验性访问在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们实现了Weyl半金属Eu2Ir2O7和量子自旋冰候选Tb2Ti2O7之间的合成Kondo晶格界面，并证明量子自旋冰相关性印在Weyl费米弧输运上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子自旋冰具有集体激发和量子涨落，这些涨落在很大程度上是电安静的，因为支撑它们的材料是绝缘的。将这种磁性环境与表面局域外尔态耦合提供了一种将其相关性直接编码到费米弧输运中的途径。然而，对该制度的实验性访问在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们实现了Weyl半金属Eu2Ir2O7和量子自旋冰候选Tb2Ti2O7之间的合成Kondo晶格界面，并证明量子自旋冰相关性印在Weyl费米弧输运上。在超低温下，电子输运从低场下的六倍各向异性响应演变为中间场窗口上的十二倍响应，然后进入高场下的折返六倍各向异性。在经典自旋冰界面处没有发生类似的十二倍响应。量子经典对比表明，相同的巡回电子通道在与量子涨落 Tb 矩相互作用时获得性质不同的对称信息，这与除了纵向偶极贡献外，Weyl 表面态和横向多极自由度之间的界面耦合一致。我们的工作建立了合成的近藤晶格界面，作为将具有多极相关性的受挫量子磁性转换为不同的韦尔费米弧输运响应的途径。

articles.title: True vs false Fermi surfaces in the Pseudogap regime and their transformation with doping and temperature in the Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: 赝能隙区域中的真费米面与假费米面及其在哈伯德模型中随掺杂和温度的变化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exact diagrammatic quantum Monte Carlo (DiagMC) results for the nearest-neighbor Hubbard model motivate a closer study of the pseudogap. Using the improved two-particle self-consistent approach (TPSC+), we analyze Energy (EDC) and Momentum Distribution Curves (MDC) simultaneously. We show that Fermi-liquid terminology breaks down in the pseudogap regime, requiring a distinction between true and false Fermi surfaces and zero-energy quasiparticle (ZEQ) lines. A false Fermi surface has a momentum-space spectral maximum but a frequency-space depression at zero energy, while a false ZEQ line violates the standard quasiparticle condition partial Σ'(k,ω)/partial ω|ω₌₀<0.The pseudogap is driven by critical thermal spin fluctuations, which occur in two dimensions because of the Mermin-Wagner theorem. Commensurate fluctuations first open an antinodal pseudogap, leaving true Fermi arcs. With decreasing temperature, the Fermi surface evolves into hole- and electron-like false Fermi surfaces. Incommensurate fluctuations generate hot spots near the diagonal, where the pseudogap persists to the quantum critical point (QCP), whereas at kAN it disappears before the QCP doping. There, the spectrum has two precursor antiferromagnetic (AFM) bands, both in the unoccupied (ω>0) region. We benchmark TPSC+ against DiagMC results for the Matsubara spectral proxy -Im[G(k,iπ T)]/π. TPSC+ underestimates pseudogap suppression in the strong-interaction regime, reproducing DiagMC behavior at lower temperatures or doping. This proxy is equivalent to the spectral function with thermal broadening η=π T, which obscures features when π T is not the smallest energy scale. Using A(k,0), we find that hole-like Fermi surfaces emerge at any interaction strength at low temperature, even at weak coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近邻哈伯德模型的精确图解量子蒙特卡罗 (DiagMC) 结果激发了对赝能隙的更深入研究。使用改进的双粒子自洽方法 (TPSC+)，我们同时分析能量 (EDC) 和动量分布曲线 (MDC)。我们证明了费米液体术语在赝能隙状态下被打破，需要区分真费米表面和假费米表面以及零能量准粒子（ZEQ）线。假费米面具有动量空间谱最大值，但在零能量处有频率空间凹陷，而假 ZEQ 线违反了标准准粒子条件部分 Σ'(k,ω)/部分 ω|ω₌₀0) 区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近邻哈伯德模型的精确图解量子蒙特卡罗 (DiagMC) 结果激发了对赝能隙的更深入研究。使用改进的双粒子自洽方法 (TPSC+)，我们同时分析能量 (EDC) 和动量分布曲线 (MDC)。我们证明了费米液体术语在赝能隙状态下被打破，需要区分真费米表面和假费米表面以及零能量准粒子（ZEQ）线。假费米面具有动量空间谱最大值，但在零能量处有频率空间凹陷，而假 ZEQ 线违反了标准准粒子条件部分 Σ'(k,ω)/部分 ω|ω₌₀0) 区域。我们将 TPSC+ 与 Matsubara 光谱代理 -Im[G(k,iπ T)]/π 的 DiagMC 结果进行基准测试。 TPSC+ 低估了强相互作用状态下的赝能隙抑制，在较低温度或掺杂下再现了 DiagMC 行为。该代理相当于具有热展宽 η=π T 的谱函数，当 π T 不是最小能量尺度时，它会掩盖特征。使用 A(k,0)，我们发现在低温下任何相互作用强度下，甚至在弱耦合下，都会出现类孔费米面。

articles.title: Short-Range Vector Spin Glasses: Parisi Hierarchies and Real-Space Ultrametricity
articles.title_zh: 短程矢量自旋玻璃：Pararisi 层次结构和实空间超度量性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Replica symmetry breaking (RSB) is the organizing principle of mean-field spin-glass theory, yet whether a continuous Parisi hierarchy can arise in a genuinely short-range system in finite spatial dimension remains unresolved. Here we introduce a disordered model of N-component vector spins on a D-dimensional hypercubic lattice, with random matrix couplings on nearest-neighbor links and random tensor couplings on elementary plaquettes. In the large-N limit, the model supports thermodynamically stable one-step, full, and one-full RSB phases, alongside replica-symmetric paramagnetic and ferromagnetic phases. We find that spatial locality constrains these ordered phases through two distinct infrared mechanisms. (i) Quenched random anisotropy destroys uniform ferromagnetism for D≤4 through an Imry-Ma mechanism. (ii) A continuous Parisi hierarchy gives rise to replica Goldstone modes whose gaplessness is protected by a Ward identity. At leading order in 1/N, these modes behave as a band of free spin waves, producing infrared-divergent fluctuations in D≤2 and a Mermin-Wagner instability of the continuously broken phase. Remarkably, the Parisi hierarchy also acquires a direct real-space interpretation. For two pure states with mutual overlap q, a characteristic length ξ(q) describes how far the differences between their frozen magnetization patterns remain correlated. Throughout a continuous sector of the Parisi hierarchy, ξ(q) is independent of temperature and decreases monotonically with q. The ultrametric organization of pure states is therefore accompanied by an ultrametric hierarchy of real-space correlation lengths: states that separate near the root of the Parisi tree differ through long-wavelength frozen patterns, whereas states that separate farther from the root differ only on progressively shorter scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 复制对称破缺（RSB）是平均场自旋玻璃理论的组织原理，但在有限空间维度的真正短程系统中是否可以出现连续的 Parisi 层次结构仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们引入了 D 维超立方晶格上 N 分量矢量自旋的无序模型，其中最近邻链接上的随机矩阵耦合和基本斑块上的随机张量耦合。在大 N 极限下，该模型支持热力学稳定的一步、全和一全 RSB 相，以及复制对称顺磁和铁磁相。我们发现空间局部性通过两种不同的红外机制限制这些有序相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复制对称破缺（RSB）是平均场自旋玻璃理论的组织原理，但在有限空间维度的真正短程系统中是否可以出现连续的 Parisi 层次结构仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们引入了 D 维超立方晶格上 N 分量矢量自旋的无序模型，其中最近邻链接上的随机矩阵耦合和基本斑块上的随机张量耦合。在大 N 极限下，该模型支持热力学稳定的一步、全和一全 RSB 相，以及复制对称顺磁和铁磁相。我们发现空间局部性通过两种不同的红外机制限制这些有序相。 (i) 淬火随机各向异性通过 Imry-Ma 机制破坏 D≤4 的均匀铁磁性。 (ii) 连续的帕里西等级制度产生了复制品戈德斯通模式，其无间隙性受到沃德身份的保护。在 1/N 的前导阶上，这些模式表现为自由自旋波带，产生 D≤2 的红外发散波动和连续破碎相的 Mermin-Wagner 不稳定性。值得注意的是，帕里西层次结构也获得了直接的真实空间解释。对于两个相互重叠 q 的纯态，特征长度 xi(q) 描述了它们的冻结磁化模式之间的差异保持相关的程度。在 Parisi 层次结构的连续扇区中， xi(q) 与温度无关，并且随 q 单调递减。因此，纯态的超度量组织伴随着实空间相关长度的超度量层次结构：在 Parisi 树根附近分离的态通过长波长冻结模式而不同，而远离根分离的态仅在逐渐较短的尺度上有所不同。

articles.title: Omnisolver: An extensible interface to Ising spin-glass and QUBO solvers: adding a distributed GPU brute-force plugin
articles.title_zh: Omnisolver：Ising 自旋玻璃和 QUBO 求解器的可扩展接口：添加分布式 GPU 强力插件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10542v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This software update extends Omnisolver with textttomnisolver-bruteforce, a first-class plugin for exact exhaustive search of QUBO and Ising instances on CUDA-enabled GPUs. The update contributes three components: packaging of the single-GPU brute-force kernel of [Computer Physics Communications 260, 107728, 2021] as a first-class Omnisolver plugin with a uniform Python and CLI interface, a Ray-based distributed framework that splits the search into 2k fixed-variable subproblems and dispatches them across multiple GPUs and hosts, with a controller that gathers and merges partial results, and numerical stabilization of the fast textttfloat32 ground-state path through compensated incremental updates, periodic exact energy re-anchoring, and best-buffer refresh. Stabilization activates automatically for N ≥ 40 leaving the public sampler API is unchanged. On dense random Ising instances we measure exhaustive solve times up to N=60 on 8× NVIDIA H100 (96 GB) GPUs, reaching approx!3.15 days at N=60 in close agreement with the empirical tN₊₁=2,t_N doubling rule, with the distributed sampler reaching the full approx!8× speedup over a single H100 from N!gtrsim!44 onwards. The plugin thereby serves as a practical ground-truth oracle for state-of-the-art classical heuristics such as the Simulated Bifurcation Machine.
articles.abstract_zh: 此软件更新通过 textttomnisolver-bruteforce 扩展了 Omnisolver，这是一个一流的插件，用于在支持 CUDA 的 GPU 上精确穷举搜索 QUBO 和 Ising 实例。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 此软件更新通过 textttomnisolver-bruteforce 扩展了 Omnisolver，这是一个一流的插件，用于在支持 CUDA 的 GPU 上精确穷举搜索 QUBO 和 Ising 实例。该更新贡献了三个组成部分：将 [计算机物理通信 260, 107728, 2021] 的单 GPU 暴力内核打包为具有统一 Python 和 CLI 接口的一流 Omnisolver 插件，基于 Ray 的分布式框架，将搜索拆分为 2k 固定变量子问题并将其分配到多个 GPU 和主机，并使用收集和合并部分结果的控制器，以及快速计算的数值稳定性textttfloat32 通过补偿增量更新、定期精确能量重新锚定和最佳缓冲区刷新实现基态路径。当 N ≥ 40 时，稳定性会自动激活，从而使公共采样器 API 保持不变。在密集随机 Ising 实例上，我们在 8× NVIDIA H100 (96 GB) GPU 上测量了高达 N=60 的详尽求解时间，在 N=60 时达到约 3.15 天，与经验 tN₊₁=2,t_N 倍增规则非常一致，分布式采样器从 N!gtrsim!44 开始比单个 H100 达到约 8× 加速。因此，该插件可以作为最先进的经典启发式（例如模拟分叉机）的实用真实预言。

articles.title: PXtal: Learning to Align Powder X-Ray Diffraction and Crystal Structures under Information Asymmetry across Modalities
articles.title_zh: PXtal：学习在跨模态信息不对称的情况下对齐粉末 X 射线衍射和晶体结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10653v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scientific multimodal learning commonly assumes that paired views are comparably informative. Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) makes this mismatch explicit: compressing a three-dimensional crystal structure into a one-dimensional diffraction pattern loses information and makes the pattern harder to connect to the crystal structure that produced it. We introduce PXtal, a framework for learning aligned PXRD and crystal representations under this physically imposed information asymmetry. PXtal uses Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to adapt the cross-modal coupling and coupling-level generalized Kullback-Leibler (GKL) divergence to supervise the full transport plan. Across six test sets, including four zero-shot transfer sets, PXtal consistently outperforms the baseline models in PXRD-to-crystal candidate retrieval, with the largest gains when PXRD patterns have close but crystallographically distinct nonpaired neighbors, meaning similar input patterns associated with different crystals. The resulting crystal and PXRD encoders transfer more effectively to downstream materials and crystallographic tasks. These results identify information asymmetry as a general design problem in scientific multimodal learning: alignment objectives should reflect what each modality preserves.
articles.abstract_zh: 科学的多模态学习通常假设成对的观点具有相对丰富的信息。粉末 X 射线衍射 (PXRD) 使这种不匹配变得明显：将三维晶体结构压缩为一维衍射图案会丢失信息，并使图案更难与产生它的晶体结构连接起来。我们介绍 PXtal，一个用于在这种物理强加的信息不对称下学习对齐的 PXRD 和晶体表示的框架。 PXtal 使用不平衡最优传输 (UOT) 来适应跨模态耦合和耦合级广义 Kullback-Leibler (GKL) 散度来监督整个传输计划。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 科学的多模态学习通常假设成对的观点具有相对丰富的信息。粉末 X 射线衍射 (PXRD) 使这种不匹配变得明显：将三维晶体结构压缩为一维衍射图案会丢失信息，并使图案更难与产生它的晶体结构连接起来。我们介绍 PXtal，一个用于在这种物理强加的信息不对称下学习对齐的 PXRD 和晶体表示的框架。 PXtal 使用不平衡最优传输 (UOT) 来适应跨模态耦合和耦合级广义 Kullback-Leibler (GKL) 散度来监督整个传输计划。在六个测试集（包括四个零样本传输集）中，PXtal 在 PXRD 到晶体候选检索方面始终优于基线模型，当 PXRD 图案具有紧密但晶体学上不同的非配对邻居（这意味着与不同晶体相关的相似输入图案）时，增益最大。由此产生的晶体和 PXRD 编码器可以更有效地传输到下游材料和晶体学任务。这些结果将信息不对称确定为科学多模式学习中的一般设计问题：调整目标应反映每种模式保留的内容。

articles.title: Thermodynamics of interacting magnetic chain molecules
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的磁链分子的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10671v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study magnets composed of molecules with an arbitrary number m of magnetically active atoms in a chain configuration interacting with nearest-neighbor couplings. We derive the thermodynamics of a chain of spin-j SU(2) magnetic atoms using a mean-field approach and determine the equilibrium states and stability conditions. The system exhibits a rich phase structure with a cascade of ferromagnetic phase transitions, their number ranging from m, for maximal ferromagnets, to zero, for paramagnets, depending on the relative strengths of the couplings. In the presence of impurities (modified couplings) at the ends of the chain, boundary states emerge that coexist with the paramagnetic phase or the fully ferromagnetic phase. For long chains, a continuum approximation can be taken that clarifies the structure of the phases. In the continuum description, magnetized states at temperatures lower than the critical temperature at which they appear correspond to kink solitons.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究由具有任意数量 m 个磁活性原子的分子组成的磁体，这些原子呈链结构，与最近邻耦合相互作用。我们使用平均场方法推导了自旋 j SU(2) 磁性原子链的热力学，并确定了平衡状态和稳定条件。该系统表现出丰富的相结构，具有一系列铁磁相变，其数量范围从 m（最大铁磁体）到 0（顺磁体），具体取决于耦合的相对强度。当链末端存在杂质（改性耦合）时，会出现与顺磁相或全铁磁相共存的边界态。对于长链，可以采用连续体近似来阐明相的结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究由具有任意数量 m 个磁活性原子的分子组成的磁体，这些原子呈链结构，与最近邻耦合相互作用。我们使用平均场方法推导了自旋 j SU(2) 磁性原子链的热力学，并确定了平衡状态和稳定条件。该系统表现出丰富的相结构，具有一系列铁磁相变，其数量范围从 m（最大铁磁体）到 0（顺磁体），具体取决于耦合的相对强度。当链末端存在杂质（改性耦合）时，会出现与顺磁相或全铁磁相共存的边界态。对于长链，可以采用连续体近似来阐明相的结构。在连续统描述中，磁化态在低于临界温度的温度下出现，对应于扭结孤子。

articles.title: On linearity or non-linearity in machine learning for quantum chaotic dynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子混沌动力学机器学习中的线性或非线性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10697v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurately simulating chaotic quantum many-body dynamics remains a major computational challenge for classical methods, due to the rapid buildup and spatial spreading of entanglement during the evolution. This raises the question of whether machine learning can provide an effective alternative for predicting quantum dynamics. We address this question by formulating quantum dynamics as a time-series forecasting problem, using a few-qubit PXP chain, realizable with Rydberg-atom arrays, as a benchmark. By varying the initial state, the system spans dynamical regimes ranging from ergodic behavior to quantum many-body scarring, providing a controlled setting for testing forecasting models across qualitatively different dynamics. We compare two contrasting architectures: an expressive nonlinear Transformer and DLinear, a simple linear forecasting model. The Transformer accurately predicts dynamics in the more ergodic regime, but its performance progressively deteriorates as the initial state approaches the scarred limit. In contrast, DLinear remains accurate across the entire family of initial states, with its main deviations consisting of small high-frequency oscillations that have little effect on the overall prediction error.
